jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: San Francisco, CA · In\-person AgentMail is building the communication infrastructure for AI agents. Today, AI agents can write code, browse the internet, and take actions on behalf of people—but they still struggle to communicate and operate independently across the services humans use every day. AgentMail gives agents their own email identities and infrastructure to send, receive, and act on email programmatically. We’ve processed hundreds of millions of emails and serve developers building some of the most ambitious agentic products. We’re looking for a Founding Product Engineer to help define what using AgentMail actually feels like. **What you’ll do** ------------------ You’ll own products from an ambiguous customer problem to something developers use every day. That means you’ll: * Build products end\-to\-end. Work across polished frontend experiences, APIs, backend services, data models, and infrastructure when the product calls for it. * Talk directly to customers. Interview developers, watch them use AgentMail, dig through support conversations and usage data, and understand where they’re getting stuck. * Turn customer problems into products. Figure out what should be built—not just how to build it—and develop conviction about which problems are actually worth solving. * Build AgentMail Studio. Help create the interface developers use to understand, debug, and interact with their agents’ email—from inspecting messages and threads to testing workflows and understanding what happened under the hood. * Shape our developer experience. Improve everything between a developer signing up and getting something useful into production: onboarding, SDKs, APIs, debugging tools, docs, and the console. * Prototype quickly. Turn an idea from a customer conversation into something they can use days later. * Sweat the details. We care deeply about how our products look, feel, and behave. You’ll have significant influence over the design and interaction patterns of AgentMail. * Help define the product engineering culture. You’ll be one of the earliest engineers explicitly focused on product and will shape how we build products as the team grows. **Who we’re looking for** ------------------------- We’re looking for an engineer who thinks about the why behind what they’re building. You might be a great fit if: * You’re an exceptional frontend engineer with strong product and design instincts. * You have strong engineering fundamentals and are comfortable going beyond the frontend—working with APIs, backend systems, databases, queues, and distributed systems when necessary. * You can take a vague problem like “developers can’t figure out why their agent didn’t respond to this email” and turn it into a product without waiting for a detailed spec. * You enjoy talking to customers and can separate what someone asks for from the underlying problem they’re actually trying to solve. * You can contextualize technical decisions in terms of customer and business impact. * You care about API design and developer experience, not just UI. * You have strong opinions about products but are willing to change your mind when the data or customer evidence says otherwise. * You’re comfortable moving quickly, shipping imperfect things, learning from usage, and iterating. * You have extremely high agency. When something is broken or missing, your instinct is to fix it. You don’t need to have been called a “Product Engineer” before. We’re much more interested in whether you’ve built things people love and whether you can independently go from customer problem idea product shipped software learning. **What this role is not** ------------------------- This isn’t a role where a PM hands you a spec and a designer hands you a Figma file. You’ll be expected to participate in the entire product process: talking to users, deciding what matters, designing solutions, writing the code, shipping them, and figuring out whether they worked. You’ll have a tremendous amount of autonomy—and an equally high bar for ownership. **Why AgentMail** ----------------- Work on a new category. We’re building infrastructure for a world where billions of AI agents need identities and ways to communicate with humans, businesses, and each other. Build for builders. Our customers are developers. You’ll work directly with highly technical users and see the impact of what you ship immediately. Own meaningful product surface area. We’re still early enough that fundamental pieces of the AgentMail experience haven’t been invented yet. You won’t be optimizing a button that’s been A/B tested for five years. You’ll help decide what the product becomes. Move extremely fast. Customer conversations can become products within days. You’ll have the autonomy and resources to build without layers of process. Have outsized influence. You’ll work directly with the founders and early engineering team and help establish how product engineering works at AgentMail. We believe the interface between AI agents and the rest of the internet is still being invented. Come help us build it.

jobs.title: IT - Analyst II
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- **Some people close tickets. You make sure the problem stays solved.** Alpha Inc. is looking for an **IT Analyst – Tier 2** who knows how to troubleshoot beyond the obvious, communicate without the tech\-speak, and take ownership when technology gets between our people and the work that needs to get done. This is the bridge between Tier 1 support and Alpha’s senior technical resources. You’ll tackle the escalations that require more digging, own issues through resolution, strengthen our documentation and support processes, and help keep employees connected and productive across HQ, field offices, and remote and mobile environments. IT Analyst \- Tier 2 We need someone who doesn’t just ask, **“Did the ticket get closed?”** We want someone who asks, **“Why did it happen, how do we prevent it from happening again, and can the next person solve it faster?”** If that sounds like how you already operate, keep reading. **About Alpha Inc.** -------------------- Alpha Inc. is a Hawai?i\-grown company operating across construction, drilling, energy, and infrastructure. Our teams work in offices, in the field, and everywhere in between—and reliable technology is part of what keeps the whole operation moving. Our culture is built around three values: **Leading with Heart** – Support people with humility, empathy, patience, and respect. **Strength in Unity** – Technology doesn't operate in a silo. Partner across teams and solve problems together. **Alpha Mentality** – Own the issue. Dig deeper. Solve it. Document it. Make it better next time. IT Analyst \- Tier 2 For this role, those aren't wall decorations. They're how we expect IT support to show up every day. **What You’ll Own** ------------------- ### **Be the Tier 2 Problem Solver** You’ll serve as a key escalation resource for endpoint, software, user access, mobile device, VPN, Wi\-Fi, printing, and field\-office issues. Moderately complex tickets are yours from **triage to resolution**. That means troubleshooting the actual cause, taking the right action, communicating with the user, and leaving behind documentation someone else can use. You’ll also know when *not* to cowboy it. Infrastructure architecture, complex integrations, advanced cybersecurity decisions, executive\-critical issues, and final Tier 3 matters belong with Alpha’s Senior IT Analyst or IT Engineers. IT Analyst \- Tier 2 ### **Keep Alpha’s Applications Moving** You’ll provide user\-facing administration and troubleshooting across platforms such as: **Microsoft 365 • Box • Jira • Confluence • Okta / Entra ID • UKG • NetSuite • Asana** You’ll handle application tickets, licensing checks, access requests, software installs, approved configuration changes, and vendor follow\-up—keeping the details from becoming roadblocks. IT Analyst \- Tier 2 ### **Own the User Lifecycle** Great IT support starts before an employee's first login and continues through their last day. You’ll help own approved account provisioning, access changes, group memberships, password and MFA support, onboarding, and deprovisioning. For new hires, you'll coordinate IT orientation, workstation setup, device issuance, application access, and first\-day readiness. For departing employees, you'll help make sure account disablement, device recovery, access removal, and documentation are handled correctly and completely. IT Analyst \- Tier 2 ### **Make the Hardware Work Where the Work Happens** Alpha isn't a company where everyone sits behind the same desk. You'll configure and troubleshoot **Windows, macOS, iOS, and mobile devices** and support employees across HQ, field offices, remote locations, and mobile environments. That means being comfortable solving technology problems in the real world—not just the perfect conditions of a test lab. IT Analyst \- Tier 2 ### **Make the IT Team Better** An A Player doesn't hoard fixes in their head. You'll maintain Jira Service Management or similar ticketing records with accurate categorization and complete notes, while building and improving Confluence and knowledge\-base content covering repeatable troubleshooting, onboarding, access requests, and escalation procedures. **Solve it once. Document it well. Make the whole team faster.** IT Analyst \- Tier 2 ### **Protect the Business** You'll apply sound cybersecurity practices in your everyday work, including MFA, phishing awareness, endpoint protection, appropriate data handling, least\-privilege access, and secure password practices. You'll collaborate with vendors, consultants, IT Engineers, and the Senior IT Analyst when service disruptions or technical problems need additional horsepower. IT Analyst \- Tier 2 **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- We aren't looking for someone who measures success by how busy the ticket queue feels. You protect confidential information. You prioritize intelligently. jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a **Data \& AI Engineer** to join our team and **contribute to data engineering, analysis, and AI/ML initiatives within a healthcare technology environment**. The ideal candidate has strong experience working with large and complex datasets, data quality and transformation, Python\-based data processing, and cloud data platforms. You will work closely with data, biomedical, IT, and engineering teams to ensure data is reliable, scalable, and ready to support advanced analytics, predictive algorithms, and AI\-driven solutions. The focus of this role is data engineering and analysis. We offer the opportunity to work on data and AI initiatives that make a meaningful impact in healthcare technology. Also, a collaborative environment spanning data, biomedical, IT, and engineering teams. **Location:** Cambridge (Massachusetts, US) **Work Mode:** on\-site **Type of contract:** C2C ### ### **Key Responsibilities:** #### **Data Wrangling** * Retrieve data from AWS S3 and query and analyze datasets using Amazon Athena, SageMaker, and Jupyter Notebooks. * Clean, transform, and prepare large datasets from multiple sources. * Identify missing data, inconsistencies, time\-alignment discrepancies, and artifact\-prone measurements. #### **Data Management** * Develop and maintain data processing pipelines that transform and parse CSV, XML, and other flat\-file formats into scalable databases and data structures such as InfluxDB. * Develop and run Python and Bash scripts to automate ingestion, inventory, validation, and quality assessment of incoming device data. #### **Data Integrity Evaluation** * Investigate data gaps, anomalies, and integrity issues using Athena, SageMaker, or Jupyter Notebooks. * Determine whether root causes relate to data curation, technical configuration, system performance, or storage limitations. #### **Troubleshooting and Collaboration** * Collaborate with biomedical and IT teams at partner sites to troubleshoot data transfer and collection issues and ensure reliable data availability. * Work closely with internal engineering, data, and technical teams to investigate and resolve data\-related issues. #### **Data Modeling and AI/ML** * Analyze and model physiological, vital\-sign, and EMR data from multiple sources to support data\-driven and AI/ML solutions. * Develop, enhance, and evaluate predictive algorithms and machine learning models using multivariate data, including numerical and textual data. #### **Statistical Validation** * Cross\-validate Python\-based machine learning and regression results against outputs generated in SAS, in collaboration with biostatistics teams. #### **Data Simulation** * Prepare and transform retrospective CSV/XML datasets to generate simulated data using a Virtual Hospital Simulator. * Support algorithm testing and validation within surveillance software. #### **Continuous Improvement** * Contribute to improving data quality, scalability, reliability, and analytical capabilities across data and AI initiatives. ### **Required Qualifications:** * **7 to 10 years of professional experience in data engineering and data analysis**. * **Hands\-on AI/ML experience**, including developing, evaluating, and enhancing predictive algorithms and machine learning and regression models using multivariate data (numerical and text\-based). * **Experience with healthcare data**, including physiological signals, vital signs, and EMR data. * **Background in the medical device industry**, including experience working with device\-generated clinical data. * Strong proficiency in **Python** for data processing, analysis, and machine learning. * Experience scripting in Bash for batch processing and automation. * Hands\-on experience with **AWS data services**, including S3, Athena, and SageMaker. * Experience working in **Jupyter Notebooks** for exploratory analysis and data investigation. * Proven experience parsing and transforming flat\-file formats (CSV, XML) into scalable databases, with exposure to time\-series databases such as InfluxDB. * Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve data quality issues, including missing data, time\-alignment problems, and measurement artifacts. * Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose root causes across data, configuration, and infrastructure. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders across multiple organizations. **Why choose us** * An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities * An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level * A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available * A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.) *Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qu**alified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.* *\#LI\-AS2* **Who are we?** --------------- **Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success. At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like: **Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you! **Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities! **Case study**: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc. As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Associate Delivery Consultant - Security, ProServe A2C Delivery, A2C, Professional Services
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. We are looking for passionate, hard\-working, and talented software engineers who have experience building innovative, mission critical, high volume applications that customers love. You will have an enormous opportunity to make a large impact on the design, architecture, and implementation of cutting edge products used every day, by people you know. Responsibilities * Responsible for the development and maintenance of key system features * Will work with other team members to investigate design approaches, prototype new technology and evaluate technical feasibility. * Will work in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver high quality software against aggressive schedules. Experience developing cloud software services and an understanding of design for scalability, performance and reliability. Development experience defining, developing and maintaining REST based interfaces Key job responsibilities 1\. Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs 2\. Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery 3\. Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies 4\. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies 5\. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts About the team Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance \- We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 2\+ years of cloud architecture and designing and implementing cloud solutions experience * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience integrating AWS cloud services with on\-premise technologies (e.g., Microsoft, IBM, Oracle, HP, SAP) * Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby * Experience with QA, testing, helpdesk, IT support, or any technician or quality assurance type work * Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows) **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * AWS Solutions Architect Certification * Knowledge of the primary AWS services such as EC2, ELB, RDS, VPC, Route53, and S3 * Experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution in a school project or while working for a company * Experience with infrastructure as code, ops automation, and configuration management tools such as Chef, Puppet, or Ansible * Experience with software development life cycle (sdlc) and agile/iterative methodologies * Master's degree or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Director, Software Development - Language Foundations, Amazon SW Builder Experience
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open\-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder. The Role We are seeking a Director of Software Development to lead Language Foundations, the organization that owns Amazon's programming\-languages strategy across our strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C\+\+, Kotlin, and Swift) and represents that strategy to the language community: the engineers who specialize in language design, compilation, and optimization, along with standards bodies and the open\-source ecosystems Amazon depends on. This leader recruits and leads some of the world's foremost language specialists, many of them Principal Engineers with deep standing in their fields. Language Foundations shapes and influences the direction of the world's most critical programming languages. Amazon sits on the Rust Foundation board, is one of the distributors of OpenJDK (Amazon Corretto), and sponsors resident engineers who are among the top contributors in their communities. This leader is central to Amazon's large\-scale language modernization, owning the tooling and language foundations that enable teams to move to modern languages and runtimes and transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software they run. It is simultaneously a community\-shaping and an internal\-modernization challenge: strengthening the ecosystems that Amazon and the industry rely on, while helping modernize some of the largest services in the world. Key job responsibilities Own the vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for Language Foundations, connecting it to builder impact: code quality, reliability, security, performance, and the enablement of agent\-supervised development. Deliver best\-in\-class support for Amazon's strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C\+\+, Kotlin, and Swift), aligning internal toolchains with industry conventions so builders and agents work on modern runtimes out of the box. Lead Amazon's language modernization through the tooling and language foundations that transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software teams build and run, including large\-scale Rust and Java runtime investments. Build the trusted, secure repository for the third\-party software Amazon depends on, curating out unmaintained and vulnerable dependencies so builders start from a safe default. Shape the external direction of strategic programming languages through Amazon's participation in standards bodies, foundations (e.g., the Rust Foundation, OpenJDK), and the open\-source community, while maintaining the cultural norms of those communities. Lead and grow a multi\-team engineering organization: recruit and develop world\-class language specialists and Principal Engineers and build the leadership bench. Influence strategy and technical direction at the most senior levels of the company through clear written narrative and data; briefs at CEO\-level reviews. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience. * 10\+ years of software development experience, including systems software, compilers, language runtimes, or developer toolchains. * 5\+ years managing people, with 3\+ years managing multiple managers or teams. * Experience developing long\-term technical vision and strategy and influencing leadership decisions. * Experience delivering large\-scale technical programs across multiple teams or organizations. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Master's or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, with 10\+ years of relevant experience. * A leadership position on a team delivering solutions at Amazon or industry scale. * Proven track record of attracting, developing, and retaining top language and systems specialists, including engineers with standing in the open\-source community. * Active participation in the language community, including membership or leadership in standards bodies, foundations, or major open\-source projects. * Deep expertise in programming language design, runtimes, compilers, or developer ecosystems, with recognized standing in the language community. * Experience leading large\-scale language or platform migrations in complex, multi\-service environments. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, CA, Santa Clara \- 297,500\.00 \- 350,000\.00 USD annually USA, MA, Boston \- 264,100\.00 \- 350,000\.00 USD annually USA, WA, Seattle \- 264,100\.00 \- 350,000\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, ML Acceleration, Trainium AI Systems, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Annapurna Labs designs the silicon behind AWS machine learning acceleration. Trainium and Inferentia servers train and serve the largest models our customers run, and before any of that hardware carries customer traffic it has to prove it works. MLA Vetting owns that gate. We build the diagnostic tests that every accelerator server runs before it becomes sellable, and we decide which failures block a host, which route to a technician for repair, and which are noise. That gate only works if we can see through it. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer II to build the data and analytics systems that tell us what our tests are actually doing across the fleet. You will build the pipelines that ingest diagnostic results from tens of thousands of servers, the dashboards that make test behavior legible, and the metrics and alarms that tell us a test has started failing on a hardware generation before it costs us a week of capacity. When the team decides whether a diagnostic has enough evidence to move from observation into blocking production, your data answers that question. This is a software engineering role, not a reporting role. You will write and operate production code, own the alarms and metrics that page us, and build detection for trends nobody is watching yet. You will work directly with hardware, firmware, provisioning, and data center operations teams who act on what you build. You are fluent in Python and SQL and have built production data pipelines at scale. Experience with Amazon Redshift, Apache Spark, workflow orchestration, and dashboarding in Grafana or QuickSight maps directly to what you will work on here. Experience with telemetry or diagnostic data from a large server fleet, or with defining metrics and anomaly detection on operational time\-series data, will have you productive faster. Familiarity with server hardware or data center operations is a plus, not a requirement — we will teach you the hardware. Key job responsibilities Design, build, and operate production data pipelines that ingest diagnostic, telemetry, and repair\-ticket data from the Trainium and Inferentia fleet into a warehouse other teams query with confidence. Build and own the metrics, alarms, and anomaly detection that surface test regressions, failure\-rate shifts, and new failure signatures across hardware generations without a human going looking for them. Build dashboards and visualizations that make fleet and test health legible to engineers, hardware partners, and leadership, covering failure rates, failure\-signature breakdowns, first pass yield, and repair latency. Analyze large\-scale fleet data to find root cause behind failure trends, and separate genuine hardware faults from software defects and test noise — a distinction that decides whether a failure reaches a technician or an engineer. Define the evidence standard that gates operational decisions, including whether a diagnostic has soaked long enough and cleanly enough in the fleet to move from observation mode into blocking production. Improve data quality and pipeline reliability so downstream consumers trust the numbers without re\-deriving them. Write clear analyses and design documents for technical and non\-technical readers, including leadership. A day in the life You start by checking an alarm that fired overnight: a diagnostic's failure rate climbed on one server generation. You query the failure signatures, find the increase concentrates in one component and one data center, and hand the breakdown to the hardware team by mid\-morning. The rest of the day goes to a pipeline you are building to join repair outcomes against diagnostic results, so the team can measure how often a repair actually fixes the fault it was dispatched for. You close the day reviewing a teammate's code review and answering an operations partner who needs a new cut of yield data. About the team MLA Vetting sits between hardware manufacturing and customer\-ready capacity. We own the diagnostic test suites and the triage framework that turn a raw hardware failure into a specific, actionable repair, and we own the fleet\-scale evidence that drives hardware and firmware improvements upstream. Our work is measured in how fast a server reaches sellable and how often it gets there on the first try. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Applied Scientist - Computational Modeling, OMHS SCS
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As an Applied Scientist on the Science SW team, you will be a versatile generalist who collaborates closely with other scientists and engineers teams to bring research to production across a broad portfolio of problems: from computer\-vision perception platforms to building\-wide optimization and orchestration. This role combines the scientific application of ML and applied mathematics with a strong product focus. It will be your job to frame ambiguous business problems as tractable scientific problems, and to implement novel ML systems, first\-principles models, embedded systems prototypes, and performance optimizations in both prototype and production environments. Key job responsibilities * Own the research and development of scientific and ML solutions across a broad range of problems spanning classical machine learning, statistical modeling, computer vision, optimization, and physics\-informed / first\-principles modeling in a production environment. * Rapidly ramp on unfamiliar problem domains, frame ambiguous or open\-ended business problems as tractable scientific problems, and prototype solutions end to end. * Prototype and evaluate sensing hardware and lightweight, edge\-deployable models that run on commodity compute under real\-world constraints. * Collaborate across multiple science and engineering teams to integrate your solutions into our deployment architecture. About the team Amazon is building next generation software, hardware, and processes that will run our global network of fulfillment centers that move millions of units of inventory, and ensure customers get what they want when promised. The Science Software team in the One MHS organization unlocks Material Handling Equipment (MHE) innovation through a multiplicity of disciplines within Artificial Intelligence (AI) and applied science, including Computer Vision (CV), Physics\-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), Optimization, Reinforcement Learning, classical Machine Learning, statistical modeling, and sensing\-hardware prototyping. Rooted in first principles aligned experimentation, the team is dedicated to building self\-optimizing fulfillment centers, developing the models that drive real\-time, building\-wide orchestration of MHE. We conduct experiments, develop models, and apply machine learning (ML) at scale to optimize throughput, flow, merge, and congestion control, and to improve operational performance across the fulfillment network.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Advanced degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field * Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+ * Strong foundation in applied mathematics, statistics, and machine learning, with the versatility to work across multiple problem domains rather than a single specialization. * Experience with popular deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and the scientific Python stack (e.g., NumPy, SciPy, scikit\-learn, pandas). **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * PhD with a demonstrated track record of solving problems across more than one domain (e.g., computer vision, statistical modeling, optimization, signal processing, controls, or physical modeling). * Experience with computer vision and/or physics\-informed and first\-principles modeling. * Hands\-on hardware prototyping experience (sensors, cameras, embedded / edge compute) and experience optimizing models for resource\-constrained hardware. * Publications at peer\-reviewed venues (e.g., CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or the leading venues in the candidate's home discipline). jobs.title: Robotics Systems Field Engineer , RIVR
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As a Robotics Field Engineer at Amazon RIVR, you will be the critical link between our advanced robotics technology and real\-world deployment. You will serve as Tier 2 technical support, acting as the primary interface for other Amazon teams when complex issues arise in the field. This role is designed for a technical problem\-solver who excels at Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and enjoys the challenge of debugging hardware and software in live environments. Beyond troubleshooting, you will play a strategic role in our development cycle by providing real\-world operational insights to our QA teams, ensuring our test cases reflect the unpredictable nature of the field. Key job responsibilities Serve as the Tier 2 technical escalation point for field operations, interfacing directly with Amazon last\-mile teams to resolve complex system issues. Perform deep\-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on field failures to identify whether issues stem from hardware, software, or environmental factors. Execute debugging and perform quick technical fixes to maintain a target ratio of 1 engineer to 5 robots. Collaborate with QA Engineers to provide real\-world input for the design of full\-system test cases, ensuring field edge cases are captured. Lead the operational readiness and optimization of RIVR's deployed robots, ensuring seamless integration across diverse sites. Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and Service \& Support SOPs for Field Technicians. Act as the technical bridge to Product and Engineering teams, translating field\-identified issues and RCA insights into structured requirements for the product roadmap. About the team Amazon RIVR is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real\-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin\-off, RIVR developed wheeled\-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale. Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud\-based coordination, Amazon RIVR is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last\-mile delivery **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure * Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust * Experience in a Linux or Unix environment * BA/BS in Engineering (Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical), Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 1\+ years of experience (including internships, research, or project work) with robotics system components or electromechanical controls. * Familiarity with ROS2 or other robotics software frameworks. * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting physical hardware, wiring, sensors, or electromechanical components. * Ability to review robot logs and system diagnostics to identify hardware, connectivity, or sensor errors. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes * Basic understanding of distributed systems. * Prior experience in a Tier 1 or Tier 2 technical support role within robotics, IoT, or industrial automation. * Exposure to Amazon operations, logistics, industrial facilities, or last\-mile delivery ecosystems. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations: San Diego, CA, USA Ever wonder how it feels to have hundreds of thousands of users counting on you to keep Amazon secure without slowing anyone down? Amazon Security's Access Review team is the group for you! We own the systems 250,000\+ Amazonians use to review and right\-size the access they hold across Teams, Bindles, Hostclasses, and Permission Groups. We sit at the intersection of security, compliance, and developer productivity, connected to nearly every part of Amazon's worldwide service\-oriented architecture. Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems in the cloud, or you're a software developer who likes to solve interesting and complex business problems, Access Review is the place for you. Our mission is to enforce industry\-leading least privilege at Amazon scale: every person and service should have exactly the access they need, and nothing more. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design and build large\-scale, high\-impact Access Management systems with company\-wide reach, and to help lead the next chapter of that mission, applying AI and machine learning to the hardest problem in the space, determining the right level of least\-privilege access automatically. You will build the intelligence that surfaces unused and excessive permissions, recommends precise access decisions, and continuously drives the fleet toward least privilege with minimal human toil. There is ample opportunity to innovate and deliver outcomes that measurably reduce Amazon's security risk. You will collaborate with the leadership team to drive key engineering and business decisions that shape the access experience for the entire Amazon developer community. You will contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle across multiple products, including design, implementation, documentation, testing, deployment, and operations. Successful candidates for this position will have strong software engineering fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, and a good grasp of advanced systems concepts and design. Experience applying AI/ML to real\-world problems is a plus, but not required, we'll help you grow into it. They must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self\-driven, and consistently deliver high\-quality results. They need to really enjoy working closely with their peers within a group of very talented engineers and builders. This position involves on\-call responsibilities. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don't get paged for the same issue twice. Come build with us! A day in the life Our team is responsible for building and maintaining multiple services that are critical for access management across Amazon. You'll work with your teammates, peers in our organization, stakeholders and customers from all around the company to define the access management experience. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Customer Experience Infrastructure
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart partnership focused team of doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real\-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and guidance that you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun. As the Software Development Manager for OIS Console Foundations, you lead the team that owns the common platform every Operational Infrastructure Services (OIS) team builds on. Your team delivers the Console foundations service teams inherit instead of rebuilding \- authorization, notifications, global search, the cloudscape component library, distributed tracing, and the embedded AI layer, so customers get answers and take action directly in the Console rather than filing a request. Thousands of solution owners across Amazon's global operations sites depend on these capabilities to deploy network, compute, and devices without learning infrastructure internals. You hire and grow the engineers who build them, set technical direction with Principal Engineers and product managers, and earn adoption from partner service teams by proving value rather than mandating use. You'll be joining a team that's at the forefront of infrastructure innovation, working on greenfield projects with significant business impact, and building solutions that directly enable Amazon's operations teams to move faster and more efficiently. Key job responsibilities The ideal candidate has built and operated customer\-facing distributed systems and has led or mentored engineers through ambiguous, multi\-quarter work. You work well with senior engineers on hard technical calls, you keep the customer outcome first, you disagree and commit, and you raise the operational bar for your team. * Lead, hire, develop, and retain a team of software engineers; manage performance, set goals, and grow careers. * Own the roadmap and delivery for your team's scope — the shared Console foundations and embedded AI layer OIS teams build on — and prioritize it with your product manager and Principal Engineer against available capacity. * Set and uphold the bar for technical design, code quality, and operational excellence; own the availability, latency, and security of your services through on\-call and operational reviews. * Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities across OIS partner service teams through influence and demonstrated value rather than mandate. * Balance speed, safety, and long\-term maintainability when making design and sequencing tradeoffs, including the higher\-stakes calls that come with authorization and AI safety. * Manage cross\-team dependencies and stakeholder relationships, and represent your team in design and operations reviews. * Keep the team focused on the customer outcome: making infrastructure self\-service for solution owners across Amazon's operations sites. A day in the life As a Software Development Manager on our team, you own the health and growth of your engineering team and the impact it delivers. You hire and develop engineers, raise the bar for design and operational excellence, and partner with principal engineers and product managers to shape technical direction and prioritize the roadmap against real constraints. Much of your impact comes through influence rather than authority. You earn adoption of shared Console capabilities from partner service teams by demonstrating value, and you weigh speed, safety, and long\-term maintainability as your team builds the foundations and embedded AI capabilities that other OIS teams rely on. You'll explore emerging AI tools and bring your learnings back to strengthen the platform and your team. This is a role where people leadership, technical judgment, and customer obsession come together to make building on OIS Console faster and more self\-service. Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include: 1\. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage 2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options 3\. Paid Time Off (PTO) 4\. 401(k) Plan If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply! About the team The Infrastructure Directed Work Orchestrator (IDO) team is part of Customer Experience Infrastructure (CXI), the Amazon organization that helps operations teams get the network, compute, and end\-user devices (laptops, scanners, printers) they need to run Amazon's buildings. We build self\-service tools that let those teams get infrastructure faster and at lower cost, in every region Amazon operates in. We measure success through total cost of ownership, speed to market, throughput, and availability. When an Amazon warehouse, sort center, or delivery station needs new infrastructure, someone has to do physical work on site: survey the building, run cables, install network ports. Today program managers, on\-site IT teams, and third\-party contractors coordinate that work by hand. The IDO team is automating it. We build a serverless orchestration service on AWS. It turns an infrastructure request into a work order, routes it to the right team or vendor, and tracks it to completion against a service\-level agreement. It then reports status back to the requesting team, across thousands of Amazon sites worldwide. Our roadmap expands IDO to cover every type of on\-site infrastructure work. It also adds a registry of pre\-qualified contractors so work routes directly to them, and extends orchestration to large internal programs and equipment repairs**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of engineering team management experience * 7\+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience * 3\+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience * Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations * Experience partnering with product or program management teams * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy * Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. You will spearhead modernization initiatives by leveraging Infrastructure\-as\-Code to automate orchestration, enhance system reliability, and optimize resource efficiency. Partnering with engineering leadership, you will build scalable, self\-service infrastructure platforms that directly support and accelerate enterprise business objectives. **What You’ll Do:** * Design and develop innovative software or hardware components for infrastructure, with a specialized focus on Cloud services. * Proactively evolve processes and technologies to ensure global scalability and meet dynamic business demands. * Collaborate with Security, Network, and cross\-functional teams to engineer solutions that strictly adhere to internal best practices. * Maintain and enhance High Availability and Disaster Recovery readiness across all infrastructure environments. * Evaluate system requirements for performance, availability, interoperability, and reliability, optimizing for the best cost\-to\-value ratio. * Transition legacy processes to repeatable Infrastructure\-as\-Code pipelines across cloud, on\-premises, and edge environments. * Manage continuous integration for software builds and deployments, specifying the necessary tools and environments. * Build and operate distributed, large\-scale systems within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment. * Manage the system lifecycle, including licensing, capacity planning, inventory, and end\-of\-life strategy. * Create and maintain technology roadmaps to guide hardware and software evolution. * Assist in negotiating vendor contracts and service\-level agreements (SLAs) for enterprise services. * Resolve complex technical issues and perform system performance tuning. * Communicate project status and optimization progress to leadership while effectively managing interdependencies. * Contribute to the identification of resource requirements and oversee vendor installations. * Maintain and update detailed system procedures and technical documentation. * Stay current with IT trends and best practices, proactively identifying personal development opportunities. * Mentor and cross\-train team members to foster a culture of knowledge sharing. * Participate in a 24x7 "On\-Call" rotation and support off\-hour system maintenance activities. * Oversee system monitoring and alerting to proactively identify health issues and performance bottlenecks. * Partner with operational and offshore teams to ensure system stability and timely issue resolution. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What You Bring:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent technical qualifications * 5\+ years of experience managing large infrastructures using Automation and Cloud technologies, with a focus on cost optimization and deep technical stack knowledge (Windows, Linux, Compute, and Storage). * Hands\-on experience with DevOps tooling (IaC, Git, CI/CD, Configuration Management, and API integrations). * Working knowledge of the Google Cloud Platform stack * Working knowledge of Windows Server, Linux and hypervisor platforms * Proficiency in system languages (BASH, Python, or PowerShell). * Working understanding and implementation of IT best practices, policies and procedures * Demonstrated ability to assess risk of technical changes * Strong ability to proactively identify and evaluate incidents and problems, determining root cause * Ability to take technical direction from the platform architect and work with engineers from multiple disciplines * Strong analytical, prioritizing, interpersonal, problem\-solving \& planning skills * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence peers and management. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Advanced experience with devops tooling (Terraform, Packer, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Ansible Automation Platform, API integrations). * Intermediate knowledge of the Google Cloud Platform stack * Intermediate knowledge of architectural design for infrastructure and enterprise services. * Intermediate knowledge of Windows Server, Linux (RHEL preferred), Hypervisor Platforms (OpenShift preferred) * Intermediate knowledge of preferred compute, storage, and networking technologies: + NetApp storage (AFF/FAS) and NetApp Cloud (CVO/CVS) + IBM Flash Storage + IBM Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) + Cisco UCS in both Manager and Intersight managed modes + SAN Switch (Cisco MDS preferred) +   Confluence for documentation **Perks: Why You’ll Love it Here** * **Generous Associate Discount** : Treat yourself to the best our brands offer! * **Summer Fridays (For Pittsburgh, NYC and Remote Corporate Associates)** : More time for the sun and the weekend between Memorial Day and Labor Day. * **Casual Dress Code** : Come as you are (and stay comfy). * **Hybrid Schedule** : Enjoy a blend of home\-office focus and in\-office collaboration. * **In\-Person Connection** : While we love our digital tools, we love our people even more! To keep our culture thriving, in\-person presence is required at one of our Pittsburgh or NYC headquarters, distribution centers or field locations for interviews, orientation and periodic quarterly meetups. * **In\-Office Events** : Exciting company\-wide events you won’t want to miss! **Pay/Benefits Information** : * Actual starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to relevant experience and location. * Subject to eligibility requirements, associates may receive health care benefits (including medical, vision, and dental); wellness benefits; 401(k) retirement benefits; life and disability insurance; employee stock purchase program; paid time off; paid sick leave; and parental leave and benefits. * Paid Time Off, paid sick leave, and holiday pay vary by job level and type, job location, employment classification (part\-time or full\-time / exempt or non\-exempt), and years of service. jobs.description: **Job Posting End Date** 10\-16\-2026 Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date. **Job Summary** The Real\-Time Reliability Engineering organization is responsible for providing the engineering expertise, studies, tools, and operational support necessary to ensure the reliable operation and restoration of AEP's Bulk Electric System. This role serves as a key technical resource supporting system reliability programs including System Restoration and Blackstar planning, short circuit analysis, operational engineering studies, emergency preparedness, and compliance with NERC Reliability Standards. The Real\-Time Reliability Engineer is responsible for evaluating existing and emerging system conditions, developing engineering solutions, and providing technical guidance that supports safe, reliable, and resilient grid operations across multiple RTO and ISO regions. This position works closely with the System Control Center (SCC), Transmission Dispatch Centers (TDC), Planning, Asset Management, Protection \& Control, Generation, and external reliability organizations to ensure operational readiness and long\-term reliability performance. Engineers within the organization are assigned ownership of specific reliability programs and are accountable for maintaining the technical accuracy, documentation, studies, procedures, and stakeholder coordination associated with those responsibilities.**Job Description** **What you'll do:** Through collaboration with the System Control Center (SCC), Transmission Dispatch Centers (TDC), Planning, Operations, Engineering, Generation, and external reliability organizations, this role develops and maintains the engineering analyses, operational procedures, and reliability programs required to support secure system operations and restoration readiness. * The successful candidate will analyze system performance, identify reliability risks, develop mitigation strategies, and provide engineering recommendations that enhance operational reliability, system resilience, and regulatory compliance. * Perform engineering analyses and studies to support bulk electric system reliability, including short circuit analysis, contingency analysis, voltage performance, thermal assessments, and system operating limit evaluations. * Develop, maintain, and execute engineering studies that support System Restoration and Blackstart programs, ensuring restoration plans remain technically accurate and operationally effective. * Identify existing and emerging reliability risks and develop recommendations to improve system performance, resiliency, and operational readiness. * Provide engineering support and technical guidance to SCC operators, TDC operators, and field organizations during normal, emergency, and restoration conditions. * Develop and maintain operating criteria, engineering procedures, technical guidelines, and decision\-support tools that support real\-time operations and system restoration activities. * Support NERC compliance initiatives and engineering requirements associated with reliability standards including, but not limited to, EOP, TOP, FAC, PRC, and PER standards. * Conduct and review short circuit, stability, restoration, and operational studies utilizing approved power system analysis software and methodologies. * Coordinate with Planning, Protection \& Control, Asset Management, Generation, and Operations personnel to evaluate system modifications, operating strategies, and reliability impacts. * Develop technical documentation, engineering reports, study results, restoration strategies, and reliability recommendations. * Support restoration drills, operator training, tabletop exercises, and emergency preparedness initiatives that improve restoration readiness and operational effectiveness. * Participate in industry working groups, standards development activities, and professional organizations such as NERC, IEEE, EPRI, PJM, SPP, ERCOT, and MISO to remain current on industry reliability practices and emerging technologies. * Serve as the engineering owner for assigned reliability programs and maintain accountability for all technical deliverables, documentation, studies, and stakeholder engagement associated with those programs. **What we're looking for:** **Engineer Assoc \- Pay Grade requirement, if they obtain a certified Professional Engineering (PE) license. * + VP or above may waive the requirement for a degree from a university with a Non\-ABET accredited program **Engineer of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology. * Individuals with a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Technology can satisfy this degree requirement, if they obtain a certified Professional Engineering (PE) license. jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Competitive salary * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Savings bank * Stock options plan * Vision insurance * Wellness resources **Prototype Engineer, Electrical** **Role Summary** Ampera is seeking an Electrical Engineering Lab Technician to provide hands\-on support to our Research and Development team. This role combines electrical assembly, installation, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting with scientific instrumentation, data acquisition, and safety interlock systems. Success requires more than technical ability. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, works independently within their capabilities, and approaches potentially hazardous work with care and sound judgment. Curiosity, accountability, and respectful collaboration are essential. **Key Responsibilities** * Read, create, and update electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, component lists, and equipment documentation. * Assemble, wire, terminate, label, install, and modify electrical equipment, panels, and experimental assemblies. * Develop, implement, and verify safety interlock systems in collaboration with the engineering team. * Support the installation, testing, and troubleshooting of high\-voltage systems within established training, authorization, and safety procedures. * Integrate scientific instruments with data acquisition equipment, including instruments with incomplete documentation. * Write, modify, and troubleshoot data acquisition software to support experiments and equipment testing. * Use appropriate electrical test instruments to diagnose problems, verify performance, and confirm equipment readiness. * Perform preventive maintenance, repairs, and upgrades. * Document equipment configurations, test results, maintenance activities, and changes clearly and accurately. * Follow electrical safety procedures, including energy isolation, safe work boundaries, and required personal protective equipment. * Raise concerns about unsafe designs or operating practices and collaborate on practical risk controls before work proceeds. * Manage assigned work, follow through on commitments, and communicate blockers or potential delays early. **Required Qualifications** * Associate's degree, Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, Ph.D., or equivalent hands\-on electrical engineering experience. * Demonstrated ability to interpret and produce electrical schematics, terminate and label wiring, use electrical test equipment, and troubleshoot systematically. * Experience with scientific instrumentation, data acquisition systems, or related equipment integration, including programming or scripting for equipment control or data collection. * Understanding of electrical hazards and the judgment to recognize when additional guidance, review, or authorization is needed. * Ability to organize and complete assigned work independently while coordinating effectively with engineers, researchers, and other technical team members. * Clear communication and accurate technical documentation. **Essential Ways of Working** These qualities are critical requirements for the role: * **Ownership and accountability:** Take responsibility for issues through resolution. Flag competing priorities, missing information, and delays early, and help identify next steps. * **Safety judgment and willingness to speak up:** Question unsafe conditions or assumptions respectfully and clearly. Help the team find a safe path forward, and pause work when necessary. * **Intellectual humility:** Recognize that calculations, documentation, and assumptions can be wrong. Verify work, welcome independent checks, and remain open to correction. * **Initiative with sound judgment:** Investigate problems, propose solutions, and seek help at the right time. Understand the limits of your knowledge and authorization. * **Collaboration and receptiveness to feedback:** Work constructively across disciplines, share information, and apply feedback to improve results. * **Curiosity and continued learning:** Show a strong interest in science and technology, identify skill gaps, and take an active role in developing the capabilities needed for assigned work. * **Adaptability:** Remain organized and responsive as experimental results, equipment needs, and project priorities change. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with high\-voltage equipment and safety interlock systems. * Experience supporting research laboratories, experimental equipment, or prototype development. * Experience integrating instruments with limited or incomplete technical documentation. * Experience with electrical panels, equipment installation, maintenance, or code\-compliant electrical work. **Additional Requirements:** * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed * This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered. **Application Materials** Please submit a resume. findings with product analytics behavioral data, member services and social feedback, and external trend sources for a holistic user perspective. * **AI Integration \& Experimentation:** Incorporate jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer, AI Observability
jobs.description: **About us** Appnovation is a global, full\-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience \& Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities. We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to keep a shared observability platform for LLM\-based applications running for a global life sciences client. The platform is built on Langfuse and self\-hosted on Kubernetes on AWS, with ClickHouse as the analytical store, PostgreSQL for metadata and Redis as the ingestion queue, all delivered through Argo CD. Two things need building rather than maintaining. The platform has no monitoring, alerting or defined service levels today, and you will own putting them in place. Infrastructure is defined as code throughout, in Kubernetes manifests, Helm values and Argo CD applications. Alongside the platform itself, you will own the runbooks that make an incident survivable by someone other than the author, and the onboarding and support path for the internal teams that depend on the platform. **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------- * **Platform Operations:** Diagnose and resolve failures across ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, the ingestion workers and the Kubernetes layer beneath them, including ingest backpressure from queue depth and worker drain behaviour. * **ClickHouse Operations:** Own ClickHouse under the operator model, including Keeper quorum, replication, shard and replica topology, and S3 storage tiering. * **Provable Backup and Restore:** Rehearse the restore, time it, document it and test it against its failure modes, rather than assuming a successful backup job means a recoverable system. * **Safe Upgrades:** Plan and rehearse upgrades in a lower environment, with a rollback plan that works even if a migration is only partly complete. * **Monitoring and Service Levels:** Build monitoring, alerting and service levels from scratch, so problems are found here before a user reports them. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Maintain Kubernetes manifests, Helm values and Argo CD applications so every change goes through the delivery pipeline. * **Runbooks and SOPs:** Write and maintain runbooks and SOPs that let a colleague resolve an incident without the author present. * **Onboarding and Support:** Run the onboarding and support path for internal teams that depend on the platform, and triage what they bring. * **Automation:** Turn recurring operational work into automation. * **Upgrade Partnership:** Work with the platform engineer who owns what the platform offers. They decide what to adopt and how it is configured; you own the migration and its rollback. **QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------ * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes on AWS (managed EKS), with routine work done through Helm values and Argo CD applications. * Hands\-on experience running ClickHouse in production, including replication and Keeper quorum, shard and replica topology, and backup and restore, ideally run through an operator. * Experience building monitoring and alerting from scratch, including service levels that reflect what users actually experience rather than what is easy to measure. * Experience upgrading self\-hosted software safely, including schema migrations, rehearsal in a lower environment and a rollback plan for a partly completed migration. * PostgreSQL and Redis operations deep enough to debug metadata\-store and queue problems, including backpressure and worker drain. * Strong operational writing: runbooks, SOPs and post\-incident reviews that a colleague can follow unaided during an incident. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Observability engineering, including OpenTelemetry Collector pipelines, alerting design and Grafana dashboards. * OIDC or enterprise SSO integration with a corporate identity provider. * GitHub Actions for plan and apply pipelines with approval gates. * Experience running LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith or Arize Phoenix. * Experience in pharma, life sciences or another regulated industry. **WHO YOU ARE** --------------- * You don't trust a backup until you've restored from it * You want to find problems before users do * You write runbooks for the person on call at 3am, not for yourself * You stay calm in incidents and focus on fixing the process afterward * You automate anything you have to do twice * You work well inside a client team and build trust quickly * You have prior experience in consulting * Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted. *At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is not only something that we embrace \- we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.* *Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.*
