jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Everyone's building AI agents, but almost nobody gets them to production. Building an impressive demo is easy. Building an AI agent that can securely take action inside enterprise systems is hard. The moment an agent accesses customer data, executes a workflow, or makes changes on behalf of a user, authorization, governance, and trust become the real engineering challenge. Arcade is the MCP runtime that gives agents the power to do both seamlessly. We connect agents to the systems they act in, then give each one a permission slip and a paper trail \- proof of what it's allowed to do, and a record of what it did. That's what makes AI safe to turn loose: real actions, on real systems, already shipping inside Fortune 100 companies. **The Revolution Needs You** Every AI app needs agentic "tools" \- special functions that let AI models take real actions. Without tools, AI can only chat. With tools, AI can actually do things. We're building the definitive tools catalog and tool\-calling platform that will unlock AI's true potential. Think Zapier for AI Actions. Think Auth0 for AI. Think really big. **Why This Is The Opportunity of a Lifetime** * **Traction:** Real deployments with Fortune\-100 customers like Morgan Stanley and Open Table * **Founder\-Market Fit:** Our CEO previously founded Stormpath (acquired by Okta), where he created the first Authentication API for developers. He's done this before \- and this time the market is 10x bigger. Our CTO led the vector database team at Redis, shipped 100\+ LLM applications, and is a contributor to LangChain and LlamaIndex. He knows this space better than anyone. * **Dream Team:** We've assembled authentication, integrations, distributed systems, and AI experts from Okta, Redis, Microsoft, Splunk, Ngrok, Google, Airbyte, Disney, and HPE who've built and founded multiple successful developer platforms. * **Perfect Timing**: Every enterprise is racing to put agents in production \- almost none get there. The problem isn't better models, it's proving which agent can take which action, on behalf of which user, against which system. That's us. * **Massive Market :** We're building critical infrastructure for the biggest technological shift of our generation. Every AI app will need what we're building. * **Backed By The Best**: Our Series A round is led by SYN Ventures, with strategic investment from Morgan Stanley and Wipro. Our earlier investors have also backed Databricks, Clickhouse, MongoDB, Perplexity, Cohere, ScaleAI, Confluent, Elastic, and Firebase. They see what we see \- this is going to be huge. **The Challenge** Arcade is hiring the principal machine learning engineer that wants to build the future of agent capabilities. These core problems define the role: * **What’s old is new:** How can a classic two\-tower e\-commerce recommendation system be used to make agents smarter? How can a classifier be used to make agents more efficient? The ability to take what’s been done and apply it to a new and ever\-changing field is paramount for this role. We’ve launched Tool Recommendations as our first foray into agent–led recommendations, and there is a long list of features we want to create on these (\& similar) building blocks. * **Own the models:** Own the model pipeline from data ingestion to model publishing lifecycle \- including models across embedding, reranking, classification, recognition, and other tasks. Be the leader of a group making agent capabilities, not just API calls, but intelligent and efficient abilities that outpace the competition. Provide insight and experience bringing ideas and practices that should be implemented in a stable but young model pipeline. * **Evaluation Obsession:** Be willing to stand by your models because you’ve been provided able data to cover every possible outcome you can. Stand by the strengths and be readily willing to admit the faults so the team can be prepared. Be willing to go row by row in a spreadsheet without pride. That kind of activity is “beneath” you because this space is too new to claim any ego. * **Enterprise ready:** Everything you build has to run where our customers run: their cloud, their hardware, and sometimes an air\-gapped network. Quantization, export, serving, and packaging are part of the model design from day one, not a deployment step at the end. Our largest customers run Arcade inside their own walls. A Fortune 100 bank doesn't send its agents' tool calls to someone else's API, and its agents can't wait on a frontier model to pick the right tool out of thousands. So the models behind Arcade's agentic features have to be small, fast, accurate, and shippable into a customer's VPC. This is just one example of why custom, small models are the unlock to many of Arcade’s future products. You'll report directly to the Head of Engineering and own the models that sit in the runtime path of every agent call we serve. Our first model for agent recommendation is already built (\& patent pending), along wi mbeddings, rerankers and more. * **Expand the use cases:** Take our model into new territory, starting with search and recommendation over tools and agent context. * **Measure what matters:** Build the eval system. That means offline evals against real agent traces, online measurement in production, and head\-to\-head comparisons with Claude, GPT, and Gemini, so every model decision has data behind it. * **Ship on\-prem:** Quantize, optimize, and package models for customer VPCs and air\-gapped environments, and work with the Runtime team on how they're served. * **Turn telemetry into training data:** Build the loop from production agent traces and tool\-call data to better models, within the data boundaries our enterprise customers require. * **Set the direction:** Choose the ML stack, write the strategy, and help decide who we hire next into ML. * **Decide what to build:** Use your depth in modern agent systems (harnesses, memory, skills) to pick where models make agents meaningfully better, and to call early whether an approach is going to work. * **Use AI to compound your own output:** Projects that take a week today should take a day next time. **Required Skills** * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, with 4\+ years training and shipping production ML systems. Formal title matters less than the work. * You've trained or fine\-tuned models that went to production and moved a metric customers cared about, not just a leaderboard number. * Expertise in production agent systems: harnesses, memory, skills, tool use, and sub\-agents. You know the nuances well enough to help decide what we build, and have intuition about what will actually work before we build it. * Know how and when fine\-tuning works and how to apply it. What data is needed, and how to derive it from what raw data telemetry gives you. * Evals you'd defend in a review. You have the statistics fluency to say whether a small delta is real or noise. * You've deployed models under real constraints like tight latency budgets, limited GPUs, or someone else's infrastructure (vLLM, ONNX, TensorRT, llama.cpp, or equivalent). * Strong Python for training and ML work, plus TypeScript or Go for the production services that serve your models. * You pick the stack, write the doc, and can still defend the decision a year later. * A do\-er, not a researcher\-in\-residence. You'd rather ship a working v0\.5 next week than a polished v2\.0 next quarter. * Comfort with ambiguity: early team, a charter that will expand, decisions made with incomplete data. * An insatiable desire to ship. **Bonus Points** * You've shipped ML into enterprise on\-prem or regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, government). * Tool\-use benchmark or eval work: BFCL, τ\-bench, ToolBench, MCP evals, or equivalent. * Familiarity with the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem. Extra bonus if you've filed an issue against the spec. * You've built training\-data pipelines from production traces with privacy controls in place. * You've been the first ML hire somewhere before, and you'd do some things differently this time. * Open\-source contributions or published work that survived contact with other engineers. * Experience at an early\-stage startup, and you loved it. **Join The Movement** We're not just building a product \- we're leading a movement to transform AI from just chatbots to agents that can take actions against real systems. This is your chance to be at the forefront of that revolution. If you want to look back in 5 years and say, "I helped build that", then we want to talk to you. Ready to make AI actually useful? Apply Now **Compensation and Benefits** This role is in person at our San Francisco office, and offers a competitive salary, equity, and benefits. Compensation is aligned with the range below and determined based on a candidate's background, experience, and performance. **Compensation: Starting at $230,000 base salary, plus equity and competitive benefits.**

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Atlantic BT helps clients realize their full potential through web\-based solutions. We are a team of exceptional people who deliver custom digital solutions to enterprise and global businesses. We provide our employees with a rich, creative and collaborative environment to further their skills, interests, and experience in all aspects of web and application development. Our employees have significant influence in shaping their careers with input as to the technologies they want to use, types of responsibilities they want to take on, and the level of ownership they wish to accept. Summary ------- Atlantic BT is seeking a dedicated, hardworking IT team member with strong Customer Support skills, cloud operations experience, and a solid work ethic to join our full\-time staff. This role supports client hosting environments in AWS, works the IT support and alert queues, and helps move our remaining console\-managed infrastructure into Terraform. Technologies utilized are AWS, Terraform/OpenTofu, Linux, Microsoft Windows, Apache, NGINX, IIS, Load Balancing, CloudFront/CDN, WAF, Redis, MySQL, MSSQL, Varnish, and DNS. Responsibilities ---------------- * Communicate effectively with clients and ABT team members to provide excellent support via phone, email, and tickets * Work directly with ABT developers, QA, and project managers to unblock their work and explain infrastructure issues in plain language * Design, build and scale customer and application\-specific hosting environments in AWS * Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform/OpenTofu, and import existing console\-managed resources into code * Perform network administration tasks, including VPC design, subnetting, routing, security groups, VPN, and DNS * Troubleshoot web application performance and security problems * Triage and respond to monitoring alerts (CloudWatch, NodePing) and lead incident response * Coordinate and execute scheduled client deployments; diagnose CI/CD pipeline failures * Perform supporting release tasks: database exports and snapshots, cache invalidations, certificate and secret updates, DNS cutovers * Perform security scans, WAF policy tasks, and mitigate problems or vulnerabilities * Manage IAM, SSO, and credential rotation; provide least\-privilege access paths * Install/configure/upgrade servers and perform server administrative tasks * Perform migrations of legacy web applications and software * Script complex tasks and deployments using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible * Monitor and control cloud spend * Provide after\-hours support and respond to monitoring alerts on a rotating schedule * Write documentation for team processes, procedures, infrastructure, and deployments * Contribute to and ensure AtlanticBT IT policies, standards, and procedures are consistently being achieved * Represent AtlanticBT internally and externally as an expert IT resource * Provide project architecture design input and project retro feedback Requirements ------------ * 3\+ years of experience cloud hosting applications and related activities + Amazon Web Services in Production Environments + Linux + Microsoft Server + MS SQL Server + MySQL * Hands\-on Terraform or OpenTofu experience: writing modules, managing state, and importing existing resources * Strong networking knowledge: subnetting, routing, DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewall rules, and VPN * Comfortable operating legacy console\-managed infrastructure while we transition to Terraform / OpenTofu * Dependable and professional * Positive, self\-motivated, quick learner * Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written) * Ability to work well with teammates: collaborative, patient, and comfortable being interrupted * Ability to work independently and with a team of peers * Ability to recognize tasks that need to be completed and willing to take responsibility for them **Experience in any of the following is a plus:** * CI/CD automation, especially Bitbucket Pipelines * AWS WAF rule authoring and bot management * SSO and identity federation Fargate, Lambda) * Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud * Web application development knowledge and experience in one or more of + PHP + .Net + Node.js + Python *Atlantic BT is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any person because of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law (referred to as "protected status"). This nondiscrimination policy extends to all terms, conditions and privileges of employment as well as the use of all company facilities, participation in all company\-sponsored activities, and all employment actions such as promotions, compensation, benefits and termination of employment.*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Incentives
jobs.description: Hello, we're Augeo – we are a global leader in enterprise\-level engagement and loyalty platform technology, delivering compelling experiences and fostering meaningful connections for employees, consumers, members and channel partners across many industries and verticals. We serve hundreds of clients, including 70\+ Fortune 500 companies, representing millions of end users. We are thought leaders and disruptors who think differently and creatively, built by entrepreneurs, operators and innovators. At Augeo, we're passionate about providing an inclusive workplace that values diversity and our sustainability initiatives. Everyone is welcome \- our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic whole selves to work. Be you, reach your full potential. We work hard, we play hard and, most importantly, we care to our core about our teams and each other. We over\-communicate around everything… especially while we navigate our new hybrid world. **Summary:** Augeo's Applied AI team builds THEO, the orchestration and intelligence layer behind the reward, recognition, incentive and advocacy programs our clients run. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Incentives domain: the THEO capability set that brings intelligence and automation to performance incentive programs, enabling organizations to configure programs, evaluate participant performance, identify earned outcomes, and orchestrate rewards and payouts at scale. Today, THEO Reward capabilities power personalized reward search, discovery, and redemption in client marketplaces, with recommendations from an ML model trained on more than four million interactions. Within the next six to twelve months we expect to be in market with both THEO Incentives and THEO Recognition capabilities supporting new and existing clients, alongside continued expansion of personalized rewards and offers. The Applied AI team is organized into four capability pods. (1\) Intelligence/ML has a product manager and an AI architect/data scientist. (2\) Rewards, (3\) Recognition, and (4\) Incentives each have a product manager and an AI architect. You would lead the Incentives pod with the Incentives AI Architect and partner most closely with Intelligence/ML on the models and signals behind incentive decisions. THEO sits at Augeo's core, and its capabilities are built for every business unit rather than rebuilt inside each one. An incentive program for a Workplace client runs on the same THEO capability as an incentive program for an Advocacy client. This role works across all of Augeo’s business units to identify shared requirements and to maintain the boundary between what THEO owns and what each unit builds on top of it. **Key Responsibilities:** * Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Incentives domain, from problem discovery through shipped, measured outcomes. Your primary success metric is incremental engagement per reward dollar: more of the behavior a client is paying for, at a lower cost per action * Alongside our Intelligence and ML team, define how AI and ML models select, personalize, and sequence incentives (rewards, points, offers) to maximize engagement and program ROI for clients and partners * Partner with data science and engineering to specify the incentive decisioning engine: the inputs it draws from THEO's user profiles and behavioral signals, model evaluation criteria, and production quality bars * Translate incentive economics (budgets, redemption rates, breakage, partner cost structures) into product requirements that balance member value with program sustainability * Design and prioritize the incentive catalog and configuration experience so clients and partners can launch and manage programs with minimal manual overhead * Build the experimentation practice for incentives, using holdout tests and uplift modeling to measure what a reward actually caused rather than what merely correlated with it. Prove which incentive strategies change behavior, and kill the ones that don't * Evaluate where generative AI and agentic workflows can automate incentive content generation, catalog curation, or program configuration, then ship the highest\-leverage ones first * Turn client, partner, and internal stakeholder needs into precise, prioritized requirements with clear success metrics * Ensure incentive products meet privacy, consent, and data governance requirements across enterprise client environments * Represent the Incentives pod in cross\-team planning, clearly communicating tradeoffs, risks, and progress to engineering, design, and commercial leadership **What Sets You Up For Success:** ### **Required Qualifications:** * 5\-8 years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of a product area from strategy through launch and iteration * **Product fundamentals**: writing clear requirements, prioritizing a roadmap against limited engineering capacity, running discovery, and defining success metrics before you build * **Experience shipping ML\-driven products**: you have owned features where a model does the core work, such as ranking, pricing, recommendations, or personalization. The team did not have to be called AI\-first, but you should be used to the faster, more experimental build\-measure\-learn cycle these products run on, including frequent experimentation and model retraining * **Fluency in AI/ML technical concepts**: you can work directly with data scientists and engineers on model evaluation, prompting, and system design without being an ML engineer yourself * **Analytical rigor**: comfortable defining metrics, interrogating data, and making prioritization calls from evidence rather than opinion ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience shipping a generative AI or LLM\-based feature to production, from prototype through general availability * Experience with loyalty, rewards, incentive, or engagement platforms * Hands\-on experience with the methods behind treatment assignment, such as uplift modeling, contextual bandits, or holdout testing, and with the personalization and recommendation systems they power * Familiarity with incentive and reward program economics: points liability, breakage, redemption modeling, or partner cost structures * Hands\-on use of AI\-powered development and prototyping tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate product discovery and delivery **Benefits Of Joining Team Augeo:** * We offer Medical, Dental and Vision coverage with additional perks through third party vendors offering more virtual and in person care at your fingertips (must be in select locations) * We offer paid Long\-Term disability and Life Insurance * HSA/FSA plans * We offer varying voluntary benefits such as critical, hospital, pet coverage and much more * Employee benefit education, campaigns and wellness opportunities * 401k retirement matching and financial planning resources * Education reimbursement * Several EAP resources * 13 paid holidays and PTO time * Rewards, incentives and gamification for birthdays, Work\-aversery's, professional and personal milestones, company involvement and kudos * Employee referral bonuses * Employee group opportunities * Fun, casual and flexible working environment that embraces the hybrid workstyle * Career growth opportunities *Augeo is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.*

This role is responsible for developing short and /or long\-term repairs that are geared towards improving quality as well as efficiency. * Basic maintenance task, such as greasing, oiling, grinding, drilling, disassembling and reassembling simple and complex machine parts. * Ability to follow maintenance procedures and maintain proper documentations, drawings, and files. and pedestrian, and noise. * The role involves various physical tasks, including lifting and operating machinery, with comprehensive training provided. **Shift (A Shift):** **4 days on 4 days off, mechanical ability is essential regarding understanding of mechanics and troubleshooting * Ability to read and interpret blueprints \& electrical schematics in equipment manuals * Ability to read and components (sheaves, sprocket eration and motor theory and protection. * Intermediate knowledge with production facility's systems, including conveyors, robotic equipment, and (Automated Storage and Retrieval System, AKL and Auto Guided Vehicles) * PLC programming * Strong electronics background (ability to read schematics / use test equipment) * Knowledgeable with using a computer program to control an electronic or electro\-mechanical device * Programming familiarity and use of various software packages * Ability to read and interpret blueprints \& electrical schematics in equipment manuals * Programming familiarity and use of various software packages * Willingness to learn and develop in maintenance field. * Efficient and effective communication skills with peers and staff. * Reasoning Ability \- Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry our instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form, Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** * Required to lift up to 40 pounds unassisted, * Must be able to stand for periods up to 10\+ hrs. * Must be able to push, pull (racks), reach, twist, turn, stoop, walk, and stand for 10\+ hours * Ability to climb ladders * Ability to bend at waist and perform repetitive foot and hand action **THE PERKS** The expected pay range for this role is $22\.16 \- $31\.35 per hour depending on experience. * Immediate Benefits * Robust Total Rewards Package * Paid Time Off * Employee Discounts * Competitive Bonus Programs * Employees 401k Match * Employee Assistance Program * Future Growth Opportunities, including personal and professional * And many more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader! **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. jobs.description: **About Aurelian** ================== Aurelian builds AI tools that help 911 centers handle more with less, so telecommunicators can stay focused on what matters most and communities get the response they need. AVA is a conversational AI agent that answers non\-emergency calls; the agent routes, triages, and resolves the calls without any human intervention. By handling administrative calls like noise complaints, lost dogs, and parking inquiries, AVA eliminates hold times and lets call\-takers focus their energy on actual emergencies. CORA supports call\-takers on the calls that matter most. CORA is an on\-screen assistant that delivers real\-time SOP checklists, smart reminders, and contextual guidance as an emergency call unfolds, so dispatchers stay calm, consistent, and confident when every second counts. When AVA detects an emergency mid\-call, it transfers the caller to a telecommunicator and passes along the caller details, location, incident type, and key statements directly into CORA. The call\-taker never starts from scratch. The problem we're solving is serious. The average emergency communications center is 30% understaffed nationwide. Staffing shortages drive burnout and attrition, which makes the shortage worse. Meanwhile, 60\-80% of the calls coming in aren't even emergencies at all. Aurelian addresses both sides of that equation: AVA reduces unnecessary call volume, and CORA makes every emergency call more manageable for the people handling it. Aurelian is live in centers across the country, answering thousands of non\-emergency calls every day, and is backed by New Enterprise Associates and Y Combinator. Aurelian is growing rapidly; we are hiring people who want to help scale this work and make a real difference in public safety infrastructure for communities across the country. **Why Join Us:** ---------------- We’re growing fast \- and looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who is passionate about solving tough problems and making a measurable difference in the future of public safety. **What You’ll Be Doing:** ------------------------- * Serve as a critical bridge between Aurelian's platform and our customers' legacy systems, ensuring strong and reliable integrations * Travel regularly to customer sites to implement, support, and optimize deployments * Dive deeply into technical challenges and go beyond traditional expectations to ensure our solutions deliver exceptional value * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and customer stakeholders, becoming a trusted partner in the field * Troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively identify issues in demanding, real\-world environments **Who We’re Looking For:** -------------------------- * Highly motivated and relentless in pursuing solutions, even when faced with complex or ambiguous problems * Eager to go the extra mile to ensure customer success and real\-world impact * Willing and able to travel regularly to customer locations as needed * Comfortable with both technical challenges and hands\-on, on\-site problem\-solving * Strong communicator who thrives in fast\-paced and evolving environments **Please Note:** At this time, we are only open to considering candidates who have **already** graduated and can start ASAP. To learn more about what it's like to work at Aurelian, visit our About Us page and follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date! We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed above. We believe exceptional people come from many different backgrounds, and we’d rather connect with you than miss the opportunity. Come do the best work of your life and join us in shaping the future of critical technology that truly matters. ### **For Full\-Time roles, Aurelian offers a variety of benefits, including:** * *Comprehensive Medical, Dental, \& Vision Insurance* * *401(k)* * *Unlimited PTO* * *Company\-wide offsites* * *Equipment stipend* * *Relocation assistance* * *Daily delivered lunches (on us)* * *Office in Seattle* * *Start\-up Equity* Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

You'll build and optimize the AI\-native systems behind our healthcare agents and copilots, blending LLMs, vision models, and classical ML across structured and unstructured data to power decisions in high\-stakes workflows. production AI pipelines.** Own and optimize pipelines that combine LLMs and classical ML (RAG, extraction, scoring, summarization, classification) for utilization management, payment integrity, claims, and appeals. * **Extract from real\-world documents.** Implement VLM\- and OCR\-based pipelines that turn medical documents, faxes, and healthcare forms into structured, reliable data. * strategies, prompt chains, tool\-using agents, and inference orchestration (e.g., LangGraph) for production use cases. * **Build evals and analyze errors.** Create eval harnesses and test sets, run error analysis, and turn findings into measurable accuracy gains. * **Monitor and improve.** Track and improve model quality, latency, cost, explainability, and safety in production. * **Experiment fast.** Prototype new techniques from recent research and help decide what's ready for production. * **Collaborate.** Work closely with senior MLEs, product, engineering, and domain experts, and document your work clearly. **Qualifications** ------------------ * **2\+ years** experience working in applied ML and LLMs. * Strong **Python** skills and familiarity with **PyTorch**, Hugging Face Transformers, and LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex). * Comfort with **embeddings, vector search, retrieval pipelines, and prompt engineering**. * Experience **fine\-tuning or adapting models**, plus working knowledge of classical ML and NLP. * Understanding of **model evaluation**, observability, and responsible AI practices. * Experience **deploying models to production** and familiarity with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes). * Solid software engineering fundamentals and clean, testable code. * A bias for experimentation, clarity, and shipping fast. * Experience with healthcare, compliance\-sensitive data, or regulated environments. * A **BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field**, or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with VLMs or document AI. * Exposure to healthcare payer workflows (UM, claims, prior authorization, medical coding). * Experience with agent frameworks or multi\-step reasoning systems. * Open\-source contributions, side projects, or technical writing. **Who You Are** --------------- * **Owner mentality.** The buck stops with you. jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avoca** =============== Avoca is transforming how home service companies engage with their customers. Our AI\-powered conversational agents handle every high\-value inbound call, from booking jobs, qualifying leads, and driving higher revenue, all at a speed and consistency unmatched by human call centers. We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top\-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 170\+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office. In a $1T\+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category\-defining platform for AI\-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high\-energy, in\-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Field Engineer on the Pre\-Sales team, you'll be the technical builder behind how we win and enable deals. You'll own two things: the integration work that proves technical feasibility to prospects and partners during the sales cycle, and the demo tooling that lets the entire go\-to\-market team tell a credible, product\-accurate story. You'll work at the intersection of Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, and AI, partnering with Account Executives and the Partnerships team as their technical counterpart. Unlike our Sales Engineers, who lead the customer\-facing technical narrative, this role goes a layer deeper on the build: you're the person who can actually stand up a working integration against an unfamiliar API and turn it into a repeatable demo asset. This is a pre\-sales role: you won't carry a closing quota, but your work directly determines whether technical buyers and integration partners trust that Avoca does what we say it does. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own technical scoping and feasibility for pre\-sales opportunities and partner integrations; turning ambiguous requirements from prospects, partners, and AEs into concrete, working implementation plans. * Build working integrations against third\-party APIs, CRMs, field service management (FSM) platforms, telephony systems, and partner ecosystems, writing real code, handling REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and webhooks, and getting a credible proof of concept working quickly. * Build and maintain the demo and sandbox tooling the GTM org relies on: reusable demo environments, representative fixture data, and internal tools, treating one\-off deal builds as reusable assets (integration patterns, reference implementations, scripts) rather than throwaway work. * Configure and tune Avoca's conversational AI for demo and POC scenarios, including prompt engineering to reflect real customer workflows. * Serve as the technical counterpart to Account Executives and Partnerships in the room with a prospect's or partner's engineering team, establishing credibility from the C\-suite to individual developers, and translating those conversations into plans a non\-technical AE can run with. * Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues that surface during evaluations, pilots, and POCs, protecting at\-risk deals and partner launches. * Partner with Product and Engineering to feed recurring integration gaps and field learnings back into the roadmap, and to keep demo environments current as the product evolves. * Partner with (not replace) Forward Deployed Engineering and Implementation when a build needs to graduate from a working POC to a hardened production deployment: you own the pre\-sales build and the demo layer; production delivery is a handoff. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 4\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role: Solutions/Sales Engineering, Forward Deployed / Deployment Engineering, Implementation or Integration Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or software engineering with meaningful customer exposure. * **Hands\-on ability to build.** Proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript (Next.js, React, Node/Fastify); ships production\-grade code and independently stand up an integration or demo tool, not just spec one for someone else to build. You don't need to be a production backend engineer, but "can build it yourself" is the bar. * Practical experience integrating against third\-party APIs and enterprise systems: REST, JSON, authentication/OAuth, webhooks, and comfort working from unfamiliar or incomplete API documentation. * Working SQL and a solid grasp of relational data: enough to model, transform, and wire up realistic data for integrations and demo environments. * Experience owning something technical end\-to\-end, from requirements through build, testing, and a working rollout, even if handed off afterward. * Strong technical judgment and troubleshooting instincts, and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * A product mindset toward internal tooling: you treat demo and sandbox infrastructure as a product with users (the GTM team). * Familiarity with AI\-powered products, conversational AI platforms, or data\-driven systems. Bonus: prompt engineering, call center / communications platforms, CRM or FSM integrations, or prior Partnerships/channel support experience. **Who You Are** --------------- * Self\-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in fast\-moving, high\-growth environments. * A builder who thrives on owning things end\-to\-end and turning one\-off work into something reusable. * Autonomous, self\-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete requirements. * A proactive, effective communicator who's equally credible with a customer's engineers and your own AEs. * In\-office, engaged, and eager to collaborate at our NYC location full\-time. **Benefits** ------------ * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance * Company\-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell * Flexible PTO plus U.S. federal holidays * Company\-wide off\-sites * Daily in\-office lunch through Parkday * Monthly wellness stipend * Dinner covered when working late * Commuter benefits and late\-night rideshare * Standing desks and workspace accommodations available on request * All core tools and software provided **Compensation:** The expected base salary for this role is $160,000\-$200,000 with final compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications determined during the interview process. Avoca’s total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks. Our Recruiting team will share the full details as you progress through our hiring process. **Why Avoca** ============= At Avoca, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category\-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We’re a fast\-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact. *Avoca provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.* Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

Demonstrated track record of scientific writing (e.g., peer\-reviewed publications, preprints, or substantial thesis work). * Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for bridging the gap between computational data science and clinical medicine.

support for major deployments, projects, or incidents. **What You’ll Need** -------------------- ### **Education \& Experience** * Associate degree in **Information Technology, Computer Science, or a The position partners with development and technology teams working in Java and Python amongst others to identify vulnerabilities, improve secure engineering practices, protect organizational assets, and support compliance, risk management, and operational objectives. The role independently performs routine and moderately complex assignments and escalates high\-impact, ambiguous, or highly complex matters to senior security resources. **What You’ll Do** * Identify, assess, and prioritize routine to moderately complex AppSec and AI Security risks, vulnerabilities, and control gaps through application, code, dependency, infrastructure\-as\-code, and AI workload scanning; document findings and escalate high\-impact or highly complex issues as appropriate. * Implement, maintain, and improve security controls and automation within GitLab development and CI/CD workflows to identify issues earlier, support secure releases, and streamline remediation. * Review Terraform configurations and related cloud deployment patterns for security weaknesses, policy violations, and control gaps; validate remediation using established standards and processes. * Support the configuration, monitoring, and improvement of WAF protections for internet\-facing applications and APIs, including services that enable AI capabilities. * Partner with engineering teams developing in Java, Python, and Go to interpret scanning results, recommend practical remediation, promote secure coding practices, and reduce recurring vulnerabilities. * Conduct defined security assessments of applications, APIs, AI solutions, models, agents, and supporting data flows to evaluate control effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, document results, and validate remediation efforts. * Collaborate with business, development, data, and technology stakeholders to document AppSec and AI Security requirements and implement solutions for defined security needs and identified risks, with senior guidance for complex or cross\-enterprise decisions. **How You’ll Do It** * Provide practical guidance on established security controls, risk management practices, and security\-related standards; Ability to effectively organize work, balance competing priorities, and manage time across complex assignments and competing deadlines. * **Licensure/Certifications** Preferred \- Amazon AWS Cloud Practitioner \- Amazon **Role Designation** Hybrid **Anchored in Connection** Our hybrid approach is designed to balance flexibility with meaningful in\-person connection and collaboration. We come together in the office two days each week – most teams designate at least one anchor day to ensure team interaction. These in\-person moments foster relationships, creativity, and alignment. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on any legally protected characteristic. Individuals with a disability who need a reasonable accommodation in order to apply, please contact us at: talent.acquisition@bluecrossmn.com. jobs.title: AI & Cyber Defense Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: AI \& Cyber Defense Full\-Stack Developer**The Opportunity:** We are seeking a full\-stack developer to help build AI\-powered cyber defense applications and agent workflows. This role combines hands\-on prototype development with integration and support of existing production infrastructure. You will develop applications that connect security telemetry, machine learning models, monitoring agents, and specialized response agents. You will also help build the underlying agent systems, including coordination, event escalation, secure information sharing, and controlled response execution. The platform uses a tiered approach, lightweight detection models and smaller monitoring agents assess activity and escalate relevant events to more capable agents configured for investigation and response. These workflows should adapt as new information becomes available and operate independently within defined permissions. The work primarily involves integrating existing models, inference services, and security tools. You will collaborate with cybersecurity and infrastructure specialists to turn concepts into working prototypes, evaluate their behavior, and support their progression toward operational use. **What You'll Work On:** * Develop full\-stack applications: Build web interfaces, dashboards, backend services, and APIs for configuring agents, reviewing security events, and managing investigations and response workflows. * Build agent workflows and networks: Implement coordination, task delegation, shared context, dynamic routing, and event\-driven escalation between agents. * Connect detection and response systems: Integrate conventional neural networks, anomaly detectors, and smaller monitoring agents with larger, specialized investigation and response agents. * Develop testing sandboxes: Create isolated, reproducible environments for testing individual agents and multi\-agent swarms using simulated incidents, synthetic telemetry, and replayable scenarios. * Integrate existing models and tools: Connect model APIs, inference services, security platforms, and response tools. Implement tool calling, structured outputs, context retrieval, and validation. * Support secure data sharing: Develop messaging and shared\-state mechanisms with appropriate access controls, credential handling, provenance tracking, and audit trails. * Implement controlled autonomy: Enable independent operation within defined permissions, with approval gates, execution limits, emergency stops, and recovery mechanisms where needed. * Evaluate system behavior: Test escalation accuracy, response effectiveness, false positives, latency, cost, and failure handling. Provide visibility into agent decisions and supporting evidence. * Support production infrastructure: Troubleshoot integrations, maintain services, improve monitoring, and contribute fixes and enhancements to existing systems. * Coordinate delivery: Translate requirements into actionable tasks, document implementation decisions, and collaborate on code reviews and project priorities. **You Have:** * 6\+ years of experience with software development, including backend services, application development, system integrations, and performance improvements * 4\+ years of experience developing full\-stack applications and API integrations, including user interfaces, backend services, application state, and relational databases * 2\+ years of experience developing, monitoring, or supporting cloud production systems, including troubleshooting application defects, data pipelines, and service integrations * 1\+ year of experience integrating AI\-powered workflows into existing applications or business processes * Experience in JavaScript or TypeScript and backend development using technologies such as Node.js, Python, or C\# and building REST or GraphQL integrations and working with SQL databases * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular, React, or Next.js and event\-driven processing, asynchronous workflows, and coordination between dependent services * Experience developing software using agentic coding tools is required, including using agents to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and develop tests * Knowledge of application security boundaries, authentication, authorization, isolated execution, and secure data exchange * Ability to develop working prototypes, troubleshoot unfamiliar systems, and maintain existing production applications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or Cybersecurity **Compensation** At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work\-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page. Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600\.00 to $176,000\.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.**Identity Statement** As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. **Candidate AI Usage Policy** AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on **your** own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in\-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly provided**. **Work Model** Our people\-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings. * **Remote**: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility. * **Hybrid**: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role. * **Onsite**: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full\-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role. **Commitment to Non\-Discrimination** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

jobs.description: **Additional Location(s):** N/A **Diversity \- Innovation \- Caring \- Global Collaboration \- Winning Spirit \- High Performance** At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high\-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions. **Position Summary** As a forward deployed AI Engineer, you will serve as an embedded technical expert supporting the development, deployment, and sustainment of AI\-enabled solutions across Boston Scientific’s global supply chain and sourcing organizations. This role will partner closely with other forward deployed AI engineers, internal product owners, subject matter experts, and end users to co\-develop scalable solutions that deliver meaningful business outcomes for a company that builds life\-saving medical devices. The organization will empower its Forward Deployed AI Engineers to address high levels of complexity and own the composition of solutions. The Forward Deployment AI Engineer will be responsible for translating workflow needs into production\-ready applications, pipelines, ontology objects, validation logic, and technical documentation. This role will be key in executing against the executive\-approved strategic supply chain and sourcing digital roadmap. **Purpose of the Role** Operate as Boston Scientific’s forward deployment AI engineer to ensure key global supply chain and sourcing use cases move from requirements gathering through production deployment with clear ownership, technical documentation, validation, and ongoing support. **Key Responsibilities** ***Solution Development \& Technical Execution*** * Embed directly with business operators to deeply understand their workflows, constraints, incentives, failure modes, and sources of friction translating ambiguous problems into solvable, high\-value technical opportunities across application behavior, data logic, technical specifications, and validation criteria * Rapidly prototype and iterate solutions using ontologies, AI, and custom engineering building just enough to validate direction, then scaling the proven patterns into robust systems. * Design end\-to\-end workflows that connect ontology objects, data integrations, models, and applications into coherent operational solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. * Deploy bleeding\-edge AI capabilities in a regulated industry, and build alongside external forward deployed engineers, technical experts in scaling technologies and AI leaders. * Diagnose and resolve complex system behaviors across data pipelines, ontologies, applications, and deployment environments, often in real time with frontline business stakeholders. * Own the technical execution of assigned sourcing and supply chain use cases from requirements gathering through production deployment. * Build, configure, test, and refine application functionality in partnership with product owners, sourcing SMEs, process leads, and end users. * Partner with internal data teams and external technical resources focused on the data platform to identify data gaps, pipeline issues, system constraints, and application defects related to data hydration. * Contribute to reusable patterns, logic, and documentation in lockstep with INFRA teams that can accelerate future sourcing and supply chain use cases. ***Business Validation \& Stakeholder Partnership*** * Serve as the tactical connective tissue between business and engineering, converting operational insights into structured requirements, architecture decisions, and delivery priorities to then build. * Facilitate clear feedback loops between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure user needs are accurately reflected in delivered solutions. * Partner with users to confirm applications reflect real\-world processes, decision points, and compliance requirements. Help turn prototype feedback into prioritized technical changes, defects, enhancements, or product decisions. * Validate application behavior and data logic with SMEs, end users, and product owners. * Support user acceptance testing, application readiness, production validation, and post\-deployment issue resolution. * Champion operational excellence and velocity, ensuring engineering choices support maintainability, ontology coherence, security guardrails, and sustainable adoption—not one\-off heroics or brittle prototypes. ***Required Skills \& Qualifications*** * Working knowledge of, or strong aptitude to learn, **market leading data and execution** platform capabilities. * 1 year of engineering experience * Proven track record as an expert\-level individual contributor * Software engineering background with proficiency in Expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js or similar packages/langu acing application behavior. * Exposure to ontology design, object\-oriented data modeling, workflow automation, or AI\-enabled business applications. * Experience working in agile, sprint\-based, or product\-oriented delivery environments. * Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to business stakeholders and leadership. **Requisition ID: 635686** **Minimum Salary: $ 71500** **Maximum Salary: $ 135800** The anticipated compensation listed above and the value of core and optional employee benefits offered by Boston Scientific (BSC) – see www.bscbenefitsconnect.com—will vary based on actual location of the position and other pertinent factors considered in determining actual compensation for the role. jobs.description: **A WORLD LEADER IN TESTING, INSPECTION \& CERTIFICATION SERVICES** Bureau Veritas offers dynamic, exciting employment opportunities with an attractive salary/benefit package and an opportunity to play a vital role with a global organization. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are looking for an opportunity to become part of a stellar team of professionals, we invite you to apply online today. This position is responsible to ensure equal opportunity in employment in that all persons are treated equally and on the basis of merit, in decisions regarding selection, placement, promotions, training, work assignments, transfers and other personnel actions. City: Claude State: Texas **Job Summary:** The Electrical Inspector – Data Centers conducts detailed inspections of electrical infrastructure within mission critical facilities across Texas. The role verifies compliance with the National Electrical Code (NEC), IEEE standards, local and state regulations, and client specific design criteria. Responsibilities include reviewing design documents, performing on site inspections of power distribution, UPS/backup systems, grounding, fire suppression integration, and providing technical guidance to contractors, owners, and internal teams. The position also supports project management activities and business development initiatives for the Data Center portfolio. Travel to multiple sites throughout Texas (e.g., Dallas Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio) is required. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Perform Field Inspections * Inspect electrical systems in data‑center facilities, including: o Power distribution panels, switchgear, and transformers o UPS, battery rooms, and generator sets o Grounding and bonding systems o Cabling pathways, conduit, and raceways o Fire‑alarm and suppression interfacing (e.g., FM‑200, CO₂) o Energy‑efficiency measures (e.g., PUE monitoring) Interpret Codes \& Standards * Research, read, and apply the NEC, IEEE 3000, NFPA 70, local building/electrical codes, and client‑specific design criteria. Explain requirements clearly to contractors, owners, and internal stakeholders. Review Design Documents * Evaluate construction drawings, single‑line diagrams, and specifications for code compliance and constructability before field work begins. Report Preparation \& Documentation * Produce detailed inspection reports, non‑compliance notices, and corrective‑action recommendations. Capture photographic evidence with digital cameras and embed images in reports. Customer Service \& Stakeholder Interaction * Provide professional technical assistance to data‑center owners, facility managers, electrical contractors, and permitting authorities. Maintain effective, courteous relationships. Project Management Support * Participate in project‑level planning, schedule coordination, and budget tracking for inspection‑related activities. Ensure timely completion of inspection milestones. Business‑Development Support * Assist the inspection management team with outreach, proposal preparation, and permit‑processing assistance for new data‑center projects. Office \& Administrative Tasks * Perform routine office duties such as data entry, filing of inspection records, and updating of compliance databases. Other Duties * Carry out additional responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor to meet departmental objectives. **Supervisory Responsibilities** No supervisory responsibilities **Skills** The requirements listed below are representative of acquired skills required. * Computer Applications – MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop * Digital Imaging – Proficient level of Use of digital cameras, photo‑editing software * Technical Writing – Proficient level of Clear, concise report generation * Verbal Communication – Strong level of Ability to convey technical information to non‑technical audiences * Problem Solving – Strong level of independent judgment on complex inspection issues * Time Management – Strong level in Prioritizing multiple site visits and project tasks **Competency** The requirements listed below are competencies required to perform the job successfully. * Attention to Detail – Detects electrical code violations and documentation errors with high accuracy. * Analytical Thinking – Evaluates schematics, single line diagrams, and on\-site conditions against current standards. * Customer Focused Service – Provides courteous, solution\-oriented assistance while maintaining professionalism. * Integrity \& Ethics – Upholds confidentiality and impartiality in all inspections and reports. * Adaptability – Adjusts to varying weather conditions, site constraints, and shifting project schedules. * Team Collaboration – Works effectively with inspection management, electrical contractors, facility engineers, and internal support staff. **Education, Certifications, and Experience (required)** Education * Associate degree in Electrical Engineering or related field (preferred). * High school diploma or GED \+ 2 \+ years relevant experience (minimum). Experience * Minimum 2 years of journey‑level experience in one or more of the following: o Municipal or county electrical inspection services o Electrical construction trades (industrial, commercial, or data center) o Electrical contracting o Demonstrated ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, single line diagrams, and specifications. * Demonstrated ability to read and interpret construction drawings and blueprints. Certifications * Journeyman Electrical or ICC (International Code Council) Electrical Certification – mandatory. * Additional certifications (e.g., CEC, OSHA 30 hour Electrical Safety, PMP) are a plus. * Multi‑discipline certifications (e.g., plumbing, electrical, mechanical) are preferred. Licensure * Valid Texas driver’s license (required). **Physical and Environmental Conditions** The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Work Setting – Primarily field based within data center facilities; exposure to a full spectrum of weather and climate variables when traveling between sites. Limited office time. * Physical Demands – Frequent use of hands for handling tools, meters, and equipment; climbing ladders or scaffolding; stooping, kneeling, crouching, and occasional crawling in tight equipment rooms. * Mobility – Ability to walk, stand, and balance on uneven or raised surfaces; occasional lifting of up to 25 lb (e.g., portable test equipment). * Vision – Clear distance, near, and adjustable focus vision required for reading schematics, labels, and inspecting detailed components. * Environmental Exposure – Daily exposure to temperature extremes (heated/cooled data center interiors, outdoor conditions), dust, and occasional noise from equipment. Note: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or skills required. **Travel Requirements** * Travel Frequency – Up to 75 % of work time may involve travel to inspection sites across Texas. * Coverage Area – Approximately 5,000 – 10,000 sq mi, covering major data center hubs (Dallas Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, and surrounding regions). * Travel Mode – Use of personal or company provided vehicle; valid driver’s license required. Overnight stays may be required for distant sites. We are happy to assist you and encourage you to consider Bureau Veritas for your next great career opportunity! jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Information Security
jobs.description: **About Carvana** At Carvana, we're changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest\-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years. Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest\-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we're just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical. Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you'll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you're driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you'll fit right in. Learn more about what it's like to work here from the people that already do. **Work Model:** This is a 100% on\-site role at our Tempe office, Monday through Friday. **About the team and position** We are looking for a Senior Engineer, Information Security to join our Security Architecture and Engineering Team that will manage our various security technologies that are used to operate our holistic information security program. You will be responsible for evaluating, managing and maintaining our security technologies. **What you'll be doing** * Design and document security architecture patterns, reference designs, and standards for cloud, application, data, identity, and network environments. * Perform security architecture reviews of new products, platforms, and vendor solutions, and turn findings into practical, risk\-based guidance for engineering and business partners. * Embed security by design into the engineering lifecycle through guardrails, paved paths, and reusable patterns that make the secure choice the easy choice. * Contribute to the security technology roadmap and align architecture decisions with business priorities and risk appetite. * Maintain various security technologies across the enterprise to ensure that the technologies are operational and providing value to the organization. * Leverage the information from disparate security technologies to improve our security risk posture. * Engineer solutions that can drive automated response to known security risks, when appropriate. * Leverage artificial intelligence (AI) to build and optimize our security technologies, jobs.title: ATM Field Service Technician
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Customer Engineer **Location:** Seattle, WA, 98141 **Travel:** 100% travel within the Assigned teritory **Payrate:** $22\.50/hr on w2 **Required Availability:** Required to work on rotating shifts, nights, weekends and some holidays. **Job Summary:** Field Service Technician responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining ATM equipment at the module level while ensuring timely issue resolution, accurate reporting, and compliance with safety and security procedures. The role requires strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, problem\-solving skills, customer service focus, and the ability to work independently in a field\-based environment with flexible scheduling and travel requirements. **About CTC:** About company \- Since its founded in 1996, CTC has grown into a trusted global partner in AI \& ML, Enterprise Applications, Digital Services, Managed Services, and Business Services. With headquarters in Detroit, Michigan, CTC has a team of over 2,000 experts worldwide. We empower more than 100 organizations to tackle complex challenges and transform them into sustainable competitive strengths\-\-driving innovation, efficiency, and growth every step of the way. Our strengths have always been Commitment to Customer, Commitment to Colleagues, and Commitment to Community (CTC). **Responsibilities:** * Perform minor maintenance, repairs, and component replacement at the module level. * Maintains parts inventory and related records. * Provides status reports throughout the service repair. * Diagnose problems based on the information provided in the call and through the error logs on the ATM. * Responsible for ownership of customer issues until resolution according to SLA agreements. * Practices security safety procedures when working with ATM's and or within financial institution. * Complete industry specific Training and certifications. * Responsible for accurate and prompt reporting of calls and activity, as well as other reporting as required. **Physical Requirements:** * May require bending/squatting, walking/standing /sitting for prolonged periods. * May require prolonged travel based on your service area. * Carry and or lift a tool kit/parts of varying weights (1\- 50 lbs.) * You may be dispatched daily on a call\-by\-call basis or have a daily schedule. * You may be required to work on rotating shifts, nights, and or weekends. **Basic Qualifications:** * High School Diploma or equivalent 0\-1 years of related experience. * Reliable transportation. * An Android smart phone to receive work orders on and access support documentation. * Have basic tools: Tools are not supplied. \#1 and \#2 flathead and philips screw drivers are most common. **Preferred Qualifications:** * An associate degree is preferred. * Previous experience with ATM or similar equipment is preferred. **This job also can be searched as:** ATM Technician, POS machine maintenance technician, Field service technician, Electro mechanical technician and etc.. Pay: Up to $22\.50 per hour Education: * Associate (Preferred) Experience: * ATM or electro mechanical: 1 year (Required) License/Certification: * Driver's license (Required) Ability to Commute: * Seattle, WA 98141 (Required) Willingness to travel: * 100% (Required) Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Staff Cloud Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== CVS Health is hiring a Staff Cloud Automation Engineer to help define, build, and scale the next generation of enterprise cloud platforms that power infrastructure delivery across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and private cloud environments. As a Staff Cloud Automation Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for advancing the Infrastructure as Code (IaC) capabilities that enable thousands of engineers to securely provision, deploy, govern, and operate infrastructure at enterprise scale. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. **Key reasons to join Cyngn:** **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** * We are searching for a **Senior Mechanical Engineer** to join our team. You will own mechanical design and release for our autonomous industrial vehicles and the equipment they tow — structures, drivetrain and drive\-unit integration, mechanisms, enclosures and sheet metal — from concept through engineering, design and production validation builds to production release. The vehicle engineering team is small and growing, and this hire adds a second mechanical design stream so that we can develop new vehicle programs in parallel with the ones we are launching. * You are a generalist who has shipped a vehicle or a large electromechanical machine. You have sized motors, gearboxes and brakes against real load cases, designed the weldment they bolt to, released the drawings, argued with the fab shop about tolerances, and then built and broken the first prototype yourself. Robotics, automotive, off\-highway or material handling — the domain matters less than the habit of owning the whole mechanical problem, from the first sketch to the production change order. * You are drawn to a small team where the design you release in one quarter is driving on a test lot the next. You treat the environment the machine lives in — sealing, drainage, thermal, dust and rain — as design inputs, not afterthoughts. You are comfortable making trade\-offs with incomplete information, writing them down, and revisiting them when the test data comes back. You treat electrical, firmware and autonomy engineers as peers, and you think about harness routing, sensor sight\-lines and service access while the frame is still a sketch. * You move fast but release cleanly: GD\&T, tolerance stacks and DFM feedback are part of how you design, not a step afterwards. You are hands\-on in the lab, direct in design reviews, and you mentor by review and by example. **What you'll do** * Own the mechanical technical specification, design, integration and release of vehicle systems: frame and structure, mounting and integration of supplier drive units and axles, wheel ends, braking, hitching and tire packaging, with structural analysis for industrial tow loads and duty cycles. * Lead drive\-system and long\-lead component trade studies with electrical and firmware (supplier drive units, torque / grade / brake performance, battery packaging) and drive those decisions to purchase orders on the program schedule. * Design product variants as one platform — common structures and a single bill of materials with configuration\-specific options — so that variants are released, built and certified from one design. * Own environmental readiness of the mechanical design: enclosure and compartment sealing, drainage, thermal paths, cable entries and connector selection, and the design\-for\-test needed to pass ingress, vibration, shock and temperature testing. * Co\-design operator\-interface hardware and service\-access features with electrical: hand\-held control hardware (grip, controls, sealing, cable management and docking) and the features technicians will use every day. * Own mechanical design for towed equipment and attachments — frames, steering geometry and tracking, powered conveyance, couplers and guarding — from first prototype through production release. * Release drawings, GD\&T, tolerance stacks and fabrication packages; partner with weldment, sheet\-metal, machining and molded\-part suppliers on quotes, DFM and first articles, and with our contract manufacturer on work instructions and engineering changes. * Lead the mechanical side of prototype builds and redesign loops across engineering, design and production validation; own the change list and de and industrial\-truck standards exposure (ISO 3691\-4, UL 583 / UL 3100, ANSI/ITSDF B56\.5\). * Contract\-manufacturer hand\-off and production ramp support. * Characterizing sensing systems (encoders, sensors) for closed\-loop motor control. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** *Cyngn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, promotion, discipline, and termination.* *If you require accommodation during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know and we will work with you to provide reasonable accommodation* ***A Note on Recruitment Scams*** *We've seen an increase in fraudulent job offers and phishing attempts impersonating real companies, including Cyngn.* *To protect yourself:* * *All official communication from Cyngn recruiters and hiring managers will come from an email address ending in* ***@cyngn.com****. We will never contact you from a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) or via unsolicited text message or messaging app.* * *Cyngn will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, background checks, or any other fees as part of the application or hiring process.* * *We will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information (e.g., bank account or Social Security number) before you've been extended and have accepted a formal offer through official channels.* * *If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Cyngn, please do not respond with personal information, and feel free to verify by reaching out to us directly through our official careers page.* **The pay range for this role is:** 160,000 \- 180,000 USD per year (HQ \- Terra Bella)

jobs.description: Data Engineer 5 Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? This data engineering team is building an end\-to\-end travel platform designed to centralize product data and power premium customer experiences. You will lead key aspects of a large\-scale, cross\-cloud migration—unifying multi\-cloud datasets into a central data lake using Python, Spark, and Databricks.
