jobs.title: Manager Data Science - Global Payment Network AI Foundations
jobs.description: Manager Data Science \- Global Payment Network AI Foundations Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **Team Description** The Global Network Analytics (GNA) team—specifically within our Foundational AI \& Automation pillar—builds machine learning engines and AI agents to drive foundational, scalable intelligence across the payments ecosystem. We create core models and AI tools to power merchant intelligence, acceptance growth, fraud/risk decisioning, and enterprise automation. **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, ML engineers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered capabilities that evaluate billions of network transactions and transform merchant intelligence. * Leverage a modern tech stack—PyTorch, AWS, VectorDBs, and LLMs—to extract actionable insights from complex numerical, tabular, and textual data feeds. * Serve as the domain expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs), adapting, fine\-tuning, and working with technology to deploy them for business users. * Translate technical ML complexity into tangible business value and strategic goals. **The Ideal Candidate is:** * Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. * Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. * Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. * A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. * Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands\-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open\-source tools and cloud computing platforms. * Influential. You are passionate about AI/ML and can bring along a cross functional team in breakthrough innovations. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non\-technical audiences. * You are experienced in training language models as well as have expertise in one or more key subdomains such as: training optimization, self\-supervised learning, explainability, RLHF. * You have an engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in training data and inference volumes. You have experience in delivering libraries, platforms, or solution level code to existing products. **Basic Qualifications:** * Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date: + A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analytics + A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics + A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analytics * At least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis * At least 1 year of experience working with machine learning * At least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases **Preferred Qualifications:** * PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in model development * At least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R * At least 4 years’ experience with machine learning * At least 4 years’ experience with SQL * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), including utilizing embedding models and working with vector databases * Experience designing and implementing AI workflows and autonomous AI agents **Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. jobs.title: Senior Director, Technical Program Management
jobs.description: Senior Director, Technical Program Management**Are you interested in leading programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale data products \& platforms?** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **At Capital One, we’re changing banking for good. We were founded on the belief that no one should be locked out of the financial system. We’re dedicated to helping foster a world where everyone has an equal opportunity to prosper.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **We’re a bank, but we don’t think like one. We’re always thinking about what’s next, about how we can innovate and inspire, and about how we can develop the tools our customers need to improve their financial lives \- by leveraging best in class technology. That’s where you come in.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **What You’ll Do:** **We are seeking an exceptional Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive Capital One’s AI and ML platforms at the heart of the company’s real\-time information strategy. We work at the intersection of generative AI research and enterprise\-scale systems, and our technologies span the AI and ML training and production lifecycle end\-to\-end, including agentic AI architectures; multi\-agent conversational systems; LLM inference; ML model training, fine\-tuning and monitoring; and much more. You will collaborate closely with world\-class researchers, engineers, business leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to take AI initiatives from concept to production, delivering high\-reliability, real\-time delightful experiences for our customers across all our lines of business (credit card, retail banking, auto finance, etc.)** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to show the organization what a great TPM can achieve.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Our TPM Sr. Directors have:** ------------------------------- * **Strong technical backgrounds (ideally building highly scalable platforms, products, or services) with the ability to proactively identify and mitigate technical risks throughout delivery life\-cycle** jobs.title: Sr. Staff Applied Researcher
jobs.description: Sr. Staff Applied Researcher At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real\-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world\-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business. This is an individual contributor (IC) role driving strategic direction through collaboration with Applied Science, Engineering and Product leaders across Capital One. As a well\-respected IC leader, you will guide and mentor a team of applied scientists and their managers without being a direct people leader. You will be expected to be an external leader representing Capital One in the research community, collaborating with prominent faculty members in the relevant AI research community. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how customers interact with their money. * Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. * Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation. * Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences. * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. * Define and evolve the company’s long\-term research agenda \- identifying emergent scientific opportunities and steering foundational investments in AI innovation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them * Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea * A leader. jobs.title: Field Service Engineer - CT
jobs.description: The successful candidate with support CT services from Albany, NY to New York City. CAREER LEVELING: This job description applies to all Field Service Engineer career levels, FSE I through FSE IV. Candidates are placed at the appropriate level based on a combination of relevant experience, demonstrated technical skill and proficiency, equipment and modality specialization, certifications and training, troubleshooting capabilities, and overall scope of expertise. Individual level and title will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications and the needs of the organization. POSITION SUMMARY: The Field Service Engineer is responsible for the installation, integration, calibration, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and performance optimization of advanced diagnostic and molecular imaging equipment, including PET, PET/CT, CT, SPECT, and SPECT/CT systems from a variety of manufacturers. The FSE applied knowledge of electronics, mechanics, instrumentation, computer systems, software, optics, control systems, and imaging technology to diagnose equipment issues, develop technical solutions, and ensure systems operate safely, accurately, and in accordance with manufacturer, company, and regulatory standards. Field Service Engineer serves as a technical resource to customers, providing responsive service and developing strong customer relationships to support customer satisfaction, contract stability, and continued business success. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each of the following essential functions satisfactorily. Install, service, maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, modify, upgrade, and repair diagnostic and molecular imaging equipment at customer locations, including PET, PET/CT, CT, SPECT, and SPECT/CT systems. Perform system installations and integrations using technical expertise and independent judgment to ensure equipment is properly configured for the customer’s clinical and technical environment. Diagnose and resolve equipment failures by evaluating electronic, mechanical, software, networking, control, and imaging\-system components; determine root cause, implement corrective action, and verify system performance following repair. Perform preventive maintenance, testing, validation, refurbishment, and system modifications in accordance with manufacturer specifications and company standards. Evaluate system performance and troubleshoot components and subsystems, including circuit boards, microprocessors, power systems, sensors, detectors, motors, gantry components, patient tables, and related equipment. Analyze system data and performance trends to identify technical issues and optimize equipment reliability, safety, and image quality. Provide technical consultation, support, and training to customers regarding equipment operation, system performance, software functionality, maintenance requirements, and technical concerns. Respond to customer service needs promptly and provide on\-site support consistent with contractual requirements and customer expectations. Maintain regular communication with customers to assess satisfaction, address unresolved concerns, and support strong customer relationships. Communicate effectively with customers, team members, leadership, technical support, and other internal departments; share relevant customer feedback, competitive information, equipment opportunities, and potential sales leads as appropriate. Independently manage, prioritize, and schedule assigned service activities to meet customer needs, internal requirements, and contractual response commitments. Accurately document service activity, including equipment condition, troubleshooting performed, repairs completed, parts used or recommended, modifications, technical findings, and required follow\-up. Ensure all service activities comply with applicable FDA, ISO, radiation safety, manufacturer, Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Management Procedures (QMI), Work Instructions (WI), and other company or regulatory requirements. Complete and maintain required technical, OEM, safety, and compliance training and certifications for supported systems. Maintain assigned tools, test equipment, documentation, parts, and other resources necessary to perform field service responsibilities. Maintain established performance standards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Remain current on imaging technology, electronics, software, system architecture, equipment upgrades, and company products and services through ongoing technical education and training. Provide technical assistance and knowledge\-sharing to other Field Service Engineers and internal teams as appropriate. Perform other duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications: Associate degree in Electronics, Biomedical Equipment Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline OR equivalent military training (BMET Program) 2\+ years of experience servicing diagnostic or molecular imaging equipment Demonstrated knowledge of electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, computer hardware/software, networking, instrumentation, and diagnostic troubleshooting. Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, schematics, diagrams, service manuals, specifications, and system data. Valid Driver’s License Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Equipment Technology, or a related discipline Physical Demands: Must be able to lift/push/pull up to 75 pounds Ability to stand, bend, kneel, crouch, and work in and around large imaging equipment in confined spaces 40% standing, 20% walking, 40% sitting Working Conditions: Work is performed at hospitals, clinics, imaging centers, and physician offices. Work may also be performed at a home office. Up to 75% travel may be required in varying weather and driving conditions. Travel may be extensive and include overnights depending on customer needs. Occupational Exposure: Work involves exposure to potentially dangerous and hazardous materials. Work involves moderate exposure to unusual elements such as extreme temperatures, dirt, dust, fumes, odors, loud noises, and confined spaces. Occupational Accommodations Statement: The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. They are representative to those knowledge, skills, and abilities that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role. An Equal Opportunity Employer We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by law or regulation. It is our intention that all qualified applicants are given equal opportunity and that selection decisions be based on job\-related Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Job Description: **Our Opportunity** ------------------- Chewy is building a highly AI\-focused team within Supply Chain Operations to create products and platforms that help teams work smarter, make better decisions, and automate repetitive work, with the potential to benefit the broader enterprise. We are seeking a **Software Engineer I** to help build applications that bring AI into employees’ everyday workflows. Our team combines AI, shared knowledge, analytics, workflow automation, and reusable integrations to help employees find information, explore data, and complete tasks while remaining in control. In this role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to develop user interfaces, backend services, and integrations. You will strengthen your software engineering fundamentals, gain hands\-on experience building AI\-powered products, and contribute to features used by teams across Chewy. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Develop, test, and maintain scoped features across user interfaces, backend services, and APIs with guidance from experienced engineers. * Help build AI\-powered experiences for knowledge discovery, analytics, and workflow automation. * Integrate AI services and enterprise APIs using established patterns for security, human review, and reliable error handling. * Embrace a builder’s mindset: test ideas by building—make, break, and rebuild in pursuit of meaningful, intelligent systems. Fail fast and iterate continuously, incorporating guidance and feedback from experienced engineers. * Use AI\-assisted development tools for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation while reviewing, understanding, and testing generated outputs. * Help evaluate AI features using representative tasks, identify inaccurate or unexpected results, and suggest improvements. * Collaborate with engineers and product partners to understand requirements, communicate progress, and apply feedback from code reviews. * Help monitor and troubleshoot applications, building familiarity with production systems and reliable software delivery. **What You’ll Need** -------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 1–2 years of software development experience; internships and co\-ops count. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, or TypeScript, and familiarity with APIs and SQL or NoSQL databases. * Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, version control, testing, and debugging. * Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools through work, coursework, or personal projects, with examples of how you reviewed, tested, and improved generated code. * Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered systems through work, coursework, or personal projects, and the curiosity to find and frame your own problems to solve. * Awareness of AI limitations, including inaccurate outputs, and the importance of validating results and protecting sensitive information. * Ability to complete well\-defined tasks with guidance, ask clear questions, incorporate feedback, and collaborate with teammates. **Bonus Qualifications** ------------------------ * Experience developing user interfaces with React and TypeScript, or a comparable frontend framework. * Coursework or projects involving language model APIs, AI\-powered applications, or workflow automation. * Familiarity with prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, or evaluating AI\-generated responses. * Exposure to cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containers, or application monitoring. * Experience with data processing or analytics, or an interest in supply chain, operations, or enterprise software. **Success in This Role** ------------------------ You deliver well\-tested, scoped features with guidance and build increasing independence. You demonstrate an AI\-first mindset through hands\-on experimentation, thoughtful validation, and practical improvements to your work while strengthening your software engineering fundamentals. The base salary range for this role is $92,500 \- $160,000\.00\.* The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08\+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus. We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com. Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations. Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally\-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect
jobs.description: As a Senior Solution Architect on our Major Accounts and Specialty team, you’ll be right at the heart of Chubb’s digital underwriting transformation, helping reshape how risks are quoted, bound, and serviced across the portfolio. You’ll lead the move away from manual, document\-heavy workflows and toward smarter straight\-through processing (STP) that makes things easier for both underwriters and brokers. Working closely with global teams, you’ll help design and build these platforms, while staying aligned with engineers at the code and detailed design level to make sure the solution is delivered exactly as intended. **In this role, you will:** * Design flexible, modular, and reusable solution architectures that align with technical standards and patterns * Implement solution architecture governance with a strong focus on design patterns, technology standards, and architectural fitness * Define the digital transformation roadmap for underwriting platforms, including legacy jobs.title: Webflow Web Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cirrascale** Cirrascale Cloud Services provides high\-performance cloud infrastructure purpose\-built for deep learning, generative AI, and large\-scale AI inference workloads. We specialize in dedicated GPU cloud solutions tailored to the unique needs of startups, research labs, and enterprise AI teams. Our mission is to accelerate AI innovation by combining powerful hardware with white\-glove service and flexible, custom\-built environments. **Job Summary** Cirrascale Cloud Services is the expert neocloud built for Private AI. We run dedicated, bare\-metal infrastructure across NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, and Tenstorrent silicon for organizations that need to train, fine\-tune, and run inference on their own data without public cloud exposure. Our customers are regulated enterprises, government agencies, research institutions, and the AI companies building frontier models. For most of them, cirrascale.com is the first conversation they have with us. We’re hiring one person to own that surface end to end: how it looks, how it’s built, and how it gets found. This is a hybrid role in the literal sense. You’ll design a landing page in Figma or Adobe in the morning and ship it in Webflow with custom code in the afternoon. You’ll also own how Cirrascale shows up in search, both the ten blue links and the AI answers that increasingly replace them. If you’d rather own a surface than work a ticket queue, this is that job. You’ll sit on a growing marketing team that moves fast and ships often. Nobody here will hand you a wireframe and wait. You’ll be in the room where the campaign gets scoped, and you’ll build what comes out of it. **Key Responsibilities** **Website design and development** * Design, build, and maintain cirrascale.com in Webflow, including product pages, solution pages, the blog, and relevant landing pages. * Architect and maintain CMS collections so content, jobs, and partner pages scale without a rebuild each time. * Build campaign and event landing pages on deadline, often with copy still in motion. * Maintain a real design system in Webflow: components, classes, and variables that keep the site consistent as it grows. * Own page speed and Core Web Vitals and keep the site accessible to WCAG 2\.1 AA. Several of our buyers are in the public sector, so this is a requirement rather than a preference. * QA across breakpoints, browsers, and devices before anything goes live. **Search and AI visibility (SEO and AEO)** * Own technical SEO end to end: site architecture, internal linking, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, and crawl health. * Build the keyword and topic strategy with the content team, and translate it into pages that actually rank. * Own answer engine optimization. Structure our content and entity data so Cirrascale gets cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google’s AI surfaces, not just indexed by them. * Manage crawler access, monitor AI citation share, and report on which pages are earning mentions. * Separate what works from what’s being sold as working. This field generates a lot of confident advice, some of it contradicted by the search engines themselves. We want someone who reads the primary source before implementing the tactic. * Report monthly on rankings, organic sessions, assisted pipeline, and AI citation coverage. **Design** * Produce campaign creative across paid social, display, email, and web. * Design event and field marketing assets: booth panels, backdrops, handouts, and signage for industry tradeshows. * Lay out datasheets, solution briefs, and co\-branded partner collateral in InDesign. * Build architecture and infrastructure diagrams that a technical reader will trust. Our audience will notice if the topology is wrong. * Work inside Cirrascale brand guidelines and improve them where they’re thin. **AI tooling** * Use AI tools daily, and build with them, not just prompt them. We already run production marketing tools built this way. * Prototype interactive components, generate and test design variants, and automate the reporting work that would otherwise eat a day a week. * Bring your own stack. We care that you ship faster because of it, not which tool you picked. **Conversion and measurement** * Own forms, CTAs, tracking, and landing pages in HubSpot, and keep the handoff to CRM clean. * Run A/B tests on pages that matter, and act on the results. * Work in GA4, Google Search Console, and HubSpot reporting. Know the difference between a metric that moved and a metric that mattered. **Required Qualifications** * 4\+ years designing and shipping marketing websites, with a portfolio of live URLs you can point to and explain. * Deep Webflow experience: CMS and collections, components, interactions, custom code embeds, and third\-party attribute libraries such as Finsweet. * Hand\-written HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. You can debug the thing the Webflow UI can’t fix. * Technical SEO you have personally executed. Not “familiar with.” You’ve fixed a crawl issue, cut LCP on a slow template, or migrated a site without losing rankings. * Working knowledge of AEO and generative engine optimization, and a defensible point of view on what’s real. * Adobe Creative Cloud fluency, with Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign at minimum. * Figma for design, prototyping, and handoff. * Daily working use of AI tools, with specific examples of what you built or automated. * Comfort with a technical audience. You don’t need to write CUDA kernels, but you should be able to read a GPU spec sheet and lay it out without mangling it. * Precision on brand: typography, spacing, color, and copy consistency, without being asked twice. * Ability to work independently, manage several projects at once, and hold a deadline when the input arrives late. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** The base salary range for the Web Engineer **is $95,000 to $115,000 /year**. This pay range reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay range for this job for the location for which it has been posted. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Benefits include: * 401(k) with company match. * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * Paid time off (PTO). * Opportunities for professional development and growth. **WHY JOIN CIRRASCALE?** Join a growing team that's pushing the boundaries of AI infrastructure. At Cirrascale, you’ll contribute to projects powering next\-generation AI applications while working with top\-tier hardware in a collaborative and innovative environment. From custom deployments to hands\-on customer support, every role here plays a part in enabling breakthroughs in AI. Cirrascale Cloud Services is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Please apply at careers@cirrascale.com Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

As the largest and most vibrant city in the state, Minneapolis depends on purposeful, dedicated and innovative employees. The City of Minneapolis is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. **Benefits Summary** Our employees enjoy competitive salaries and generous benefits. We pride ourselves on a comprehensive benefits program that supports employees' health and financial well\-being. Programs, resources, and benefit eligibility varies based on position, average hours worked, location and length of service. For detailed benefits information, please visit the benefits page. **Insurance** **Health insurance** Eligibility for benefits begins the first of the month following employment date. The City of Minneapolis offers eligible employees one plan design with a choice of six provider networks, allowing you to select the best option for you. Available plans include Medica Choice Passport, Medica Elect, VantagePlus with Medica, Park Nicollet and HealthPartners Medical Group First with Medica, Ridgeview Community Network powered by Medica, and Clear Value with Medica. **Dental insurance** The City of Minneapolis offers dental insurance through Delta Dental of Minnesota and pays 100% of the monthly premium for eligible employees. **Life insurance** The city provides basic life insurance of one times your annual salary up to $50,000\. layouts and design work from field and survey data. * Assists at the front counter; conducts plan reviews, including grading, street, sewer, and storm drain projects; reviews applications and jobs.title: UI/UX Designer, Design Systems
jobs.description: Clearwater Analytics delivers a unified, front\-to\-back investment management platform for institutional investors across public and private markets. Our platform, including products like Beacon by Clearwater and Enfusion by Clearwater, supports the full investment lifecycle — front office portfolio and order management, trading, and risk and performance; middle and back office accounting, reporting, and reconciliation; and compliance and investment data management. Clearwater powers more than $10 trillion in assets for 2,400\+ clients worldwide, including asset managers, insurers, hedge funds, corporations, banks, pensions, and public sector institutions. A strong, well\-governed design system is core to how we scale great design across this large, fast\-growing platform. **Role Overview** ================= We're looking for a UX/UI Designer, Design Systems to contribute to the strategy, craft, and execution of Clearwater's design system. This is a hands\-on role: you'll help shape the direction of the system, design and help build its components and tokens, and drive adoption across product teams. Joining the Design Systems team, you'll be a key contributor to design systems at Clearwater and a close partner to engineering. This role requires more than systems thinking in Figma. You must be strong in visual/UI craft and comfortable working in code — contributing to or pairing closely with engineers on component libraries, design tokens, and front\-end implementation — so that what ships in production matches the system's intent. Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying a design system in a live product is required. Increasingly, our design system needs to serve builders beyond the design team — engineers, PMs, and AI coding agents generating UI directly from our components and tokens. You'll help treat the design system as enablement infrastructure for anyone building on Clearwater's platform. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Contribute to the vision, roadmap, and governance for Clearwater's design system across all web products. * Design and help build core components, patterns, and design tokens — working hands\-on in both Figma and code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and component frameworks such as React) so design and implementation stay in lockstep. * Drive the Figma\-to\-Storybook component library workflow, ensuring components, variants, and documentation stay synchronized between design and the published library engineers build against. * Partner with engineering to build and maintain the design system's token pipeline (e.g., Style Dictionary or similar) and shared component library, ensuring tokens map cleanly from design to code. * Use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to accelerate component development, prototyping, and design\-to\-code handoff. * Contribute to making the design system machine\-consumable — structured component specs, tokens, and documentation that AI coding tools can pull from directly (e.g., an MCP\-style integration), so AI\-generated UI is on\-brand by construction rather than by review. * Contribute to guardrails and validation (audits, eval criteria, automated checks) that catch off\-system or off\-brand output from AI\-assisted or non\-designer contributors at scale, not just from formal design reviews. * Contribute to defining and evolving design system standards, documentation, and contribution guidelines to support adoption at scale across distributed product teams. * Drive adoption of the design system across the organization; identify gaps and help prioritize new components or patterns based on real product needs. * Mentor and support designers and engineers contributing to or consuming the system; help raise the bar on visual and interaction craft. * Collaborate closely with Product Designers, Visual Designers, Interaction Designers, and Engineers to ensure the system supports dense, data\-heavy enterprise workflows (tables, dashboards, reporting, complex forms). * Help establish and maintain accessibility standards (WCAG) as a built\-in property of every component, not an afterthought. * Contribute to presenting design systems strategy and progress to senior stakeholders, including the VP, Head of UX and engineering leadership. * Track and report on design system health: adoption rate, component coverage, contribution velocity, and design/engineering consistency. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 5\+ years of experience in product/UX/UI design, including 2\+ years working on design systems at scale. * Proven, hands\-on experience designing and deploying a production design system — from Figma library and tokens through shipped code — is required. Design\-only or theoretical design systems experience is not sufficient. * Strong UI development skills: proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with working knowledge of component\-based front\-end frameworks (e.g., React), and comfort contributing to o pairing closely with engineers on the system's codebase. * Proficiency with Claude Code or similar AI\-assisted coding tools to accelerate component development and design\-to\-code workflows. * Experience making a design system consumable by non\-designers or AI tooling (structured documentation, APIs/MCPs, or similar), not just human\-facing Figma/Storybook libraries. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining a Figma\-to\-Storybook (or equivalent) component library pipeline, keeping design and code in sync. * Advanced Figma skills: variables/tokens, component architecture, auto layout, and prototyping. * Strong visual design craft — typography, layout, color, spacing, and interaction states — and the ability to apply it to dense, enterprise B2B interfaces. * Solid understanding of design token tooling and pipelines and how tokens flow from design into production code. * Strong grasp of accessibility fundamentals (WCAG) and how to encode them into reusable components. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting design work and design systems progress to cross\-functional partners and leadership. * A portfolio that demonstrates both design systems thinking and shipped, production UI — not only visual or marketing work. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience designing for enterprise SaaS or data\-heavy/fintech products (tables, dashboards, complex forms, reporting). * Experience mentoring or supporting designers and engineers contributing to a shared design system. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted design tools and workflows (e.g., Figma Make, Claude) to accelerate design system work. * Experience contributing to design system governance models (contribution models, versioning, release processes). * Motion and micro\-interaction design experience. **Key Skills** ============== * Design systems craft and execution * Strong visual and UI craft * Front\-end/UI development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, component frameworks, Claude Code) * Figma\-to\-Storybook component library workflows * Design token architecture and tooling * Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication * Mentorship **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Clearwater has a well\-governed, actively adopted design system spanning Figma and code. * Product teams ship faster and more consistently because the system covers their real needs. * Design and engineering stay in sync through reliable, well\-documented token and component pipelines. * Design system quality and adoption visibly improve quarter over quarter. * Non\-design contributors (PMs, engineers, AI\-assisted workflows) can produce on\-system UI without a designer in the loop for every change. **How to Apply** ================ Please submit: * Resume * Portfolio (required), including 2–3 case studies that highlight your design systems work — covering both design decisions and how the system was implemented and adopted in production. * A brief note on your experience taking a design system from Figma into shipped, production code. **What We Offer** ================= * Business casual atmosphere in a flexible working environment * Team\-focused culture that promotes innovation and ownership * Access cutting\-edge investment reporting technology and expertise * Defined and undefined career pathways, allowing you to grow your way * Competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits * Maternity and paternity leave * Personal Time Off and Volunteer Time Off to give back to the community * Work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year * Work from home Fridays **Why Join Us?** ================ This is an incredible opportunity to contribute to a passionate design and engineering team that is shaping the future of investment management technology. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, apply now! Thank you for your interest in a career with Clearwater!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Voice AI
jobs.description: Cloaked is building a cyber expert at your side \- one that watches, advises, and acts to keep you safe and private in the age of AI. 600k\+ paying members already use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them: masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through. We've protected 10M\+ identities, screened 50M\+ calls, and removed 1B\+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Backed by a $375M Series B, we're now building the agents that turn detection into action \- for individuals, families, and the companies that want to protect their people. **About the Role** We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to join the Call Guard team and help build the next generation of our real\-time voice AI. You'll own major parts of the stack, from voice agent design and conversational latency to adversarial robustness and the infrastructure underneath. As Cloaked grows, you'll have room to contribute to how we build AI\-native consumer products across engineering. Call Guard is Cloaked's AI call screening product. It intercepts unknown callers, holds a real\-time AI conversation with them, and only rings the user through if the call is legit. Spam, scams, and voice\-cloned callers get stopped before they reach your phone. We've screened 50M\+ calls to date. **What will you do?** * Design and ship production voice agents that talk with unknown callers, classify intent, and block scams autonomously * Own key components of Call Guard's real\-time voice AI stack and contribute to its architecture and technical direction * Drive down end\-to\-end conversational latency across STT, agent reasoning, and TTS * Build defenses against adversarial AI callers, including voice\-cloning attacks targeting our users * Evaluate and integrate frontier models (LLMs, speech models, agent frameworks) for production use * Build and maintain telephony, VoIP routing, and the cloud infrastructure the voice agent runs on * Partner with product, design, and mobile to ship voice experiences that feel effortless * Raise the team's bar on quality through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing * Use AI tools daily to move faster **What skills and experiences will help you?** * 5\+ years building production software, ideally real\-time or distributed systems * Hands\-on experience shipping voice or conversational AI products in production * Fluency with modern voice AI stacks: STT (Whisper, Deepgram), TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia), and real\-time orchestration (LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar) * Production experience with LLMs and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalents) * Experience optimizing for low latency in real\-time systems * Strong Python and/or Go, with experience building scalable, secure backend systems and APIs * Solid cloud infrastructure experience (AWS or GCP, containerized deployments) * Experience shipping consumer products at scale * Daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex) with good judgment on when and how to use them **What's nice to have?** * Telephony, VoIP, SIP, or carrier\-level call routing experience * WebRTC or real\-time media infrastructure experience * Background in speech recognition, signal processing, or audio engineering * Familiarity with adversarial ML, AI safety, or anti\-fraud systems * Experience handling PII and sensitive data * Prior work on consumer privacy or security products **What do we like?** * Passion for security, privacy, and internet ethics * Curiosity about the frontier of voice AI and applied ML * Strong ownership and a bias to act * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Thrives on a high\-velocity team and enjoys learning from and teaching others * Startup or growth\-stage experience **What we offer** ----------------- Cloaked is a well\-funded Series B startup based out of NYC. pipeline. * Programming Skills: Proficient in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, Java, or Scala, with the ability to write efficient scripts and automation tools. * System Monitoring and Log Management: Familiar with using monitoring and log management tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or other similar tools. * Troubleshooting and Debugging: Strong debugging jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Ambient AI
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** We’re building a next\-generation ambient AI product suite for healthcare, helping clinicians focus on patient care by automatically capturing, understanding, and structuring clinical conversations. Behind that experience is a distributed system responsible for ingesting long\-form audio, processing real\-time and asynchronous streams, orchestrating multiple AI models, and reliably producing clinical outputs. These workflows must remain observable and recoverable across network interruptions, partial failures, model timeouts, and rapidly changing inference infrastructure. We’re hiring a Staff Backend Engineer to help build and operate this foundation. You’ll work across audio ingestion, media processing, inference orchestration, distributed workflows, storage, observability, and cloud infrastructure. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys making complex systems dependable. You think carefully about failure modes, idempotency, backpressure, data integrity, latency, and operational simplicity. You also understand that infrastructure exists to serve the product: the systems you build must ultimately create a fast, reliable, and trustworthy experience for clinicians. **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and operate backend systems that power our Ambient AI products across mobile and web. * Build and evolve inference workflows that coordinate transcription, diarization, language models, clinical extraction, summarization, and other AI capabilities. * Develop orchestration systems for long\-running, multi\-stage workflows, including: + Scheduling, queueing, and workload prioritization + Retries, timeouts, fallbacks, and dead\-letter handling + Idempotency, replay, and safe workflow recovery + Model routing, versioning, and configuration + Progress tracking and user\-visible workflow state + Graceful degradation when dependencies are unavailable * Improve the reliability and scalability of services operating under variable, compute\-intensive workloads. * Define and maintain service\-level objectives for critical workflows, including availability, processing latency, completion rates, and data durability. * Build strong observability across services and pipelines through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, and diagnostic tooling. * Lead incident response and post\-incident analysis for important production failures, turning operational lessons into lasting improvements. * Identify systemic failure patterns and eliminate them through better abstractions, automation, testing, and architecture. * Improve cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, capacity planning, and operational tooling as the platform scales. * Design APIs and data models that allow mobile, web, and internal systems to interact with long\-running workflows safely and predictably. * Build tools that make inference pipelines easier to inspect, test, replay, evaluate, and debug. * Balance reliability, latency, quality, and infrastructure cost across AI and media\-processing workloads. * Partner closely with mobile, product, AI, security, and clinical teams to turn new capabilities into production\-ready workflows. * Mentor other engineers and help establish strong practices for distributed systems, observability, operational readiness, and backend architecture. **What You Have** * 8\+ years of professional backend or infrastructure engineering experience. * Experience designing, building, and operating production distributed systems. * Strong proficiency in at least one modern backend programming language. * Ex workflow execution. * A strong understanding of distributed\-systems concepts such as idempotency, consistency, concurrency, backpressure, retries, failure isolation, and eventual completion. * Experience operating services in a cloud environment, including deployment, monitoring, scaling, and incident response. * Experience designing APIs, service boundaries, and data models for complex product workflows. * A track record of improving system reliability, observability, scalability, or operational efficiency. * Strong debugging skills across application, infrastructure, data, and external dependency boundaries. * An ability to reason about both real\-time and long\-running workloads with different latency and durability requirements. * Comfort working across backend, infrastructure, product, and AI systems rather than within a narrowly defined layer. * An ownership mindset and bias for action. You identify important risks, create clarity, and drive ambiguous infrastructure work through completion. **Nice to Haves** * Experience building speech\-to\-text, diarization, transcription, or other audio\-based machine\-learning workflows. * Experience orchestrating large language models or multi\-model inference pipelines in production. * Familiarity with workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal or similar durable execution platforms. * Experience with event\-streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, SQS, or similar systems. * Experience with model routing, inference gateways, rate limiting, batching, caching, or GPU\-backed workloads. * Experience building internal tooling for workflow inspection, replay, evaluation, or model debugging. * Experience defining SLOs, managing error budgets, designing alerts, and leading production incident response. * Familiarity with distributed tracing and observability platforms such as Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Sentry, or similar tools. * Experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud\-native deployment systems. * Experience optimizing systems for throughput, tail latency, infrastructure cost, and workload isolation. * Experience with offline clients, background synchronization, or systems that reconcile delayed and duplicated events. * Exposure to healthcare, HIPAA, SOC 2, encryption, privacy, security, or other regulated environments. * Experience supporting AI\-native, real\-time, or agentic product experiences. **Why Join** * Build the backend foundation for an AI healthcare product used in real clinical workflows. * Solve challenging systems problems involving distributed orchestration, and production AI. * Make reliability improvements that clinicians experience directly through faster, safer, and more dependable workflows. * Shape how inference systems are orchestrated, observed, recovered, and scaled in production. * Work closely with product and AI teams while maintaining deep ownership of backend architecture and infrastructure. * Help define the operational and engineering standards for a rapidly growing platform. * Join at a stage where core systems, technical strategy, and engineering culture are still highly shapeable. * Grow into broader backend, infrastructure, or technical leadership as the team and product expand. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $210K \- $275K

jobs.title: Marketing & Business Development Manager (Entry-Level)
jobs.description: **Marketing \& Business Development Manager** ============================================= **Location:** Bridgewater, Massachusetts **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Schedule:** 40 Hours per Week, Monday–Friday, In\-Person **Salary Range:** $60,000–$70,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications **Travel:** Occasional local travel for business purposes **Position Summary** -------------------- Coneco Engineers \& Scientists, Inc. is seeking a creative, organized, and motivated **Marketing \& Business Development Manager** to support and grow the company's marketing, proposal development, communications, and business development efforts. This is an excellent opportunity for an early\-career professional or recent college graduate who is looking to build a career in marketing and business development while gaining hands\-on experience across multiple areas of a growing professional services company. While previous experience is welcomed, **we are open to entry\-level candidates and recent college graduates and encourage them to apply.** We are willing to train the right person who demonstrates strong communication skills, creativity, initiative, organization, and a genuine willingness to learn and grow with Coneco. The Marketing \& Business Development Manager will help strengthen Coneco's market presence, coordinate proposals and qualification packages, manage social media and marketing initiatives, support company\-wide communications and mailings, and provide general administrative support when needed. As part of a small and collaborative organization, this is a hands\-on role. The successful candidate should be comfortable "wearing many hats," learning new responsibilities, working across departments, and stepping in where needed to help the team succeed. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** ---------------------------------------- ### **Marketing, Branding \& Social Media** * Help develop and maintain Coneco's overall marketing presence and brand. * Manage and grow the company's professional social media presence, including planning, creating, scheduling, and publishing content. * Develop content highlighting company projects, services, employees, recruiting efforts, community involvement, industry news, and company milestones. * Maintain consistent company branding across digital and printed materials. * Create and update brochures, presentations, advertisements, project sheets, employee profiles, and other marketing materials. * Assist with maintaining and updating company website content. * Coordinate project photographs, employee features, company news, and other content for marketing purposes. * Identify creative opportunities to increase Coneco's visibility within the industries and communities we serve. * Monitor basic social media and marketing performance and recommend new ideas and opportunities. ### **Proposals \& Business Development** * Coordinate the preparation and submission of proposals, Statements of Qualifications (SOQs), qualification packages, and other business development materials. * Work with company leadership, project managers, technical staff, and administrative personnel to gather information needed jobs.title: HVAC Project Manager
jobs.description: Position Summary The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing HVAC, mechanical, and piping construction projects from inception through completion. This position oversees project budgets, schedules, subcontractors, procurement, client relations, and field operations to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. The Project Manager collaborates closely with owners, engineers, field supervisors, and contractors to resolve issues, maintain project progress, and deliver exceptional results for clients. Essential Duties \& Responsibilities Project Planning \& Execution * Manage all phases of assigned mechanical construction projects from preconstruction through closeout. * Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and work plans. * Review project drawings, specifications, contracts, and scope of work. * Coordinate labor, materials, equipment, and subcontractors to support project objectives. * Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions when necessary. * Ensure projects are completed according to contract requirements and quality standards. Financial Management * Prepare and manage project budgets, forecasts, and cost reports. * Track labor productivity, material costs, and project expenditures. * Review and approve invoices, purchase orders, and subcontractor payments. * Manage change orders, cost impacts, and project billing. * Identify opportunities to improve project profitability and efficiency. Client \& Stakeholder Relations * Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, owners, and project stakeholders. * Lead owner, architect, and contractor (OAC) meetings. * Maintain positive relationships with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and trade partners. * Communicate project status, milestones, and potential issues proactively. * Ensure customer satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle. Field Coordination \& Leadership * Collaborate with field supervisors and foremen to ensure efficient project execution. * Support jobsite teams in resolving technical and operational challenges. * Conduct jobsite visits to monitor progress, quality, and safety compliance. * Coordinate with other trades to minimize conflicts and maintain schedules. * Promote a culture of teamwork, accountability, and safety. Risk Management \& Compliance * Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA regulations, and contract requirements. * Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, and project documentation. * Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies. * Maintain accurate records and project files throughout the project lifecycle. * Support project closeout activities, including punch lists and final documentation. Qualifications \& Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field preferred. * Minimum of five (5\) years of project management experience in the mechanical construction industry. * Experience managing HVAC, piping, and mechanical construction projects. * Strong understanding of project scheduling, budgeting, and cost control. * Proficiency with construction management software and Microsoft Office applications. * Experience with project management platforms such as Procore, Bluebeam, or similar software preferred. * Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as needed. Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities * Strong leadership and team management skills. * Excellent communication and relationship\-building abilities. * Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities. * Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills. * Knowledge of mechanical systems, construction practices, and industry standards. * Ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications, and contracts. * Strong negotiation and conflict\-resolution abilities. Work Environment \& Physical Requirements * Combination of office and field work on active construction sites. * Frequent travel to project locations as required. * Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for extended periods. * Occasional lifting of materials and equipment up to 25 pounds. * May require visits to mechanical rooms, rooftops, and active construction environments. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer – AI Systems & Agent Engineering
jobs.description: **Role Summary** ---------------- Direct Agents is running a growing fleet of AI\-powered systems across our client and internal reporting stack — automated account agents, intelligence systems, always\-on client dashboards — and is now building a new, confidential generative AI product for the media industry. We're hiring a full\-time, remote Full\-Stack Developer to do both: help keep the existing fleet running and improving, and help build the new product from the ground up. A meaningful part of this job is working inside Claude Code as our primary engineering environment — steering and reviewing AI\-generated code and agent workflows, not only writing everything by hand. **What You'll Work On** ----------------------- Live systems you'll help support and extend: * **Internal agent platform** — syncs and synthesizes account data, call transcripts, and performance signals across every client account, surfacing findings automatically * **Client\-facing report sites and dashboards** — hosted, JavaScript front ends backed by a SQL data layer and marketing\-data pipelines, live for a dozen\-plus client and internal audiences * **Workflow automations** — connecting data sources, chat, and email/calendar tools so reporting and account data move without manual steps Plus: * **The confidential new product** — a from\-scratch generative AI build for the media industry, where you'll help shape architecture and features from day one **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build and maintain full\-stack features across our Python/FastAPI backends, JavaScript front ends (Vue preferred), and SQL data layer * Work inside Claude Code daily: prompt and steer agentic coding workflows, review AI\-generated code and pull requests for correctness, and extend our library of custom skills and subagents * Debug and harden the data pipelines (marketing\-data extracts, SQL views, workflow automations) that feed client dashboards and internal agents * Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, GPT) for generative features — copy generation, insight extraction, creative/image analysis — in both the existing systems and the new product * Own deploys for live client\-facing sites and internal tools, including monitoring, rollback, and incident response * Collaborate with data, strategy, and account teams to translate reporting and media needs into working software * Document systems, prompts, and workflows so institutional knowledge isn't locked in one person's head * Contribute to architecture and feature decisions on the new confidential product alongside day\-to\-day support work **Our Stack \& Tools** ---------------------- * **Primary dev environment:** Claude Code — agentic coding, subagent workflows, custom skills. Comfort working AI\-assisted (directing and reviewing agent output, not only typing every line by hand) is a core requirement for this role, not a bonus skill. * **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQL (SQL Server / Azure SQL) * **Frontend:** Vue.js (React or Angular experience also useful — several of our tools are React) * **Data \& pipelines:** marketing\-data platforms, workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n), SQL databases * **Deployment \& infra:** Netlify, containerized cloud services, Git\-based version control * **AI:** Claude and GPT APIs, retrieval/vector search, agent orchestration patterns **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) * Proven full\-stack development experience, with genuine interest or hands\-on experience in AI\-assisted or agentic development — not just calling an LLM API, but working inside tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar * Solid backend skills in Python; front\-end proficiency in JavaScript, Vue preferred * Familiarity with LLM APIs, vector search, or media/marketing AI workflows is a strong plus * Experience with RESTful APIs, Git\-based version control, and agile workflows * Comfortable owning both greenfield build work and ongoing support/maintenance of live, client\-facing systems * Excellent collaboration and communication skills — this role works directly with data, strategy, and account teams, not only engineering Please be aware of fraudulent recruiters and scams. If you move forward in our recruitment process, you will only be contacted by the Direct Agents HR team. Questions? Email hrconcerns@directagents.com 9VUusog43S

requirements and help define the future\-state IES solution. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Conduct requirements analysis of existing state systems to support the implementation and modernization of an Integrated Eligibility System (IES). * Participate in **business rules extraction** efforts from existing/legacy state systems. * Perform quality control activities related to rules extraction, including: + Verifying **100% coverage** of identified business rules. + Ensuring extracted rules are accurate, complete, and consumable by business partners and business analysts. + Identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and ambiguities. * Work with agency business partners to determine which existing business rules should: + Carry forward into the future\-state system. + Be modified or transformed. + Be retired. * Document **as\-is and to\-be business and system requirements** using the IES\-prescribed business analysis methodology, processes, tools, and templates. * Develop and maintain business analysis artifacts, including: + Context diagrams + Business process flows + Workflow diagrams + Use cases + User stories + Requirements specifications + Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) + Data dictionaries + User interface specifications + Wireframes and mockups + Other project documentation as required * Conduct requirements elicitation sessions with: + State agency stakeholders + Local district subject matter experts + System users + Business analysts + Technical teams + Executive stakeholders * Facilitate stakeholder discussions to identify business needs, requirements, processes, rules, and system dependencies. * Translate business needs into clear and actionable functional and system requirements. * Ensure requirements and supporting work products align with business objectives, project scope, and IES modernization goals. * Support the development of future\-state workflows and processes for modernized eligibility systems. * Perform peer reviews of business analysis work products and participate in internal quality review processes. * Support project planning, roadmaps, testing activities, and change management as needed. * Develop or assist with **test scenarios and business validation activities**. * Collect and analyze information regarding legacy system interfaces. * Assist with documenting interfaces between state\-supervised and locally administered applications. * Draft and maintain **Interface Control Documentation (ICD)**. * Assist with determining the disposition of legacy/mainframe interfaces as part of the modernized solution. * Work effectively within blended teams consisting of state employees, contractors, vendors, business analysts, and technical resources. * Manage assigned deliverables according to established project timelines, priorities, and quality standards. * Communicate project findings, risks, issues, dependencies, and recommendations to appropriate stakeholders. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- ### **Experience** * **3–7 years of experience as an A ss analysis experience within state government**, preferably in the human services domain. * **3–7 years of experience focused on Eligibility, Enrollment, and Case Management (EECM).** * Demonstrated experience eliciting requirements from stakeholders and managing requirements throughout the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**. * Experience developing business and technical artifacts for complex modernization initiatives. * Experience producing: + Business process flows + User stories + Data dictionaries + Wireframes + Functional/technical specifications + Requirements documentation * **3–7 years of experience working on an Integrated Eligibility System (IES) modernization program** implementing transformed health and human services applications. * Experience working with systems and processes that align with applicable **state and federal human services standards**. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * **3–7 years of experience performing business analysis and workflow automation specifically for eligibility systems.** * Experience assisting with project planning and development of project roadmaps. * Experience creating business and system **test scenarios**. * Experience managing and documenting **change requests**. * Experience collecting and documenting legacy interface information for state\-supervised and locally administered applications. * Experience drafting **Interface Control Documents (ICDs)**. * Experience evaluating and assisting with the disposition of **mainframe/legacy interfaces** during modernization. * Experience working with large\-scale state human services modernization programs. * Experience collaborating with state agencies, local government organizations, system integrators, and vendor teams. * Strong understanding of eligibility, enrollment, and case management business processes. **Ideal Candidate** ------------------- The ideal candidate is a **business\-focused Automation Engineer/Business Analyst** who understands both
