Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. **Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics** Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote\-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud\-based scientific research R\&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. **We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.** **What do we need** Dotmatics is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team. We are building the most powerful R\&D AI\-Powered platform in the world. Luma is an AI\-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence, Luma fits the way our customers "do science". It allows scientists to streamline scientific research with adaptive R\&D workflows driven by AI and seamless data integration. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will be responsible for building robust, scalable features and ensuring the technical health of our codebase. We value engineers who are curious about AI and are motivated to find new ways to use AI in software development. **This is a hybrid role, requiring you to work from our Boston, US office twice per week.** This is no ordinary engineering role \- this is working on a product with real world meaning \- a product that helps define the way scientists works, helping bring medicine to market quicker, finding cures for diseases faster...This is LUMA **In this role you will** * Lead the development of complex, high\-impact features * Develop and maintain serverless and event\-driven data pipelines capable of handling high\-volume scientific data. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code. You will proactively identify technical debt and advocate for architectural improvements. * Partner closely with other team members to build intuitive user interfaces that simplify complex scientific research. * Provide technical guidance through thoughtful code reviews and pair programming, fostering a culture of continuous learning. * Support the reliability of our services by implementing observability and participating in the deployment and monitoring of your code in production. **We are looking for** candidates with 8\+ years experience in engineering preferably in a SaaS environment, and ideally with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent. You will be curious and inquisitive, questioning the why and the how, and will bring strong software engineering experience with NodeJs, React, Java, Go, C\# (or similar object\-oriented/backend languages). **The key skills we are looking for** * Proven experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and working with PostgreSQL. * Hands\-on experience with AWS services and a solid understanding of Docker/Kubernetes for container orchestration. * Experience working with message\-based architectures (e.g., Kafka) and event\-driven patterns. * A strong advocate for automated testing (unit, integration, E2E) and experience with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions or AWS CodePipeline. * Proficiency in Agile methodologies and a track record of delivering value in iterative cycles. **You may also have experience in** * Experience building and scaling complex data ingestion or processing workflows. * Experience with Terraform or similar deployment technologies. * Exposure to AWS/GCP or experience designing systems that can run across multiple cloud providers. * Experience leading small project teams or acting as a "feature lead". * Background in Life Sciences or R\&D data management. Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. **Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.**

jobs.title: Partnership Integration Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York City **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Product Solutions **About EliseAI** At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone. * **Housing**: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place. * **Healthcare**: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork. With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $250 million Series E round led by Andreessen Horowitz to accelerate this mission. **About The Role** As a Partner Solutions Engineer at EliseAI, you'll scope, design, and launch the integrations that connect our partners' systems to our platform. You'll work directly with our partners’ engineering teams to understand their product, guide them through our APIs, and shape how our systems connect. Internally, you'll coordinate with partnerships, engineering, and product teams while staying the partner's technical point of contact from kickoff through launch. With each integration, you'll turn what you learn into patterns, docs, and tooling that make the next partner faster to launch. You'll be building with a team that ships quickly, while shaping our partner ecosystem and directly contributing to our growth. **Key Responsibilities** * Be the technical lead for partners from discovery through production, getting to know their systems and workflows. Bring customers into the conversation when needed * Manage several integrations at once as the technical project manager, prioritizing across competing go\-live dates and keeping partners moving toward launch * Architect how EliseAI connects with each partner, including how data flows between systems and which APIs are used. Build toward standard patterns so partners in the same category can launch faster * Own testing and launch readiness so integrations go live successfully, then monitor performance after launch to catch issues before partners or customers do * Identify gaps in our own APIs and work with Engineering and Product to scope and prioritize the right solutions * Contribute to our developer docs, playbooks, and tooling, and turn recurring partner pain points into improvements that help shape what we build next **Move at rocket speed, build something massive.** We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard. **Requirements** * 3\+ years in a partner or customer facing technical role, such as technical consulting, solutions engineering, technical partnerships, integrations, or software engineering in a high growth tech environment or an adjacent field * Deep familiarity with APIs, webhooks, system architecture, and modern integration patterns. You can read and reason about code (Python or similar) * Experience working directly with external technical stakeholders, such as vendor or customer engineering teams * A track record of aligning cross\-functional teams and explaining technical tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Proven ability to prioritize across competing deadlines and execute on several projects at once * Demonstrated ownership and resourceful problem solving in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments **Why Join** Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you. **Benefits** In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits: * Equity in the company * Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100% * Fully paid parental leave * Commuter benefits * 401k benefits * Fitness \& home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters * A collaborative in\-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office * Unlimited vacation and paid holidays * We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful! **Job Compensation Range:** The salary range for this role is $135,000 \- $200,000 with the ability to earn overtime. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits \& perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors, including experience, skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process. Employment with EliseAI is on an “at\-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law. jobs.title: Vice President, Cyber AI
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Eliza is a technology services company and Advanced\-tier OpenAI partner that's dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **The Shape of the Role** ------------------------- Our VP Cyber is a practice leader first. You'll build and run Eliza's Office of the CISO, the security practice we're launching to help enterprise security leaders get ahead of AI\-driven threats. You'll own its revenue number, its client relationships, and the team that delivers the work. You'll report directly to the CTO and sit on Eliza's executive team. Here's why now: Software has never been easier to build, and it's never shipped with less security. AI\-assisted development is growing the amount of code every security team has to defend, and the same tools are making attackers faster. Security leaders feel that pressure today, and our partnership with OpenAI puts us in the room with them. Right now our technical leadership carries this work on top of their existing jobs. That got us early conversations with serious buyers. It won't get us a practice. This is the first hire in the function which means you will build the practice team, playbook, and book of business. You'll also own Eliza's internal security program. It's lean today, but it gets interesting fast: we build composable, adaptive AI software, and securing it is a problem nobody has fully solved yet. Two things to know before applying. First, we're an AI\-native firm and we work that way internally: this practice is scoped to start lean because we expect you to use AI tools aggressively across everything you do, from threat research and code review to proposals, client education, and delivery playbooks. If AI isn't already core to how you work, this role will feel impossible. Second, this is a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment. You'll get outcomes, not instructions. Priorities shift quickly, ambiguity is constant, and the bar is high. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Build and own the Office of the CISO practice** * Own the practice P\&L and revenue number starting from zero, including pricing, packaging, and which offers we lead with * Define our service lines across security assessments, red, blue, and purple team work, and security training, and decide where AI\-assisted delivery gives clients a real edge * Set the practice strategy with the CEO and hold it accountable to pipeline and revenue targets ### **2\. Lead with education and win CISO relationships** * Act as the face of the practice with CISOs and security leaders. Open doors, run executive briefings, and close engagements alongside our commercial team. * Build the thought leadership that makes Eliza the first call security leaders make: talks, briefings, workshops, and a clear point of view on AI and security * Sell by teaching. The CISOs we meet don't need a pitch. They need someone who has lived the problem and can explain what's changed. ### **3\. Own the OpenAI security partnership** * Act as Eliza's senior security counterpart to OpenAI's security and partner teams, and hold your own technically with their leadership * Turn partner leads and co\-sell opportunities into scoped, funded engagements * Meet and maintain the capability standards the partnership requires, starting with running security work on our own platform first ### **4\. Build the delivery organization** * Hire and lead the practice team of security engineers and consultants, starting lean and scaling with demand * Build repeatable delivery: workshop formats, assessment methods, evidence standards, and the quality bar every engagement is held to * Stay hands\-on. Early on, expect to be in the code, the findings, and the client room. ### **5\. Serve as Eliza's Security Leader** * Own Eliza's internal security program, policies, and posture as we grow * Define how we secure composable, adaptive AI software, a new threat surface without an established playbook * Treat Eliza as customer zero. What we learn securing our own platform becomes what we sell. **To be successful, we expect someone to have…** ------------------------------------------------ * Current or recent experience operating as a VP or equivalent security executive. You're already doing this job at a high level. * Experience building a services business, security consultancy, or managed or delivery services organization, including owning revenue * Credibility with CISOs as a peer. You can walk into a room with a Fortune 500 security leader and they lean in. * Deep technical roots. You still read code, understand how modern applications and cloud infrastructure break, and can pressure\-test a finding yourself. * A point of view on how AI changes attack and defense, backed by daily use. Show us how you use AI tools today to research threats, review code, and get more security work done, faster, at higher quality. * A track record of thought leadership: speaking, writing, advising, or teaching that has shaped how other security leaders think * A habit of owning outcomes, not tasks. You're comfortable building from zero with a revenue target and no playbook. * Willingness to travel frequently for client and partner meetings **And maybe…** -------------- * Experience in high\-stakes or highly regulated environments like financial services, national security, defense, or critical infrastructure * A background in offensive security, red teaming, or security research * Experience at a security services or penetration testing firm, or building a security practice inside a consulting firm * Firsthand experience leading an organization through a major security incident, and the lessons that came with it **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive executive compensation: base salary, meaningful equity, and upside tied to the growth of the practice you build * A seat on Eliza's executive team * Direct partnership with OpenAI's security organization on one of their top priority areas * Remote flexibility, with in\-person time where it matters * The chance to define what AI\-native security services look like for a whole market * Full ownership from day one. You're building the practice, not inheriting one.

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.description: If you are an Electrical Engineering graduate (BSE) and a natural born leader looking for an opportunity to launch a successful engineering career, Emerson has an exciting role for you! This position provides hands\-on technical leadership to Manufacturing Operations during the planning, introduction, integration, and production of complex test and measurement systems. jobs.title: STRUCTURAL ENGINEER II
jobs.description: Engineering Services \& Products Company seeks a Structural Engineer II in Dyersville, IA to independently coordinate and perform structural steel design for buildings and foundation elements. Candidate must be able to function as part of an engineering team as well as work closely with and advise design staff. Must have sufficient understanding of project execution and design engineering to thoroughly define project scope and determine budget estimations for the civil/structural portion of projects. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Perform and validate advanced structural and component\-level calculations and analyses (e.g., finite element, load path, connection, fatigue, and reliability analysis). * Develop engineering specifications and design criteria applying IBC, ASCE, AISC, and ACI codes and standards. * Review structural calculations, models, and drawings for technical accuracy and code compliance, and mentor junior engineers and interns. * Collaborate with manufacturing on design\-for\-fabrication. * Perform shallow and deep foundation and masonry design. * Serve as technical point of contact on bid review and engineering questions from sales, customers, building officials, and R\&D, and support new\-product development. * Other duties as assigned. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Experience working with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.) * Experience with RISA\-3D, RAM Advanse/Elements, CASTA, MBS or similar Structural Engineering software a plus * Experience mentoring ETIs * Specialization in structural building design is desired. Proficient in AISC and AISI material specifications, ASCE 7 and IBC * Strong technical and analytical aptitude, willing and able to research and learn complex topics with minimal guidance * Review and check structural drawings for completeness and accuracy * Ability to multi\-task and manage multiple activities/projects * Must have strong communication skills * Experience with project scheduling and management of multiple projects * Ability to work effectively in teams or alone * Able to maintain a results\-oriented demeanor in a fast\-paced environment Telecommuting/remote work permitted from various worksites throughout the United States after an initial period of at least 6 months at the primary worksite and with supervisor approval and frequent onsite visits. **Education and/or Experience:** Requires a Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or equivalent combination of education, experience, and training. **Language Skills**: Ability to read and interpret documents such as blueprints, operating instructions, and procedure manuals. **Computer Skills:** Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Power Point. jobs.description: ### **Senior Director, Process Excellence** * JR\-163861 * Hybrid * Toronto * Dallas * General Management * Full time **Who are we?** Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. **Job Summary** A lot of companies are still working out what AI means for how work gets done. At Equinix, this role sits at the center of that question. In this role, you’ll help decide how the company reimagines its most critical value streams leveraging AI, and how its leaders build the management habits that make the changes stick. The role also develops the management practices / operating system that put continuous improvement principles to work, drawing on lean principles, along with the toolset that supports them, in partnership with HR. In selected areas of focus, this leader coaches parts of the organization directly on building the operating system that sustains a culture of continuous improvement. Transformation * Facilitate working sessions with business leaders and forward\-deployed engineers to examine how work actually flows, find the structural bottlenecks, handoffs, and rework, and define the future flow before solutions are built * Bring Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream thinking together with process and process mining, so the redesign is grounded in how work runs today and aimed at measurable gains in speed, quality, cost, and decision\-making * Help business leaders design for decisions and outcomes rather than tasks, build intelligence into core workflows, and place AI, automation, and human judgment where each adds the most value * Advise senior leaders on where AI applies and where it does not, and challenge designs that only speed up an existing process * redesigned processes perform, so gains are sustained and drift is caught early * Establish a consistent approach across the enterprise to prioritizing, framing, and launching value stream redesigns scale, and build communities of practice in process redesign and AI\-enabled improvement so the capability spreads beyond this team * Assess how mature the practices are across the organization, jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **Hi! We're Forerunner.** ========================= Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high\-stakes decisions made without a complete picture. Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies. **About the role** ------------------ As a Deployment Specialist, you will own the end\-to\-end deployment experience for our customers — from discovery to go\-live — ensuring the outcome aligns with business impact. You’ll act at the intersection of strategy, project management, and operational delivery, collaborating with customers, internal teams, and technical resources to make deployments high\-quality, repeatable, and outcome\-driven. **What you'll do** ------------------ ### **Customer Discovery \& Planning** * Lead structured workshops with customers to uncover business objectives, operational constraints, and success metrics. * Translate findings into a clear deployment roadmap and set of deliverables. * Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and governance. ### **Project Leadership** * Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer during deployment. * Coordinate across cross\-functional teams (Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Success Manager, other internal stakeholders) to ensure alignment and momentum. * Proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and escalate when necessary. * Provide regular status updates to both the customer and internal leadership. ### **Solution Design \& Oversight** * Using both the product front\-end and Forerunner MCP, configure client systems and ensure system design stays aligned with business goals. * Work with the Forward Deployed Engineer to scope integrations and customizations. * Ensure that deployment deliverables map back to the business requirements and success criteria. ### **Customer Enablement \& Handoff** * Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) and drive readiness for go\-live. * Collaborate with the Customer Success Manager to ensure a smooth transition to the ongoing success phase. * Document lessons learned, refine the playbook, and drive continuous improvement across deployments. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 4\-6 years of experience in project management, SaaS implementation delivery, customer consulting, and operations. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant, North America
jobs.description: At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year. We believe in the power of our product. We continue to execute and build momentum as we develop our customer base with the world's top banks; we work with four of the five largest banks in the US, acquirers, processors, and merchants. In our fast\-paced and open environment, you will be working with a collaborative team spanning across the globe and delivering exceptional results. We are committed to building something extraordinary. **Join Us!** **You:** As a Senior Solutions Consultant at Feedzai, you will play an integral role in the sale of our leading RiskOps platform to high\-profile Financial Institutions. You will partner with Feedzai's sales team to understand clients, prospects and partners' business, functional and technical needs and demonstrate how those can be achieved through the capabilities of our platform. You not only support effective qualification, but also own the technical dimension that addresses the business needs \- you will successfully employ a combination of communication and soft skills, compelling storytelling, solution design and collaboration with a strong solutions design mindset to act as the trusted advisor with the clients. As needed you'll also be a bridge to our product and development teams, distilling sales engagement feedback for them to help guide our roadmap. Finally you'll have the organizational skills to do all this, and be able to lead multiple RFP proposals. **Your Day to Day:** * Provide product demonstrations and lead technical sales discussions both remote and onsite across Europe. * Assist the sales team in leading tailored value driven pitches (market to technology), strongly focused in financial crime. * Understand client business needs and offer solution designs to address those needs, in a continuous education mode and problem\-solving mindset. * Manage (orchestrate, complete, review, submit) formal Tenders (ie, RFPs, RFIs). * Build formal proposals and own its life cycle throughout the sales process to ensure crisp translation of business needs into technical requirements. * Engage with multiple stakeholders, from Product to Delivery, to ensure not only the right staffing for client engagements is in place but also to ensure market insights are shared across teams **You Have, You Know\-how, You are:** * BS or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent proven experience in Enterprise Software sales and strong technical acumen. * 5\+ years of professional experience as Solution Consultant in complex environments, supporting teams to land and expand client's portfolio. * Proven experience in the Financial Services industry \- Financial Crime * Relevant commercial / sales experience, with a track record working as a Solution Consultant / Pre\-sales Engineer, supporting quota carriers in selling enterprise\-level software in complex and mission\-critical environments. * Experience at a growth\-stage Enterprise software SaaS company. * Ability to understand and determine an enterprise's client's needs and how Feedzai's products might best fit through a consultative approach. * Strong business acumen with executive presence, strong presentation skills and excellent listening skills * Must be organized and a self\-starter, able to deliver high\-quality work without a tactical oversight in a fast\-paced environment. * Highly driven, organized, ambitious and tenacious. A natural problem solver with a strong student mentality, work ethic and positive mental attitude. * Willingness to travel up to 30% \- this is a remote role, with travel as required. **Your First 30\-Days at Feedzai:** You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one\-on\-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team! Life at Feedzai Instagram Feedzai Culture **Feedzai is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** **Feedzai does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.** **Feedzai will use the personal data you provide us with by filling out this form for reviewing your application and to potentially negotiate a contract with you. Your personal data will be retained by Feedzai for 24 months following your application. Please see our Privacy Notice available at https://www.feedzai.com/legal/feedzai\-candidate\-privacy\-policy/ and https://www.feedzai.com/legal/feedzai\-california\-candidates\-privacy\-policy/ for more information on how we process your personal data.**

jobs.description: **Overview:** This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States, with the ability to work Eastern Time Zone business hours. Analyze, code, test, and implement in coordination with management, associates, and end users. Serve as production system support by resolving issues and ensuring ongoing functionality. Requires advanced experience with Microsoft Team Foundation Server or similar code repository system. Requires in\-depth knowledge of Waterfall and Agile. Requires experience with control\-m jobs and file\-based transfer applications including Sterling and SFTP. Requires hands\-on experience with the following databases: SQL DB, ETL development and data integration strategies. Requires experience in cloud technologies including experience with AZDO and experience developing HELM charts to develop and automate Azure CI/CD pipelines. Requires knowledge of hosting software applications on containerized platforms including Kubernetes, Rancher, and OpenShift. Requires experience integrating applications with Amazon/NetApp S3 buckets and storage concepts using AWS SDKs and APIs. Requires experience with vulnerability remediation on containers and docker images. Requires experience in Java. Experience and skills can be gained before or concurrent with graduate degree. **Additional Information:** This job posting is expected to remain active for 31 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants. The base pay for this position is generally between $148,382 to $225,522 per year. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non\-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment. Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits. \#EJC \#LI\-DNI

jobs.title: Supervisor OT Network Security - Cyber Security & TSOC
jobs.description: ***FirstEnergy at a Glance*** We are a forward\-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger. FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor\-owned electric systems, more than 24,500 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid\-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of 3,780 megawatts. This position is within FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp. This position’s base reporting location is in Akron, Ohio with significant flexible work location opportunities. This position is within FirstEnergy’s Cyber Security Operations and reports to the Manager of Cyber Security Technologies. We’re looking for a strategic, technically skilled leader to shape the future of OT Network Security. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for the operation of OT network traffic analysis and visibility platforms protecting FirstEnergy’s realtime (OT) networks — including substations and other field/critical infrastructure locations — that ensure compliance with NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards, specifically NERC CIP\-015, for programmable electronic devices and networks within the OT environment in support of the electric grid. This role is responsible for responding to operational and cyber security incidents, including those affecting OT/ICS assets and BES Cyber Systems. This role works closely with IT Transmission Systems and other cybersecurity personnel. Responsibilities Include * Provides leadership across our suite of OT Network Security tools, ensuring that they are configured appropriately, have the proper visibility into our real\-time network, and are adhering FirstEnergy to NERC CIP Compliance standards. * Supervise a team responsible for providing visibility into the segmented operational technology networks through passive monitoring, network telemetry collection, communications analysis and intrusion detection supported by the IT Tx team for our OT/ICS environments. * Maintain a high level of technical knowledge of the platforms supported by the team, including network protection devices and security postures deployed across substations, generation facilities, data centers, and other OT/field locations connecting servers, routers, and other Layer 3 devices. * Experience in designing, building, and delivering automated access control solutions, i.e., least privilege and zero trust. * Coordinate activities to maintain security platforms and applications with the latest firmware, software, and security patches. * Assist the manager and director with coordinating team projects to engineer, design, configure, and administer platforms to deliver quality, secure, and functional solutions in support of FirstEnergy’s business objectives. * Partner with transmission and SCADA engineering teams on OT\-related communications protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850\) and build/maintain working relationships with OT partners to ensure security activities are coordinated and non\-disruptive to operations. * Responsible for managing staff performance by setting objectives, goals, priorities, tracking performance and providing feedback. Assists in personal growth of staff through individual development plans, mentoring, coaching and stretch assignments. * Respond and coordinate support requests and incidents that are received by the team. Assign work to team members and track progress. * Act as first point of escalation for team’s response to operational and security incidents 24/7 * Assist management with overseeing the complete lifecycle of all OT security\-related technologies \[JV1] \[AB2] deployed at FirstEnergy from design, implementation, replacement, to retirement, including budgeting. * Develop and maintain key relationships with vendors. Assist management with obtaining quotes for hardware, software, and services. * Assist leadership with defining staff goals and managing performance against goals and priorities. Directs personnel actions in accordance with the company’s guidelines and procedures. * Ensure security\-related systems meet all applicable regulatory requirements and adhere to cybersecurity policies. * Willing and able to travel to corporate locations, on a frequent basis, in support of cyber security initiatives. Assist management with leading team’s response to cyber security and operational incidents across FirstEnergy. * Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information security, or similar discipline required, along with 7\+ years of cyber security experience. * Must have experience installing, configuring, and administering various cybersecurity network visibility tools. * Ideal candidate will have direct experience working within a Cyber Security Operations team, with a strong understanding of the security platforms deployed. * Experience making strategic and tactical decisions derived from threat and risk\-based analysis of security information, while balancing the operational needs of the business. * Demonstrate a high level of technical expertise, with a strong understanding and knowledge of computer, network, and OT/IT security systems. * Demonstrate strong knowledge of core networking skills, specifically on network fundamentals, IP connectivity, and network access. * Demonstrate effective written and verbal communication skills which include creating and delivering presentations, briefs, and training sessions. * Must compose well\-written, professional documents and reports. * Ability to communicate complex and technical issues to a diverse population, orally and in writing, in an easily understood, authoritative and actionable manner. * Strong project management skills and experience in creating and managing project plans and resource allocation. * Demonstrate the ability to work effectively with people at varying levels within an organization to accomplish tasks and goals. * Experience with compliance activities such as: SOX, CIP. * Ability to effectively manage a large, budgeted portfolio, forecast and re\-forecast dollars for both Labor and OTL. * Strong knowledge of core architectural design principles to achieve optimal availability and disaster recovery availability. * Ability to travel on a frequent basis to other FirstEnergy buildings in the Akron area. Infrequent overnight business travel may be required throughout the FirstEnergy service territory. ***Benefits, Compensation \& Workforce Diversity*** At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. We are committed to rewarding individual and team efforts through our total rewards philosophy which includes competitive pay plus incentive compensation, a company\-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) savings plan with matching employer contribution, a choice of medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, and life insurance programs, as well as skills development training with tuition reimbursement. Please visit our website at www.firstenergycorp.com to learn more about all of our employee rewards programs. FirstEnergy proudly supports workforce diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with a disability. No recruiters or agencies without a previously signed contract. Unable to sponsor or transfer H\-1B visas at this time. ***Safety*** Safety is a core value for FirstEnergy and is essential to all of our business activities. We ensure employees have the tools, information, and processes to perform their duties in a manner that assures safety for themselves, their co\-workers, our customers and the public. Our goals are to provide a safe work environment, to maintain an accident\-free, injury\-free workplace, and to promote and maintain public safety. To meet these goals, we dedicate ourselves to achieving world\-class safety standards. ***Position Classification*** Exempt ***FirstEnergy Human Resources Team***

jobs.title: Marketing Technology Senior Developer
jobs.description: Overview: The Marketing Technology Senior Developer works in the office and designs, develops, integrates, deploys, and supports technology solutions that promote our marketing and digital experience capabilities following Marketing goals/metrics. You will report to the Vice President, Information Security, partnering with Marketing Technology, Enterprise Technology, Data \& Analytics, and external development teams. Translating complex requirements into secure, scalable, supportable solutions across websites, marketing platforms, data services, APIs, and cloud environments. **The Opportunity:** You will combine hands\-on application development with strong business partnership. We expect the developer to understand marketing workflows, to recommend practical technical approaches, to build and test solutions. This will include document designs, support releases across environments and troubleshoot production issues while continuously improving reliability and operational efficiency. **The Day\-to\-Day:** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain applications that support marketing websites, landing pages, lead generation, personalization, content delivery, and digital experience programs. * Translate business and technical requirements into clean, scalable implementations, working closely with Marketing Technology partners and internal or external development partners. * Build and maintain front\-end experiences using modern web technologies and frameworks, with emphasis on responsive design, accessibility, performance, reusable components, and maintainable code. * Develop and support back\-end services, APIs, serverless functions, data access logic, and integrations between marketing platforms and enterprise systems. * Create data\-processing patterns, including pagination, batching, replay or recovery options, error handling, regional failover behavior, logging, and monitoring. * Support marketing data and activation workflows by connecting content management, customer data, personalization, analytics, identity, and downstream campaign systems. * Contribute to the technical roadmap for marketing platforms, identifying opportunities to improve architecture, performance, scalability, security, and developer experience. * Partner with platform owners and solution architects to shape requirements for new features, integrations, and platform extensions. * Manage development work through established source control, peer review, testing, change management, approval, and release processes across development, UAT, and production environments. * Investigate incidents and defects, determine causes, implement durable fixes, and communicate status and technical effects clearly to partners. * Develop proofs of concept and lightweight internal tools or dashboards to validate ideas, improve operational visibility, and accelerate informed decision\-making. * Create and maintain technical documentation, solution diagrams, API specifications, deployment notes, support procedures, and operational runbooks. **Your Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * 4\+ years of professional experience in application development, front\-end engineering, full\-stack development, systems integration, or a closely related discipline. * Demonstrated experience delivering production software and integrations in enterprise or high\-availability environments. * Hands\-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern web application development. * Experience developing or consuming APIs and working with cloud\-hosted applications, services, or databases. * Analyze complex technical and business situations, evaluate options, and develop practical solutions. * Communicate technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Compensation:*** $120,000 \- $175,000 base salary per year in the state of WA. New hires should expect to start at the lower end of the range depending on experience * Eligible for a discretionary bonus based on firm and individual performance **Why Fisher Investments:** We work for a bigger purpose: bettering the investment universe. We take great pride in our inclusive culture, our learning and development framework customized for every employee, and our Great Place to Work Certification. It's the people that make the Fisher purpose possible, and we invest in them by offering exceptional benefits like:* 100% paid medical, dental and vision premiums for you and your qualifying dependents * A 50% 401(k) match, up to the IRS maximum * 20 days of PTO, plus 10 paid holidays * Family Support programs including 8 week Paid Primary Caregiver Leave, $10,000 fertility, family forming, and hormonal health assistance, and back\-up child, adult, and elder care * This is an in\-office role. Based on your role, tenure, and performance eligibility you may have the opportunity to participate in our hybrid work from home program. This program is subject to change. FISHER INVESTMENTS IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Our roles include designing new facilities, upgrading existing developments, evaluating safety, and assessing risks. This work is critical to accelerating the evidence\-to\-policy lifecycle in low\-resource settings by reducing the time researchers need to produce validated model results, and by holding supporting technology to scientific standards of validity and reproducibility. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Technical Execution \& AI Integration:** Produce well\-tested, maintainable code with strong use of CI/CD, code review, and modern quality practices. Use AI development tools to accelerate code development and improve quality, and share proven, best practice back to the team. * **Modeling Frameworks:** Build, evaluate, and deploy AI\-enabled modeling components with sound technical rigor, including data pipelines, context engineering, tool interfaces, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails. Work across IDM's modeling paradigms (agent\-based, compartmental, statistical) to develop robust and reproducible framework capabilities. * **Autonomy \& Delivery:** Independently plan and execute work across concurrent projects, coordinating with teammates to keep deliverables on track with minimal supervision. Communicate proactively when timelines or priorities shift and escalate risks clearly with proposed solutions. * **Problem Solving:** Structure open\-ended modeling problems into tractable components, driving clarity for the team on where to start. Apply mathematical and AI/ML techniques creatively to solve complex modeling challenges and unblock peers when needed. Track emerging AI methods and modeling tools relevant to the team and bring insights into current projects. * **AI for Scientific Research:** Design and build AI capabilities that refine how IDM researchers work, including summarization and synthesis of scientific literature, natural\-language access to research data, structured extraction from unstructured sources, and agentic workflows that help automate research tasks. Hold a high bar for scientific credibility, leveraging traceable output and human review where results inform policy decisions. * **Collaboration \& Partnership:** Build strong working relationships with IDM/PST researchers and LMIC\-based research partners to deliver solutions that accelerate research outcomes. Communicate clearly with both technical and research audiences, adapting to partner contexts and gaining buy\-in for engineering approaches. * **Team Culture \& Growth:** Exemplify team culture, DEI norms, and collaborative engineering practice for peers and more junior engineers. Serve as a reliable go\-to within the team for technical direction, design reviews, and problem escalation. **Your Experience** ------------------- * Typically, 5–8 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated impact in a research software or computational modeling context. * Hands\-on experience building with generative AI, including agent design, tool use, and context management, in production or research\-grade environments, along with a working grasp of how AI system quality gets measured and improved. * Knowledge of and hands\-on experience with computational modeling, such as agent\-based modeling (ABM), compartmental models, or statistical/ML approaches. * Demonstrated ability to deliver well\-tested, maintainable code within a CI/CD\-enabled engineering workflow. * Ability to work independently on multi\-week tasks, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and adapt priorities based on manager and team feedback. **Preferred Experience** * Experience collaborating closely with researchers, applied scientists, or domain experts in global health or public health settings. * Familiarity with open\-source software development practices, including contribution workflows, documentation standards, and community engagement * Exposure to cloud\-based data and compute platforms used for large\-scale analysis or simulation workloads. * Hands\-on experience with production AI system design, such as orchestration across long\-running tasks, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails, at a level that could help guide practice for a team. * Background in epidemiology, computational biology, infectious disease modeling, or scientific computing. * Experience working in LMIC contexts or designing software for use in low\-resource or low\-bandwidth environments. Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located. The Foundation does not provide immigration\-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g. H\-1B, O\-1, L\-1, E, OPT, STEM\-OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc.). We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features. Identify common\-platform capabilities, program\-specific needs, capacity gaps, duplicated infrastructure, and obsolescence risks. * **Partner with the PEM to drive integrated execution** * Work directly with the PEMs to integrate asset readiness into the platform execution plan. * Translate physical infrastructure needs into accountable owners, dates, dependencies, decision points, readiness criteria, and recovery actions. * Provide a single, decision\-ready view of bench and lab readiness, open issues, configuration risks, capacity constraints, and milestone confidence. * Drive asset\-related issues across organizational and technical boundaries from ambiguity to ownership, decision, implementation, and verified closure. Ensure asset readiness is visible through relevant GVDP, software\-quality, vehicle\-integration, and launch milestones. * **Govern configuration, Bench BOM, and release integrity** * Establish and maintain the Bench BOM for persistent HIL and regression environments. * Coordinate tech packages (eBoM), part numbers, required attributes, I/O configurations, software\-channel data, virtual models, variant rules, calibration content, harnesses, ECUs, instrumentation, and test\-support hardware. * Align deployed bench configurations to the version\-controlled eBOM and Teamcenter release model. * Ensure correct hardware, software, calibration, and configuration versions are built into Co\-Sim, HIL, CVF, and regression environments. Coordinate DSI and VPI eBOM releases, C with greater speed, repeatability, and confidence. By organizing the right assets, configurations, ownership, and operating rhythms, you will help GM move from disconnected benches and one\-off environments to a scalable enterprise capability. **Reports to:** Chief Engineer, Software \& Electronics Platform **Primary partners:** Program Engineering Manager, Software \& Electronics Platform **Leadership scope:** Technical leader and physical\-asset strategy owner for persistent HIL and validation infrastructure **Company Vehicle:** Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, through which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. jobs.description: This posting is for a new vacancy. In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Jose, CA, USA; Waterloo, ON, Canada**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field or equivalent experience. * 5 years of software development experience with one or more general purpose programming languages including but not limited to: GO, Java, Python, C/C\+\+, C\#, Objective C, Python, JavaScript, Kotlin. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Excellent problem\-solving skills and understanding of algorithms and their level of complexity. * Excellent software and systems troubleshooting and debugging skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software developers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for software developers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. jobs.title: Customer Engineer, Cloud AI, Google Cloud
jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role. * Experience with Machine Learning model development or deployment. * Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), agentic design patterns (e.g., tool\-use, multi\-agent collaboration), or integrating models into autonomous workflows via advanced API prompting or RAG. * Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a technical field. * Experience building machine learning solutions and leveraging specific machine learning architectures (e.g., deep learning, LSTM, convolutional networks). * Experience architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems. * Experience learning and working with new emerging technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud/IT technology space. * Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Jax, Ray), AI accelerators (e.g., TPUs, GPUs), model architectures (e.g., encoders, decoders, transformers), or using machine learning APIs. **About the job** ----------------- When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products. As a Practice Customer Engineer (CE) with a specialty in Cloud AI, you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in our most strategic product areas, in partnership with Platform CEs, to be writing code to develop prototypes, proofs\-of\-concept, and demos to sell new, highly specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI\-centered customer challenges and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development. You will have excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills, engaging with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge, and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $152000 \- $221000 (USD) \+ 42\.86% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Drive the technical win for complex workloads within Cloud AI to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the sales cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp. * Combine sales strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer\-tailored solutions that secure buy\-in from customer domain experts. * Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. * Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go\-To\-Market team. * Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues. jobs.description: This role is not eligible for U.S. immigration sponsorship.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment. * Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols. * Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting. * Must have the ability to work non\-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift\-based schedules as required. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program. * 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols. * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.). * Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment. * Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome challenges, and to adapt to changes in a dynamic work environment. **About the job** ----------------- Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state\-of\-the\-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $86000 \- $118000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions. * Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and applying the resources needed to resolve identified issues. * Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards. * Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end\-of\-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting. * Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance. Candidates must be able to work 100% onsite.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment. * Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols. * Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting. * Must have the ability to work non\-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift\-based schedules as required. * Must be available to travel to support business priorities as operationally required. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program. * 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols. * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.). * Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment. * Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome challenges, and to adapt to changes in a dynamic work environment. **About the job** ----------------- Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state\-of\-the\-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $86000 \- $118000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions. * Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and applying the resources needed to resolve identified issues. * Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards. * Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end\-of\-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting. * Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 7 years of experience in a professional creative domain (e.g., design, film, visual effects (VFX), marketing, or technical direction). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Advanced experience with Google Flow or related generative computing paradigms. Ability to naturally experiment, push technical boundaries, and solve complex pipeline puzzles. * Exceptional relationship\-building skills. Comfortable in a deep technical architecture review with client engineers and to host a public livestream or presenting to executive creative directors. * Ability to prioritize high\-leverage activities that have the highest return on investment (ROI) and ready to take initiative to make a client successful. You will lead cross\-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships. You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources. You will be a practitioner at heart—someone who learns by doing and constantly pushes what is possible with next\-generation creative computing. You will partner with our sales team to pitch major brands and studios, embed directly with creative directors to co\-create production\-ready workflows, and lead front of the camera to inspire our global community through tutorials and livestreams. This is a high\-leverage, high\-impact role designed for a bold builder who wants to shape the future of creative work. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Design and lead workshops, and build custom workflows tailored to our strategic clients' actual creative briefs and production pipelines. * Serve as an authentic public representative of Google Flow. Create high\-quality tutorials, case studies, and campaign content showcasing enterprise best practices. Host webinars and livestreams, and build reusable tools and assets for Flow’s public template library. * Synthesize firsthand customer friction and pipeline gaps from the field. jobs.title: Image Sensor Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, imaging related fields, or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience with imaging sensors, image processing, camera tuning. * 2 years of experience working in complementary metal\-oxide\-semiconductor (CMOS) imaging/electro optical systems. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field. * Experience translating system requirements to sensor specifications and down\-selecting image sensors for products (electrical, optical, sensor etc.). * Experience scripting in MATLAB/Python. * Knowledge of FPGA, SPAD, ISP, major SOC platforms, computer vision, or machine learning. * Basic knowledge of image sensor design: pixels, analog readout and serial interfaces. **About the job** ----------------- Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct\-to\-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration. The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $132000 \- $189000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Derive ERS (Engineering Required Specification) and image sensor handbook for the Mobile, Home and AR/VR applications. * Test, validate and evaluate various image sensors at the board, camera module and device level and FA, EFFA at the different production stages to deliver best\-quality image sensors. * Derive the new sensor key matrix, test methodology and algorithm to validate and evaluate image sensors for various applications to assess how the image sensors perform in the real use cases. * Set\-up new test environments and equipment to perform robust, reliable and consistent test results regardless of time, place and people. * Work with the cross functional teams to ensure the smooth and flawless integration of image sensors into the final products. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in a customer or client\-facing role supporting supply chain, logistics, or vendor relations. * 5 years of experience building relationships with stakeholders or clients. * 5 years of experience identifying issues in processes and creating solutions, and working with cross\-functional teams. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * MBA or Master's degree. * 3 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights in order to guide business decisions. * Experience with data center logistics. * Ability to work independently and as part of a cross\-functional team. * Ability to apply structured thinking and logic to work and provide innovative solutions to issues. **About the job** ----------------- Google Cloud Logistics Operations team is focused on operating our logistics and supply chain in support of our internal and external customers with the goal of delivering on\-time, in full and utilizing efficient practices and waste reduction methodologies. In this role, you will be the leader of how Google optimizes daily logistics processes while incorporating current industry standards and best practices. You will be responsible for driving continuous process improvement recommendations, managing the implementation of changes within operations, standardizing user documentation, creating processes that motivate action, and interacting with all partner teams. You will initiate and oversee operational improvement efforts for Google Cloud Logistics, analyze operational impacts to inform improvements, work with key stakeholders, motivate innovation within the operational teams, and create presentations or documents for the leadership team highlighting operational performance and improvements. This work will interact with both data center operations and warehouse operations as well.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running.
