jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role. * 2 years of experience taking software products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc). * Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows. * Experience building or implementing AI/ML\-driven features or infrastructure (e.g., working with LLMs, NLP, or data pipelines) ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in a technology or business related field. * 2 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering and business stakeholders in a geographically distributed environment. * 2 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders. * 2 years of experience in software development or engineering, with a strong understanding of infrastructure components, APIs, and scaling data\-intensive platforms. * Experience with prompt engineering, model evaluation, or deploying AI solutions in an enterprise environment. * Industry experience in either the data domain, enterprise platforms or infrastructure. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. Corporate Engineering is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the systems that keep the company running smoothly, ensuring Google remains the world's leading provider of enterprise technology solutions. Within Corporate Engineering, the Enterprise Data and Governance team is evolving the Enterprise Data Platform to create a data ecosystem that is operationally ready for the next generation of artificial intelligence; expanding our scope to support traditional data scenarios while simultaneously upgrading our infrastructure for an agentic future. As the Product Manager, you will build organizational and product strategy, focusing on how we transition our infrastructure from passive inventory to an active semantic engine. You will drive the development of high\-integrity, certified data products that enable autonomous workflows and resolve complex, cross\-domain challenges across the enterprise. At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Product Strategy and Operations Principal, Cloud AI
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company. * Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross\-functional programs or projects. * Experience building go\-to\-market strategies. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with advanced SQL, Python, and BigQuery. * Understanding of enterprise software business models. * Ability to deconstruct complex, legacy operations and architect an Agentic AI replacement that achieves a step\-function improvement in throughput or time\-to\-insight * Ability to identify problems, design projects to address, execute with little guidance, and guide the work of more junior team members. * Ability to independently drive complex projects with multiple executive stakeholders to successful completion. * Ability to ramp up quickly on a wide range of topics from accounting business recognition to AI/ML applications. **About the job** ----------------- Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines. Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands. Cloud AI aims to enable the world's enterprises to undertake digital transformation through AI technologies and powerful solutions designed to create real business value. As the Principal of Product Strategy and Operations (PS\&O) for Cloud AI, you will lead the evolution from legacy cloud AI structures to Agentic ecosystems. You will be responsible for the Intelligent Data Platform roadmap, moving the organization from a reactive What data do we have? posture to a proactive, intent\-driven What data do we need? architecture. This role is for a leader who can bridge the gap between high\-level statistical modeling and global operational scale. You will sit at the intersection of generative AI development and commercial execution. You will act as a strategic partner to VP level leadership, translating complex AI infrastructure needs into actionable business roadmaps and GTM strategies. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6 years of experience working with client\-side web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or HTTP). * 6 years of experience coding with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C\+\+, Python). * Experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. * Experience in an analytical role such as business intelligence, data analytics, or statistics. * Experience working with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL). * Experience with cloud technologies such as architecting, developing, or maintaining cloud solutions in virtualized environments or cloud data engineering. * Experience using Machine Learning and building solutions. * Experience working with systems (e.g., Linux, Unix). **About the job** ----------------- In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Addison, TX, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Thornton, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical field, business, operations, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in program management. * Experience working within networking, data center, or telecommunications infrastructure environments. * Experience with network infrastructure security or experience with operational hardware product management (e.g., defining hardware product roadmaps, prioritizing backlogs, or managing product lifecycles). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience delivering technical programs within hyperscale cloud environments, large\-scale telecommunications, or global infrastructure sectors. * Experience maintaining relationships with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) hardware vendors and influencing product development or roadmaps. * Experience in operational product management, lifecycle planning, or New Product Introductions (NPI) for physical hardware portfolios. * Experience managing complex stakeholders and driving alignment across organizational silos without direct authority. * Practical understanding of network\-layer or physical infrastructure security frameworks. * Ability to act as a pragmatic speaking partner for internal security organizations, translating security requirements into operational deliverables. **About the job** ----------------- A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the Edge Capacity Delivery team, you will drive critical strategic initiatives that maintain and secure our connection to the outside world. This unique leadership role bridges two distinct and critical domains: operational product management for our global Content Delivery Network (CDN) hardware portfolio, and the implementation of our edge security frameworks. In this position, you will optimize quality and efficiency for a massive, globally distributed hardware fleet. On the product side, you will guide standard Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) hardware through its full lifecycle, influencing vendor roadmaps and navigating supply chain complexities. On the security side, you will act as a pragmatic speaking partner to our security organizations, focusing on physical site and network\-layer security rather than application\-level software vulnerabilities. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role requiring exceptional stakeholder management, program leadership in ambiguous hyperscale environments, and ability to influence without authority across complex organizational silos. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Direct cross\-functional initiatives to execute security strategies and frameworks across globally distributed edge infrastructure, acting as a pragmatic liaison to security organizations with a focus on network\-layer and physical site security. * Serve as the operational product lead for the edge caching and Content Delivery Network (CDN) hardware portfolio, developing comprehensive product roadmaps and prioritizing engineering backlogs. * Lead end\-to\-end lifecycle management and introduction processes for new edge hardware generations, developing deployment plans to ensure capacity reliability and seamless integration. * Collaborate directly with third\-party hardware vendors and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) to influence vendor product roadmaps, evaluate technical specifications, and navigate supply chain complexities. * Serve as the primary operational conduit between engineering teams and internal business stakeholders, translating customer delivery requirements and technical network capabilities into structured operational plans. jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Chicago, IL or New York, NY Base Salary Range: $200,000 \- $250,000 *(Base salary is only one part of Group One Trading's total compensation, which includes an annual discretionary bonus.)* **THE OPPORTUNITY** Our Principal Data Engineer owns the architecture and technical direction of the data platform that powers trading analysis, reporting, and decision\-making across Group One. They work closely with traders, risk, finance, and technology leadership to understand how data is produced and consumed across the firm, and translate those needs into a platform designed for reliability, scalability, and long\-term evolution. Data usage is expanding rapidly across every part of our firm, and we are building a next\-generation data platform to support it. Our existing Microsoft\-based environment gives us a strong foundation and deep understanding of our data as we design what comes next. This role will define that future: evaluating technologies, selecting the architecture, establishing engineering standards, and defining a migration strategy that delivers value early while moving us deliberately toward the target platform. You will partner closely with our Senior Data Engineers who serve as the primary builders of the platform and provide technical leadership to the broader data team throughout the transition. We are looking for someone who has designed modern data platforms before, has lived with the consequences of their own architectural decisions, and knows how to make decisive technical choices while remaining open to being challenged by the engineers building alongside them. **THE SKILLSET** * Extensive experience designing, building, and evolving production data platforms, including at least one significant modernization or migration from a legacy architecture * Deep expertise in modern data architectures and the trade\-offs among cloud data warehouses, lakehouses, batch and streaming systems, orchestration frameworks, transformation tooling, and event\-driven architectures * Experience evaluating and working with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, dbt, Kafka, or comparable platforms * Strong command of data architecture principles, including data modeling, storage and compute architecture, governance, lineage, security, reliability, and cost management * Expert\-level SQL and strong proficiency in Python or a comparable language, with the ability and inclination to remain hands\-on * Working familiarity with the Microsoft data stack\-including MSSQL, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, and Power BI\-sufficient to understand existing workloads and design a pragmatic migration path * Experience establishing engineering standards around infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, testing, observability, and data quality * Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring experienced engineers, driving architectural decisions, and building consensus across teams with competing requirements * Sound judgment around architectural trade\-offs, build\-versus\-buy decisions, vendor selection, and production change risk * Ability to communicate complex architectural decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **WHAT TO EXPECT AS A PRINCIPAL DATA ENGINEER** **Within 1 month**, you will understand our existing data environment, the systems that feed it, and the teams that depend on it. You will work directly with traders, risk, finance, operations, and technology leadership to understand our highest\-value data use cases, current limitations, and long\-term objectives. **Within 3 months**, you will have assessed our existing data landscape and established the target architecture for our next\-generation platform, including technology selections, build\-versus\-buy decisions, migration strategy, and implementation sequencing. Working alongside our Senior Data Engineers, you will validate the architecture against real workloads, establish engineering standards, and begin putting the first components into production. **Within 6 months**, you will have production workloads operating on the new platform and a repeatable pattern for migrating additional datasets, pipelines, and reporting workloads. You will be leading the technical direction of the data engineering team, developing the engineers around you, and partnering with technology and business leadership on the longer\-term roadmap for data at Group One. **THE BENEFITS** *Our Principal Data Engineer earns a competitive salary, including a performance\-based bonus. We provide fantastic benefits, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k) retirement plans with employer matching, medical, dental, vision, generous vacation time, paid holidays, parental leave, and flexible spending accounts (FSA) for health care, dependent daycare, and parking or mass transit expenses.* *If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, apply today! Please fill out our initial 3\-minute, mobile\-friendly application for the Principal Data Engineer role. We look forward to meeting you!*

jobs.title: Influencer and events manager
jobs.description: What Hackmamba does We are an AI\-native developer marketing agency. Our clients are devtools and B2B SaaS companies who need to reach one of the hardest audiences in software, engineers who are marketing\-allergic and make decisions based on what they can actually build. Why this role exists Clients come to Hackmamba for growth. Content gets them part of the way there. The rest depends on getting their products in front of the right audiences, in creator feeds and on stages where developers already pay attention. This role builds and runs both of those channels for our clients. In your first three to six months, you will: * Build and onboard a creator network across TikTok, X, YouTube, and LinkedIn with a combined reach of 100,000 people, ready to run client promotions and early access programs. * Host 10 events around the world every month, mixing in\-person meetups with virtual sessions What you will do * Find, vet, and onboard creators whose audiences match our clients' buyers. Keep that network active, organized, and ready to go on short notice. * Run creator promotions for clients from brief to report, including rates, deliverables, timelines, and disclosure requirements. * Own the events calendar. You will pick cities and formats, secure venues, partners, and speakers, and run each event from the first invite to the follow\-up. * Run virtual events such as livestreams, X Spaces, webinars, and workshops alongside in\-person meetups and conference side events. * Work with our content, distribution, and growth teams so every creator campaign and event feeds into each client's wider growth plan. * Track what each campaign and event produces, from reach and attendance to signups and product adoption. Share what you learn with clients and the team. * Manage budgets and vendors across creators and events, and tie every dollar to results. What we are looking for * You have **3 to 6 years of experience** in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, community, or event management, and ideally you have done both. * You have built a creator network before and can show the reach, engagement, and conversions it produced. We will ask about them. * You have run events end to end, both in person and online. You know what it takes to fill a room and keep a livestream audience watching. * You live on these platforms. You know how TikTok, X, YouTube, and LinkedIn each work, what creators on each one expect, and what makes developer audiences tune out. * You stay organized at volume. Ten events a month and a growing creator roster means many moving parts, and you keep track of all of them. * You communicate well with creators and clients, and you keep things moving when plans change. * We prioritize agency experience. Experience in tech, devtools, or B2B SaaS is a strong plus. The setup * **Salary**: $36,000/yr * **Where**: fully remote, based in the US or Europe, with priority for the Central European Time zone. * **Type**: full\-time, with some travel for in\-person events. * **How we work**: outcome\-based. We care about what your creators and events deliver for clients, and you decide how to get there. How we are We love what we do. We are builders. We ship. We give each other real feedback. We do not do performative hustle, and we do not do meetings that should have been a Loom. When you apply Send these three things: * A short note on why this caught your eye * Examples of creator campaigns or events you have run, with links, recaps, or anything else that shows how you think and what you drove * The metric you are most proud of, and the context behind it Pay: $36,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Tell us about a creator or influencer network you built or managed. How many creators were in it, which platforms were they on, and what was their combined reach? * What is the highest number of events you have run in a single month? Share the mix of in\-person and virtual events and one result you are proud of Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
jobs.description: **ABOUT HAPPY MONEY** ===================== Happy Money is a consumer finance company that empowers people to achieve their goals through simple, transparent loans funded by trusted financial institutions. Through its proprietary lending platform, Hive, Happy Money delivers a fully digital experience that simplifies borrowing for consumers and helps credit unions, banks and asset managers diversify balance sheets and scale with confidence. Happy Money's end\-to\-end loan origination and participation programs provide partners with turnkey access to high\-performing assets, underpinned by disciplined credit expertise and robust risk management. Together with its lending partners, Happy Money has originated more than $7 billion in loans to help nearly 350,000 people take greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com. View our Employee Privacy Policy here. Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed company. Remote work doesn't mean less work, we work full\-time jobs and show up to them fully every day. To learn more about our values and the way we work, review our Happy Money Way Overview! **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ Happy Money's Engineering team is seeking to hire a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, deploy, and own consumer applications, infrastructure, and data\-delivering products and services in support of Happy Money's lending business. You will work in an autonomous environment, and be able to take general direction and formulate specific tasks to accomplish the desired results for Happy Money Customers. You have a strong sense of product ownership and a customer mindset. You will work to contribute to complex functional specs and design docs when necessary. **RESPONSIBILITIES** -------------------- * Develop and build products that provide an exceptional customer experience for our members. * Own design, test, development and delivery of new and existing features. * Participate in all phases of the software development life cycle. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, business owners, and other engineers to identify the best solutions. * Demonstrated experience driving engineering efficiency through the adoption of AI\-driven coding agents and agentic workflows, to autonomously build, test, and ship complex React applications at scale. * Experience implementing automated frontend testing for critical components and user workflows. * Capable of working in isolation to design solutions to complex problems. * Design and develop maintainable, scalable, fault\-tolerant, and efficient systems. * Upholding code quality to ensure features are up to standards to deliver a quality product. * Prioritize team needs in technical debt and tooling to relieve operational load and evolve the system to meet the changing needs of the environment. * Bring positive energy into meetings and ensure all coworkers feel valued and included in every interaction. * Mentor other frontend engineers across the Engineering team. * Demonstrate a proactive mindset by defaulting to action, taking initiative to address challenges, and driving projects forward. **ABOUT YOU** ------------- * 5\+ years building production React applications, with deep expertise in React, hooks, and component architecture at scale. * You have production experience developing in ReactJS, CSS, GraphQL, Javascript, NodeJS, and are a polyglot with working knowledge of Python, Java, and the ability to pick up new languages and technologies quickly. * Delivering a product across the entire technology stack motivates you more than working in an individual silo of frontend or backend, but you have a stronger affinity and experience building frontend user interfaces and UI based SDKs for other developers. * Believe strongly in testing everything you design and develop using automation. * Ability to scope, scale, and prioritize tasks to help team project plan and deliver on their milestones, delivering results over clear and ambiguous business and technical projects. * You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. * You are results\-oriented, and know how to unblock yourself and others to achieve goals and objectives. * Familiarity with AWS technologies \- EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, etc. * You have production experience developing scalable/highly available consumer applications. * You have a BA/Master degree in Computer Science or related field of study or equivalent work experience. **BENEFITS \& PERKS** --------------------- * Generous medical, dental, and vision insurance options * Eligible for Annual Bonus * 401k Plan with a matching contribution * Generous PTO including sick leave, vacation, volunteer, and more * 12 Weeks Paid Parental Leave * Company\-paid short \& long term disability and life insurance * Monthly tech stipend to help cover expenses for remote work * Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed workforce

jobs.title: Flight Operation Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Harmattan AI is a next\-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1\.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission\-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real\-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. ### **About the Role** As a **Flight Operations Engineer**, you will be the bridge between our R\&D lab and the operational field. You are responsible for the "last mile" of our technology: demonstrating capabilities to global defense partners, training end\-users on complex autonomous systems, and conducting final field validation. This role requires a unique combination of elite piloting skills, hands\-on hardware engineering and high degree of technical autonomy. ### **Responsibilities** * Test Campaigns: Plan and execute real\-world test campaigns to validate performance, reliability, and edge\-case behaviors of new hardware and software releases. * Lead high\-stakes live flight demonstrations for defense stakeholders, showcasing mission\-specific capabilities in diverse environments. * Deliver comprehensive training programs to ensure clients can safely and effectively operate Harmattan AI systems covering flight theory, autonomous mission planning, and emergency procedures. * Cross\-Team Collaboration: Work closely with hardware, software, and systems teams to support debugging and iteration based on test outcomes. * Execute the deployment and the tactical logistics of autonomous systems, managing the end\-to\-end integration of command\-and\-control (C2\) infrastructure and RF data links in complex, real\-world environments to ensure 100% mission readiness ### **Candidate Requirements** * 2–5 years of experience in flight operations, flight testing or validation on aerospace or robotic systems, or embedded robotics. * Proven track record in the end\-to\-end assembly, integration, and maintenance of high\-performance FPV, multicopters and/or Fixed\-Wing systems. * Wide engineering culture around flight dynamics, control systems, avionics, and/or RF systems. * Bonus: Pilot certification, experience with military or industrial drone platforms. * Detail\-oriented with excellent documentation and organizational skills. * Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide teams toward success. * Proven ability to simplify complex technical concepts for training and public presentations. * Comfortable with a dynamic schedule that requires frequent international presence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing US
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Harmattan AI is a next\-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1\.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission\-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real\-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. **About the Role** ------------------ As Head of Marketing, US, you will build Harmattan AI’s marketing function in the United States from the ground up, working in close alignment with the Global Head of Marketing. Harmattan AI’s core company, mission, product positioning, and brand are global and centrally defined. You will be responsible for translating that strategy into the U.S. market, shaping how it is communicated and activated across the U.S. defense ecosystem while maintaining a consistent global identity. You will lead U.S. product marketing execution, events, communications, and employer branding, moving constantly between strategy and hands\-on delivery. This role suits a builder who can adapt global direction to U.S. customers and stakeholders, create the processes needed to execute effectively, and deliver at speed. **Responsibilities** -------------------- U.S. Strategy \& Positioning * Develop and execute the U.S. marketing strategy and rolling 12\-month calendar, aligned with global marketing. * Establish U.S. messaging architecture adaptation across company, product, customer, and mission levels. * Activate the Harmattan AI brand for U.S. audiences. * Own U.S. positioning for Harmattan's product portfolio, grounded in real operational use cases. Product Marketing \& Sales Enablement * Build and maintain a library of U.S. collateral: capability briefs, one\-pagers, white papers, and customer presentations. * Create a repeatable process for rapidly producing materials supporting BD, capture opportunities, and customer engagements. * Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, accurate messaging for operational and acquisition audiences. * Direct photo and video capture at demonstrations to produce compelling, credible visual storytelling. Communications, Events \& Employer Brand * Own U.S. public relations and earned\-media strategy, building relationships with defense media and analysts. * Execute U.S. events and trade\-shows across defense conferences, symposiums, and demonstrations. * Support executive communications, including talking points, briefs, announcements, and high\-visibility media engagements. * Build U.S. employer\-branding and digital campaigns supporting the growth of the Austin operation. Leadership \& Performance * Define U.S. marketing KPIs tied to pipeline, customer engagement, recruiting, and market credibility. * Manage agencies, contractors, and event vendors, and build the future U.S. marketing team. **Candidate Requirements** -------------------------- * Significant experience building or scaling marketing at a U.S. defense technology, aerospace, autonomy, or national security company. * Experience in a high\-growth defense technology environment is strongly preferred. * Deep fluency in the U.S. national security ecosystem and how to communicate credibly with defense audiences. * Proven ability to market sophisticated technology accurately, without buzzwords or overclaiming capability. * Track record across product marketing, executive communications, event strategy, thought leadership, and sales enablement. * Hands\-on operator who personally produces work at speed, rather than only managing agencies or teams. * Experience working with veterans, engineers, operators, and government customers is highly valued. * A strong portfolio of prior work is required; a relevant bachelor's degree is preferred but secondary to demonstrated performance. * Full commitment to Harmattan AI's mission and a readiness to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

mentoring young professionals * Extensive experience in the use of procedures and workflows in the execution of projects * Significant previous experience in engineering planning for the discipline * jobs.title: Clinical Engineer Associate
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Healthcare needs a better rhythm: one that keeps care continuous and deeply human. Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that works alongside clinicians to make that possible. We're a team of doctors, engineers, designers, researchers, and creatives building tools that help clinicians stay focused on what matters most: their patients. In just 18 months, Heidi has given back more than 18 million hours to healthcare professionals, supporting 73 million patient visits in 116 countries. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi worldwide. Backed by significant venture funding, we're growing rapidly across the US, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with leading health systems and thousands of clinicians globally. **The Role** ------------ As a **Clinical Engineer Associate**, you’ll be the person who makes Heidi actually work in the real world. Serving as the technical counterpart to the Applied AI Managers, you’ll work to translate customer business needs into agentic solutions helping customers realize what's possible with our platform. You'll own the full technical lifecycle from first deployment through to a thriving, self\-sufficient customer: building custom clinical and operational workflows, debugging production issues, and becoming a trusted technical partner to the clinicians and operational teams you work with. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work directly with clinical and operational stakeholders to design and build custom workflows that fit how care is actually delivered. * Be the escalation point for complex agentic issues — diagnosing problems, coordinating with engineering, and closing the loop with the customer. * Lead demos, technical discussions, and solution architecture for clinical AI workflows * Define what success looks like for each deployed workflow, then build the evaluations that prove it * Visit the clinics and hospitals we work with, so you understand the teams we're building for firsthand * Own the margin trade\-offs on when to build, customise or roll out existing knowledge flows * Run the safety audits and recommend constant eval refinements **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years in an implementation engineering, or customer\-facing technical role \- ideally in SaaS, healthtech, or enterprise software. * Comfortable owning ambiguous, high\-stakes problems end\-to\-end without a playbook. * Sharp communicator \- you can explain a complex integration failure to a CTO and a head nurse in the same breath. * Experience working embedded with enterprise customers or health systems is a strong plus. **Other Things To Know** ------------------------ * This role can be based in\-office in either New York or San Francisco. * You will work directly on North America's most important commercial problems. * You will have significant autonomy and ownership from day one. **The Way We Work** ------------------- * **Live Forever**: We build for healthcare's next decade, not next quarter. We set outrageous targets, lead healthcare forward, and follow the evidence, even when it's uncomfortable. * **Practice Ownership**: Everyone here carries the company. We raise the bar on hiring and excellence, own the outcome end\-to\-end, and focus on what matters over process. * **Move Fast, Fix Faster**: The more we do, the more we learn. We ship atoms daily, learn from every release, and stay precise at pace. * **Get Better**: The best clinicians teach. So do we. We live in clinicians' reality, bring warmth to the work, and choose clarity, not cleverness. **Why You Will Flourish With Us** --------------------------------- * Become an owner, with significant shares (equity) in the company. If Heidi wins, we all win. * Healthcare, Dental and Vision benefit options. * 401k with 3% match. * $100/month Healthy Heidi's budget. * $700/year learning and development budget. * $500 home office setup budget. * Recharge Days after major pushes. * The rare chance to create a global impact as you immerse yourself in one of the world's fastest\-growing healthtech companies. Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t\_uJ\-A?si\=oSMy5zQeUcb\_faE3 **Multiple Openings:** Applications accepted on an ongoing basis. **Summary:** Electrical Engineers and Electrical Designers are responsible for the design, coordination, documentation, and delivery of electrical building systems for our Mission Critical Data Center practice. Individuals will perform engineering calculations, prepare and review design documents, coordinate with project teams, manage tasks or projects, provide technical leadership, mentor others, and support business development activities. (Multiple Openings) Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. **Henderson's Electrical Services:** * Power Systems Design \& Distribution * Low \& Medium Voltage Design * Emergency \& Standby Power Generation * Lighting Systems \& Controls Design * Lightning Protection * Grounding Design * Fault Current \& Overcurrent Coordination Studies * Arc Flash Studies * Emergency Egress Illumination * Solar \& Wind Power Design * more.. **Responsibilities:** * Prepares design documents under the supervision of experienced engineering and design staff. * Supports the review of shop drawings for conformance to plans and specifications. * Assists with engineering calculations as directed. * May support business development or pursuit activities under direct supervision. * Occasionally You deserve it!) * Financial Wellness \& Coaching Program (Financial security makes you a happier team member.) More information can be found here \- https://www.hendersonengineers.com/careers/. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Strategist (NYC)
jobs.description: **Grab your cape, become a SuperHyro!** Hyro, the leader in Responsible AI Agents for Healthcare, enables health systems to safely automate workflows and conversations across their most valuable platforms, services, and channels \- including call centers, websites, SMS, mobile apps, and more. You'll be part strategist, part technologist, and part change agent, and you'll help write the playbook for a function that doesn't exist anywhere else at Hyro yet. You don't need to write production code, but you can hold your own with engineers and explain it to executives. * A product mindset: you can articulate why a specific capability matters to a specific user in a specific workflow. * A track record of building trust fast and moving stakeholders from "interesting" to "let's do it." * Willingness to travel to client sites regularly (approximately 25%). **Advantages:** * Experience at a healthtech company or with health\-system customers * Hands\-on experience with ML, AI, or NLU products **This is a hybrid role, with at least three days per week in our NYC office. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis.** The salary range for this NY\-based position is $110k – $170k annually, exempt,based on experience, qualifications, and skills. jobs.title: Engineering Internship
jobs.description: IDEMIA Public Security, a division of IDEMIA Group, is the leading provider of secure and trusted biometric\-based solutions, transforming public and private organizations across the globe. Our industry\-enabled and client\-specific solutions draw upon decades of expertise in biometrics to revolutionize the fields of public security, justice and public safety, travel and transport, identity, and access control. Built on privacy and trust, our market\-leading iris, fingerprint and facial recognition solutions top independent benchmarking for accuracy, fairness and scalability. These exacting standards enable our clients to build safer, fairer societies where people can live, interact, and move about freely. With 4000\+ employees around the world and 150\+ partners worldwide, we offer more than just a job \- we provide a dynamic environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your talents are valued. Be part of a global leader shaping the future of biometric based technology. Learn more **here**. The Device Platform Engineering team (Delivery Optimization, IDEMIA Public Security) is building mature CI/CD practices for the fleet of field devices that run enrollment, and we're hiring a hands\-on intern to help get there. Our aim is a delivery pipeline where software reaches devices in a fully automated way, every change is validated before it lands, the state of the fleet is continuously visible, and fixes are verified across the fleet rather than assumed. The organizing idea is a maturity climb: we move each piece of work from React (done manually, one device at a time) to Repeat (a documented process a person runs consistently) to Automate (the system runs it without hands) to Optimize (making that automation faster, safer, and self\-healing), and you'll help push real work up those rungs. You'll help package software for automated deployment, build the validation that confirms a deployment actually worked, contribute to fleet inventory and drift detection, help verify security fixes across the fleet, and turn manual steps into repeatable automation, learning modern endpoint management, scripting, CI/CD, and security operations along the way, with engineers pairing with you and AI tooling as a baseline part of the work. No prior experience is required; what matters is curiosity, clear communication, and a verification mindset, wanting evidence something did the right thing, not just that it ran. The role is scoped to non\-credentialed work, and its projects are meant to become self\-sustaining rather than babysat, so you finish with a portfolio of real, demonstrable outcomes. Important Dates: Start Date: May 17, 2027 End Date: Aug 6, 2027 Note: This is a hybrid role, you must be able to travel to the office. The US hourly rate for this position is $25\.

jobs.title: Manager Data Science - Global Payment Network AI Foundations
jobs.description: Posted Date 10/05/2026 Description Manager Data Science \- Global Payment Network AI Foundations Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **Team Description** The Global Network Analytics (GNA) team—specifically within our Foundational AI \& Automation pillar—builds machine learning engines and AI agents to drive foundational, scalable intelligence across the payments ecosystem. We create core models and AI tools to power merchant intelligence, acceptance growth, fraud/risk decisioning, and enterprise automation. **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, ML engineers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered capabilities that evaluate billions of network transactions and transform merchant intelligence. * Leverage a modern tech stack—PyTorch, AWS, VectorDBs, and LLMs—to extract actionable insights from complex numerical, tabular, and textual data feeds. * Serve as the domain expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs), adapting, fine\-tuning, and working with technology to deploy them for business users. * Translate technical ML complexity into tangible business value and strategic goals. **The Ideal Candidate is:** * Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. * Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. * Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. * A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. * Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands\-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open\-source tools and cloud computing platforms. * Influential. You are passionate about AI/ML and can bring along a cross functional team in breakthrough innovations. jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Sr. Security Engineer will report to the Technology Department. This role will build and examine reports, data, and analytics to improve and troubleshoot security systems. The Senior Security Engineer is expected to administer and maintain access to security systems. This role will be responsible for immediate response to team member and stakeholder emails, phone calls, and ad\-hoc inquiries. This role includes regular on\-call responsibilities to ensure continuous operational support outside standard business hours. The typical on\-call schedule is one week per month. On\-call shifts may include evenings, weekends, and holidays as part of a rotating schedule. During on\-call periods, employees must be reachable by phone, Microsoft Teams, and/or Microsoft Outlook and able to respond within a 60\-minute window. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Develop a strong knowledge and skillset across all security functional areas including application security, technical project management, third party risk, policy governance, awareness training. * Contribute and assist in the coordination of evidence collection and audit maintenance for organizational assessments. * Contribute to all aspects of application security, including vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, code review, and security training. * Coordinate and assist in the evidence collection and response queries for inbound and outbound security and IT due diligence as part of a third\-party risk management program. * Assist in the implementation of security related SDLC practices including code reviews, static/dynamic code analysis and vulnerability assessments. * Maintain awareness of known vulnerabilities in application technologies used within Inspira. * Research into suspected application vulnerabilities. * Lead efforts to respond to findings from audits, security questionnaires, and internal/external scanning or testing. * Assist in the development of the policies and procedures related to information security, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards. * Coordinate risk assessments on third\-party vendors. Triage and implement appropriate controls to mitigate identified risks. * Assist and coordinate cross\-functional work with other internal business units, such as Compliance, Legal, IT, Finance, HR, and engage with other leaders to drive security outcomes that benefit the organization. * Track and provide security metrics, status updates and reports for the Inspira Security Program * Provide guidance to Security Engineer I/II roles. * Other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education and Experience:** * 5\-7 years of experience * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software/Computing Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. * Technical Certifications a plus **Skills and Abilities:** * Highly self\-motivated * Possess a combination of technology, security, and analytics skills. * Knowledge of the Financial or Insurance Services Industry preferred. * Intellectual curiosity to find new and unusual ways of how to solve cyber security issues. * Ability to approach cyber security challenges while keeping an eye on what is important. * Experience interpreting, analyzing, and maintaining systems. * Ability to create and maintaining respectful, strong working relationships with both IT and business units to integrate security principles with business operations. * Strong client service orientation * Ability to prioritize, plan and take initiative and be highly self\-motivated. * Strong verbal and written communication skills; positive attitude; ability to work as team member. * Experience in a high availability environment preferred. * Knowledge of NIST and CIS practices and frameworks preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Infrequent travel * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation to monitor and respond to security alerts and incidents in real time. * Acknowledge alerts from the designated on\-call monitoring system within a 60\-minute window and provide a quick status update (e.g., “Investigating,” “Will engage within X minutes,” etc.). * Ensure your company\-issued laptop and required access tools are available during on\-call shifts, including when traveling or away from your primary work location for extended periods. * Maintain readiness to troubleshoot, mitigate, or escalate security issues in accordance with established incident response procedures. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Inspira provides industry\-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program. Compensation: $100,200\-$134,000 per year Additional Details : **Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.** Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed \- we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best\-In\-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits. Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. If you're energized and inspired by meaningful work, continuous development, and being part of a team that turns collective effort into real impact, we want to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application. *Our office locations are designed to bring people together, foster collaboration, and build meaningful connections. While some roles are based at one of our office locations, remote status and role locations are subject to change, and relocation is not provided.*

jobs.title: Associate Systems Engineer, V&V
jobs.description: Job Summary This role is an exciting opportunity to help advance Insulet’s mission of improving the lives of people with diabetes by supporting the quality and reliability of innovative medical technology. As an Associate Systems V\&V Engineer, you will contribute to the development of products that patients rely on every day, working alongside cross\-functional teams in a collaborative and fast\-paced environment. This position offers early\-career engineers the chance to grow within Systems Engineering, gain exposure to cutting\-edge product development, and make a meaningful impact on delivering safe, effective, and life\-changing solutions to customers worldwide.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; The Associate Systems V\&V Engineer will be a member of the Systems Engineering COE responsible for Systems Engineering activities related to verification and validation of Insulet’s products. The position will report to the Manager Systems Design Verification located at Insulet’s Headquarters in Acton, MA. **Responsibilities:** • Work with Systems Engineering and other cross\-disciplinary engineering functions to develop detailed Test Cases and Protocols for design verification • Execute verification and validation tasks according to established timelines. • Develop verification and validation of test tools. • Write reports and log issues for executed verification tests • Author product issue records and process these to closure. • Participate in Technical Reviews and Design Reviews. • Contribute to Systems team efforts by performing other duties as required. **Education and Experience:** • Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering or a related field • 0\-2 years of relevant industry experience **Preferred Skills and Competencies:** • Demonstrated working knowledge of engineering principles and scientific methods. • Effective verbal and written communication skills. • Ability to follow written and verbal directions and procedures. • Experience in using any of the following software packages: Jira, Helix, Confluence • Ability to generate and maintain accure records. • Previous experience working in medical device or similar regulated environments Physical Requirements (if applicable): • Not Applicable **NOTE:** This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements and requires on\-site work from an Insulet office. Additional Information: \&\#xa;\&\#xa;Compensation \& Benefits:\&\#xa;\&\#xa;For U.S.\-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $66,500\.00 \- $99,800\.00\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:\&\#xa;• Medical, dental, and vision insurance\&\#xa;• 401(k) with company match\&\#xa;• Paid time off (PTO)\&\#xa;• And additional employee wellness programs\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Application Details:\&\#xa;This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.\&\#xa;To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education. Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non\-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non\-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com. We are looking for highly motivated, performance\-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it! jobs.title: Cloud Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- **The Role and Impact** As a Cloud Software Development Engineer in the System Simulation and Modeling (SSM) organization, you will design, develop, and optimize software solutions that enable Intel's next generation platforms before silicon is available. You will contribute to innovations in simulation, system software, automation, and cloud infrastructure that accelerate firmware and software development across Intel product lines. In this role, you will work closely with firmware engineers, operating system developers, architects, silicon designers, and software teams to develop high\-fidelity development environments and shift\-left solutions that improve product quality, reduce execution risk, and accelerate time\-to\-market. Your work will directly contribute to Intel's skills to develop, integrate, validate, and optimize complex system software stacks in a modern cloud\-based development ecosystem. You will be expected to independently drive technical solutions, solve complex system\-level problems, and deliver high\-quality software from design through deployment. **About the Team** The System Simulation and Modeling (SSM) team is part of the Product Enablement Solutions Group (PESG). We are transforming how Intel firmware and software are developed, integrated, and validated through advanced simulation, modeling, automation, and cloud technologies. Our team develops large\-scale system simulation platforms that enable software development and validation months before silicon availability. These capabilities are critical to Intel's product execution strategy, reducing schedule risk while accelerating innovation across Data Center, AI, and emerging platform technologies. **Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:** * Design, develop, debug, validate, and optimize software solutions supporting simulation, system modeling, automation, and cloud\-based development environments. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand firmware, drivers, operating systems, middleware, and SDK requirements and deliver solutions that enable shift\-left development. * Develop scalable software and automation frameworks that improve developer productivity and product readiness. * Analyze and resolve complex technical issues involving system software, simulation environments, firmware, and hardware\-software interactions. * Apply AI\-assisted development practices and automation techniques to improve engineering efficiency and software quality. * Exercise sound technical judgment to remove obstacles, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver robust solutions. * Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, automation, and scalability across development workflows. Participate in technical reviews and contribute to engineering best practices across the team. * **A successful candidate will demonstrate the following behavioral traits:** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of delivering high\-quality solutions. * Effective communication and collaboration skills, willing to work across geographically distributed teams. **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Minimum Qualifications** , you must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. * **Bachelor's degree** in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 4\+ years of experience. **OR** * **Master's degree** in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 3\+ years of experience, **OR** * **PhD** in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 1\+ years of experience **Experience should be in:** * Software development or related technical disciplines. * Developing and debugging software solutions in large\-scale development environments. * Computer architecture and system software concepts. * C\+\+, Python, or similar programming languages. Executing technical projects and solving complex engineering problems. * **This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.** **Preferred qualifications** are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. One or more of the following skills is highly desired: * Experience with system simulation, virtual platforms, modeling technologies, or emulation environments. * Knowledge of computer architecture domains such as RAS, Memory Technologies, Security, I/O subsystems, Accelerators, GPUs, or AI platforms. * Experience debugging firmware, operating systems, device drivers, or other low\-level software. * Experience with cloud\-native development, distributed systems, Kubernetes, containers, or modern DevOps practices. Experience applying AI/ML technologies to software engineering workflows, automation, or developer productivity. * **Why Join Us** Join Intel's SSM organization and help redefine how future products are built. You will work at the intersection of simulation, cloud computing, AI, and system software while developing technologies that enable software readiness before silicon availability. Your contributions will directly support Intel to deliver innovative products faster, with higher quality and lower execution risk. **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- N/A **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. jobs.title: Mine Planning Engineer I
jobs.description: **About Jerritt Canyon** The Jerritt Canyon deposit was discovered in 1972, and the first gold production from the property occurred in 1981\. The Jerritt Canyon property contains 30,821 hectares of mining claims located in the mining\-friendly state of Nevada. First Majestic acquired the Jerritt Canyon Gold Mine from Sprott Mining Inc. on April 30, 2021\. In May 2023, operations were suspended to prioritize exploration and technical studies. Jerritt Canyon is now entering a new phase of evaluation and planning, requiring substantial technical support to advance the work necessary for a potential future restart of operations. **The Opportunity** We are seeking a motivated and technically minded Mine Planning Engineer I to support the development and execution of safe, efficient, and economically viable mine plans. The successful candidate will work closely with mining operations, geology, surveying, and other technical teams to develop short\- and long\-term mine plans, analyze production data, and support continuous improvement of mining activities. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent engineering graduate or early\-career professional to develop practical experience in mine operations, mine engineering, mine planning, production optimization, and mining software. **Responsibilities** * Create weekly and monthly operations plans that support the 12 monthly forecast. * Track daily mining activities and report on weekly and monthly actuals versus planned KPIs. * Develop mine designs, including pit/underground layouts, haul roads, benches, dumps, stockpiles, and other mining infrastructure as applicable. * Support mine production scheduling to meet safety, production, quality, and cost objectives. * Analyze production, geological, survey, and operational data to identify opportunities for improved mine performance. * Assist with mine optimization studies, including equipment utilization, material movement, sequencing, and resource allocation. * Prepare and maintain mine planning models, schedules, drawings, reports, and technical documentation. * Work with geology and surveying teams to ensure mine plans accurately reflect current geological models and surveyed conditions. * Support reconciliation of planned versus actual production, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions. * Assist operations personnel with the implementation of mine plans and provide technical support as required. * Participate in site inspections and field activities to verify operating conditions and ensure plans are practical and achievable. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, cost reduction, resource recovery, and operational efficiency. * Prepare presentations and technical reports for engineering, operations, and management teams. *The above duties and responsibilities represent the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all\-inclusive.* **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geological Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. * Relevant coursework in mine design, ventilation, drill and blast, geotechnical engineering, mineral processing, geology, surveying, and engineering economics is preferred. * 0–2 years of relevant mining or engineering experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Internship, co\-op, summer placement, or university project experience in mining, mine planning, or technical services is highly desirable. * Exposure to open\-pit and/or underground mining operations is an advantage. * Familiarity with mine planning/scheduling software such as Deswik, Whittle, and Ventsim or similar platforms is preferred. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and the ability to analyze and interpret engineering data. **Equal Employment Opportunity** The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunities to employees and applicants in accordance with all applicable laws.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description: **What you will do** ==================== Under general direction from the Installation/Operations Manager and/or Project Manager, you will be responsible for the profitable execution of assigned small dollar Fire Install Projects. Collaborate with Sales, Operations Leadership, and other teams as needed to provide sales support activities early in the project development process, offering input on strategy, vendor/partner selection, scope enhancements, value engineering, risk assessment, and more. You will provide work direction to project execution teams that may include Engineers, Designers, Technicians, Project Coordinators, Estimators, and Subcontractors, ensuring that assigned projects are completed accurately, on\-time, billed, within budget, and within the scope of the contract. You will also be responsible for maintaining positive cash flow and actively pursuing change orders. Ensure that work performed complies with state, local, and Federal legal requirements while upholding the highest ethical standards. You will adhere to and ensure that Johnson Controls staff and subcontractors adhere to all safety standards, following consistent and repeatable project management procedures and processes. Maintain an effective balance between customer satisfaction and project financial results. **How you will do it** ====================== Ensure that Johnson Controls resources and our subcontractor/vendor resources are adhering to the site/JCI safety policies, whichever is more stringent. Manage the scope, costs, resources, and risks on assigned projects to deliver projects on time and within budget. Act as the primary on\-site leader for execution teams on assigned projects. Develop a Project Execution Plan, including but not limited to Work Breakdown Structure, Organizational Chart, Safety Plan, Project Schedules, Issues/Risk Logs, and Staffing Requirements to execute projects according to plan. Evaluate the contractual scope of work and the impact of client issued instructions/notices, field directives, and/or project schedule changes. Actively pursue change orders for said changes and additional opportunities. Perform associated cost estimates, prepare proposals, and negotiate final settlement prices as well as customer acceptance. Manage project\-related accounts payable, billing, and collections. Complete project billing with the assistance of the project coordinator in a timely and accurate format to the client to maintain positive cash flow. Review and interpret contract Terms and Conditions to ensure work is completed to customer satisfaction and JCI standards. Analyze financial reporting systems and project schedules to proactively address potential problems. Effectively communicate project progress, issues, and financial status to management as required. Manage risks and establish project recovery plans when required. Resolve disputes with minimal need for escalation. Prepare RFPs, negotiate, and issue subcontracts. Ensure project document controls comply with contract requirements and JCI standards. Oversee project construction for compliance with specifications, local codes, and installation techniques. Manage the selection, ordering, and delivery schedule of materials to be procured for the projects assigned. Develop and maintain viable long\-term relationships with customers, consultants, prime contractors, and subcontractors. Attend job progress meetings as required. Ensure subcontractors understand project expectations. Coordinate with the Installation/Operations Manager and/or Construction Manager for allocation of resources needed to meet project objectives. Ensure any engineering and commissioning performed by the field team is in accordance with established standards. Facilitate escalation of product\-related problems. Assist Installation/Operations Manager and/or sales in project development efforts. Provide feedback on the performance of Engineers and Designers to Engineering and Design Team Leaders as well as Operations Management. Perform Installation to Service turnover toward the end of every project. **What we look for:** ===================== Bachelor’s degree in Construction, Civil/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or Architecture is preferred. An Associate degree with equivalent work\-related experience and/or a minimum of five years of direct field experience in the Building Construction Industry is required. Must have the ability to verbally and non\-verbally communicate technical material to both a technical and non\-technical audience. Travel may be required based on project assignment and needs. Must be proficient in Project Management software and financial accounting systems. Experience working with MS Project, MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Adobe Writer, Visio, and basic Windows environment. Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred. **HIRING SALARY RANGE:** $87,800\-$120,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This role offers a competitive Bonus plan that will take into account individual, group, and corporate performance. This position includes a competitive benefits package.
