jobs.title: Staff Biostatistician
jobs.description: **About Karius** Karius is a life science, venture\-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell\-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions. **Position Summary** The Staff Biostatistician serves as a senior statistical expert and leads statistical strategy across multiple complex studies or interconnected programs. This position applies deep statistical expertise to complex and ambiguous scientific questions, influences study and analytical strategy, and establishes statistical approaches and best practices. The Staff Biostatistician works across functions to ensure statistical rigor and serves as a technical mentor to other statisticians and analytical partners. **Why Should You Join Us?** Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The products Karius offers today are some of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our tests are the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. You, as part of the Karius team, will be able to see how directly your work has a life\-changing impact on people, and at scale. **Reports to:** Director, Clinical Statistics \& Data Management **Location:** Redwood City (Hybrid) or Remote (USA), United States **Primary Responsibilities** * Lead statistical strategy across multiple clinical, diagnostic, translational, research, or evidence\-generation studies and programs. * Serve as a statistical expert to clinical, scientific, technical, product, and regulatory stakeholders. * Lead statistical aspects of complex study design, including endpoint strategy, sample size determination, analysis populations, methodology selection, and sensitivity analyses. * Develop statistical approaches for complex, novel, or ambiguous scientific and clinical questions. * Apply advanced statistical methodologies to complex clinical, diagnostic, genomic, laboratory, and real\-world datasets. * Lead statistical evaluation of diagnostic performance, clinical outcomes, longitudinal data, survival outcomes, missing data, confounding, subgroup analyses, and other complex endpoints. * Identify methodological risks, limitations, and opportunities and recommend statistically rigorous approaches. * Provide statistical leadership in interpreting study findings and determining appropriate conclusions. * Influence study design, evidence\-generation strategy, and cross\-functional decision\-making through statistical expertise. * Lead statistical content for study reports, regulatory materials, manuscripts, abstracts, presentations, and external scientific communications. * Support statistical components of regulatory interactions and responses, as appropriate. * Establish and improve statistical standards, reusable methodologies, workflows, and analytical best practices. * Review complex statistical work and provide technical oversight and guidance to other statisticians. * Mentor statisticians and analytical partners and support development of statistical capabilities across the team. * Stay current with evolving statistical methodologies, regulatory expectations, and diagnostic research practices and incorporate relevant advances into organizational approaches. * Demonstrated experience mentoring and providing technical guidance to statisticians and other analytical partners. * Strong scientific judgment, communication, collaboration, and influencing skills. * Strong knowledge of regulatory expectations and statistical practices within regulated life sciences environments preferred. **What’s Fun About the Job?** Karius is operating at the edge of what is now known to be possible in diagnostics. With that, comes a wave of new and incredible challenges and opportunities. To deliver on that value, you will be tapping into some of the most advanced technologies, architecting and innovating where the current solutions simply don't suffice. You will get to see how much your work really matters. **Travel:** Travel required up to 15% for team events. **Physical Requirements** Subject to extended periods of sitting and/or standing, vision to monitor and moderate noise levels. Work is gen n\-making through statistical expertise. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and scientific judgment, with the ability to address novel or ambiguous statistical challenges. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical concepts into clear recommendations for diverse audiences. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex priorities and collaborate effectively across clinical, scientific, technical, product, and regulatory functions. * Experience mentoring and providing technical guidance to statisticians and other analytical partners. * Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and statistical practices within regulated life sciences environments preferred. **Personal Qualifications** * Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills with strong scientific and statistical judgment. * Ability to independently address highly complex, novel, or ambiguous problems and develop practical solutions. * Demonstrated ability to think beyond individual analyses and consider broader study, program, and organizational implications. * Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect statistical decisions to clinical and scientific objectives. * Demonstrated ability to influence decisions through expertise, evidence, and sound judgment. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to make complex statistical concepts accessible and actionable for diverse audiences. * Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills across disciplines and levels of the organization. * Ability to identify risks, challenge assumptions constructively, and provide clear recommendations. * Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop other technical contributors. * High degree of ownership, initiative, and accountability. * Commitment to advancing statistical rigor, analytical quality, and best practices across the organization. **Disclaimer** The above job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Responsibilities and duties may change or be adjusted to meet the needs of the company, and additional duties may be assigned as necessary. The job description is subject to change at any time at the discretion of Karius. At Karius, we value a diverse and inclusive workplace and provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees and are committed to honor and invest in the full diversity of people, in our hiring, recruiting and development of employees across the Company. All qualified applicants for employment are encouraged to apply and will be considered without regard to an individual’s race, color, sex, gender identity and gender expression (including transgender individuals who are transitioning, have transitioned, or are perceived to be transitioning to the gender with which they identify), religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Senior Algorithms Engineer
jobs.description: **What is a Senior Algorithms Engineer?** At Keen, the Senior Algorithms Engineer develops, deploys and improves the algorithms that run in Keen AI Cortex . You're a software engineer first, with the understanding of mathematics, data, and inference to read a model spec, question it, and suggest changes the Principal Algorithms Architect hadn't considered. You'll work directly with the Lead Engineer, and Principal Algorithms Architect, taking modeling ideas from prototype to production code and contributing to the algorithms when you see a better path. **Requirements** **What you’ll do as the Senior Algorithms Engineer** * Own algorithmic features end\-to\-end across the next generation of Keen's AI Cortex. Design, implement, test, ship, and watch them run in production. * Pitch in on adjacent Python backend projects (Django and FastAPI APIs, AWS infrastructure) when a piece of work spans more than one service. * Keep the engineering practices tight: code review, tests, CI gates, documentation, and a clean ticketed workflow. * Use AI coding tools with judgment. Fast iteration is the point. So is catching the moments when the model is confidently wrong. * Develop algorithms from business ideas and turn them into production code, * Collaborate with others in the development of the solutions, including the ability to effectively push back when the implementation can be improved . * Communicate clearly across Product, Research, and Engineering. Write the design doc, name the tradeoff, get the decision made. **What Tech Stack do we choose?** * Google Suite for mail / calendar * Jira for project management * PostgreSQL, SQLite, pandas, NumPy * AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, pytest * Solvers such as Ipopt, GAMS * Python 3\+ Django, FastAPI, REST APIs * Slack for internal communications **What expertise do the best Senior Algorithms Engineers for Keen have?** Must\-have: * 7\+ years shipping production Python on a team * Knowledge of inference methods, particularly in economics and business domains including time\-series models (or more generally state\-space modeling), probability modeling, and multivariate systems. * Comfortable with the engineering basics: tests, CI, code review, documentation, and working out of tickets * Hands\-on experience with AWS, Docker * Operates independently. Scopes own work, talks to stakeholders, makes judgment calls when no one else is available to make them * Writes and speaks clearly * Math foundation in linear algebra, probability, and statistics. Demonstrated ability to read and write mathematical specifications, interpret and improve documented solutions. * Working knowledge of pandas and NumPy, with understanding of the use of these packages in implementing algorithms. Nice\-to\-have: * Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) or another econometric background * Bayesian inference experience * Optimization exposure * A track record of developing mathematical algorithms into shipped production systems. **Benefits** **Keen is different.** As a Inc. 5000 Fastest\-Growing Private Company and a Triangle Business Journal Top 10 Best Place to Work, we’re growing quickly. But our growth isn’t the only thing that differentiates us. At Keen, we’re proponents of a Conscious Culture. Conscious Culture is a workforce built on purpose. A conscious culture means a workplace that is intentional, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee in making sure that how our company operates is as important as our business outcomes. This is where management and employees both practice self\-awareness, and everyone feels accountable, empowered, and expected to act in accordance with the culture we seek to foster. Because we work smarter Monday\-Thursday, we’re able to offer all employees a three\-day weekend.

jobs.title: Service Technician - Precision Equipment
jobs.description: **Service Technician** Keystone Precision Solutions \| Crofton, MD \| Full\-Time Keystone Precision Solutions is looking for a Service Technician at their Crofton, MD location to inspect, troubleshoot, calibrate, and repair the surveying and geospatial equipment that engineers, surveyors, and construction professionals depend on every day. This is precision technology (think GNSS receivers, robotic total stations, laser scanners) and the work requires someone who's equal parts technically sharp, detail\-oriented, and good with people. **Why This Role Stands Out** \- You'll work with cutting\-edge positioning and measurement technology used by professionals across the Mid\-Atlantic region \- The Crofton office is a small, independent operation. Most days, it's you and one other person. You'll have real ownership of your work without anyone hovering over your shoulder \- KPS has been the leader in this space for over 30 years. You'll learn from experienced colleagues and build expertise in a niche that's in high demand and short on talent \- Quarterly bonuses reward your performance **What You'll Do** Your days will mix bench work, customer interaction, and problem\-solving. Specifically, you'll: * Inspect, test, troubleshoot, configure, maintain, and repair professional surveying and geospatial equipment, including GNSS receivers, robotic and conventional total stations, data collectors, field controllers, levels, laser scanners, and related accessories * Diagnose hardware, firmware, connectivity, communication, configuration, and field\-performance issues across a range of precision instruments * Perform equipment testing, calibration verification, firmware updates, configuration, and quality\-control procedures * Greet showroom customers, assess drop\-off equipment, and communicate repair timelines and status updates * Assist customers with technical questions, equipment setup, connectivity, and general surveying workflows * Collaborate with KPS Sales, Support, Rental, and Service teams to evaluate, prepare, and support equipment throughout its lifecycle * Maintain detailed records of service activities, including maintenance logs, repair reports, and calibration documentation * Provide secondary support to inside sales when needed **What You Bring** The strongest candidates will have a combination of technical aptitude and a genuine interest in how precision equipment works. Specifically: * 2\+ years of hands\-on technical experience in electronics, mechanical repair, precision instruments, or a related field * Strong troubleshooting ability across mechanical, electronic, and software systems * Comfort with computers: installing software, updating firmware, configuring devices, and troubleshooting connectivity * Experience with surveying equipment, geospatial technology, or brands like Trimble, Spectra Geospatial, or Nikon is a real advantage, but KPS will train the right person with strong fundamentals * Customer\-facing communication skills. You'll be explaining technical issues to people with varying levels of technical background, so the ability to translate complex information into plain language matters. * Self\-sufficiency and dependability. The Crofton office operates with a small crew, and the sales team and customers across the region count on you showing up and getting it done. * Fine motor skills and manual dexterity for detailed work with precision instruments (tweezers, delicate tool work, pinching, pressing, rotating) * Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs. and stand for extended periods * High school diploma or GED required. Technical, vocational, or associate degree in a related field is a plus. * Valid driver's license **About Keystone Precision Solutions** Keystone Precision Solutions (KPS) is a leading provider of geospatial measurement solutions serving surveying, engineering, construction, mapping, and related industries throughout the Northeastern and Mid\-Atlantic United States. They provide professional\-grade positioning and measurement technology along with technical consultation, equipment service and repair, rentals, training, support, and positioning services. KPS has been the premier name in this space for over 30 years. **What KPS Offers** * Total compensation: $25\-26 per hour plus quarterly performance bonuses potentially adding a total of $8,000\-$15,000\+ a year * Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance * 401(k) program * Paid time off for vacations, personal days, and community service days * Monday through Friday schedule with no weekends **How to Apply** Apply here: https://app.jobvite.com/j?cj\=oQNUAfwR\&s\=Indeed *Our hiring management partner is myHR Partner. myHR Partner is not a staffing service or recruiter. All resumes and applications will be reviewed for this position and only for Keystone Precision Solutions.* *Keystone Precision Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate and are committed to ensuring that our place can be anyone's place.* Pay: From $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * What is your desired pay range? Experience: * Hands on technical troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance: 2 years (Required) License/Certification: * Drivers license (Required) Ability to Commute: * Crofton, MD 21114 (Required) Work Location: In person

and technical requirements. * Monitor production progress and adjusts assignments to support timely project delivery. * Manage the organization and maintenance of project directories and CAD production files. * Develop and implements processes that improve productivity, consistency, and workflow efficiency. * Maintain production records and prepares related reports and correspondence. * * Establish clear work expectations and provides technical direction, coaching, and performance feedback. * Review completed work and evaluates employee performance, work quality, and technical development. * Identify training needs and provides or coordinates instruction in software applications, drafting procedures, and company standards. * Conduct performance reviews for direct reports. * Participate in the hiring and selection of CAD staff and provides recommendations to senior management. * Support succession planning and continued development within the Civil CAD career path. * Promote consistent production practices, accountability, and collaboration across the CAD team. **Additional Responsibilities** * Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **Skills and Specifications** * Demonstrates advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. * Applies comprehensive knowledge of civil engineering plan production, CAD standards, and applicable municipal and state requirements. * Interprets technical design information to support complex civil CAD production and technical direction. * Uses Microsoft Office Suite effectively. * Exercises sound technical and operational judgment when resolving complex production, staffing, and workflow issues. * Applies advanced knowledge of CAD workflows, standards, and production processes to department operations. **Attributes** * Works effectively both independently and as part of a team. * Takes accountability for assigned responsibilities, deadlines, and work quality. * Maintains attention to detail, organization, and reliable follow\-through. * Adapts to changing business needs, project demands, and staffing priorities. * Communicates clearly, both verbally and in writing. * Builds and maintains positive professional relationships with coworkers, project partners, and leadership. * Takes initiative in carrying out assigned responsibilities and identifying appropriate next steps. * Exercises sound professional judgment in decision\-making and problem\-solving. * Maintains confidentiality when handling sensitive company, client, employee, or project information. **Education, Experience, and Qualifications** * Twelve (12\) or more years of progressively responsible CAD experience. * Three (3\) or more years of experience supervising CAD staff and overseeing CAD production. * Experience developing staff, managing production workload, and improving CAD production processes. * Associate degree in computer\-aided drafting, engineering technology, or a related field preferred. **Physical Considerations** * Ability to operate standard office equipment, including a personal computer, printer, copier, and telephone. * Ability to perform repetitive, fine hand and arm movements associated with computer use and document handling. **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive salary \+ performance\-based bonus opportunities * 401(k) with employer match * Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family * Generous paid time off \+ paid holidays * Professional development and career advancement support **Why LDC** * You are trusted to lead production and make decisions that impact project delivery * You play a key role in maintaining and improving CAD standards and quality * You have the opportunity to mentor and develop junior designers and technicians * You work closely with engineers and project managers across a variety of projects * You are part of a team that values quality, accountability, and collaboration

jobs.description: ### **About Lantern** Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com. Job Overview As an Operations Automation Specialist, you will personally resolve provider inquiries — and then build the tools that make resolving them one\-by\-one unnecessary. Today, resolving a provider's question well requires detailed manual auditing and review across multiple systems. It's careful work, and it doesn't scale. The data needed to answer these questions faster and more accurately already exists across our data sources — and modern AI tools give us the opportunity to bring that work together and scale it in a way we haven't yet. You'll start by doing the job as it exists today: working real provider inquiries, learning the systems, and building the judgment that comes from firsthand experience with the problem. From there, your job shifts toward building — using AI\-assisted workflows to resolve inquiries faster, surface patterns worth fixing at the root, and move providers toward getting their answers without needing to contact us at all. This is a new kind of role for Lantern, built specifically because this problem is ready for it. This is a technical role in the lowercase\-t sense: you don't need to arrive as a software engineer, and this isn't the data\-analyst track either — it's for people with the instinct to spot patterns and automate them away, even without the formal technical background yet to do it at scale. For the right person, it's a deliberate stepping stone toward more technical roles at Lantern over time. We're deliberately not writing this as a data\-engineering job. Someone who already codes fluently can thrive here, but so can a business\-minded person with real communication skills and the drive to build — the second profile is just as much the target as the first. We're not narrowing this to one experience level. A recent grad with the right instincts is a big part of who we want in the pipeline — but so is someone with five or ten years of practical business experience who has been deliberately building toward exactly this kind of role. More time doing the work often means sharper pattern recognition, not a worse fit. We'll teach you the domain — you don't need to know claims or healthcare going in. What we won't do is teach you SQL or Claude Code step by step; the expectation is that you go figure new tools out largely on your own, the same way people have always picked up new tools on the job. What You'll Do: Resolve, hands\-on * Work a live queue of provider claims inquiries — status, payment amount, denial and rejection questions, aged\-claim batches — through to accurate resolution * Audit individual claims across systems to confirm they were submitted, validated, priced, and paid correctly * Escalate genuine pricing or appeals determinations, and document what you learn so the pattern can eventually be automated Understand the problem at scale * Query claims, pricing, and provider data directly using SQL — you'll pick up our specific tools (including Databricks) on the job — to characterize inquiry volume, root causes, and cost to serve — much of which isn't measured today * Separate inquiries caused by real payment problems from inquiries caused by providers simply lacking visibility — they need different fixes Build the fix * Design and build AI\-assisted workflows that triage inquiries, retrieve the relevant claim and contract facts, validate payments, and draft accurate, provider\-ready responses * Build in verification, not just automation — a confident wrong answer about a payment amount is worse than a slower correct one * Test against real ticket volume, measure impact honestly, and iterate Push upstream * Where a category of inquiry traces back to a fixable upstream issue — deferred claims, ingestion errors, notification gaps — work the root cause, not just the symptom * Contribute to provider self\-service so fewer questions need to reach us in the first place About You: We're looking for someone with the business and communication fundamentals to do this job well today, plus the eagerness to build the automation that makes it unnecessary tomorrow. This is not a data\-engineering posting — a business background, a support/ops background, uter science degree — you're not building distributed systems, you're using tools that already exist to make an operational process dramatically better * Already being an expert in SQL, Python, or AI tooling — what we're looking for is real curiosity and a track record of teaching yourself new tools; we'll give you real problems, context, and room to grow into them, not a step\-by\-step curriculum * Hands\-on experience with Databricks or other enterprise data\-engineering tooling — that's specific to our internal stack, and you'll pick it up here with real access and context once you're on the team * Any specific number of years of "AI experience" — the tools are too new for that bar to mean anything yet; genuine, demonstrated use matters, not tenure **What Success Looks Like** At 3 months: You're resolving provider inquiries independently, including complex ones. The inquiry population is measured and segmented for the first time. At least one AI\-assisted workflow is live and measurably cutting down manual handling. At 6 months: A growing share of provider inquiries are resolved without a manual research step. Cost per resolved inquiry is down, resolutions per person are up, and more providers are getting answers without needing to contact us at all. **Location \& Logistics** Hybrid \| Dallas, TX or New York, NY \| 3 days per week in office (required due to the sensitivity of the data this role handles) Lantern does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in the provision of employment opportunities and benefits. **Benefits:** * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Life Insurance * 401k with company match * Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave **Compensation**: Base salary range: $90,000–$120,000, depending on relevant experience, location, and qualifications. **About You:** * You use **LOGIC** in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast\-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small \& big wins. * **INCLUSION** is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives \& you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with. * You have the **GRIT**, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas. * You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep **HUMANITY** in all decisions. Your customers aren't just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change. * Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the **TRUTH** vs. giving people the answers they want to hear. * You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change. These pillars of **LIGHT** are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this **LIGHT**, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern. Please apply to our role \& someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process. Lantern does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.title: LTG - Cloud Engineer II
jobs.description: **We are Lennar** Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States. **A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future** Join Cloud Engineering as a Cloud Engineer on the Developer Experience (DevEx) team, the group that builds and operates the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) used by every engineering team at Lennar. DevEx owns the developer portal (Spotify Portal, built on Backstage), shared CI/CD pipelines, source control administration, infrastructure as code tooling, application security tooling, and the observability and testing standards teams build on. In this role you will build and maintain platform capabilities through a code\-driven model, own components of the platform from design through delivery, and help engineering teams across Lennar get the most out of the tools DevEx provides. **Your Responsibilities on the Team** * Build and maintain features of the internal developer portal, including plugins, integrations, and software templates. * Build and improve reusable service templates that give engineering teams a standardized, self\-service way to create new applications and infrastructure. * Build, test, and maintain reusable CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions used across engineering teams. * Support GitHub Enterprise administration, including repository management, access provisioning, and policy enforcement. * Develop and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform, including reusable modules and workspace automation. * Integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines and help teams address findings. * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting standards for services built on the platform. * Contribute to the automated testing frameworks and quality checks built into the developer workflow. * Help measure developer productivity and platform adoption through dashboards and reporting. * Participate in the team’s support rotation, troubleshoot platform issues, and automate recurring requests. * Take part in design reviews, and write documentation and runbooks for the components you own. * Review InnerSource contributions from other teams, and mentor Level I engineers on team standards and practices. **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred. * 2\-3 years of experience in Software, DevOps, or platform engineering. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as TypeScript, Python, or Go. * Hands\-on experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD. * Hands\-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code. * Familiarity with core AWS services, including identity and access management, containers, and serverless. * Familiarity with Internal Developer Platform (IDP) concepts; exposure to Backstage is a plus. * Understanding of good software engineering practices: version control, code review, and automated testing. * Familiarity with application security scanning in CI/CD pipelines. * Ability to troubleshoot build, deployment, and pipeline failures independently. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with engineers across teams. Bonus: Experience with Backstage or another developer portal; observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or Grafana; test automation frameworks; AWS certifications; contributions to InnerSource or open\-source projects. **Physical \& Office/Site Presence Requirements** This is an in\-person office role based in Miami, FL, with a current 3 days in office, 2 day remote schedule. This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. *This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.* *Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.* **Life at Lennar** At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well\-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits. Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview \| LinkedIn\< https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/ \> for the latest job opportunities. **Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Digital Marketing
jobs.description: **About Us** Live Oak Bank is a digital bank that serves small business owners across the country. Our groundbreaking spin on service and technology has fueled our mission to be America’s Small Business Bank. Our products help customers buy, build, and expand their business, and our high\-yield savings and CD products help them grow their hard\-earned money. At Live Oak, we never lose sight of the well\-being of our people. We believe our employees are the heart of our company. Our commitment to our customers and culture is intertwined, and we seek those who embody and embrace what it takes to empower the American dream. **How This Role Impacts Live Oak and its People** We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer \- Digital Marketing to serve as a key technology partner to Live Oak's Digital Marketing organization. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, digital marketing, analytics, and customer experience. The ideal candidate will help design, implement, and optimize the technology, data, analytics, and measurement capabilities that power Live Oak's digital marketing ecosystem. This individual will partner closely with marketers, analysts, product teams, and engineers to enhance digital acquisition, customer engagement, marketing performance measurement, and website experiences. Success in this role requires a strong technical foundation combined with an understanding of digital marketing technologies, customer journey analytics, attribution, and data\-driven optimization. Location: Candidate is required to be located or relocate to Wilmington, North Carolina. Work sponsorship is not supported now or in the future. **What You’ll Do** **at Live Oak** *Marketing Technology, Data \& Analytic*s * Serve as the technology partner for the Digital Marketing team, translating marketing objectives into scalable technical solutions. * Design, develop, and support digital marketing technology platforms, integrations, and data flows that enable customer acquisition, campaign execution, and performance measurement. * Partner with marketing, analytics, and business stakeholders to enhance multi\-touch attribution, conversion tracking, customer journey analytics, and marketing effectiveness reporting. * Partner and develop web analytics implementations, tagging strategies, event tracking frameworks, and digital data collection standards across customer\-facing channels. * Ensure marketing and customer behavioral data is accurately captured, governed, and accessible for reporting, segmentation, personalization, and optimization. * Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate marketing technologies including analytics platforms, CRM systems, customer data platforms (CDPs), experimentation tools, advertising technologies, and marketing automation platforms. * Drive improvements in data quality, observability, automation, and reporting across the digital marketing ecosystem. *Digital Experience \& Customer Acquisition* * Partner with Digital Marketing to optimize customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and conversion strategies across digital channels. * Support digital marketing initiatives including paid media, SEO, SEM, email marketing, content marketing, social media, and website experiences through scalable technology solutions. * Develop technology\-enabled solutions that support personalization, audience segmentation, campaign targeting, and customer journey orchestration. * Lead website optimization efforts focused on user experience, accessibility, search performance, engagement, and conversion improvement. * Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition and engagement through experimentation, A/B testing, and behavioral analytics. * Translate business requirements into technical capabilities that support growth and marketing objectives. * Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, manage dependencies, and align technology investments with business goals. *Measurement, Reporting \& Optimization* * Partner with the Data team on dashboards, reporting frameworks, and data products that provide visibility into key performance indicators and business outcomes. * Monitor customer behavior, conversion funnels, and digital performance to identify trends, opportunities, and optimization recommendations. * Continuously improve data\-driven decision\-making through analytics, insights, and scalable reporting solutions. * Leverage customer insights and performance data to drive ongoing improvements in digital experiences and marketing effectiveness. *Leadership, Partnership \& Governance* * Partner with compliance, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure digital marketing technologies and processes meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and technology partners when applicable. * Stay current with emerging technologies, digital analytics capabilities, customer experience trends, AI\-powered tools, and advancements i actices (Node.js, React, Bootstrap, Python) * Expert in Cloud tools (SF.COM, AWS S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting digital marketing technology solutions and integrations. * Strong understanding of web analytics, digital tagging, event tracking, conversion measurement, and customer journey analytics. * Experience with analytics and reporting platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Power BI, or similar technologies. * Experience with CRM, customer data, and marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, or comparable solutions. * Experience working closely with marketing, product, analytics, and business teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. * Strong understanding of data architecture, customer data flows, and marketing measurement frameworks. * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management capabilities. * Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and influencing outcomes across multiple teams. **Preferred Experience** * Experience within financial services, banking, fintech, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience implementing multi\-touch attribution, marketing mix measurement, or customer journey analytics frameworks. * Experience supporting SEO, SEM, paid media tracking, lead generation, and conversion optimization initiatives. * Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, and personalization technologies. * Experience leading website modernization, digital transformation, or customer experience optimization initiatives. * Understanding of privacy regulations, consent management, and responsible customer data practices. * Team leadership, mentoring, and technical coaching experience. * Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology investments and marketing performance to measurable business results. * Adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for innovation, analytics, and customer experience. **Our Values** * **Dedication:** Possess a deep commitment to Live Oak Bank’s mission and core values, exemplified through a strong work ethic, adaptability and pride in your work. * **Ownership:** Take initiative to deliver positive results by proactively and creatively solving problems, while maintaining a high degree of quality. * **Respect:** Treat everyone with courtesy, politeness, and kindness. * **Innovation:** Embrace fresh ideas and fearlessly contribute new solutions to emerging or existing problems. * **Teamwork:** Foster collaboration, accountability, and trust with others and understand that together, we do more For a detailed overview of our employee benefits please visit: **http://www.liveoakbank.com/careers/** Live Oak Bank is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled. We consider applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran status or disability. Equal access to programs, service and employment is available to all persons. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify human resources at HumanResources@liveoak.bank. EEO is the Law The base pay range for this position is $128,500\.00 \- $179,900\.00 per year. Compensation may also include annual bonuses and long\-term incentives, subject to various metrics and company policy. A candidate’s salary is determined by several factors including travel, relevant work experience or skills and expertise. Please note that we provide at least the minimum requirement of paid sick leave to our employees who reside in states that require employer\-paid sick leave, including but not limited to Arizona, California, Colorado, District of Columbia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Washington.

jobs.title: Full Stack Agentic AI Senior Engineer - AIaaS
jobs.description: AI/ML Computational Science Senior Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time Job No. R00362176 \| Mountain View, CA **We Are** Accenture is helping enterprises reinvent their organizations and businesses with human\-centered AI solutions and services to drive breakthrough innovation and lasting competitive advantage. With more than 45,000 AI and data professionals across the company, our AI \& Data practice brings together cutting\-edge AI technologies, deep industry experience, strategic investment, exceptional interdisciplinary talent, and a powerful ecosystem of partners to help clients scale AI with speed and confidence. **You Are** A Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer leader who focuses on delivering end‑to‑end agentic AI solutions while providing advanced technical expertise to support complex customer engagements. The scope spans agentic AI as a Service intelligent systems, full‑stack solution development, and human‑AI interaction, alongside close collaboration with diverse teams, including but not limited, client teams, global capability teams, and operational teams, to translate business challenges into scalable, production‑ready agentic AI solutions. **The Work** The role contributes to building and positioning cloud‑based, customizable advanced agentic AI offerings, combining hands‑on solution development with discovery, technical validation, and customer‑facing demonstrations to enable credible, highly differentiated agentic AI‑as‑a‑Service outcomes. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, deploy, and operate end to end, human\-centered agentic AI systems across frontend, backend, data, and intelligent components * Integrate AI / ML / NLP capabilities into workflows to address real\-world client or business problems * Implement agentic AI behaviors using human\-centered design and hybrid neural symbolic approaches * Support complex Mid\-Market sales opportunities by partnering with Sales to shape advanced technical solutions * Participate in discovery sessions to identify customer challenges, objectives, and technical requirements * Lead technical demos, workshops, and proof of concept engagements to demonstrate solution fit and value * Contribute to technical solution design and input into proposals, statements of work, and contracts * Provide technical guidance on industry use cases, best practices, and pre delivery considerations * Develop scalable APIs and services that ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability * Collaborate across product, business, and sales teams to deliver cohesive technical and customer facing outcomes Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. **Here's what you need** * Minimum of 8 years of experience as a full stack AI or machine learning engineer or scientist, working with AI / ML models in production at scale, including monitoring, alerting, bug fixing and auditing * Minimum of 8 years of experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming * Minimum of 5 years of experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may support AI / Agentic AI applications, big data analytics, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks * Minimum of 4 years of experience in building and deploying AI / ML based software to a cloud environment. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience) **Professional Skills Requirements** * Strong written \& verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Strong client\-facing skillsets in a consulting environment * Strong cross\-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client\-side teams * Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation **Bonus points if you have** * Proficiency in Python and python\-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications. * Experience with the following programming languages: Clojure, C\+\+, Java, R, SQL * MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.) Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below. We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/20/2026\. Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long\-term disability  and require accommodation to perform the essential functions of your role, you will be asked to participate in our reasonable accommodation process. Accommodations made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodations once hired. If you would like to be considered for employment opportunities with Accenture and have accommodation needs such as for a disability or religious observance, please call us toll free at 1 (877\) 889\-9009 or send us an email or speak with your recruiter. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities. Accenture is an EEO and Affirmative Action Employer of Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities. Accenture is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. **Other Employment Statements** Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **TL;DR** – We’re looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Engineer to help build the future of AI\-powered software creation. You will be a founding member of our FDE function, working directly with our customers to translate ambitious ideas into real products. This is a hands\-on software engineering role: you will design, write, and ship production code. It’s a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before. **Why Lovable?** ---------------- Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024\. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent\-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low\-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest\-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. **About the role** ------------------ Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both. You’ll build alongside customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving technically difficult problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn’t simply to make individual deployments successful: it’s to identify what should become part of the Lovable platform and then build it. As one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll also help define the function \- from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it collaborates with customers and our core product teams. If you want to stay deeply hands\-on while shaping a product, a team and a new engineering discipline, this is that role. As you’ll be working directly with customers, travel up to 50% could be required depending on needs. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * 8\+ years of hands\-on experience building and shipping production software * Strong full\-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development * A track record of writing maintainable, well\-tested code and owning what you build in production * Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems * Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production\-quality solutions * Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users * Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and end\-to\-end ownership **Bonus if you’ve:** * Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before * Led zero\-to\-one product development * Worked in a founding or early startup environment **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and problems * Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems * Design, code, test, deploy, and operate solutions across Lovable’s frontend and backend * Translate insights from real usage into foundational platform improvements * Own projects end\-to\-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration * Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI\-system boundaries * Shape how Forward Deployed Engineering operates at Lovable, including its engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks * Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations **Our Tech Stack** ------------------ * **Backend:** Golang \& Rust * **Frontend:** React, Typescript * **Cloud:** Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers * **Tooling:** Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more **How we hire** --------------- * Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team. * Complete a quick live coding exercise. * Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews. * Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud. **About your application** -------------------------- * Please submit your application in English \- it’s our company language * We treat all candidates equally \- if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal Compensation Range: $199K \- $271K

Headquarters in Tysons, Virginia, M.C. Dean delivers resilient, secure, and innovative power and technology solutions through engineering expertise and smart systems integration. **Why Join Us?** Our people are passionate about engineering innovation that improves lives and drives impactful change. Guided by our core values—agility, expertise, and trust—we foster a collaborative and forward\-thinking work environment. At M.C. Dean, we are committed to building the next generation of technical leaders in electrical, engineering, and cybersecurity industries. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, M.C. Dean performs work throughout the United States and Europe, including integrated regional offices in Baltimore, MD; Charleston, SC; Atlanta, GA; Tampa, FL; Houston \& Dallas, TX; Santa Clara, CA; Portland, OR; and Stuttgart, Germany. M.C. Dean delivers multi\-disciplinary systems engineering for electrical, electronic security, telecommunications, life\-safety, instrumentation and control, and command and control systems; and provides machine\-to\-machine communications, and physical and cybersecurity services to clients across six continents. We are trusted by Fortune 100 global enterprises, data centers and top defense, civilian, and intelligence agencies, to design, build, operate and maintain their most mission critical systems. Engineers who join M.C. Dean's technical team have the opportunity to actively innovate and apply their technical skills in a multitude of ways. You have the opportunity to work on client sites and in our engineering solutioning labs, which serve as an extensive testing environment for our customers with virtual servers, hardware, software and equipment for remote testing of access control, intrusion detection, facial recognition, and environmental data analysis. M.C. Dean is also an innovator in the design and delivery of large\-scale modular systems led out of the company's manufacturing center in Virginia. Engineers have the opportunity to develop their career paths as desired to develop a broad and highly advanced set of technical skills across the company's integrated business units. This job posting is focused on the identification of engineering graduates interested in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented and collaborative workplace environment with specific applications in Power, Mechanical, Security, Systems, and Software. The work that shapes you, also shapes the world. We are seeking new candidates driven to excellence and inspired to build a smarter, more sustainable, and connected future. Responsibilities: The project engineer shall perform the requirements of the physical engineering role while also supporting the project engineer performing in the functional engineering role. **Functional Engineering:*** Support project leadership by ensuring operational needs are met in design documentation (ex. Interpretting device layouts in Shop Drawings to ensure the project scope is clear, confirming test requirements in commissioning plans are clearly identified to ensure the correct tests will be performed, identifying the products needed to ensure the correct products are being purchased, etc.) * Support field installation teams by ensuring operational needs are met in design documentation (ex. Interpretting details in Shop Drawings to ensure the field installers can mount and assemble the devices, confirming test procedures are clearly defined in commissioning plans to ensure the field installers can perform the tests accurately, identifying the products on site match the product data submittal for the field to build with, etc.) * Communicate effectively with the project’s Functional Engineer and other stakeholders to facilitate project progress and address technical challenges. **Physical Engineering:*** Assist the project leader with risk management, change management, tracking subcontractor deliverables, scheduling, ordering and receiving project materials, etc. * Assist the superintendent with troubleshooting commissioning process issues, tracking manpower, tracking 3rd party installation predecessors/successors/dependencies that affect the telecom work, ordering and receiving labels. * Write Request for Information questions to the customer or designer. * Create and update the project installation plan in InfraLink to manage the installation. Update and status installation \& commissioning progress, initiate and track trouble tickets, etc. * Conduct quality control inspections of 3rd party predecessors/successors/dependencies that affect the telecommunications installation to ensure compliance with standards * Conduct quality control inspections of the telecommunications installation to ensure compliance with standards. * Coordinate commissioning work to include, but not limited to, setting up Test IDs, tracking testing progress, reviewing test results, and submitting data for warranty. * Produce engineering closeout documentation as part of project completion. * Support the Project Leader and Superintendent in the commissioning and documentation process. Qualifications: **Qualifications*** 0\+ years of experience with Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (preferably from an ABET accredited program). **Abilities:*** Exposure to computer screens for an extended period of time. * Sitting for extended periods of time. * Reach by extending hands or arms in any direction. * Have finger dexterity in order to manipulate objects with fingers rather than whole hands or arms, for example, using a keyboard. * Listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences. * Communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand. * Read and understand information and ideas presented in writing. * Apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense. * Identify and understand the speech of another person.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Data Engineer **Department:** Information Technology **Reports to:** Data Team Manager **Compensation:** $100,000 \- $130,000 **Hours:** Full\-time, Monday \- Friday, 8:30am \- 5:00pm, with flexibility as business and project needs require. Benefits * Three weeks of paid vacation * Paid sick time * Eight and a half paid holidays per year * Two paid flexible holidays per year * ICHRA Health Insurance Reimbursement * 100% Employer Paid Dental and Vision Insurance * 100% Employer Paid Life Insurance * 100% Employer Paid Medical Clinic Membership or Cash Equivalent for employees and dependents * Other benefits accrue over the first 3\-24 months, including additional paid vacation, 401(k) with company matching, and quarterly profit share. **Place of Work:** Corporate Headquarters \- 1730 South Street, Redding CA, 96001 Company Overview Maas Energy Works is the leading developer and operator of agricultural waste\-to\-energy systems in the United States. The Company designs, develops, constructs, and operates biogas renewable energy generation systems, primarily on dairy farms. Our projects include anaerobic digesters, biogas\-powered electric generation, and renewable natural gas upgrading. Position Description We are hiring a Data Engineer to own the operational backbone of our data platform: SQL Servers, the pipelines that move data out of it, and the Microsoft Fabric data warehouse that feeds reporting, regulatory work, and internal applications. The data is high\-frequency time\-series and operational data from more than 100 projects, so reliability, completeness, and monitoring matter as much as building new things. This is a hands\-on role on a small team that is actively modernizing its platform. We want someone who learns new tools on their own initiative, takes ownership of production systems, and wants to grow with the platform. Essential Responsibilities * Administer the SQL Server environment in Azure: backups and restore testing, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, security and access, storage growth, and performance tuning. * Monitor continuous data ingestion from 100\+ projects and resolve gaps, delays, duplicates, and out\-of\-range values before they reach downstream reporting. * Build, maintain, and troubleshoot pipelines that move data from staging and external REST APIs into the Fabric data warehouse. * Maintain and extend the warehouse's dimensional models, data quality rules, and load performance. * Build alerting for pipeline failures, data freshness, and completeness, and own the response when they fire. * Contribute to the migration of remaining workloads from Azure Synapse to Microsoft Fabric. * Support analysts and application developers who consume warehouse data through Power BI semantic models and internal applications. * Write and maintain runbooks and technical documentation, and work in Git with code review and CI/CD deployment. Required Qualifications * 3\+ years of professional experience with SQL Server and T\-SQL, including set\-based query design, stored procedures, execution\-plan tuning, and indexing. * Hands\-on database administration in production: backup and recovery, SQL Agent, maintenance jobs, logins and role\-based security, and capacity monitoring. * Experience building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines (Azure Data Factory, Synapse pipelines, Fabric Data Factory, or SSIS), including incremental loads, failure handling, and reruns. * Working knowledge of dimensional modeling: facts, dimensions, grain, and slowly changing dimensions. * Hands\-on Microsoft Fabric experience: Warehouse and Lakehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflow Gen2, notebooks, and capacity monitoring. * Familiarity with Azure fundamentals: resource organization, networking basics, managed identities, and Key Vault. * Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, or alerting production data. * Proficiency with Git. * A track record of learning new tools and platforms independently and applying them to real work. * Python, and C\# programming languages * Spark framework Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Power BI semantic models * Experience with high\-volume time\-series, IoT, or industrial operations data. * Microsoft certification DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) or DP\-700 (Fabric Data Engineer). Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Physical Demand Requirements Work Environment \- Office Staff This role operates primarily in a professional office environment and uses computers, cloud platforms, databases, development tools, and communication systems. Limited travel to company offices or project locations may be required. Physical Demands \- Office Staff This is largely a sedentary role requiring extended computer work, regular communication, and the ability to manage multiple technical priorities. The position may occasionally require travel in vehicles or airplanes and access to company operating locations.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - General Construction
jobs.description: **Summary \- Assistant Project Manager, General Construction** Coordination and supervision of a project under construction in coordination with the Superintendent including scheduling, cost analysis and control, subcontractor relationships, encouraging and initiating new methods for more efficient construction and developing new business opportunities. **General Responsibilities \- Assistant Project Manager, General Construction** · Demonstrates a positive, professional working relationship with Clients, Architects and Engineers using positive attitude, listening attentively and is able to work effectively with various positions. · Strives to ensure a safe working environment, making team members feel comfortable when approached, showing respect for co\-workers during challenging moments. · Positively influences subordinates through training and mentoring to achieve optimal performance. · Effectively represents the Company during Owner \& Subcontractor Meeting, projecting leadership strength in meeting settings, expressing leadership through confident communication of projected activities and project issues, while ultimately balancing client satisfaction. **Cost \& Risk Management \- Assistant Project Manager, General Construction** · Has made him/herself intimately familiar with Owner Contract, General Conditions, Plans \& Specifications and is able to command discussion in this arena with full confidence through knowledge of the subject. · Ensures timely completion of the buyout process through timely review of subcontracts, verification of scopes of work, tracking of buyout process "ball\-in\-court", including issuance and return of executed subcontracts. Consistently reviews buyout log on weekly basis for verification of this process. · Verifies the updating and timely tracking of Change Order pricing through the CPR Log, tracks subcontractor proposals and conducts verification of proposal scopes for accuracy. Submitting CPR's in a timely manner after identification of a potential change order. Reviewed on weekly basis at minimum with team. o Drafts and/or conducts final review and completion of Change Orders (CPR's) to Owner, assuring language is written appropriately, subcontractor proposals have accurate scopes, includes well detailed sketches, drawing backup, schedules and pictures as necessary. · Assures RFI's are issued in a timely manner, ideally drafted by Project Engineer and verified by PM; issued within 24 hours of the identification of an issue. · Monitors job cost closely enough and monitors cost to complete in order to identify active and future negative variances, in turn completing budget transfer for cost to complete analysis projections timely. Completed at a minimum, monthly analysis and transfers if necessary in order to consistently maintain a maximum negative variance of less than 0\.05%. (Applies to negative variances resulting from lack of projection adjustments). · Assures Subcontractor notifications/reminders are issued on a monthly basis, outlining deadlines for Payment Application Submissions, and consistently enforces this deadline to assure timely processing of payments. · Effectively completes the Owner Payment Application draft and delivers to Owner by the 25th of the month and secures approval to best of teams ability within 1 week of submission. · Assures Subcontractor Schedule of Values are submitted with sufficient detail and breakout, reviewed for improper loading, reviewed for approved change orders, Owner Direct Purchase Order (if applicable) and with contract required schedule of value line items included. · Consistently tracks and ensures receipt, including tracking of submitted/approved value, and checklist verification for Subcontractor Payment Requisitions. Additionally assures timely submission to accounting for processing. Received by 20th and sent to Accounting Department by no later than 25th of month. · Timely reviews and approves invoices in accounting review software, verifies invoices have been coded appropriately, tied to purchase orders, routed with delivery tickets and acceptable for approval. Review and approvals should occur a minimum of twice per week. o (If Applicable) Assures effective and timely tracking of Owner Direct Purchase Orders, including timely issuance, processing of invoices, processing of budget transfers; assuring job cost reflects accurate reduction in overall contract value as ODP's are issued. (Ideally within 2 weeks of issuance). · (If Applicable) Assures effective and timely tracking of LEED scorecard. · Ensures Daily Reports created daily, as\-builts updated monthly and that no subcontractor commences work without executed Contract, Insurance in place and Bond (if required) is in hand. · Ensures the MRFs are provided accurately and timely. · On self performance projects, ensures cost tracking log is updated timely (Updated weekly) **Field Office Coordination \- Assistant Project Manager, General Construction** · Consistentl  · Ability to review subcontractor change orders for scope, and negotiate with subcontractors accordingly. · Exhibits proficiency in review of plans and specifications for completeness, conflicts and agreement between disciplines. · Ability to craft and/or review prepared RFI language, crafted in a manner to best solicit desired response as necessary and create best position for MCM. · Ability to identify and document potential issues to mitigate conflicts, time impacts, and cost events. **Corporate Involvement \- Assistant Project Manager, General Construction** · Participates regularly in continuing education, personal training, and professional improvement to continually improve Project Management skills. · Ability to perform peer and subordinate performance evaluations, providing fair and frank evaluation of individuals performance using constructive, positive evaluation and constructive criticism in order to provide recommendations for individual's professional improvement. (Review of prior year's developmental Goals, future goals to individually set targets for upcoming year) · Offers improvements and recommendations in relation to corporate policies and procedures. · Participates in corporate, community and/or networking causes and gatherings to promote corporate and personal exposure and community involvement. · Solicit and work toward receiving outstanding reference recommendation letters from client, if available. Achieve highest possible score from client if no reference letters are allowed. · Maintain and develop networking relationships with current, past, and future Clients, Architects, etc. for business development. **Skills/Knowledge \- Assistant Project Manager, General Construction** · Good interpersonal relationship \& strong communication skills. · Delegation of duties and follow up. · Able to initiate and maintain positive internal and external public relations. · Ability to check quality, correctness and supervise field work \- all disciplines. · Able to apply innovative and effective management techniques to maximize employee performance. **Qualifications and Experience \- Assistant Project Manager, General Construction** · Four (4\) year Engineering or Construction Management degree. Graduate degree preferred. · Florida General Contractor’s License or PE License desired. · Minimum four (4\) years experience/knowledge of construction, design, finance and management of less than $5 million. The above description covers the principal tasks and responsibilities of the job. The description shall not, however, be construed as a complete listing of all miscellaneous, incidental or similar duties which may be required from day to day. *MCM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All aspects of consideration for employment with MCM are governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by federal, state and/or local law.* Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * • Will you be willing to go through a background check? * • Will you be willing to take a drug test? * • Have you previously been employed by MCM, StrongCore Group, or any of its subsidiaries? * • Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., E\-3, H\-1B, O\-1, TN, etc. visa status)? * • Do you have any pending criminal charges (including misdemeanor, felony, or criminal negligence)? * • Have you ever been convicted of a crime (including misdemeanor, felony, or criminal negligence)? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Commercial Construction: 4 years (Required) * Project Management: 2 years (Required) Language: * Spanish (Preferred) Work Location: In person
