We are committed to delivering sustainable solutions that improve the quality of life for communities worldwide. **Job Description:** We are looking for a Design Compliance Manager with a minimum of 15 years of experience in design supervision, of which 5 years should be on facilities/buildings. The ability to manage a team and collaborate with others is a must. Experience in Progressive Design\-Build delivery or alternative delivery is a significant plus. In person presence in Seattle / Federal Way is required. **Position Overview:** We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Design Compliance Manager to lead the design efforts for a major progressive design build program in Seattle. The successful candidate will oversee the design process, ensuring that all project requirements are met with a focus on quality, safety, and sustainability. **Key Responsibilities:** * Work with the design team of the progressive design\-builder, providing direction and support throughout the project lifecycle. * Build a strong culture among the consultant (DBPM) design team, including with ‘design lead’ direct reports for various disciplines, with emphasis on collaboration, trust, and accountability. * Support the design\-build team to develop and implement design strategies that align with project goals and client expectations. * Engage with the design\-build team. Work with multidisciplinary teams, including engineers, architects, and planners, to develop cohesive and integrated design solutions. * Provide support for the preparation of design documents, specifications, and reports. Be responsible for the technical requirements and specifications on behalf of the client. * Review progressive design\-builder’s design for compliance with all relevant codes, standards, and regulations. * Manage project budgets, schedules, and resources to ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery. * Conduct design reviews and provide technical guidance to resolve design issues. * Foster strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and contractors. * Coordinate with internal stakeholders and AHJs. * Promote a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement within the design team. * Be present at the project office full time throughout the design phase. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred. * Professional Engineer (PE) license or architecture license (AIA/RA) is preferred. * Minimum of 15 years of experience in design management, 5 of these in facilities/buildings, preferably in transit or infrastructure projects. * DBIA certified is desirable. * Proven track record of successfully managing large\-scale design projects. * Strong leadership and team management skills. * Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. * Experience with Progressive Design\-Build or similar collaborative delivery method (CM/GC / CMAR, Alliance) and ability to embrace this work environment. * Knowledge of local, state, and federal regulations and standards is preferred. **What We Offer:** * Competitive salary and benefits package. * Opportunities for professional growth and development. * A collaborative and inclusive work environment. * The chance to work on impactful projects that make a difference in the community. Bring your expertise, curiosity, and drive to make a difference. If you are ready to join a collaborative consultancy where your perspective is valued, your growth is supported, and you are empowered to lead with integrity, we would love to hear from you. **Benefits \& Rewards** **The expected salary for this position is $155,000 \- $185,000\.** Individual pay is determined based on several factors such as work location, education, experience, and unique skills. In addition to base salary, Mott MacDonald offers performance\-based bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package, giving employees a direct connection to our success. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support the health, wellbeing, financial security, and professional growth of our employees. Eligible employees have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA and HSA accounts, company\-paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, and a competitive 401(k) plan with company matching. We also provide paid time off, paid holidays, caregiver leave, employee referral bonuses, professional registration and membership reimbursements, and tuition assistance to support continued learning and career development. **Collaboration at Our Core** At Mott MacDonald, we believe great ideas happen when we're together. Our hybrid approach centers on an in\-office culture, with most of your time spent collaborating face\-to\-face and a minimum of three days per week in the office. We balance flexibility with connection, so you and your manager can choose how to meet clients, team, and personal commitments. **Equal opportunity is the law.** We seek to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they have the opportunity to contribute. * English version * Spanish Version * Chinese version All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status or disability status.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician II - Boston, MA
jobs.description: **About NCR Atleos** NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe. NCR Atleos was ranked \#12 in Newsweek’s prestigious 2025 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces® list. **Title: Field Service Technician II** **Location: Boston, MA** **Intro for the business:** At NCR Atleos, our Field Services organization is on the front line of keeping commerce running for some of the world’s largest retailers and financial institutions. Our technicians are trusted partners to our customers, delivering reliable, high\-quality service that keeps essential self\-service technology operating around the clock. We are looking for Field Service Technicians who are technically curious, mechanically inclined, and customer focused. Whether you already have field service experience or bring transferable technical skills, NCR Atleos provides the training, tools, and support needed to build a long\-term career in a high\-impact, customer\-facing role. **Position Summary** Are you a Field Technician, Field Engineer, or Service Technician—or interested in starting a career in this field? Are you tech savvy with strong mechanical aptitude and transferrable skills? Do you want to work with some of the largest retailers and banks in the industry? If so, NCR Atleos is interested in speaking with you! NCR Atleos’s Field Services Team creates value for our customers by delivering solutions that build long term relationships. Acting as a first line response to our customers, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with the focus being finding the right solution. You will organize, triage customer issues, and even handle some problems before they start. No matter the situation, your formal training (provided through NCR Atleos) will allow you to provide customers what they need when they need it. Our virtual and hands on classroom training enables fast learning and fosters an environment where you can stretch yourself and make an impact. NCR Atleos is committed to growing the capabilities of our people. We are building a learning community where you can work with diverse individuals, explore new ways of thinking, and expand your capabilities. Our service operations have dedicated teachers, mentors and coaches who work across territories to share their knowledge to enhance each other’s growth. NCR Atleos is dedicated to building a diverse community, one where employees feel a sense of belonging and teamwork, are valued for their contributions and the perspectives they bring. This role truly keeps commerce running across the globe and is an ambassador for the NCR Atleos Brand. Starting compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience, (geographic) location, and business needs. **Key Areas of Responsibility** * Perform customer installations, maintenance, and service calls promptly and effectively * Service and repair electromechanical equipment, including ATMs and self\-checkout systems, within an assigned territory * Perform scheduled maintenance, corrective repairs, and system overhauls * Diagnose and resolve issues involving hardware, software, networking, and system configurations * Manage network faults, system access, security settings, and remote connectivity * Organize and triage customer issues, addressing problems proactively when possible * Communicate with customers in an open, helpful, and professional manner focused on resolution * Participate in virtual and hands\-on training programs provided by NCR Atleos * Comply with NCR Atleos policies, including Shared Values, Code of Conduct, health and safety standards, accurate timekeeping, and fleet and safe driving requirements * Perform other related duties consistent with qualifications and business needs * May be reassigned to adjacent service territories during standard shifts to meet operational needs; managers will strive to communicate in advance whenever possible to minimize schedule disruptions * May elect to participate in overnight travel assignments to support broader service coverage; all travel follows established company policy and reimbursement guidelines **Basic Qualifications** • Local candidate to the specific geographic area• One (1\) or more years of related experience * Authorized to work in the United States * At least 19 years of age * Valid driver’s license and driving record that meets NCR Atleos fleet requirements * PC skills, basic electronic skills, and operating system familiarity * Ability to perform essential job functions without reasonable accommodation, including: o Prolonged travel with several hours of driving per day o Rotating and weekend shifts o Carrying and lifting tools, parts, and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. without assistance o Bending, squatting, walking, standing, sitting, reaching, and repetitive hand movements manipulating objects of various sizes **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with large servers, mainframe computers, and imaging software * A\+ Certification, CompTIA, or Network\+ (N\+) Certification Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job. **Full time employee benefits include**: * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Life Insurance * Vision Insurance * Short/Long Term Disability * Paid Vacation * 401k **EEO Statement** NCR Atleos is an equal\-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job\-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. jobs.title: Manager of Data Engineering
jobs.description: Posting Description:**Who We Are:** --------------- NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people\-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities / Essential Functions:** ---------------------------------------------------------------- Lead the platform architecture and build Own the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of our Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (Bronze Silver* Gold), ensuring data flows optimally from raw ingestion through conformed, analytics\-ready models. * Make and document key architectural decisions around ingestion patterns, storage, the serving layer, orchestration, and performance — balancing speed, reliability, and cost. * Establish the engineering practices that keep the platform healthy as it scales: version control, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. **Lead and grow the team** -------------------------- * Guide a small team of data engineers — setting coding and design standards, running code reviews, and unblocking day\-to\-day work. * Mentor engineers and help grow their technical skills, giving the team a clear sense of how “good” is defined. * Help shape hiring and team structure as the function grows. **Build and maintain the data pipelines** ----------------------------------------- * Develop and operate ingestion pipelines from multiple sources — pharmacy claims, eligibility, formulary, contract data, rebate and actuarial data, and public reference APIs (e.g., NADAC, NCPDP, CMS, 340B). * Normalize and conform data across differing PBM file specifications, formularies, and claims layouts so that downstream models are consistent and trustworthy. * Design and evolve the conformed data model and star schema that serve as the analytical source of truth. **Serve the business** ---------------------- * Ensure the platform reliably feeds downstream consumers: Power BI, Excel reporting, internal web applications, and AI/Copilot\-ready data services. * Serve as a point for complex reporting and data issues, guiding to resolution across reporting and data teams * Own data quality, governance, lineage, performance, and cost optimization end to end. * Partner with the platform architect, analytics, clinical, and product teams to align the technical roadmap with business and client priorities, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete data solutions. * Collaborate with cross\-functional leaders to prioritize initiatives and allocate resources **Minimum Requirements for Education, Experience, and Certifications/Licenses:** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * 7\+ years in data engineering, including 2\+ years leading, mentoring, or acting as tech lead for other engineers. * Deep experience building lakehouse / medallion architectures. Microsoft Fabric strongly preferred; comparable experience with Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar platforms will be considered. * Strong SQL and hands\-on proficiency in Python and/or PySpark for large\-scale data transformation. * Dimensional modeling expertise — you can design and maintain star schemas that hold up as reporting needs grow. * BI analytics fluency, including an understanding of the semantic/serving layer that makes BI performant and trustworthy. * A track record of taming messy data — ingesting and conforming heterogeneous sources and file formats into clean, reliable models. * Solid engineering fundamentals — data governance, data quality frameworks, and CI/CD for data pipelines. * Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders and collaborate across teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with pharmacy, PBM, healthcare claims, or payer data. * Familiarity with pharmacy data standards (NCPDP, claims file layouts) and healthcare reference data. * Experience enabling AI/Copilot or MCP\-based data access on top of a data platform. * Broader Azure ecosystem experience (Azure SQL, data pipelines, security/RBAC, cost management). * Experience standing up a data platform or engineering function in an early or growth\-stage environment. **What We Offer:** ------------------ We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO \& paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health \& wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, ultimately, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $135,000 – $150,000\. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance\-based incentives. **NFP and You... Better Together!** NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.title: VP, Business Technology - Ground Control
jobs.description: Posting Description: **Who We Are:** Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. **Overview:**The VP, Business Technology for Ground Control functions as the key technology partner to Newport Private Wealth leadership and leads the technology roadmap and delivery for the business. The role contributes to pinpointing where technology is needed, collaborates on solutions with enterprise technology teams, and ensures those solutions drive measurable operational and client outcomes. This leader will bridge Ground Control's distinct business management framework with Wealthspire's enterprise platforms and strategic direction. The role focuses on unifying and refining workflows across the U.S. and U.K. It seeks to minimize manual tasks, boost data quality and reporting, and expand the business without sacrificing client responsiveness. **Ground Control Business Priorities** * Develop a cohesive technology roadmap for Ground Control throughout the United States and United Kingdom, while considering local operational and regulatory requirements. * Improve and automate high\-volume business management workflows, including onboarding, service delivery, approvals, transaction processing, financial operations, reporting, and exception management. * Reduce fragmented tools and manual handoffs by connecting business workflows to Wealthspire enterprise platforms, shared data, and integration capabilities. * Strengthen business data ownership, reporting consistency, and access to client service, operational performance, capacity, and risk. * Partner with leaders and frontline teams to preserve high\-touch client service while increasing scalability, control, and operational resilience. **Core Responsibilities** Business Collaboration and Opportunity Pipeline * Function as the key technology liaison to the business leadership group, building a strong grasp of strategic focuses, operational obstacles, and growth aims. * Establish and manage an ordered stream of technology\-focused opportunities for the business, aligning current necessities with the extended platform roadmap. * Develop clear problem statements, expected outcomes, and initial value estimates, including cost savings, capacity creation, risk reduction, client experience, and revenue impact. * Represent business priorities in enterprise technology planning, investment decisions, and roadmap governance. **Solution Definition and Product Shaping** * Translate business needs into clear requirements, use cases, process designs, and measurable outcomes that delivery teams can act on. * Develop solutions collaboratively with Enterprise Applications, Data and Analytics, AI and Automation, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Infrastructure groups. * Apply a build, buy, and integrate approach, using enterprise platforms and reusable capabilities wherever they can meet the business need. * Ensure proposed solutions align with the business operating model and the broader Wealthspire technology and data strategy. **Delivery Partnership and Roadmap Execution** * Own the business roadmap and remain accountable for clarity of scope, business decisions, collaborator involvement, readiness, and value realization. * Partner with product, program, engineering, data, and vendor teams through design, testing, implementation, and stabilization. * Identify dependencies, risks, and decisions early and promote timely resolution with business and technology leaders. * Coordinate related initiatives so the business experiences a coherent set of capabilities rather than disconnected technology projects. **Data Operations and Business Reporting** * Own business\-facing data, reporting, and analytics outcomes for the assigned business. * Define critical metrics, reporting requirements, data ownership expectations, and data quality priorities with business leaders. * Work alongside e . **What This Role Does Not Own** This role is responsible for business outcomes, priorities, requirements, readiness, adoption, and value realization. It works alongside, but does not substitute, the enterprise teams responsible for these areas: * Enterprise technology strategy, architecture standards, or platform engineering. * Infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, DevOps, service desk operations, or enterprise technology governance. * Enterprise data platform engineering or data pipeline development. * Enterprise AI governance or enterprise\-wide training programs. * Independent technology procurement or vendor commitments outside established enterprise governance. **Leadership Profile** * Strong business orientation with the technology fluency to shape practical solutions and challenge assumptions constructively. * Ability to translate between executives, frontline business teams, product leaders, data teams, engineers, and external partners. * Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional change, driving adoption, and delivering measurable business outcomes. * Sound judgment in balancing local business needs with enterprise standards, reuse, risk, and long\-term scalability. * Clear, credible communicator who can frame decisions, build alignment, and maintain momentum through ambiguity. * Operates with jobs.description: We are searching for a Backend Compiler Engineer for an exciting and fun role in our GPU Software organization. jobs.title: Network Specialist II

jobs.title: Android Engineer, Plugin Developer Platform
jobs.description: Applied AI Engineering \- San Francisco **About the Team** The Plugin Developer Platform team builds the APIs, SDKs, and tools that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, connectors, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and interactive apps. We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work covers plugin creation and publishing, the systems that run plugins across our products, and open standards that developers can build on. **About the Role** We’re looking for an experienced Android engineer to bring plugins foundations that help developers extend ChatGPT and help users discover and use those capabilities from their devices. You’ll work across native Android interfaces engineers, owning features from early exploration through implementation, launch, and iteration. You’ll also engage directly with developers and partners to understand how their workflows translate to Android. Their experience will inform the interfaces and abstractions you build, the problems you prioritize, and the tradeoffs you make. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. **In this role, you will:** * Build Android experiences for plugins, connectors, and interactive apps within ChatGPT. * Develop reusable Android components and interfaces that support a growing ecosystem of developer\-built experiences. * Partner with platform engineers to connect native mobile experiences with APIs, SDKs, and backend systems. * Work with developers and partners to identify integration challenges and improve the experience of building for mobile. * Improve app performance, reliability, architecture, testing, and developer tooling. * Own projects from initial requirements through release, measurement, and iteration. **You might thrive in this role if you:** * Have deep experience building Android applications using Kotlin and modern Android development frameworks. * Have shipped consumer\-facing mobile products at scale and care deeply about performance, quality, and user experience. * Bring a platform mindset and enjoy designing reusable interfaces and abstractions that other developers build on. * Enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, and design, and working directly with developers and partners. * Are excited about bringing AI\-powered tools and extensible experiences to mobile. * Thrive in fast\-moving environments where you help define both product and technical direction. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Revenue)
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **Job Summary** --------------- OpenGov is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to serve as a dedicated practitioner within the Applied AI team, focused on Sales/GTM use cases across the revenue organization — SDR outbound, AE pipeline and opportunity management, and CSM account management and renewals — along with the account/opportunity intelligence that feeds all three. This role sits at the intersection of seller workflows, revenue systems, and applied AI, and includes hands\-on GTM engineering: building the workflows, integrations, and automations across revenue systems that make sellers faster. It exists to systematically redesign how OpenGov's revenue organization runs its motion in an AI\-native world, from lead through cash and the renewals that follow. This is a technical role applied in a traditionally non\-technical space. You bring a sharp problem\-solving mind, comfort with modern AI tools, and the instinct to decompose a complex, manual seller workflow into its components — and then design something fundamentally better. You need the ability to think from first principles, build trust with sellers and RevOps before designing for them, and own the full lifecycle from problem discovery to solution adoption. You will build the agents and systems that turn raw go\-to\-market signal (procurement data, contract/vendor intelligence, account and contact records, call and email activity) into action sellers actually take — signal\-to\-sequence automation for SDR outbound, next\-best\-action and deal\-risk surfacing for AE opportunity management, and account\-health and renewal\-risk surfacing for CSMs. You will also serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house, and be the primary AI capability advisor for the revenue organization. This role operates within the Applied AI team's technical ecosystem. You will partner closely with a dedicated analytics/ops counterpart on the sales side, partner with AI and data engineers on complex builds, and work directly with sales leadership, RevOps, and SDR/AE/CSM teams for domain guidance and go\-to\-market context. Given the revenue\-centric focus of this work, this role requires a genuine interest in driving conversion across the funnel (such as contact\-to\-meeting rate, S1/S2 conversion, and win rate), along with deal\-cycle length and renewal outcomes. Pipeline management itself sits with sales leadership and RevOps, and you will work closely with them. You will not own KPI definitions or reporting, but you will apply the necessary rigor and ROI framing to make sure what gets built is actually moving those numbers. You will have access to data, ownership, and core responsibilities at a level comparable to senior sales leadership, and are expected to exercise that with corresponding discretion. **You Will…** ------------- * **Own the AI\-native signal\-to\-action layer for Sales**: design, build, and continuously improve the agents and automations that turn account/contact/product signal into qualified SDR sequences, AE opportunity actions, and CSM account and renewal actions, with clear human review and approval points before anything reaches a prospect or customer. * **Build for AE and CSM workflows specifically, not just top\-of\-funnel outbound**: deal\-risk and next\-best\-action surfacing for AEs managing opportunities through the pipeline, and account\-health, renewal\-risk, and expansion\-signal surfacing for CSMs managing customers through renewal — this role's scope is the revenue organization, not one segment of it. * **Serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house**: drive the roadmap, prioritization, and quality bar for the call\- and deal\-intelligence and other revenue systems the Applied AI team builds, in partnership with sales leadership and the RevOps/analytics counterpart. * **Design the human oversight for every agent you ship**: approval gates, escalation paths, and clear ownership boundaries so SDRs, AEs, and CSMs stay in control of what goes out under their name — an agent recommends and drafts, a human approves and sends. * **Build and run evaluation frameworks for agent beh  tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar), and working fluency with SQL; able to extract insight from data and frame it clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-starter with high initiative: you see opportunities, propose solutions, and drive them forward without waiting to be told. This role will involve significant ambiguity, and the right person will find that energizing rather than paralyzing. * Exceptional written and verbal communication: you write clearly, you do not create information silos, and you know how to tailor your message to the audience in front of you. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Prior experience in sales/revenue operations, customer success operations, or a forward\-deployed/solutions\-architecture role. * Experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, or building MCP servers. * Familiarity with AI governance concepts: prompt design, data access controls, audit trails, and responsible AI principles in sensitive\-data environments. * Experience building or deploying workflow automations or internal tools without engineering support. * Familiarity with Snowflake, Looker, or similar data platforms at a data analysis level (not data engineering). * Applied ML and experimentation background: A/B testing, propensity models, recommendations, or lead/account scoring. * Experience working in a fast\-moving, high\-growth SaaS environment where the org is actively evolving and priorities shift quickly. * Experience working at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, or Sales and RevOps — roles that required navigating cross\-functional data ownership and system permissions. * Prior exposure to public sector or B2G sales, or other environments with elevated data handling standards. **Compensation** ---------------- Chicago, IL: $150,000 \- $165,000 On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $150K \- $165K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. ### **About the Role** Forward Deployed Engineering is how we build that platform with real clients instead of guessing. An FDE embeds with a client, works in the client's own codebase, and builds their integration against OpenLoop's production API. Whatever the client needs that the platform cannot do yet is filed as a platform gap and built once, centrally, so every client inherits it. The work product of an FDE is not the client's integration; it is the reusable asset that client forced into existence: a recipe others start from, an executable check behind every claim in our docs, a client manifest that makes the impact of any platform change computable, and the SDKs, agents and tooling that make the next deployment faster than the last. You will write production code in two places, the client's system and ours. You will take an ask that is vague or over\-promised and turn it into a scope you can defend. You will tell a client, and our own sales team, when something should not be committed to. And you will leave every deployment better instrumented than you found it, so the next client needs less of us than the last one did. We are hiring for this role at the Senior, Staff and Senior Staff levels. Apply once; we will calibrate level during the process based on the scope you have carried, not on years alone. The section below describes what changes as scope grows. ### **What You'll Do** * Build for clients, in their codebase, against our API. Embed with a client's engineering team and stand up their integration on OpenLoop's Partner API: their app, their data, their identity, their legacy systems. Own the outcome through go\-live and the weeks after it. Never wire around the platform: where the API falls short, file the gap with the endpoint it stands in for, and leave a dated, time\-boxed workaround at most. * Build with AI in the loop, for clients and for us. Ship the systems that let a client build on us with AI in the loop: SDKs and reference implementations, a CLI and machine\-readable docs a client can hand to their own coding agent, and agentic workflows on our API such as intake, routing, support and refill journeys, with human review by design, evaluations before launch and monitoring after. * Run deployments on the agent roster, and make it better. Use and extend the agents that run our deployments: the tenant readiness gate, conformance checks against a live tenant, seeding checkers, docs\-freshness and superseding drafts, gap filing, client communication drafts. Every agent output is a draft a human approves, and you are accountable for knowing when the agent is wrong. * Turn one client's need into every client's capability. Contribute additive recipes and checks to the shared cookbook, keep client manifests current, and bring the evidence that moves a recurring workaround into the platform roadmap instead of into another workaround. The measure is how much less of us the next client needs. * Turn ambiguity into a plan. Take a client ask that is vague, over\-promised or self\-contradictory and produce a phased, defensible scope, with a clear statement of what we are not doing and what the API does not do yet. * Never undo prior work. Checks lock the claims we publish; manifests tell you who depends on what; edits are additive or explicitly superseding with a compatibility window. A change that would break a live client stops and becomes a proposal, not a merge. * Hold the line, internally and externally. Be the credible technical voice with client engineering and with our own go\-to\-market team: what we cannot do, what we should not do, and what will not fit the timeline are three different answers, and all three are better delivered early. * Raise the bar around you. Share what a deployment taught you, review other people's integration designs, and help write the playbook for a team that is being built now. ### **Who You Are** * 5 to 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time delivering directly for external customers or partners, in their environments, not only internal roadmap work. We are filling roles across this range; depth of ownership matters more to us than the number. * End\-to\-end ownership of complex, customer\-facing technical delivery: you can name the deployments you ran, what went wrong, and what you did about it after launch. * Strong integration engineering depth: API design and consumption, auth, webhooks versus polling, idempotency, rate limits, pagination, schema drift, reconciliation, and comfort across the stack from APIs to data to cloud infrastructure. * You build with AI agents every day and can show how you verify what they produce, when you stop trusting them, and how you evaluate an LLM\-based system before it reaches a customer. * Experience handling sensitive data with a security\-first mindset, treating compliance constraints as design inputs rather than follow\-ups. * Excellent communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, including delivering unwelcome news to a customer early and keeping the relationship. * Demonstrated judgment about scope: you can point to things you descoped, sequenced or declined, and explain why. * Evidence of leverage beyond your own delivery: SDKs, tooling, checks, reference implementations or practices you built that made other people's work faster. The scale of that leverage is part of how we calibrate level. **Preferred** * Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain where a mistake has consequences beyond a rollback. * Practical experience shipping LLM\-based or agentic systems to production, including how you measured quality and what you did when the model was confidently wrong. * Experience building developer platforms: SDKs, CLIs, API conventions, documentation that is tested rather than written. * Familiarity with EHR, scheduling, pharmacy or payments integrations; FHIR is a plus. * Experience working alongside sales or solutions teams in pre\-sales technical conversations without becoming a blocker. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **How You Work** OpenLoop's values are prescriptive, and this role tests all of them: Disciplined Intensity: effective under real deadline pressure, and you build systems instead of becoming the only person who can fix things. Do No Harm: patient safety and data integrity come first, and you know when to slow down to do it right. Step In, Stay In: your ownership travels to the outcome, not to the handoff. Purposeful Speed: you ship fast without leaving behind something only you can maintain. Clarity Over Comfort: you say the thing, explain the why, and invite disagreement. Core collaboration hours are CST 8am to 5pm, with client\-facing work occasionally requiring flexibility outside them. Remote within the United States; periodic travel to clients and to team working sessions. **Our Benefits** ---------------- In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect - Remote
jobs.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people\-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** Optum Health Technology is seeking an experienced AI Solution Architect to lead the architecture, design, and governance of enterprise\-scale AI solutions that transform healthcare delivery, clinician experience, operational efficiency, and consumer engagement. This role will partner closely with business leaders, product teams, engineering organizations, data scientists, and enterprise architects to define and implement AI\-first technology strategies. The architect will design scalable, secure, and compliant solutions leveraging generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, cloud\-native platforms, and healthcare data ecosystems. The successful candidate will establish reference architectures, accelerate AI adoption across Optum Health, and ensure AI solutions align with responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, and enterprise technology standards. You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Lead end\-to\-end architecture for AI\-powered healthcare solutions across clinical, operational, consumer, provider, and value\-based care domains * Define enterprise AI architecture patterns, standards, guardrails, and reusable frameworks for GenAI, agentic AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation solutions * Design scalable architectures incorporating LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and healthcare data platforms * Partner with business and product leaders to identify opportunities where AI can drive meaningful business and healthcare outcomes * Establish AI platform integration patterns leveraging Azure AI services, cloud\-native technologies, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise applications * Has good underdstnading of US Healthcare domain, healthcare standards and platforms including FHIR, HL7, Epic, claims systems, provider systems, and clinical data platforms * Collaborate with AI engineering, MLOps, platform engineering, security, privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure production readiness * Define and implement Responsible AI controls including fairness, explainability, transparency, governance, risk management, and human\-in\-the\-loop processes * Guide engineering teams on AI application design, prompt engineering strategies, agent orchestration patterns, model evaluation, and deployment architectures * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and industry trends to inform long\-term Optum Health technology strategy * Influence enterprise\-wide architectural decisions and provide technical leadership across multiple portfolios and business segments * Drive hands\-on execution through rapid prototyping, proof\-of\-concept (PoC) development, and minimum viable product (MVP) implementations * Apply deep AIDLC understanding to establish, optimize, and standardize the AI Development Life Cycle across projects * Operates as a recognized AI architecture leader across Optum Health * Influences architecture decisions across multiple portfolios and business units * Balances innovation with risk management, compliance, security, and business value * Champions AI\-first thinking and drives adoption of modern engineering and architecture practices * Mentors architects and engineers while fostering technical excellence and innovation * Communicates effectively with executive leadership, engineering teams, and business stakeholders You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications:** * 12\+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or software engineering roles * 3\+ years of experience designing and delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or intelligent automation solutions * 1\+ year of experience architecting solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Deep expertise on one of the Agentic Platform or framework such as LangGrph, Agno, Autogen, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, or conversational AI platforms, Guardrails * 1\+ year of experience with vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge management platforms * 1\+ year of experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI and data services * 1\+ year of experience designing distributed, scalable, and resilient enterprise architectures * 1\+ year of experience defining architecture standards, reference architectures, and technology governance processes * Proven experience leading cross\-functional teams across product, engineering, architecture, and business organizations * Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive enterprise technology decisions **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related discipline * Healthcare industry experience across Optum Health, provider organizations, population health, value\-based care, or payer platforms * Experience integrating healthcare systems utilizing HL7, FHIR, EHR platforms, claims systems, provider systems, or clinical applications * Experience deploying production\-scale AI platforms and MLOps capabilities * Experience with Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot technologies, and enterprise AI platforms * All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $112,700 \- $193,200 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. **Application Deadline:** This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.* *UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.* *UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug\-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

jobs.title: Data Science Lead
jobs.description: **OpusClip** **is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.** We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 10 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence. We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more. Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024\. Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values: * Be a Champion Team * Prioritize Ruthlessly * Ship fast, Quality Follows * Obsess over customers Be a part of this exciting journey with us! **About the Role** ------------------ OpusClip is looking for a staff\-level, product\-oriented Data Science leader to build an effective and increasingly AI\-native data function. You will set priorities for a small Data team, personally lead our hardest analytical problems, improve how we measure product and business performance, and build systems that help teams make better decisions with less manual analytical work. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You may lead through direct management or technical leadership; formal people management is not required. We care more about your ability to lead through judgment, technical depth, and example. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI across product analytics, experimentation, user intelligence, data quality, growth measurement, AI data flywheels, and agentic analytics. This expands the existing role from owning trusted metrics and analyses into setting direction and creating leverage across the Data function. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Lead the Data function** * Set priorities for a small Data team and focus limited capacity on the highest\-impact problems. * Personally lead ambiguous or high\-stakes analytical projects. * Raise standards for metrics, experimentation, analytical quality, and decision\-making. * Lead and develop Data Scientists, analysts, and Data Engineers through technical direction and example. * Reduce repetitive and reactive work by turning recurring problems into reusable systems and processes. ### **Drive product and business decisions** * Analyze activation, retention, segmentation, monetization, user behavior, and lifetime value. * Translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear recommendations. * Identify opportunities where Data can directly improve key company metrics. * Build stronger user profiling and segmentation to inform product strategy, operations, and company goal setting. * Improve experimentation and causal measurement across Product and Growth. The existing JD already emphasizes turning product and customer data into business decisions; this role owns that mandate at a broader level. ### **Improve data quality and measurement** * Establish trusted definitions and validation for critical product and business metrics. * Identify systematic issues across tracking, pipelines, transformations, tables, and dashboards. * Partner with Data Engineering and Engineering to prevent recurring data problems rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms. * Build reusable datasets, metric definitions, monitoring, and analytical frameworks that improve self\-service. jobs.title: Electrical Power Generation Engineer (Substation, MV & LV power) - Data Center Operations (on-site Nashville, TN)
jobs.description: \>\>This position will be full\-time on\-site at Oracle's offices located in **Nashville, TN** . Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Oracle’s relocation policies. Candidates should expect a **minimum of 25% travel** , with additional travel as business needs require.\<\< The Electrical Power Generation Engineer provides technical leadership for the design, delivery, commissioning, and operational readiness of mission\-critical data center power infrastructure. The role requires extensive knowledge of grid substations, medium\-voltage (MV) and low\-voltage (LV) distribution equipment, power quality monitoring, power\-generation systems, protective relaying, switchgear, transformers, and related electrical infrastructure. This engineer works cross\-functionally with design, engineering, construction, delivery, commissioning, and operations teams from project inception through final handover to ensure the power\-generation infrastructure is safe, resilient, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with data center availability objectives. **Key Responsibilities** * Serve as the electrical power\-generation subject\-matter expert across concept development, detailed design, construction, commissioning, operational handover, and lifecycle support. * Define electrical design criteria, system architecture, capacity, redundancy, reliability, maintainability, grounding, protection, and operational\-readiness requirements. * Lead design and technical reviews for grid substations, utility interconnections, high\-voltage and medium\-voltage substations, transformers, switchgear, breakers, protection relays, cables, grounding, metering, and communications interfaces. * Design and review MV and LV electrical distribution systems, including MV switchgear, transformers, LV switchboards, motor\-control centers, panelboards, distribution boards, UPS interfaces, automatic transfer switches, and busway systems. * Review electrical interfaces for generator systems, generator step\-up transformers, generator breakers, paralleling switchgear, load banks, and associated balance\-of\-plant electrical equipment. * Establish and validate power\-system operating strategies, including utility transfer, generator paralleling, power quality monitoring, load shedding, restoration, emergency operations, and failover scenarios. * Coordinate utility\-interconnection requirements, including protection coordination, relay settings, anti\-islanding, transfer\-trip, telemetry, metering, energization plans, and operating agreements. * Perform or review short\-circuit, load\-flow, arc\-flash, harmonic, grounding, voltage\-drop, and protective\-device coordination studies. * Review electrical one\-line diagrams, schematics, protection diagrams, equipment specifications, cable schedules, vendor submittals, and construction\-installation packages. * Collaborate with mechanical, I\&C, network, controls, construction, delivery, commissioning, and operations teams to ensure coordinated, buildable, testable, and maintainable solutions. * Develop and support commissioning plans for substation energization, equipment startup, relay testing, switchgear testing, generator testing, load\-bank testing, integrated systems testing, and utility\-transfer tests. * Lead root\-cause analysis of electrical faults, protective trips, power\-quality events, equipment failures, and recurring operational issues. * Develop electrical operating procedures, maintenance strategies, emergency\-response plans, spare\-parts recommendations, and lifecycle replacement plans. * Ensure complete turnover documentation, including as\-built drawings, relay settings, test reports, commissioning records, equipment manuals, training materials, warranties, and asset records. * Support operations through periodic testing, outage planning, capacity upgrades, maintenance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement. Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety, utility, environmental, and regulatory requirements. * **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * 10\+ years of experience with utility substations, grid interconnection, MV and LV electrical distribution systems, and mission\-critical or industrial power infrastructure. * Strong knowledge of MV switchgear, LV switchboards, transformers, protective relays, generators, paralleling switchgear, UPS systems, ATS equipment, and electrical distribution equipment. * Experience performing or reviewing short\-circuit, load\-flow, arc\-flash, grounding, harmonic, and protection\-coordination studies. * Demonstrated experience delivering electrical infrastructure from design through construction, commissioning, and operational turnover. * Ability to interpret and develop electrical one\-line diagrams, control schematics, protection diagrams, equipment specifications, and commissioning procedures. * Strong cross\-functional coordination, troubleshooting, technical writing, vendor\-management, and communication skills. * Ability to support 24/7 critical operations, planned maintenance windows, and emergency\-response events. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with hyperscale or enterprise data centers, microgrids, utility\-scale power systems, or high\-voltage substations. * Familiarity with IEEE, IEC, NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, NEC, NESC, NETA, OSHA, and applicable utility\-interconnection standards. * Experience with SEL, GE, Siemens, ABB/Hitachi Energy, Schneider Electric, Eaton, and Vertiv UPS systems and equipment. jobs.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building platforms and tools that enable engineering teams to build, test, deploy, and operate cloud services at scale. Our team develops distributed services, APIs, developer tooling, and full\-stack experiences that improve the developer experience across OCI. As a Principal Platform Software Engineer, you will own major platform components from technical design and implementation through rollout and production operation. You will work with partner engineering teams to turn developer pain points into reusable capabilities, remain hands\-on across the stack, and provide technical leadership and mentorship within the team. AI\-native software engineering is a core part of this work. You will build and evaluate AI\-enabled developer workflows and apply AI\-assisted and agentic techniques to how software is designed, implemented, tested, reviewed, operated, and maintained, while protecting correctness, security, reliability, and maintainability. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and build scalable distributed services, APIs, developer tools, and user\-facing experiences for OCI engineering teams. * Own major components and features across requirements, architecture, implementation, automated testing, safe rollout, and production support. * Partner with engineering teams to identify recurring developer pain points and turn them into reusable platform capabilities across development, CI/CD, and operations. * Prototype solutions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and remain hands\-on with implementation, debugging, and performance tuning. * Contribute reusable engineering patterns for testing, observability, security, reliability, and operational readiness. * Mentor engineers and provide technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, and clear technical documentation. * Operate production services, participate in on\-call and incident response, and improve automation, runbooks, and incident prevention. **AI\-First Engineering Expectations** * Apply AI\-assisted and agentic techniques to implementation, testing, code review, debugging, documentation, operations, and software maintenance. * Build and evaluate AI\-enabled developer tools and workflows that simplify or automate recurring engineering work. * Critically validate AI\-generated code, tests, designs, and analysis through engineering review and automated checks. * Contribute reusable patterns, interfaces, tests, and documentation that help engineers and AI agents work effectively, while following enterprise security and privacy requirements and using approved tools. **Minimum Qualifications** * BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6 to 10\+ years of professional software development experience. * Proficiency in Java and experience building REST and/or gRPC services. * Experience building full\-stack software, including backend services and user\-facing tools or web applications. * Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems. * Experience designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable distributed systems, with attention to correctness, resilience, and predictable performance. * Experience with distributed databases and SQL and/or NoSQL data stores. * Experience with modern engineering practices, including source control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience delivering large\-scale services through implementation, safe deployment, and production operation. * Experience with production observability, operational automation, incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. * Ability to provide hands\-on technical leadership, mentor engineers, and improve engineering practices through design and code reviews. * Practical experience applying AI\-assisted development techniques and critically validating generated code, tests, designs, or analysis. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building developer platforms, developer tooling, CI/CD systems, or engineering productivity capabilities. * Experience building AI\-enabled developer tools, coding agents, or agentic engineering workflows. * Experience developing and operating services on OCI, AWS, Azure, or another public cloud. * Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform. * Experience with multi\-tenant services, capacity planning, caching, throttling, and performance isolation.

jobs.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description: As a Principal Platform Engineer on the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team, you’ll provide technical leadership for Tier\-0, mission\-critical identity services powering authentication and authorization at cloud scale. You’ll design highly available and reliable distributed systems, lead complex technical initiatives, and help build the next generation of identity infrastructure for AI and agentic ecosystems. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with broad impact across architecture, engineering, and service operations. **Required Technical Skills** * Strong programming skills in Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, or a similar language. * Deep understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and high\-availability architectures. * Significant experience designing and operating large\-scale, mission\-critical cloud services. * Strong experience with REST APIs, microservices, cloud architectures, CI/CD, and automated testing. * Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, application security, and secure software development. * Experience troubleshooting complex production systems and driving reliability and performance improvements. Understanding of security and compliance requirements such as FedRAMP and PCI DSS. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems. * Experience operating Tier\-0 or similarly critical services with stringent availability requirements. * Experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Experience with observability, SLOs, distributed tracing, and reliability engineering. * Experience with OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, JWT, or related identity standards. * Experience with applied cryptography. Familiarity with emerging identity models for AI agents, machine identities, delegation, and agentic systems. * **Expectations** * Own the technical direction and long\-term health of critical IAM capabilities. * Solve complex and ambiguous problems spanning multiple systems and teams. * Make sound architectural decisions balancing security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. * Drive Tier\-0 service availability and reliability through resilient architecture and operational excellence. * Lead complex initiatives from architecture through production operation. * Anticipate technical and operational risks and drive solutions proactively. * Help define identity and authorization architectures for the emerging agentic ecosystem. * Influence technical decisions across teams and mentor other engineers. Remain hands\-on through implementation, prototyping, debugging, and technical reviews. * **Success Indicators** * Delivers secure, highly available IAM systems at significant scale. * Improves the reliability and resilience of mission\-critical services. * Drives major technical initiatives across service and team boundaries. * Anticipates and resolves complex architectural and production challenges. * Advances next\-generation identity capabilities for AI and agentic workloads. * Raises the technical effectiveness of the broader engineering organization. * Earns trust through strong technical judgment, execution, ownership, and influence. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture, design, and development of secure, highly available IAM services. * Drive service reliability, availability, scalability, and operational excellence for Tier\-0 production systems. * Design and operate distributed services at high scale, addressing performance, capacity, resilience, and failure modes. * Define technical direction and lead complex initiatives spanning multiple services and teams. * Architect next\-generation identity capabilities for AI agents, machine identities, services, and users. * Lead design reviews and make high\-impact architectural decisions. * Diagnose complex production issues and drive systemic improvements that prevent recurrence. * Improve observability, automation, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. * Partner with Product Management, Security, and engineering teams to deliver durable technical solutions. Mentor engineers and raise engineering standards through technical leadership, design, and code reviews. * \#LI\-SP1

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure’s Physical Networking organization builds and operates the global network infrastructure supporting OCI workloads across more than 50 regions. Join the team responsible for network fabrics supporting OCI Dedicated Regions and Multicloud Connectivity. As a hands\-on Senior Network Engineer, you’ll work with customers on network requirements, develop network designs and standards, and help establish reliable deployment and incident response processes. You’ll own defined projects while collaborating with internal teams and mentoring peers. The successful candidate will combine strong networking fundamentals with automation, disciplined change execution, and practical problem\-solving. You will collaborate with network automation, virtual networking, compute, hardware, security, monitoring, region deployment, and operations teams to deliver reliable, secure, and repeatable deployments for our customers. **What you’ll do** * Design and operate data\-center fabrics, routing, and secure connectivity supporting OCI’s physical network infrastructure. * Translate customer and product requirements into network designs, configuration standards, and deployment plans. * Own projects from technical design through validation, deployment, documentation, and operational handoff. * Build network automation and validation tools using Python, APIs, Git workflows, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Execute production changes with pre\-change checks, post\-change verification, and rollback procedures. * Improve monitoring, capacity planning, runbooks, and incident response; troubleshoot issues across protocols, devices, optics, and automation. * Participate in a periodic on\-call rotation, responding to large\-scale network incidents and driving them to resolution. * Contribute to design reviews, develop repeatable standards, and mentor other engineers. **Required qualifications** * Eight years of relevant network engineering experience; or a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field and four years of experience; or a master’s degree and two years of experience; or a relevant doctorate. * Strong understanding of Layer 2 through Layer 4 networking, IP addressing and subnetting, BGP, OSPF, IPv4, IPv6, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, ECMP, and high\-availability design. * Experience designing, deploying, or operating data\-center , cloud, service\-provider, or large\-enterprise networks. * Hands\-on experience automating network provisioning, configuration, validation, or operations using Python or another programming language. * Experience with Git, APIs, CI/CD workflows, automated testing, configuration modeling, or infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Experience executing production network changes with appropriate risk assessment, validation, rollback, and change\-management controls. * Demonstrated troubleshooting skills across network protocols, devices, automation systems, and physical infrastructure. * Experience participating in incident response, root\-cause analysis, operational readiness, and continuous improvement. * Ability to work independently, manage project milestones and dependencies, and coordinate effectively with engineering and operations teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical designs, runbooks, and project updates. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience building or operating hyperscale cloud, service\-provider , ISP, or large\-scale data\-center networks. * Experience partnering with cloud networking and platform teams to integrate virtual network services with physical underlay infrastructure. * Experience with Clos or spine\-leaf fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, SDN overlays, traffic engineering, segmentation, and secure service connectivity. * Experience with Terraform, Ansible, YANG, OpenConfig , NETCONF, gNMI , or comparable model\-driven networking technologies. * Experience implementing network telemetry and observability using SNMP, streaming telemetry, NetFlow/IPFIX, flow logs, dashboards, alerting, and service\-level indicators. * Knowledge of network\-security principles, including ACL and routing\-policy management, least privilege, segmentation, MACsec, IPsec, and TLS. * Experience with commodity Ethernet platforms, optics, structured cabling, hardware qualification, and network operating\-system validation. * Experience improving operational workflows through automated validation, reusable runbooks, deployment guardrails, or configuration\-drift detection. * Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve automation, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, or operational efficiency.
