jobs.description: Overview: Our corporate office in Rohnert Park, CA has an immediate opening for an experienced IT **Technology Specialis**t person with an upbeat approachable attitude. As a Technology / Help Desk Specialist, you will be required to provide technical support to the staff, troubleshoot hardware and software problems, and support multiple operating systems and software applications. In addition, this position will work closely with the rest of the IT support team to identify and resolve technical issues that arise. Work with the programming team to perform various tests to identify and resolve bugs and defects in software. To ensure success as a help desk specialist, you should have advanced knowledge of computer software and hardware systems, excellent diagnostic skills, and high\-level communication skills. A skilled help desk specialist provides fast and effective support over the phone, video, and in person. **Apply Today!** Responsibilities: * The focus of the position is to assist with installation and support of hardware and software at all the company locations. Assist the IT Department by providing support to resolve software and hardware problems. * Provide technical assistance and support for incoming queries and issues related to computer systems, software, and hardware. * Identifying, diagnosing, and resolving hardware and software problems. Resolve problems quickly and effectively, minimizing downtime and ensuring that staff can continue to work without interruption. * Performing various tests to identify and resolve issues and bugs in software products: Collaborating with the programming team to assess and debug software products before they are deployed or implemented. * Walk customer through problem\-solving process. * Conducting routine patching and system maintenance such as applying software updates, monitoring system performance, and managing backups. * Implement and maintain security measures to protect IT infrastructure from potential threats, such as malware, viruses, and hackers. * Stay up to date with industry trends and new technologies. This can involve attending conferences or workshops, reading technical blogs and articles, or participating in online communities to share knowledge and learn from others. * Work closely with the rest of the IT team, including developers, engineers, to ensure that the IT systems are robust, secure, and optimized for performance. * Follow up with customers to ensure issues have been resolved. * Responds to telephone calls, email, and personnel requests for technical support from local and remote customers. * Run reports to determine malfunctions that continue to occur. * Performs other assignments from time to time as requested by Supervisor or Manager to achieve department and company business goals. Qualifications: An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.* High school diploma or equivalent credential required. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in a similar role. * Comfortable troubleshooting system issues, providing system support, and conducting routine patching and maintenance. * Experience in software testing, quality assurance, or development. * Excellent communication skills, with experience communicating technical issues and solutions to technical and non\-technical team members in a clear and concise manner. * Ability to collaborate and build trusting internal relationships. Must be able to build relationships required to enable teamwork. * Must have Citrix experience. * Must have Network Configuration experience. * Proficient with Active Directory * Knowledge of VMware is a plus. * Knowledge of VEAME and Netapp storage systems is a plus. * Good working knowledge of MS Exchange, MS Server * Strong computer skills including MS Office, internet/email, Excel. * Must be creative, proactive, motivated, enthusiastic, and driven. * Exceptional attention to detail and well organized. * Willingness to approach projects with a can\-do attitude and create reasonable process where none exists; adept to finding solutions to tough problems. * Must be willing to travel to other company locations. **Education \& Experience:*** Associate degree in computer science or relevant experience in computer science, information technology, or a related field. * Certifications in relevant technologies, such as Microsoft, Cisco, or CompTIA. * Advanced computer proficiency. * CompTIA A\+ Computer Troubleshooting Certification (preferred) * Strong customer service skills. **All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, age, color, sex (including pregnancy), religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, military status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable laws or regulations. jobs.title: Data Center Engineer
jobs.description: Pico fuels the global capital markets community by providing exceptional market data services and customized managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients through the full trading lifecycle. We are a global company headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo. **Purpose of the role:** Working across Pico's and its clients' data centers in New Jersey, with additional coverage in Chicago, Mexico and Canada, the role holder will lead a team responsible for the physical build, maintenance and operational integrity of the data centre environment. The successful candidate will bring proven leadership experience and will be accountable for managing the team's book of work, setting priorities, allocating resources, developing team members and ensuring high\-quality, timely delivery. Working closely with Network and Systems Engineering, Project Management and Client Service Delivery, the role holder will provide clear direction, promote accountability and collaboration, and ensure projects and operational activities are delivered safely and efficiently. A structured approach, strong problem\-solving skills and the flexibility to work within short change windows, late at night and outside normal business hours are essential. **Responsibilities and duties** *(include but not limited to)* Key responsibilities include: * Lead, motivate and develop the Data Centre team, setting clear expectations and promoting a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement * Own and manage the team's book of work, ensuring that operational activities, projects, incidents and service requests are recorded, prioritized and delivered to agreed timelines and quality standards * Plan and allocate team resources across Chicago, New York, Mexico and Canada, balancing business priorities, capacity, skills and operational risk * Monitor delivery performance, remove blockers, manage competing priorities and provide clear progress, risk and dependency updates to stakeholders * Conduct regular team meetings and one\-to\-one discussions, provide coaching and feedback, and support individual development and succession planning * Work closely with Network and Systems Engineering, Project Management and Client Service Delivery to coordinate implementation, maintenance and support activities * Ensure the physical build, maintenance and operational integrity of Pico's and its clients' data centre environments, including rack and stack, cabling, hardware installation, migrations, cross\-connects and circuit testing * Ensure work is completed safely and in accordance with change controls, technical standards, documented procedures and customer requirements * Oversee accurate and timely updates in the ticketing system, together with inventory records, rack elevations, audit results and power\-utilisation reporting * Coordinate data centre access, shipping and receiving, equipment storage and third\-party or vendor activity * Lead the response to incidents and outages, ensuring appropriate escalation, communication, restoration activity and follow\-up actions * Provide hands\-on technical support when required and maintain a structured, problem\-solving approach during short change windows and business\-critical activity * Maintain on\-call and out\-of\-hours coverage across the team, including emergency attendance at data centre facilities when required * Travel between data centre locations as required, sometimes at short notice **Education, Skills and background** *(incl. Education and Experience Requirements)* * 10\+ years of experience in Telecommunications or Data Centre related field * In depth knowledge of Telecom structured cabling standards * In depth knowledge of network device / server deployment * In depth knowledge of DCO standards and operations * Effective organizational skills and high attention to detail * Building Management System and Branch Circuit Monitoring experience * Strong troubleshooting skills * Professional business communication and interpersonal skills * Demonstrated people leadership skills, including the ability to motivate, develop, and support team members while promoting accountability and collaboration * Mission Critical Data Centre Facility Maintenance **Working Arrangements** **(Build into Template)** **Working Arrangements** The working days for this role are Tuesday to Saturday: Tuesday to Friday 11 AM to 7 PM and Sat 9 AM to 6 PM. Sunday availability on request. This is a non\-office\-based position. Travel between data centers in New Jersey (and occasionally beyond) will be required on an on\-going basis. Home base is New Jersey, where we operate out of Equinix NY4, the travel is primarily within AMRS. The role holder will be expected to work whatever hours are necessary for the performance of this role (recognizing that it involves multiple jurisdictions / geographies including but not limited to EMEA, USA and APAC). **Other important information** Physical demands of the position include: * Lift and handle up to 50 pounds * Bend, stoop, and stretch as required for placement and retrieval of network devices, materials, or equipment * Work under a raised data center floor * Climb ladders (up to a16 feet) to reach plenum spaces **IMPORTANT DATA PRIVACY INFORMATION:** This position is available with Pico Services Inc. The controller of your personal data will be Pico Services Inc. For further information on what personal data we collect, how we will process your personal data and your rights with respect to your personal data please read our Pico Job Candidate Privacy Notice, View Here. Be a part of Pico Family Pico is an equal opportunity employer. Pico does not discriminate on the basis of a candidate's age, race, gender, color, religion, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or other non\-merit factors. All employment decisions at Pico are based on business needs, job requirements and qualifications. If you require any assistance or accommodations to be made for the recruitment process, please inform us when you submit your online application.

jobs.title: SAP Chief Solution Architect, Chief
jobs.description: Requisition ID \# 174151 **Job Category:** Information Technology **Job Level:** Director/Chief **Business Unit:** Technology \& Security **Work Type:** Hybrid **Job Location:** Oakland Department Overview Technology \& Security designs, develops, operates, and maintains PG\&E’s technology, telecommunica\-tions, and security capabilities that enable the company to meet its commitment to providing safe, reliable, and affordable service to customers. Technology \& Security partners with the business to strengthen capabilities through the development of new functionality, the implementation of modern and secure technologies, and the continuous improvement of systems and services. By reducing risk, increasing productivity, managing costs, and enabling organizational effectiveness, Technology \& Security helps advance PG\&E’s strategic priorities through trusted, innovative, and secure solutions. Position Summary The SAP Chief Technical Architect is the technology futurist and chief engineering authority for the Propel Program. This role defines what SAP capabilities PG\&E should adopt, when to adopt them, how to govern them, and how to ensure the technical foundation is ready for future releases. The role owns the long\-term SAP technology strategy and future\-state architecture across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business Technology Platform, Integration Suite, Datasphere, Business Data Cloud, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Build, HANA Cloud, SAP AI and Joule, security, development, data, integration, observability, and platform services. It aligns SAP strategy with enterprise strategy and ensures solutions are scalable, secure, operable, cost\-conscious, upgrade\-ready, and consistent with Clean Core principles. This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. This Chief will be assigned to PG\&E’s headquarters in Oakland, California. Reporting This SAP Chief Technical Architect reports directly to the Senior Director, IT—SAP Technology Enablement \& Operations. This is an engineering executive, high\-level individual contributor role that leads through technical authority, influence, standards, governance, and cross\-functional coordination. The SAP Chief Technical Architect provides functional direction to architects and technical teams and acts as the escalation point and tie\-breaker for high\-impact technology decisions. Job Responsibilities The SAP Chief Technical Architect addresses complex issues that span the enterprise. managing projects or initiatives that are high complexity and significant risk. The Chief works with Senior Management to guide strategies and decisions. “Propel” is the enterprise\-wide technical transformation project. Own Propel's 12\-, 24\-, and 36\-month SAP technology roadmap, including target\-state architecture, lifecycle transitions, sequencing, dependencies, investment needs, and retirement of legacy capabilities. Keep SAP strategy aligned with PG\&E enterprise strategy, business priorities, security requirements, architecture standards, operating\-model needs, financial objectives, and SAP product direction. Evaluate emerging SAP capabilities and recommend what to adopt, when to adopt it, and what not to adopt based on business value, maturity, risk, cost, security, operational readiness, and release timing. Own the SAP innovation backlog and governed POC pipeline for generative and agentic AI, Joule, SAP Knowledge Graph, SAP Build Code, Event Mesh, Business Data Cloud, SAP Graph, advanced observability, and Cloud ALM. Define success criteria and scale, defer, redesign, or stop recommendations. Own Propel's SAP technical governance framework and architecture decision process. Establish reference architectures, standards, reusable patterns, guardrails, decision records, architecture signoffs, and exception controls. Define and govern BTP platform architecture, account and subaccount principles, environments, entitlements, connectivity, security, service adoption, lifecycle management, observability, support readiness, capacity, and cost optimization. Guide adoption of Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, Build Work Zone, Build Process Automation, Build Code, Business Application Studio, HANA Cloud, AI Core, AI Launchpad, and Joule Foundation. Own future\-state integration architecture across SAP, MuleSoft, legacy platforms, cloud applications, GIS, OpenText, SailPoint, HR ecosystems, and enterprise services. Drive API\-first, event\-driven, reusable patterns and reduce point\-to\-point integrations. Set the direction for SAP data, reporting, and analytics, including the transition path for Datasphere and Business Data Cloud, HANA Cloud, enterprise data platforms, semantic models, data products, data quality, lineage, access, reuse, and lifecycle controls. Own the roadmap for SAP Cloud ALM, monitoring, observability, test management, change control, release management, business\-process and integration monitoring, technology  p across multiple SAP architecture domains, including S/4HANA, BTP, integration, data and analytics, development, security, platform engineering, application lifecycle management, and operations. Experience defining target\-state architectures, multi\-year roadmaps, transition plans, architecture standards, technology governance, and investment recommendations for large SAP transformations. Experience influencing architects, engineers, delivery teams, executives, vendors, and system integrators and communicating complex technology decisions, risk, cost, and trade\-offs to senior leadership. Experience providing direction to a team of technology architects Desired Master's degree in a related discipline. Deep expertise with SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP, with experience in Integration Suite and one or more of Datasphere, Business Data Cloud, Cloud ALM, SAP Build, HANA Cloud, SAP AI Core, AI Launchpad, or Joule. Experience with Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensibility, API\-first integration, event\-driven architecture, semantic modeling, data products, cloud operating models, and complementary enterprise platforms. Relevant architecture, SAP, cloud, security, or IT service management certifications; experience in a regulated, asset\-intensive, or utility environment. Leadership Qualities PG\&E expects its leaders to conduct themselves with the highest ethics and integrity and to embody specific leadership qualities. Strategic Mindset Sees ahead to future possibilities and translates them into breakthrough strategies. Operates effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear. A Leader in the Community and Industry Effectively builds formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization. Anticipates and balances the needs of multiple stakeholders. Demonstrates Safety Leadership A safety champion in words and deeds with respect to both employee and public safety. Creating and maintaining a speak up culture free of retaliation. Influences and Inspires Using various\- communications that convey a clear understanding of the needs of different audiences. Maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process, and people\-related dynamics. Optimizes Team Performance Building teams with a strong identity that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals. Creating a climate where people are developed and motivated to do their best to help the organization. Values Inclusion and Respects Individual Differences Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization. Fiscally Responsible Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions. Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals. Leads Ethically and in a Compliant Manner Sponsoring and sustaining a high integrity speak\-up corporate culture which prioritizes safety, compliance, and ethics. Building on necessary level of industry, company, and subject\-matter expertise, including laws and regulations. Provides a High Level of Customer Service Building strong customer relationships and delivering hometown, customer\-centric solutions. Compensation PG\&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. We estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed within the reasonable compensation range of $195K to $264K. The decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis. This leadership role is also eligible for an annual Short Term Incentive Plan (STIP) award, as well as the Long Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) grant.

jobs.title: Distinguished Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States of America Santa Clara, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-023227 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. **Job Summary** As a Distinguished Forward Deployed Engineer for Prisma AIRS, you will serve as the principal technical authority embedded within strategic enterprise engineering teams. Operating at the intersection of AI safety, zero\-trust architecture, and distributed systems, you will architect, build, and deploy secure enterprise\-grade AI workloads to production. You will write highly performant code, define industry\-leading deployment standards, and bridge high\-impact enterprise environments with core product engineering. Your technical leadership will drive direct contributions back to the core Prisma AIRS engine, shaping the future of our product roadmap. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead Architectural Design Reviews to build zero\-trust, high\-availability AI safety topologies across enterprise environments. * Write production\-grade code (Python, Go, C\+\+) integrating Prisma AIRS into enterprise microservices and AI infrastructure. * Build high\-throughput middleware and proxy extensions for real\-time prompt security and identity\-aware access controls. * Architect automated IaC deployment modules and SDK wrappers to accelerate rapid enterprise product adoption. * Optimize low\-latency traffic paths for streaming LLM payloads, intelligent caching, and global load balancing. * Serve as the ultimate tier\-4 escalation point for mission\-critical production outages and complex distributed systems. * Analyze telemetry pipelines to resolve edge\-case failures across agentic frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex. * Upstream custom plugins, platform optimizations, and core engine enhancements to primary Prisma AIRS repositories. * Partner with cross\-functional leadership to convert recurring enterprise architectural patterns into native product capabilities. * Author enterprise reference architectures and whitepapers to establish industry standards for AI security and compliance. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of professional software development and distributed systems architecture experience in production environments. * Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience. * Master\-level proficiency in Python, Go, or C\+\+, with expertise in asynchronous programming and high\-concurrency systems. * Extensive background designing and operating API gateways (Envoy, Kong) and enterprise protocols (gRPC, REST). * Expert\-level knowledge of LLM orchestration, vector databases, runtime guardrails, and prompt injection mitigation. * Advanced mastery of containerization, custom Kubernetes operators, service meshes, and infrastructure\-as\-code across major cloud providers. * Comprehensive knowledge of enterprise security protocols, data loss prevention, and network segmentation frameworks. * Proven ability to build consensus and partner with executive leadership to translate mandates into engineering designs. * Hands\-on builder mindset, comfortable presenting to executives and debugging live production incidents. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep experience building, evaluating, and securing autonomous AI agent architectures and tool\-use execution environments. * Prior contribution to open\-source AI security tools, red\-teaming research, or LLM vulnerability benchmark suites. * Expertise in architecting large\-scale observability and logging infrastructure using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Datadog. * Hands\-on experience with automated synthetic data generation, ML\-driven data sanitization pipelines, and offline evaluation sandboxes. **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $248,700\.00 \- $341,250\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: ##### **Job Summary** Pantomath is hiring an Applied AI Engineer, Agents to build AI agents that solve complex enterprise data problems. You'll combine applied research with hands\-on engineering to develop new capabilities, evaluate what works, and bring promising approaches into production. The role spans models, agent systems, and product development: you'll explore emerging techniques, run rigorous experiments, and own the software that turns research into useful customer experiences. You'll have meaningful ownership of both the research and the engineering, with a direct path from an idea to a capability customers use. ##### **What You’ll Do** * Build and ship AI agents. Develop agentic products that solve complex enterprise problems and deliver meaningful customer value. * Advance model and agent capabilities. Explore fine\-tuning, post\-training, and other adaptation techniques to improve performance on enterprise tasks. * Design experiments and evaluations. Build datasets, benchmarks, and feedback loops to measure progress and understand failure patterns. * Build the systems behind the agents. Develop services, integrations, and infrastructure that support reliable execution at scale. * Bring research into production. Turn promising experiments into product capabilities, owning implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement. * Improve production performance. Make practical tradeoffs across quality, reliability, latency, cost, and security. * Shape the product and research direction. Partner with engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams to identify valuable problems and pursue approaches that work. ##### **What You’ll Need** * Experience building and shipping AI systems, with substantial hands\-on contributions to code, experimentation, and production engineering. * Hands\-on experience with post\-training tools such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TRL, and PEFT, including supervised fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient adaptation such as LoRA, and preference optimization or reinforcement learning. * Practical experience with LLMs, agent systems, and model evaluation. * Experience adapting or training models, with an understanding of data quality, experimental design, and generalization. * Exposure to training and evaluation data pipelines, synthetic data generation, or human feedback systems. * A working knowledge of agent orchestration, tool use, retrieval, or inference optimization. * Comfort working with enterprise data platforms, distributed systems, or production AI infrastructure. * Familiarity with distributed GPU training and efficient inference using tools such as FSDP, DeepSpeed, or vLLM, alongside reproducible experimentation and model evaluation. ##### **What You’ll Bring** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages. * The ability to read research, reproduce useful results, and assess whether an approach will translate to real\-world performance. * Comfort owning ambiguous problems and moving between research exploration and product delivery. * Clear communication, technical judgment, and a collaborative approach. ##### **About Pantomath** Pantomath is building the autonomous layer for enterprise Data Operations. Our agents catch data incidents, trace them to their root cause across the stack, and resolve them with operational context from across your entire stack. Backed by a $30M Series B led by General Catalyst (alongside Sierra Ventures, Bowery Capital, Epic Ventures, and Hitachi Ventures), Pantomath is pioneering the transition of enterprises from passive data monitoring to real\-time, autonomous incident resolution. Across our entire company, Pantomath brings together seasoned startup founders, operators with prior successful exits, and veteran talent from market\-defining technology companies including Google, Meta, Stripe, Databricks, Microsoft and Amazon. We combine the high\-ownership, high\-velocity culture of a scaling venture\-backed startup with the deep execution rigor and track record of proven industry leaders. ##### **Equal Opportunity \& Accommodations** Pantomath is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics and are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals — whether during the application and interview process or throughout employment. To request an accommodation, please contact the Head of People. ##### **FLSA Compliance Statement** This position is classified as Exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), meaning it is not eligible for overtime compensation. This classification is based on responsibilities involving advanced expertise, independent judgment, and discretionary authority over significant matters. **Pay Range for this role is 150,000 \- 230,000**

You will partner with engineering leaders and product teams to identify high\-leverage opportunities, shape technical roadmaps, raise engineering standards, and guide initiatives from early exploration through production adoption. Essential Job Functions * Define technical strategy and architecture for AI\-powered product experiences across the learner and content\-authoring ecosystem. * Design, build, and ship full\-stack systems using TypeScript, Vue.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Azure. * Lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives from problem definition through delivery, adoption, and ongoing improvement. * Establish reusable patterns for retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, model orchestration, prompt management, and human\-in\-the\-loop experiences. * Design and maintain evaluation frameworks, quality metrics, observability, and feedback loops for LLM\-powered features. * Integrate model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and other providers with careful attention to reliability, latency, token usage, cost, privacy, security, prompt\-injection risk, and graceful degradation. * Own technical direction for AI\-powered content authoring and management capabilities. * Partner with product, platform, design, data, and sibling engineering teams to translate ambiguous problems into coherent technical plans and shippable systems. * Identify architectural risks, clarify tradeoffs, and make decisions that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and long\-term leverage. * Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, operational standards, and workflows. * Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to accelerate planning, implementation, testing, and review while maintaining strong standards for correctness, jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: Lead Software Engineer, AI Experience Penn Foster Group \| Fully remote within the United States Position Summary As a Lead Software Engineer, AI Experience at Penn Foster Group, you will provide technical leadership for the design and delivery of AI\-native products that help millions of learners discover, enroll in, and progress through our programs. You will operate across product, engineering, and platform boundaries—turning ambiguous opportunities into reliable, scalable systems and establishing the technical direction for AI experiences across the organization. This is a hands\-on role requiring strong full\-stack execution, architectural judgment, and the ability to influence through technical strategy, design, and mentorship. You will help define how Penn Foster builds with AI by developing retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation systems, and production\-grade model integrations. You will partner with engineering leaders and product teams to identify high\-leverage opportunities, shape technical roadmaps, raise engineering standards, and guide initiatives from early exploration through production adoption. Essential Job Functions * Define technical strategy and architecture for AI\-powered product experiences across the learner and content\-authoring ecosystem. * Design, build, and ship full\-stack systems using TypeScript, Vue.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Azure. * Lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives from problem definition through delivery, adoption, and ongoing improvement. * Establish reusable patterns for retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, model orchestration, prompt management, and human\-in\-the\-loop experiences. * Design and maintain evaluation frameworks, quality metrics, observability, and feedback loops for LLM\-powered features. * Integrate model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and other providers with careful attention to reliability, latency, token usage, cost, privacy, security, prompt\-injection risk, and graceful degradation. * Own technical direction for AI\-powered content authoring and management capabilities. * Partner with product, platform, design, data, and sibling engineering teams to translate ambiguous problems into coherent technical plans and shippable systems. * Identify architectural risks, clarify tradeoffs, and make decisions that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and long\-term leverage. * Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, operational standards, and effective development practices. * Mentor and develop engineers across teams, particularly in AI\-assisted development, context engineering, evaluation design, system reliability, and agentic workflows. * Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to accelerate planning, implementation, testing, and review while maintaining strong standards for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Ensure that systems are scalable, observable, secure, accessible, and economically sustainable in production. * Contribute to engineering\-wide discussions about responsible AI adoption, technical standards, platform capabilities, and organizational priorities. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities * 10\+ years of experience building and operating customer\-facing software products. * Demonstrated impact as a technical leader, staff engineer, principal engineer, tech lead, or equivalent role. * Strong full\-stack engineering fundamentals, including browser technologies, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, cloud infrastructure, and distributed systems. * Experience designing and delivering AI\-powered products using LLMs, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, agentic workflows, or related technologies. * A track record of leading complex initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or organizational boundaries. * Ability to set technical direction without relying on formal authority and to build alignment among engineers, product leaders, designers, and other stakeholders. * Strong architectural judgment and the ability to communicate complex tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience creating durable engineering patterns, platforms, or capabilities that enable other teams to move faster. * Product sensibility and a strong focus on user experience, quality, speed, and measurable outcomes. * Comfort working in ambiguous environments where the problem, solution, and path to execution must be shaped collaboratively. * High ownership mentality, with the ability to move between strategy, architecture, implementation, and operational follow\-through. * Experience mentoring engineers and strengthening engineering practices across a team or organization. * Commitment to building reliable, secure, observable, and cost\-effective AI systems. * Thrives in a remote, async\-first environment with a lean, high\-output team. * Experience working at a startup or organization with a high engineering bar and a bias toward meaningful, measurable impact. Working Conditions \& Hiring Process * U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role. * Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, and similar activities. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed. * On\-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on\-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply. * Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement. * Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre\-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law. * Identity Verification (Form I\-9\): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I\-9 verification, which may require an in\-person identity verification step with an authorized representative. About Us At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real\-world skills and knowledge that enable learners to achieve long\-term success. Our history dates back to 1890, when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to gain the skills needed for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission by providing accessible training and education for in\-demand skills and building a workforce prepared for the future job market. Equal Employment Opportunity We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse in identities, lived experiences, and ideas, creating a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because they enable us to maximize the number of learners who reach their goals, deliver the experiences we want them to have, and become the kind of company we want to work in. jobs.title: ML Engineer - API Platform
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Physical Intelligence is bringing general\-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically\-actuated devices of the future. We’ve made significant progress toward building models that can control many different robots across a wide range of tasks. Now, we’re building the platform that will make those models accessible to the broader world. As an API Product Engineer, you’ll build the product surface that allows other companies to use Pi’s models much like developers use an LLM API today: bring their own data, fine\-tune models, evaluate them, and run low\-latency inference in their own environments. You’ll own this experience end to end, turning capabilities that today require close collaboration with our team into a platform that can eventually support thousands—and ultimately millions—of robots. **The Team** ------------ Software Engineering at Pi builds the systems that scale research breakthroughs into reliable products in the physical world. This role sits at the intersection of our AI, infrastructure, and external partners. You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers to turn rapidly evolving model capabilities into APIs and tools that external users, from hobbyists to large organizations, can actually build on. Today, onboarding a new partner to Pi can involve significant hands\-on work. The goal is to make that increasingly unnecessary: partners should be able to bring us data, fine\-tune a model, evaluate it, and run inference through a product that is intuitive, reliable, and built to scale. **In This Role You Will** ------------------------- This is a software and systems role first. Robotics experience is not required, and we’re particularly excited about people who have built developer platforms, model APIs, or infrastructure products outside of robotics. * Build Pi’s model API end to end, including data ingestion, fine\-tuning, evaluation, low\-latency remote inference, partner\-facing tools, and deployment integrations. * Design systems that can scale from a small number of deeply integrated partners to thousands of organizations and potentially millions of robots. * Architect reliable, multi\-tenant infrastructure around rate limiting, isolation, backpressure, versioning, observability, and SLOs. * Turn partner data into a first\-class product experience, from initial upload through validation, processing, fine\-tuning, and evaluation. * Build and operate low\-latency inference systems that allow Pi models to control robots running in real\-world environments. * Work closely with researchers to turn new model capabilities into stable, usable product surfaces. * Learn from how partners use the platform and turn recurring friction into better APIs, tooling, documentation, and abstractions. * Write high\-quality production code that integrates deeply with Pi’s existing infrastructure. * Define what the developer platform for general\-purpose robotics should look like. There is no established playbook for this yet. **What We Hope You'll Bring** ----------------------------- * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems. * Deep backend and systems experience across APIs, services, databases, caching, distributed systems, and infrastructure. * Experience building and scaling developer platforms. We’re especially interested in people who have shipped platforms for model fine\-tuning, inference, or other compute\-intensive workloads. * An understanding of the problems that emerge as systems scale: reliability, latency, multi\-tenancy, versioning, observability, and operational complexity. * Enough familiarity with machine learning systems to deploy, serve, and debug models in production. You do not need to be an ML researcher. * Strong Python skills and the ability to work comfortably across infrastructure and product boundaries. * A high degree of ownership. You’re comfortable taking an ambiguous problem, building the first version end to end, and then designing the system so it no longer depends on you. **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * Experience building low\-latency or real\-time systems, including streaming, inference transport, WebSockets, QUIC, or similar technologies. * Experience building model\-serving, inference, fine\-tuning, or developer\-platform infrastructure. * Experience at an early\-stage infrastructure, AI, robotics, or autonomous systems company. * Familiarity with our stack: Python, Postgres, ClickHouse, GCP, Kubernetes, Modal, React, and TypeScript. * Experience with security, authentication, authorization, or multi\-tenant infrastructure. **What This Role Is Not** ------------------------- * This is not a Customer Success role. You won’t own ongoing partner support or change management inside customer organizations. * This is not a Partner Roboticist or Applied Research role. You won’t be responsible for training policies for individual partners or debugging robots on site. * This is not a traditional ML infrastructure role focused primarily on training systems, compilers, or accelerator scheduling. You’ll work closely with those systems, but your focus is the product and platform through which the outside world uses Pi’s models. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Power Engineering Technologist I - CC
jobs.description: **Position Overview:** This is an entry\-level position that supports our Engineering team and reports directly to regional operational leadership. The role includes a combination of office and field work, providing hands\-on experience applying technical skills to help design safe, reliable, and cost\-effective solutions for power distribution projects. You should be comfortable learning design tools, following company and client workflows and procedures, accurately entering data, and developing a foundational understanding of each project's technical requirements. Pike Engineering offers a wide variety of benefits including but not limited to Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance; Paid Time Off; 401(k); Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts; Employee and Dependent Basic Life Insurance; Employee and Dependent Basic Accidental Death \& Dismemberment; Short Term Disability; Long Term Disability; Critical Illness; Accident and Whole Life Insurance; Legal Services, Identity Theft, and Cyber Security; Employee Discounts and Service Awards. All health care benefits are available upon election on day one (1\) of your employment with Pike. The compensation range for this position is between $24\.00 and $26\.00\. **Essential Functions:** * This role requires regular on\-site attendance and is not eligible for remote or hybrid work. * Interpret and comply with all applicable codes, regulations, policies, and procedures while maintaining accurate, well\-organized project documentation. * Support Project Design \& Preparation: Assist with the development of complete project and job packages, including drawings, material lists, estimates, and requisitions, using company and client design software and work management tools. * Develop Technical Field \& Construction Knowledge: Prepare comprehensive project and job packages—such as drawings, material lists, estimates, and requisitions—while utilizing company and client design software and work management tools. * Provide regular project status updates and build strong working relationships with internal and external partners to ensure expectations, timelines, and business objectives are met. * Engage in Continuous Learning \& Mentorship: Actively build technical, design, and field knowledge through ongoing training and mentorship from experienced team members, supervisors, and Professional Engineers. * Participate in storm restoration activities as needed. **Minimum Requirements:** * Regular attendance is required. * High school diploma or GED (Certain client projects or contractual requirements may require an Associate degree from a two \- year college or technical school). * 0\-2 years of experience in power distribution engineering, electrical craft work, or GIS/CAD\-related work. **Other Abilities:** * Valid driver's license and vehicle suitable for business use (mileage reimbursement may apply). **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This role involves primarily office\-based work with regular sitting and frequent use of hands for computer and tool handling, and talking and hearing throughout the day. The position also includes occasional standing, walking, reaching, climbing or balancing, and stooping or kneeling during field activities. We may require employees to lift up to 10 pounds regularly. The job also requires visual abilities, including close and distance vision, color distinction, peripheral vision, and depth perception. Reasonable accommodations can be made for individuals with disabilities. **Work Environment:** Your work will involve a mix of office and field work. While most duties are performed in a typical office setting, you may occasionally perform work outdoors in various weather conditions and in areas that you or others elevate or deem hazardous. Some tasks may also involve exposure to a risk of electrical shock during field visits. We make reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities. **Our Benefits:** * Medical, dental and vision insurance * HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * 401(k) with company match * Life insurance, and short\-term and long\-term disability * Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family. NOTE: We do not intend this job description to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Pike Engineering is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin and/or status as a protected veteran or individual with a disability.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer Plumbing (Miami, FL)
jobs.description: **Planate Management Group (PMG) is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, and Orlando, Florida USA with a technical support center in South East Asia and East Africa, that provides program management and facilities engineering services worldwide. Planate is a small business provider of planning, design, infrastructure management, technical consulting, engineering, and construction management services in support of the US Department of Defense (DOD) and its Service (Army, Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps) missions, along with other US federal agencies, all over the world.** As a **Mechanical Engineer**, you will be responsible for providing mechanical engineering and construction management support for the Chiller Plant System and Chilled and Condenser Water System Repair/Replace at the Miami VA Medical Center. You will ensure compliance with design intent, construction standards, and project objectives throughout all phases of the project. **This position is contingent upon the award of the contract, and the contract duration is one year with three option years.** **Key Responsibilities:** * Support construction management activities including inspections and reporting * Review mechanical and plumbing systems design, shop drawings, and submittals * Monitor construction progress and ensure adherence to schedule and budget * Maintain project documentation, logs, and as\-built drawings * Assist in resolving technical issues, RFIs, and design clarifications * Support cost estimating, change order analysis, and project controls * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams and contractors * Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards **Qualifications to be successful in the role:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Construction Management or 10 years of directly related experience in lieu of bachelor's degree. * Licensed Professional Mechanical Engineer in the State of Florida * Minimum 7 years of experience in construction/project management * Experience with chiller utility systems in federal or healthcare projects preferred * Demonstrated knowledge of VA standards, FAR, NFPA, and OSHA requirements. * Ability to interpret construction drawings and specifications. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. **Why Planate?** Planate Management Group is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Joining the Planate team opens you to an experience working for a Global company where you are among a team that is considered a premier trusted partner for planning, design, engineering, asset management, and professional service solutions anytime, anywhere. We Take Care of Our Own; Personally, and Profession. **Full\-time employees enjoy the following benefits:** * Medical insurance/Dental/Vision Insurance * 401K plan eligibility upon hire * Health and Savings Account plan * Life/AD\&D Insurance Coverage * Short\-Term Disability Insurance Coverage * Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off * Wellness Offering * Training and Development * License/Certification support * Recognition and Rewards program * Travel Insurance We’d love for you to be a part of our Global workforce, helping us serve as an effective and integrated partner to advance every client's mission!

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Customer Context
jobs.description: Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000\+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch. With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best\-in\-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue\-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started. Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018\. We are looking for a polyglot **Senior Fullstack Engineer** to join the **Customer Context** team. You’ll help build and scale the foundational services, APIs, and pipelines that power the Postscript product. This role blends strong backend engineering skills with a deep appreciation for data intensive systems, performance, and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with other software engineers, data engineers, and product to help e\-commerce marketers maximize their revenue with best\-in\-class targeting and context\-driven AI. This is a high\-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well, without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. AI isn't a nice\-to\-have here — it's central to how we work. We expect our engineers to be active practitioners of AI\-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with AI in their day\-to\-day craft. If you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here. As a senior engineer at Postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it. **This position is fully remote and can be based in the US or Canada.** **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team, and become the go\-to technical expert for what you own * Independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity * Architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable REST APIs and backend services for internal and external use * Drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction.. Improve long\-term maintainability without blocking near\-term delivery * Build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving * Stay at the forefront of emerging AI tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how Postscript engineers work * Contribute to how we think about integrating AI into our systems and workflows. That means not just using AI tools, but helping shape where and how AI creates leverage across the engineering org * Collaborate cross\-functionally with product, data, and go\-to\-market teams by communicating clearly and proactively in an async\-first environment * Identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team * Improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 6\+ years of experience building large\-scale data\-intensive backend systems and APIs * You are an active, daily user of AI coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow * Some or all of these languages: Python, Go, Rust, React, and TypeScript * You follow the AI tooling landscape closely: new model releases, emerging agentic workflows, and evolving best practices aren't things you catch up on eventually. * You think critically about AI output and you know where it accelerates you, where it introduces risk, and how to verify what it produces * You are able to context switch quickly across concurrent workstreams * Experience working on both 0\-to\-1 initiatives and complex existing systems, and knowing how to balance building new things with improving what's there * You have working knowledge of event\-driven distributed systems, Kafka, and familiarity with distributed data processing technologies (Flink/Spark/etc) * Experience growing systems under production customer load, ideally from early days to the multi\-terabyte stage * Experience building and designing high\-scale systems AWS with a broad variety of database technologies (RDBMS, OLAP, NoSQL, etc.) * You know how to intelligently model relational data and design index strategies. You write performant SQL for transactional and analytical workloads * Experience with infrastructure as code (eg, Terraform). You are comfortable evaluating and applying your infra changes. * Familiarity building and observing applications on AWS \& Kubernetes, ideally with Datadog, Signoz, or comparable observability tooling * Clear, direct communication. Cross\-functional partners and async teams can count on you to surface information proactively * Strong instincts for technical tradeoffs informed by both engineering best practices and business priorities **What You'll Love About Us** ----------------------------- * Salary range of USD $175,000–$205,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo\-based salaries) * High growth startup — plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career * Work from home (or wherever in US / Canada) * Fun — we're passionate and enjoy what we do * Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity * Flexible paid time off * Health, dental, vision insurance *For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant* *Privacy Notice* *You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever\-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.*

jobs.title: Product Engineer — Marketplace
jobs.description: As one of the first Product Engineers at Pure, you’ll build the tools people use to buy and sell rare coins and precious metals. Your work will cover listings, trading, checkout, payments, and account features. You’ll work closely with design, growth, customer support, and product leadership to decide what to build and see it through to launch. **About Pure** -------------- Founded in 2023, Pure is a marketplace for rare coins and precious metals, serving over 11,000 organizations and processing more than $75 million in transactions each month. Much of this industry still runs on phone calls, spreadsheets, and relationships. We’re building a marketplace that makes pricing clearer and buying and selling easier. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build marketplace features from start to finish, including backend services and customer\-facing interfaces. * Make technical decisions for listings, trading, checkout, payments, and account features. * Build fast, accessible web experiences with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. * Improve fraud prevention, risk detection, and payment and order reliability. * Work with Growth on acquisition, onboarding, activation, and retention. * Use customer feedback, product data, and input from our operations team to improve what you ship. * Review code, contribute to architecture decisions, and help other engineers develop their skills. **Who You Are** --------------- * You have 3\+ years of experience building customer\-facing software, ideally at a startup. * You’re comfortable taking a feature from an initial idea through development, launch, and improvements. * You have strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. * You’ve built backend APIs and services with Node.js or a similar stack, using PostgreSQL or another relational database. * You use data and customer feedback to understand whether a feature is working. * You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical teammates. * You can make decisions and keep work moving when priorities change. **Bonus** --------- * Experience building marketplaces, fintech, commerce, or other products that handle transactions. * Experience with payments, fraud detection, identity, or trust and safety systems. * Experience building experiments, analytics tools, or growth features. * Experience scaling web applications with high traffic. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Flexible work arrangements: remote, hybrid, or in\-office in Los Angeles * Medical and dental coverage * 401(k) with employer match * Daily lunches and a wellness stipend Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.title: Product Engineer — Vault Platform
jobs.description: As one of the first Product Engineers at Pure, you’ll own key parts of our Vault Platform, from customer vault accounts to the systems our operations team uses to receive, verify, store, and ship high\-value physical assets. You’ll help decide what to build, make technical decisions, and stay responsible for how your work performs after launch. You’ll work directly with operations, customer support, compliance, and partners to understand their needs and turn them into working software. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Take ownership of products and services from the initial idea through development, launch, and ongoing improvements. * Build customer\-facing tools for vault accounts, asset management, shipments, and transfers with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. * Design and maintain backend systems for asset intake, verification, inventory, storage, and shipping. * Be responsible for keeping asset ownership records, custody history, and movement accurate and traceable. * Work directly with warehouse and logistics teams to improve how assets are received, authenticated, stored, and fulfilled. * Build and maintain APIs, webhooks, and integrations that marketplaces, financial institutions, and other partners depend on. * Identify gaps in internal tools with Customer Support and Operations, and carry improvements through to completion. * Work with Compliance and Risk to implement identity verification, permissions, and custody controls. * Use customer feedback and operational data to set priorities and measure whether your changes solve the problem. * Make technical decisions across the stack and take responsibility for reliability, maintenance, and delivery. **Who You Are** --------------- * You have 3\+ years of experience building software products, ideally at a startup. * You’re comfortable owning a product area, deciding what needs attention, and seeing work through without waiting for a detailed specification. * You have strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. * You’ve built backend APIs and services with Node.js or a similar stack, using PostgreSQL. * You enjoy understanding how people work and building software that makes their jobs easier. * You can design systems that keep records accurate, enforce permissions, and make changes easy to trace. * You communicate clearly with engineers, operations teams, customer support, and business partners. * You take responsibility for what you ship, follow up on how it’s used, and address problems when they come up. **Bonus** --------- * Experience building logistics, warehouse management, inventory, or fulfillment systems. * Experience building developer platforms, APIs, OAuth integrations, or webhook infrastructure. * Experience with event\-driven systems and workflow automation. * Experience building financial infrastructure, custody platforms, or software for regulated businesses. * Experience designing audit trails, permission systems, or safeguards for data integrity. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Flexible work arrangements: remote, hybrid, or in\-office in Los Angeles * Medical and dental coverage * 401(k) with employer match * Daily lunches and a wellness stipend Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best\-in\-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second\-largest distributor of roofing products, the second\-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com. What you will do:: * Design, develop, and maintain eCommerce services and user interfaces. * Implement scalable, low\-latency systems that meet performance and security goals. * Build intuitive and performant front\-end experiences. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver end\-to\-end product features. * Write clean, efficient, and testable code. * Participate in design and code reviews. * Support the continuous improvement of system reliability and operational excellence. * Contribute to shared libraries, platform components, and design systems. What you will bring:: **Qualifications \& Skills*** 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented programming languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Go). * Experience with modern front\-end technologies and frameworks such as React, Next.js, or TypeScript. * Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. * Experience developing and maintaining production systems in a cloud environment (e.g., AWS, GCP). * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong collaboration and communication skills **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience building commerce, checkout, or personalization systems. * Familiarity with responsive, accessible, and high\-performance UI development. * Exposure to AI/ML systems or data\-driven services. * Experience with experimentation frameworks, recommendation systems, or search technologies. * Knowledge of CI/CD, observability, and performance tuning tools. What you will earn:: What you'll earn * Base pay range: $138,000 \- $235,000 * Annual performance bonus * Long term incentive (equity/stock) * 401(k) with employer match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * PTO, company holidays, and parental leave * Paid Time Off/Paid Sick Leave: Applicants can expect to accrue 15 days of paid time off during their first year (4\.62 hours for every 80 hours worked) and increased accruals after five years of service. * Paid training and certifications * Legal assistance and identity protection * Pet insurance * Employee assistance program (EAP) QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. To comply with Pay Transparency laws, employers must disclose an annual salary range. Actual offers depend on factors such as location, experience, skills, and market data. This position may also offer variable compensation. Please contact careers@QXO.com if you have any questions related to this job posting. Pay Range: USD $138,000\.00 \- USD $235,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Team** We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers. We're looking for an **AI Engineer** to join our **AI Platform team**, which builds and operates the generative AI pipelines powering our products, many of which involve financial and trading data, terminology, and specifications. You'll join a small high\-impact team where you'll have real ownership from day one. You'll work across our broader AI\-platform portfolio: prompting and prompt evaluation, agentic systems, MCP tooling, and evaluation pipelines: writing backend Python on top of LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI. This is an applied engineering role focused on shipping and maintaining production LLM systems. This role is hybrid, based in our Limassol office. ### **Tasks:** * Design, build, and maintain LLM\-powered features and pipelines for our generative AI products, including those handling financial and trading content * Develop and improve agentic systems and multi\-agent workflows, including integrations using MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers/tooling * Write production\-grade backend Python services on top of LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI) and/or on\-premise LLMs * Build and iterate on prompt engineering and prompt\-evaluation pipelines, including structured output generation and validation * Take prototypes and proofs\-of\-concept and turn them into reliable, maintainable production services * Monitor and manage LLM cost, latency, and reliability trade\-offs across pipelines * Collaborate closely with a small, senior AI Platform team on architecture, code review, and technical direction. ### **Requirements:** * Production LLM experience: You've shipped real, live features using OpenAI and/or Anthropic APIs, or with on\-premise/open\-weight LLMs, not just experimentation or side projects * Hands\-on experience building multi\-agent systems or workflows and working with MCP servers * Strong Python \& software engineering fundamentals (2–4\+ years): REST APIs, SQL, Docker, git, and concurrency, with a demonstrated ability to take projects from prototype to maintainable production service * Practical LLM engineering skills: Comfortable working with structured outputs, prompt evaluation, and cost\-aware design decisions in real systems * English fluency (written and verbal). ### **Nice to Have:** * Prior experience working in fintech * Finance/markets knowledge: tickers, earnings, technical indicators, forex/CFDs * Quant background * Experience with model fine\-tuning/training, RAG, or LLM optimization techniques * Track record in Kaggle competitions focused on LLMs or multi\-agent frameworks * GPU infrastructure experience: provisioning GPU compute or serving open\-weight models (e.g., Hugging Face inference) * Experience with Kubernetes, Kubeflow, or Airflow * Data analysis and statistics experience * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, etc.) * Fluent Russian. *We know the combination of production LLM engineering and finance\-domain knowledge is rare. If you're a strong AI/LLM engineer without a finance background, we still want to hear from you.* ### **What we offer:** * Hybrid work model in our brand\-new office in Limassol. * Health insurance and mental health services. * 13th salary and 21 vacation days per year. * Sick leave without medical certificate: 3 days per quarter. * Catered lunches in the office. * Tuition reimbursement (kindergartens/schools). * Onsite Gym. * Corporate events and workshops. * Bonuses for special events (e.g., child's birth). * Birthday and anniversary gifts. * Company\-provided laptop. * Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.). * Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency. With a team of 500\+ creative and tech\-driven people across the globe, Quadcode is the place where ideas turn into impact, where every project is a chance to grow, innovate, and make your mark. **Join us today, and let's shape the future of fintech together!** *Note: All applications will be treated with strict confidence.
