jobs.title: Sr. AI Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Why Stifel: Stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole. Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, **where success meets success**. What You'll Be Doing: The Sr. AI Cloud Platform Engineer is a member of the Security Engineering \& Automation team, the security organization's shared build capability, and is responsible for the platform architecture and hands\-on engineering of secure, reusable capabilities that enable security teams to operate more efficiently and consistently. This role architects and develops shared security platforms, tool integrations, AI\-enabled security capabilities, metrics and dashboarding services, proofs of concept, and automation that removes recurring manual work, built once and designed for adoption by multiple security pods rather than as one\-off solutions. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role partners with Security Architecture and cloud platform architects to align team\-owned solutions with organizational standards and strategic direction. The team operates under a clear contract, Security Engineering \& Automation builds, and consuming pods configure, run, and report. What We're Looking For: * Lead the architecture and technical design of the team's shared capabilities — platforms, services, integrations, APIs, data pipelines, and automation — built to be secure, scalable, resilient, and reusable. * Build shared security tool integrations and reusable automation that eliminate manual toil, reduce duplicated engineering effort, and improve consistency across security pods. * Architect AI solutions that both secure the organization's use of AI and apply AI to improve security operations, analysis, and decision support. * Build and maintain shared metrics, data, and dashboarding capabilities, including common data models and integration patterns, that enable automated, business\-readable reporting across the security organization. * Partner with Security Architecture to embed security requirements, approved patterns, controls, and risk decisions into platform designs, and collaborate with enterprise and cloud platform architects to align with broader technology strategies and standards. * Translate business, security, operational, and regulatory requirements into platform designs and executable implementation plans. * Develop infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK, and build automation and integrations using Python, Bash, PowerShell, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, APIs, and event\-driven and workflow orchestration services. * Embed identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network controls, data protection, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement into team\-owned solutions. * Conduct proofs of concept and technical evaluations to validate solution viability and inform build\-versus\-buy decisions, assessing technologies for technical fit, security, interoperability, supportability, cost, and reuse potential. * Create reusable reference architectures, implementation patterns, technical standards, and onboarding guidance, and contribute to the team's service catalog, including available capabilities, engagement criteria, and ownership expectations. * Define consumption, configuration, and support boundaries for team\-built services in partnership with product management and consuming pods, along with measurable outcomes such as adoption, toil reduction, onboarding time, and data freshness. * Maintain the reliability, availability, observability, and security of shared team\-owned platforms and their CI/CD and operational tooling, and support incidents and root\-cause analysis while pod\-specific operations, triage, and tool administration remain with the consuming pod. * Publish architecture diagrams, decision records, runbooks, and service documentation, and communicate evaluations, proof\-of\-concept results, roadmaps, and delivered business value through planning forums, demonstrations, and stakeholder reviews. * Mentor engineers and promote strong platform engineering, secure development, automation, and architecture practices within the team. What You'll Bring: * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify manual toil and design reusable capabilities that eliminate it. * Ability to effectively communicate technical topics and architectural decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Deep understanding of platform architecture principles, including scalability, reliability, observability, interoperability, and cost management. * Understanding of AI and LLM\-based systems, including generative AI, agentic workflows, and their security considerations. * Demonstrated ability to operate independently, lead technical design efforts, prioritize workload, and collaborate across orga ts. * Experience incorporating security requirements and controls into cloud and platform solutions in partnership with Security Architecture or comparable governance functions. * Experience designing for measurable outcomes such as adoption, toil reduction, reliability, and onboarding efficiency. Education \& Experience: * Minimum Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or a related combination of education and experience. * Minimum Required: 6\+ years of platform, infrastructure, DevOps, cloud, automation, integration, security engineering, or software engineering experience; 3\+ years of hands\-on AWS experience in production environments. * Minimum Required: Experience applying AI, machine learning, or generative AI to automation, engineering, or security use cases. * Preferred: Experience with metrics platforms, APIs, or workflow orchestration. * Preferred: Experience supporting regulated or financial\-services environments. Licenses \& Credentials: * Minimum Required: AWS Certified Solutions Architect — Associate or Professional, or equivalent demonstrated AWS expertise. * Preferred: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer — Professional. * AWS Certified Security — Specialty, AWS Certified Machine Learning — Specialty, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CCSP, CISSP, or comparable cloud, AI, or platform engineering credentials, is a plus. Systems \& Technology: * Deep hands\-on AWS experience, including services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Organizations, and Control Tower. * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) and scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages. * Experience designing and integrating APIs, event\-driven services, workflow automation, and third\-party security technologies for adoption by multiple teams. * Experience with AI and machine learning services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or OpenAI APIs, including generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and model gateways. * Working knowledge of cloud and platform security, including IAM least privilege, secrets management, encryption, network security, logging, monitoring, data protection, and policy\-as\-code. * Preferred: Metrics, dashboarding, and data platforms such as Grafana, Power BI, QuickSight, or OpenSearch. * Preferred: CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or ECS/EKS), and observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry). * Preferred: Experience with OPA, AWS Config, Service Control Policies, cloud security posture management, data\-loss prevention, or automated guardrail technologies. About Stifel: Stifel is more than 130 years old and still thinking like a start\-up. We are a global wealth management and investment banking firm serious about innovation and fresh ideas. Built on a simple premise of safeguarding our clients’ money as if it were our own, coined by our namesake, Herman Stifel, our success is intimately tied to our commitment to helping families, companies, and municipalities find their own success. While our headquarters is in St. Louis, we have offices in New York, San Francisco, Baltimore, London, Frankfurt, Toronto, and more than 400 other locations. Stifel is home to approximately 9,000 individuals who are currently building their careers as financial advisors, research analysts, project managers, marketing specialists, developers, bankers, operations associates, among hundreds more. Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success. At Stifel we offer an entrepreneurial environment, comprehensive benefits package to include health, dental and vision care, 401k, wellness initiatives, life insurance, and paid time off. Stifel is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, HR Solutions
jobs.description: Overview: **Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.** With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors. Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. **Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies. Responsibilities: **Position Purpose:** The Forward Deployed Engineer, HR Solutions will be a hands\-on business and technical problem solver within the StoneX HR AI Pod, responsible for translating ambiguous HR business problems into clear requirements and practical, production\-ready solutions. Reporting into EIT and embedded within HR, this role will work directly with HR leaders, process owners, and subject matter experts to understand current processes, identify root causes, define business and technical requirements, evaluate solution options, and take the selected solution through deployment and ongoing production support. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in ambiguity, moving between business discovery and hands\-on technical delivery, and selecting the simplest effective approach. Solutions may include process redesign, platform configuration, workflow automation, integration, data, conventional application development, or AI. **Technology Ecosystem:*** **Front\-End:** Microsoft Copilot/Copilot Studio user experiences, HR employee self\-service, chatbots, resource\-library agents, preboarding/onboarding experiences, job description/posting tools * **Back End:** APIs, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, data integrations, workflow automations, enterprise systems, HR systems, Oracle integrations, SQL, data transformation, Python, JavaScript * **Architect:** APIs, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, data integrations, workflow automations, enterprise systems, HR systems, Oracle integrations, SQL, data transformation, Python, JavaScript * **Cloud:** Oracle HCM Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud, Azure, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI, cloud\-based integration patterns **Primary duties will include:*** Partner directly with HR leaders and process owners to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes. * Identify where AI, automation, data, or traditional technology can improve HR processes and employee experiences. * Lead discovery and translate ambiguous business needs into validated functional requirements, nonfunctional requirements, process designs, data and integration requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate the most appropriate technology\-enabled solution with end users, using AI where it provides clear value. * Design, build, and deploy workflow automations, integrations, applications, data solutions, and AI\-enabled capabilities where appropriate. * Analyze current\-state processes, business rules, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and failure points so the solution addresses the root cause rather than automating an ineffective process. * Evaluate solution options and communicate tradeoffs across business value, complexity, risk, cost, maintainability, supportability, and time to value. * Develop solutions using Microsoft Copilot and related Microsoft AI and automation capabilities. * Integrate solutions with Oracle and other HR systems, data sources, APIs, and StoneX platforms. * Take successful prototypes from pilot through production deployment. * Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement for deployed solutions. * Partner with EIT architecture, data, security, and governance teams to ensure solutions meet StoneX standards. * Build appropriate human review, privacy, security, risk, and control requirements into solution design. * Document technical design, integrations, dependencies, support requirements, and lessons learned. * Establish measurable success criteria before implementation and assess results after deployment to determine whether the solution should be improved, scaled, replaced, or retired. **Example HR Pod Use Cases:** * The Forward Deployed Engineer may support initiatives such as: * HR employee self\-service and chatbot solutions * Oracle\-enabled AI and automation * Workforce planning tools and agents * Recruiting and interview scheduling automation * Job description and job\-posting creation * HR knowledge and resource\-library agents * Preboarding and onboarding experiences * HR reporting, analytics, and data automation * HR data quality and audit processes * Workflow redesign and other AI\-enabled HR solutions This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all\-inclusive and can be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management deems necessary. Qualifications: **To land this role you will need**:* Hands\-on experience building AI\-enabled applications, agents, automations, or workflow solutions. * Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, or related Microsoft technologies. * Experience integrating applications with APIs, enterprise systems, and data sources. * Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and data integration concepts. * Experience taking technical solutions from prototype through testing, deployment, and production support. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Demonstrated experience leading discovery with non\-technical business partners and translating ambiguous business problems into functional requirements, technical requirements, process designs, acceptance criteria, and a delivered solution. * Experience with software development practices, testing, documentation, version control, and production support. * Strong judgment related to data privacy, security, controls, and responsible AI use. **What makes you stand out:*** Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud or other Oracle platforms. * Experience with Oracle integrations, APIs, or Oracle Integration Cloud. * Previous HR technology, HR systems, or HR process experience. * Experience with SQL and data transformation. * Experience with Python, JavaScript, or another relevant development language. * Familiarity with Azure, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, and cloud\-based integration patterns. * Experience with conversational AI, AI agents, or agentic workflows. * Experience with Power BI or other analytics tools. * Experience working in an agile, product, consulting, or forward\-deployed engineering environment. **Education / Certification Requirements:** \- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, business technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Relevant technical, cloud, integration, data, process, or product certifications are a plus, but practical experience translating business needs into production solutions is more important * Commitment to continual professional and technical development **Working environment:** \- * In\-office 4 days a week *Hiring Salary Range $**110K\-130K* *(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities of the applicant, internal equity and alignment with market data.) Subject to business performance and recommendations of management, this role may be eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. This compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.*

jobs.title: Principal AI Safety Architect
jobs.description: **Principal AI Safety Architect** ================================= **Date:** Oct 5, 2026 **Location:** San Jose, California, United States **Company:** Super Micro Computer **Job Req ID: 30442** --------------------- **About Supermicro:** --------------------- Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us. **Job Summary:** ---------------- Supermicro is hiring a Principal AI Safety Engineer in Technology Enablement to help customers run agentic AI on Supermicro infrastructure in named enterprises and in GPU clouds (neoclouds). This is a customer\-facing design role, not a security operations role. You will join architecture workshops, define how agents and tenants are isolated, identified, governed, and audited, and write that control layer into the design before systems are quoted or shipped. Enterprise work is one customer, one data boundary. Neocloud work is many tenants on a shared factory. You will cover both. You will work with Supermicro solution architects, factory engineering, cloud and enterprise sales, and NVIDIA field teams. Supermicro partners with NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel, and with leading storage and networking companies. This role is majority NVIDIA\-focused, including NVIDIA runtime and guardrail software, confidential computing, and data\-center security features where they belong in the design. The same control model must still work when a factory includes AMD, Intel, or partner storage and networking. San Jose, CA location is preferred. Exceptional Principal\-level candidates elsewhere in the United States will be considered if they can travel for customer workshops. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** ------------------------------------------ **1\. Customer\-facing AI safety architecture — enterprise and neocloud** Join engagements when customers will deploy agents, tools, or regulated inference. * **Enterprise:** safety profile for a single owner — data boundary, air\-gap or private cloud, human gates, audit, and what OpenShell vs Sentry vs confidential computing actually enforce in that boundary. * **Neocloud:** tenant isolation, inference\-gateway policy, quota and blast\-radius controls, confidential computing and DPU isolation between tenants, and **attested evidence** a cloud customer can hand to their own CISO (identity, policy decisions, telemetry — not agent self\-reporting). * Set proof\-of\-concept pass/fail criteria so safety is tested, not assumed. Define what is enforceable on current installed NVIDIA systems versus what requires BlueField\-4 Sentry or Vera\-class platforms. **2\. Controls on Supermicro AI factories** Map the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform onto Supermicro server, rack, and cluster designs used by enterprises and GPU cloud operators. * Place OpenShell (runtime, least\-privilege policy, sandbox) and Sentry (BlueField\-4 / DOCA, out\-of\-band monitoring, millisecond containment) in the design. * Identify where confidential computing, SmartNIC/DPU security, multi\-tenant networking, air\-gapped operation, or partner security platforms belong. * Design one control model that still works when a factory includes AMD, Intel, or partner storage and networking. OpenShell’s extendability off NVIDIA CPUs is part of that model, not an afterthought. * Produce the safety chapter of the quote package: what is in hardware, what is in runtime, what remains a customer operational control. **3\. Field enablement and demonstration** Create safety design templates for both motions: named\-enterprise factory and multi\-tenant neocloud. Help solution architects start the conversation; you own the safety architecture when agents or tenancy are in scope. Contribute customer\-facing material and represent Supermicro in technical sessions with enterprises, GPU cloud operators, NVIDIA, and other partners. You will put a working control demo in front of a customer and an NVIDIA architect. OpenShell at minimum; Sentry / BlueField\-4 / confidential computing where the platform supports it. **Qualifications:** ------------------- * Bachelor’s or master’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent. * 12\+ years in security engineering, platform security, cloud security, or applied AI systems. 5\+ years accepted with hands\-on production work on agent or LLM runtime controls (sandbox, policy engine, gateway, or equivalent — not training\-only or policy\-paper backgrounds). * Able to prototype and demonstrate controls: Python or equivalent, containers, and policy or guardrail configuration. * Hands\-on with at least two of: NVIDIA OpenShell, NVIDIA Sentry / BlueField / DOCA, confidential computing, inference gateway, NIM, or NeMo Guardrails. OpenShell or Sentry strongly preferred after this announcement. * Hands\-on experience with sandboxes, policy engines, secret proxies, identity for agents, or equivalent. * Experience with at least one of: regulated enterprise AI or multi\-tenant GPU / AI cloud isolation. Both strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of NVIDIA enterprise and safety software and how it lands on server, DPU, and rack designs. NVIDIA certification desirable. * Ability to design controls for mixed GPU/CPU environments and for shared\-cluster tenancy. * Comfortable presenting to customer security leaders, cloud architects, and NVIDIA technical teams. **Salary Range** ---------------- $210,000 \- $255,000 The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs. **EEO Statement** ----------------- Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.** **We are looking for:** **Project Engineer – Capital Projects, Multidisciplinary Leadership \& Equipment Engineering.** * The Project Engineer is responsible for the planning, engineering, project management, and execution of capital projects with values up to $5 million. * The position provides end\-to\-end project leadership from concept development and FEL through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout. * The Project Engineer serves as the project leader and is responsible for leading multidisciplinary project teams consisting of process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and controls, civil/structural, operations, maintenance, EHS, procurement, finance, contractors, and external engineering resources. * In addition to project management responsibilities, the Project Engineer may serve as theLead Equipment Engineer on larger capital projects, providing technical leadership and engineering oversight for major process and mechanical equipment. * This includes developing equipment requirements, evaluating technical solutions, coordinating vendor engineering, reviewing equipment specifications and designs, and supporting equipment procurement, installation, commissioning, and startup. * The Project Engineer is accountable for delivering assigned projects safely, on schedule, within approved budget, and in accordance with company standards and project objectives. **We count on you to:** **Project Management \& Leadership** * Serve as theProject Manager for capital projects up to $5 million. * Provide overall leadership and accountability for project scope, cost, schedule, quality, safety, and execution. * Lead multidisciplinary project teams through all phases of project development and execution. * Establish project objectives, responsibilities, milestones, deliverables, and performance jobs.title: Sr Engineer, AI
jobs.description: At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees! This role is essential for enhancing artificial intelligence (AI) models that support customer service automation within the organization. It primarily focuses on optimizing AI performance through techniques such as prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and developing AI tools and workflows. The role involves architecting advanced agentic AI systems to improve reasoning and interaction capabilities across complex workflows. Success is measured by the reliability, accuracy, and efficiency of AI models meeting strategic objectives and customer satisfaction goals. The work directly impacts organizational AI capabilities and improves customer service operations through seamless integration of AI enhancements.**Responsibilities**: * Optimize AI performance through prompt engineering and fine\-tuning to enhance customer service automation * Develop AI tools and workflows to support implementation of advanced AI systems within customer service operations * Architect sophisticated agentic AI systems to improve reasoning and interaction capabilities across complex workflows * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of AI\-driven enhancements into production systems * Evaluate the reliability, accuracy, and efficiency of AI models to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and customer satisfaction * Conduct ongoing research to stay updated with the latest AI technologies and methodologies applicable to customer service Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed * **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**: **Required:** * **Data Management/Data Modeling \-** Retrieval Augmented Generation **(RAG);** Vector Databases/Embeddings * **Prompt Engineering** \- LLM orchestration and RAG workflow design * **Python \-** LLM Orchestration Frameworks, e.g., LangChain, ADK * **Cloud Computing \- RAG deployment**, LLM application infrastructure, vector database/cloud AI services * **Data Analysis** * **Model Tuning** * Customer\-Focused * Collaboration **Education and Work Experience**: * Bachelor's Degree Bachelor’s degree plus **5** years of related work experience OR advanced degree with **3** years of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent (Required) * Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or Related Field Master's/Advanced Degree Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or Data Science (Preferred) * 4\-7 years Experience in developing and optimizing AI models for customer service automation using advanced techniques such as prompt engineering and fine\-tuning. (Preferred) * 4\-7 years Experience in architecting and deploying sophisticated agentic AI systems to enhance reasoning and interaction capabilities in complex workflows. (Preferred) * 4\-7 years Experience in collaborating with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI\-driven enhancements into production systems. (Preferred) **Licenses and Certifications**: * Certified Analytics Professional (CAP): Certification that endorses an individual's expertise in analytics, including the ability to transform complex data into valuable insights and actions, which is crucial for optimizing AI models in customer service automation. (Preferred) * NVIDIA Deep Learning AI Certification: This certification demonstrates proficiency in designing and deploying deep learning AI applications, relevant for enhancing AI model performance in complex systems like customer service workflows. (Preferred) * Certified Data Scientist (CDS): Certification that validates the skills required to analyze data scientifically and use it for operational improvements, which supports the development and optimization of AI tools and workflows. (Preferred) * At least 18 years of age * Legally authorized to work in the United States **Travel**: Travel Required (Yes/No): No **DOT Regulated**: DOT Regulated Position (Yes/No): No Safety Sensitive Position (Yes/No): No ***\*\*\*The pay range below is the "National Pay Range" and does not reflect the actual range for the locations listed. Please click on the link at the end of the second paragraph below to see the "actual" pay range for each location.*** Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity: $153,065 \- $276,115 National Base Pay Range: $133,100 \- $240,100 The Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity represents the expected total cash compensation for this role at target performance, combining base salary and annual incentive opportunity. Actual earnings may be higher or lower depending on individual performance and overall company results. The base pay range reflects the compensation component of this opportunity. The candidate’s actual pay will be based on various factors, such as work location, qualifications, and experience, so the actual starting pay will vary within this range. To find the pay range for this role based on hiring location, click here. At T\-Mobile, employees in regular, non\-temporary roles are eligible for an annual bonus or periodic sales incentive or bonus, based on their role. Corporate employees are eligible for a year\-end bonus based on individual and/or company performance and which is set at a percentage of the employee’s eligible earnings in the prior year. Certain positions in Customer Care are eligible for monthly bonuses based on individual and/or team performance. The incentive component included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflects target performance. Actual earnings included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflect target performance; actual payouts may vary. At T\-Mobile, our benefits exemplify the spirit of One Team, Together! A big part of how we care for one another is working to ensure our benefits evolve to meet the needs of our team members. Full and part\-time employees have access to the same benefits when eligible. We cover all of the bases, offering medical, dental and vision insurance, a flexible spending account, 401(k), employee stock grants, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and up to 12 paid holidays \- which total about 4 weeks for new full\-time employees and about 2\.5 weeks for new part\-time employees annually \- paid parental and family leave, family building benefits, back\-up care, enhanced family support, childcare subsidy, tuition assistance, college coaching, short\- and long\-term disability, voluntary AD\&D coverage, voluntary accident coverage, voluntary life insurance, voluntary disability insurance, and voluntary long\-term care insurance. We don't stop there \- eligible employees can also receive mobile service \& home internet discounts, pet insurance, and access to commuter and transit programs! To learn about T\-Mobile’s amazing benefits, check out *www.t\-mobilebenefits.com**.* Never stop growing!### As part of the T\-Mobile team, you know the Un\-carrier doesn’t have a corporate ladder–it’s more like a jungle gym of possibilities! We love helping our employees grow in their careers, because it’s that shared drive to aim high that drives our business and our culture forward. By applying for this career opportunity, you’re living our values while investing in your career growth–and we applaud it. You’re unstoppable!### T\-Mobile USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All decisions concerning the employment relationship will be made without regard to age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, religious affiliation, marital status, citizenship status, veteran status, the presence of any physical or mental disability, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Software Engineer II (MPDE)
jobs.description: Join TE Connectivity's innovative Passive Optics organization as a Software Engineer II and help develop the software platforms, automation systems, and data\-driven solutions that enable the next generation of optical connectivity products powering AI and hyperscale computing infrastructure. You'll solve complex challenges at the intersection of software, automation, manufacturing, and photonics while creating tools that accelerate product development and scale advanced manufacturing operations. Please note: operations are currently based at a temporary site in Webster, NY. The team will transition to a permanent Rochester location (near RIT) upon completion. **We are are hiring multpile Software Engineers at our Rochester, NY location** Why This Role Matters As AI and cloud infrastructure continue driving unprecedented demand for optical interconnect solutions, sophisticated software systems have become essential to product development, manufacturing automation, data analysis, and quality assurance. You'll play a critical role in developing the applications, automation frameworks, and test platforms that enable TE to deliver industry\-leading optical connectivity solutions at scale. **Job Requirements** -------------------- * **Software Development \& Automation** + Engineering Software Solutions: Design, develop, and maintain software applications supporting optical product development, manufacturing process development, testing, and automation initiatives. + Automation Platforms: Develop software for automated assembly systems, machine vision applications, robotics, motion control systems, and data acquisition platforms. + Data Systems \& Analytics: Create applications and dashboards that collect, manage, visualize, and analyze manufacturing, test, and product performance data. + System Integration: Integrate software with laboratory equipment, industrial automation platforms, databases, vision systems, and enterprise applications.**Product Development \& Manufacturing** + Test System Development: Design and implement software solutions for product validation, automated testing, data logging, and performance characterization. + Manufacturing Software Support: Develop applications that improve process control, equipment efficiency, traceability, and manufacturing quality. + Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with optical, mechanical, electrical, process development, manufacturing, and quality engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions that meet business and technical objectives. + Documentation: Develop software requirements, architecture documentation, validation protocols, user guides, technical specifications, and support documentation for deployed systems. **What your background should look like** ----------------------------------------- Education: BS or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience: Minimum of 3 or more years * Programming Skills: Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C\#, C\+\+, Java, or similar. * Software Development Practices: Experience with version control systems, software testing, debugging, and software lifecycle management. **Core Technical Competencies** * Application Development: Experience developing desktop, web\-based, or engineering software applications. * Automation \& Equipment Integration: Knowledge of industrial automation systems, PLCs, machine vision systems, robotics, motion control platforms, or manufacturing equipment integration. * Data Management: Experience working with databases, SQL, data acquisition systems, data analytics, and reporting tools. * Software Architecture: Understanding of object\-oriented programming, software design principles, API development, and system integration methodologies. * Test \& Validation: Experience developing automated test platforms, validation tools, and software verification methodologies. **ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY** TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter). **COMPENSATION** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $83,000\- $124,600 (subject to change dependent on physical location) * Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity. * Total Compensation \= Base Salary \+ Incentive(s) \+ Benefits **BENEFITS** * A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits. **EOE, Including Disability/Vets** **IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD** TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity **never requests payment or fees** from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**. jobs.title: Senior, ML Engineer - Tracking
jobs.description: **About the Company** At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer. **Meet the Team:** Accurate and highly available information about other actors and objects is fundamental to the safe operation of autonomous trucks. Core capabilities depend on accurate tracking estimates to ensure safe and efficient vehicle behavior. The Tracking Team develops the ML models, state estimation algorithms, and production software responsible for associating and estimating the kinematics of other actors and objects in real time. Our solutions fuse information from multiple sensors and maintain robust performance despite sensor imperfections, environmental challenges, and system degradation. As part of this team, you will develop and deploy production\-ready tracking solutions and help solve the challenges of bringing autonomous vehicle technology to real\-world commercial applications. **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, and deploy production ML models for mulit\-object tracking, including association, learned pose and kinematic estimation, and sensor fusion using camera, LiDAR, radar, and other vehicle sensors. * Develop scalable training and evaluation workflows using PyTorch, distributed training infrastructure, and large\-scale real\-world datasets. * Design and improve tracking and sensor fusion algorithms for robust vehicle pose and kinematics * Analyze large\-scale vehicle data to characterize performance, identify failure modes, and drive model and system improvements. * Develop robust, efficient production software in modern C\+\+ and Python across the full development lifecycle. * Define evaluation, verification, and validation strategies to ensure Tracking quality, robustness, and safety across diverse operating conditions. * Make technical design and architecture decisions, balancing model performance, computational efficiency, robustness, and production constraints. * Collaborate with perception, mapping, planning, controls, and platform teams to deliver integrated autonomous driving capabilities. * Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and development of engineering best practices. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with 6\+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master's degree with 3\+ years of relevant industry experience, or a PhD with 1\+ year of relevant industry experience. * Experience with AV or robotics perception systems (tracking, detection, SLAM, scen modeling, ect.). * Strong experience developing and deploying ML models for perception, localization, or sensor fusion domains. * Proficiency with PyTorch and modern ML tooling for training, inference, and optimization. * Solid understanding of 3D geometry, probabilistic estimation, coordinate transforms, and robotics fundamentals. * Demonstrated ability to work with large multimodal datasets and build scalable pipelines for processing, labeling, and evaluation. * Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and C\+\+, including algorithms, data structures, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively on cross\-functional teams. **Bonus Points** * Experience with state estimation techniques such as factor graphs, Kalman filtering, nonlinear optimization, or related probabilistic estimation methods. * Familiarity with distributed computing tools such as Ray, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration frameworks. * Knowledge of embedded and real\-time constraints for on\-vehicle deployment. * Experience in simulation, synthetic data generation, and uncertainty\-aware ML modeling. * Contributions to open\-source robotics, perception, or ML frameworks. * Familiarity with functional safety standards and automotive development processes, including ISO 26262\. **Perks of Being a Full\-time Torc'r** Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers: * A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options * 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees * 401K plan with a 6% employer match * Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date) * AD\+D and Life Insurance At Torc, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc'rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities. Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign\-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. jobs.description: **Engineer \- Equipment Training Engineer** =========================================== **Job Title: Engineer \- Equipment Training Engineer** A job at TSMC Arizona offers an opportunity to work at one of the most advanced semiconductor fabs in the United States. Today, TSMC Arizona’s first fab is in full operations on its N5 and N4 process technology. Its second fab will utilize its N3 process technology and will start operations in the second half of 2027\. Its third fab will manufacture chips using 2nm or even more advanced process technology, with production starting by the end of the decade. America’s leading technology companies rely on TSMC Arizona for the next generations of chips that will power the AI and digital future. As an **Equipment Training Engineer,** you will demonstrate a strong sense of reliability and enthusiasm and will possess an attitude that embodies our core values – **I**ntegrity, **C**ommitment, **I**nnovation and **C**ustomer Trust. * As an Equipment Training Engineer at the Fab21 (F21\) Component Training Center, you will be the hands\-on technical mentor who shapes the next generation of semiconductor talent. On a daily basis, you transition between being an instructional leader, a technical expert, and an equipment owner. You will run intensive, simulator\-based training labs across 9 core technical domains—ranging from RF systems and vacuum technology to chemical wet cleans and robotics. When you aren't actively teaching new engineers how to safely handle tools and troubleshoot machine alarms, you are responsible for maintaining and calibrating the center's highly specialized training systems to ensure perfect operational readiness. Additionally, you will collaborate with key hardware vendors to integrate cutting\-edge technologies into the classroom, while aligning your training curriculum with HQ standards to ensure all engineering graduates are factory\-ready and certified to work in the cleanroom. **J****ob D****escription:** Your main responsibilities include: * 40% \| Technical Instruction \& Troubleshooting Support * + Deliver standard, hands\-on technical training and practical troubleshooting courses across nine core domains: RF, Vacuum, Wet Clean, Chiller, Transfer System, t\-Loadport, Gas, Heater, and Hand Tools. + Assist trainees in understanding component\-level working principles and executing simulator\-based diagnostics while strictly enforcing cleanroom SOPs. * 40% \| Equipment \& Tool Maintenance * + Perform daily inspections, preventative maintenance, calibration, and troubleshooting of the training center's specialized tools, instructional mechanical kits, and simulator equipment to ensure safety and operational readiness. * 10% \| Training Material Updates \& Trainee Guidance * + Assist in updating basic training materials and simulator\-based fault scenarios. + Provide basic evaluations of trainee progress and help new hires get acclimated to the cleanroom environment and general corporate culture. * 10% \| Vendor Coordination Support * + Coordinate with component vendors for routine tool servicing, spare parts delivery, and support the logistics for vendor\-led technical seminars. **Minimum Requirement:** Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States and have: * Ability to stand for extended periods during hands\-on training instruction. Ability to lift, carry, and manipulate training equipment, mechanical kits, and hand tools (up to 25 lbs). * Ability to perform repetitive motions (gripping, turning, calibrating) during equipment maintenance. * Ability to work in a training center environment with exposure to industrial equipment noise, compressed gases, RF radiation, and chemical agents used in wet\-clean demonstrations. * Ability to sit for extended periods during curriculum design, documentation, and office\-based work. * Ability to use a computer, keyboard, and mouse for prolonged periods. * Ability to wear appropriate PPE including cleanroom garments (gowning) when entering or demonstrating cleanroom\-adjacent environments. **Education:** * Minimum Required: Bachelor's degree (master’s degree as preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline. **Preferred** **Skills \& Experiences:** * **Vendor \& Tool Expertise:** Hands\-on experience or official certifications from major semiconductor equipment manufacturers (e.g., Applied Materials, ASML, Lam Research, TEL) or key component suppliers. * **Instructional Excellence:** Proven track record as an internal trainer, technical instructor, or equipment mentor in a high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. * **Advanced Troubleshooting:** Deep expertise in RF matching networks, advanced vacuum leak detection, or robot calibration and teaching. * **Instructional Design:** Experience in developing simulator\-based training modules, e\-learning platforms, or interactive virtual reality (VR) training tools. * **Core Competencies:** Proficient in semiconductor core components, cleanroom safety, and troubleshooting methodologies. Excellent communication, presentation, and mentoring skills. **Shift:** * Standard work hours: Monday through Friday 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm **Work Location**: Phoenix, AZ (Onsite) **Travel**: Approximately 10% **Application Consideration Consent:** By applying to this position, I acknowledge and agree that my application and qualifications may be considered for other roles within the company. However, I reserve the right to withdraw my consent for future consideration of other roles within the company at any time. Candidates must be willing and able to work on\-site at our Phoenix Arizona facility. As a valued member of the TSMC family, we place a significant focus on your health and well\-being. When you are at your best—physically, mentally, and financially—our company thrives. TSMC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits program that includes: * **Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans:** Choose the options that best fit your and your family’s needs. * **Income\-Protection Programs:** Financial assistance during injury or illness. * **401(k) Retirement Savings Plan:** Secure your financial future with competitive employer contributions. * **Paid Time\-Off Programs and Holidays:** Recharge and spend quality time with loved ones. **Work Location**: 5088 W. Innovation Circle, Phoenix, AZ 85083 TSMC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. As a global leader in healthcare, we leverage advanced technology and data to deliver patient\-centric solutions, enhance customer engagement, and drive innovation. We collaborate closely with the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data\-driven decision\-making. The US CRM organization sits within Strategy, Platforms \& Transformation (SPT) – AI \& Platform Products and plays a crucial role in driving the transformation to a next\-generation Customer360 operating model. Novartis seeks an accomplished product leader with a track record of turning business demand from multiple commercial functions into a well\-managed data product backlog. Strong prioritization judgment, stakeholder partnership, and hands\-on data fluency are essential to success in this role. Reporting to the Director, PO Audience Activation \& Marketing Intelligence, the Data Cloud Integration Product Manager owns the enterprise integration capability that brings governed, reusable, and reliable data into Data Cloud and makes shared data products available across Data Spaces. The role converts requests for new Data Streams and enterprise analytics views into prioritized pipeline work, defines reusable integration patterns, coordinates architecture and delivery dependencies, and ensures that Data Streams, Data Lake Objects, batch data transforms, calculated insights, and cross\-space reporting models are built and maintained to enterprise standards. **Key Performance Indicators** KPI area What good looks like * Delivery predictability Committed integration scope is delivered with transparent dependencies, risks, and release readiness. * Pipeline reliability Shared data pipelines meet agreed refresh, stability, monitoring, and support expectations. * Data quality Source\-to\-target data is reconciled and meets defined completeness, validity, and usability criteria. * Reuse and standardization Enterprise patterns and shared data products reduce duplicative integration work across Data Spaces. * Backlog health Integration work is prioritized, clearly specified, testable, and ready for sprint and PI planning. * Operational excellence Incidents, defects, technical debt, lineage, and ownership are visible and actively managed. **Ideal Background** * Bachelor's degree in data, technology, business, engineering, computer science, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. * Fluent English; other languages are desirable. * 5\+ years of product management, data integration, data engineering, platform delivery, or technical product ownership experience. * Strong knowledge of data integration concepts, APIs, batch and streaming pipelines, transformation, data contracts, schema mapping, lineage, observability, and data quality. * Hands\-on understanding of Salesforce Data Cloud, including Data Streams, Data Lake Objects, data modeling, identity resolution dependencies, calculated insights, and activation workflows. * Demonstrated experience leading an agile backlog and coordinating delivery across architects, engineers, analysts, QA, source\-system owners, and business product teams. * Strong ability to translate business and analytics needs into scalable technical requirements and explain architecture trade\-offs to nontechnical stakeholders. **Preferred** * Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms, Veeva, CRM integration, and enterprise analytics ecosystems. * Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, metadata management, data cataloging, and production support practices. * Background in pharma, life sciences, or another regulated, data\-intensive industry. * **Leadership Competencies** Navigate complexity * Enable impactful and timely decision\-making across business, data, technology, privacy, and compliance stakeholders. * Identify the critical issues in complex situations, maintain focus on enterprise outcomes, and adapt priorities as conditions change. * Take a long\-term view of platform sustainability, downstream impacts, and reusable enterprise capabilities. * **Deliver collective impact** * Integrate diverse perspectives to achieve the best outcome for the enterprise. * Influence without authority and collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries. * Challenge assumptions constructively and make decisions grounded in evidence. Pay: $75\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Network Engineer II

This role performs hands\-on troubleshooting and root cause analysis, supports the deployment of network and security solutions, and uses automation and AI\-driven tools to improve operational efficiency while maintaining accurate documentation and providing day\-to\-day support for network and firewall issues. **Focus \& Scope** *Essential duties and responsibilities, i.e. those which are basic, necessary, and an integral part of the job, are indicated below:* * Implement, configure, and support enterprise wired and wireless network infrastructure across core and branch locations to ensure reliable connectivity and strong performance. * Perform troubleshooting and root cause analysis on network, security, and firewall\-related issues, implementing corrective actions and escalating complex problems as needed. * Configure and maintain remote connectivity solutions, VPN infrastructure, and ISP connections to support secure and reliable access for distributed users and locations. * Implement system enhancements that improve network reliability, security posture, and overall performance while aligning with business objectives and industry best practices. * Maintain network hardware and software currency by ensuring appropriate security patches, firmware updates, and configuration standards are consistently applied. * Monitor network health through performance metrics and diagnostics, recommending and implementing solutions to improve security, performance, and cost efficiency. * Develop and maintain technical documentation including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and configuration guidelines to support consistent operations. * Stay current with emerging cybersecurity threats, vendor product updates, and industry best practices to proactively address vulnerabilities and leverage new capabilities. * Use AI\-driven tools and automation technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort in routine network management tasks. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to provide first\-line response for network issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal business impact. **Relationships, Qualifications and Requirements, \& Competencies** Key Relationships Reports To: * Sr IT Manager, Technology Operations Direct Reports: * None External Clients: * Vendors, Technology Partners, Solutions Providers, and Consultants. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Physical: Sitting for long periods of time working on the computer or attending meetings. Exposed to the conditions of job sites which can include loud noise, dust, fumes, and extreme weather conditions prevalent at the time. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Excellence & Escalations
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1\-OPT, F1\-CPT, H\-1B, TN, J\-1, etc** **Your Role:** The Senior Manager, Technical Excellence \& Escalations leads the two teams that sit between Technical Support and the rest of the business: the global Technical Excellence team, staffed by our Technical Leads, and the global Escalations Engineering team. Both produce Tenable's earliest and clearest signal about product supportability and customer risk. Both have historically produced that signal faster than the organization could act on it. This role exists to close that gap. This is not a queue\-management job. The Senior Manager is accountable for two outcomes: turning Technical Lead expertise and escalation findings into tracked change with Product and Engineering, and running one escalations practice that behaves identically in AMER, EMEA, and APJ. The role sits within Operations \& Scale and works in close partnership with the Sr. Director, who sets overall strategy and carries the executive narrative. The Senior Manager owns the operating model, the day\-to\-day practice, and the working\-level relationships with Product and Engineering that make change actually happen. They lead senior individual contributors who are already force multipliers — which makes this a job about influence and orchestration, not direction. Who You Are: * **An orchestrator, not a bottleneck.** You create the conditions for senior experts to influence the organization instead of routing their work through yourself. * **Technically credible.** You have the depth to earn respect from Principal\-level engineers and to challenge an Engineering assessment that doesn't hold up. * **A clear communicator under pressure.** You can hold a room containing both a frustrated customer and an Engineering lead, and translate technical detail into business consequence. * **A systems thinker.** You are drawn to the pattern behind the escalation. You would rather fix the class of problem than win the individual case. * **Comfortable influencing without authority.** Much of what this role must accomplish depends on teams you don't own. * **Effective remotely.** You build trust and hold a team together without relying on being in the room, and you communicate in writing well enough that distance isn't a handicap. * **A developer of senior talent.** You are energized by growing people who are already very good, and you give direct feedback. **Your Opportunity:** Technical Excellence Team * Run the operating model and product coverage plan for the global Technical Excellence team — every strategic product has clear lead ownership, defined authority, and no coverage gaps across theaters. * Set the team's working agenda: what leads work on, what they own, and how their time splits between reactive escalation support and proactive supportability work. * Turn Technical Lead findings — defect patterns, supportability gaps, documentation failures, recurring friction — into one prioritized, evidence\-backed agenda, not a stream of individual product complaints. * Position Technical Leads as credible partners in Product and Engineering forums, with the data, framing, and support they need to influence rather than escalate. * Contribute to the Technical Lead career path with the Education \& Enablement Manager, and apply it consistently — progression from Technical Lead through Senior and Principal, and the competencies that separate each grade. Global Escalations Practice * Own the global escalations practice day to day: process design, entry and exit criteria, severity definitions, roles, communication standards, and adherence. * Drive it to a single global standard. One model, consistently applied and measured across all theaters, with regional variance only where legally or operationally required. * Operate and enforce the working agreement with Product Engineering — SLA a  manual pulls. Leadership \& People Development * Lead and develop a senior, highly autonomous, globally distributed team, including the Principal Technical Lead as a technical partner and strategic extension of the function. * Operate as a player\-coach: hold the operating cadence and coach the team, and step personally into a live critical escalation or a difficult Engineering conversation when it matters. * Build succession depth in both teams and eliminate single\-person dependency on strategic products and accounts. * Partner with the Education \& Enablement Manager — a peer in the same function — to close skill gaps in both populations and feed field learnings into broader Technical Support enablement and certification. * Set goals, performance expectations, and measurement for both teams in line with global Technical Support objectives. * Drive AI adoption within Technical Lead and Escalations workflows under the Support AI governance framework, acting as the proving ground for capability the wider TSO will inherit. **What You'll Need:** * 8\+ years in Technical Support, Escalation Management, or customer\-facing engineering in enterprise software, with recent focus on security or vulnerability management. * 3\+ years managing technical teams — ideally senior individual contributors, technical leads, or escalation engineers. Experience managing remote and globally distributed teams strongly preferred. * Hands\-on experience running an escalation practice or program, including process design and cross\-functional coordination. * Demonstrated ability to influence product and engineering priorities using support and escalation data. * Experience operating within Support–Engineering agreements, including SLA adherence for defect resolution. * Comfort with support metrics and the analysis behind them — escalation volume, re\-escalation rate, time\-to\-resolution, ticket volume reduction — and the ability to build the evidence case for investment. * Strong understanding of Tenable's product portfolio and security best practices, or the demonstrated ability to reach it quickly. * Technical foundation across networking, authentication, operating systems, and cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) sufficient to lead technical discussions credibly. * Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable with senior stakeholders and with customers at any level. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. * Able to work in a hybrid/on\-site capacity at our office in Columbia MD or Boston MA. * Available to provide leadership coverage for critical escalations outside standard business hours as needed, and to work across AMER, EMEA, and APJ time zones to support globally distributed teams. * Occasional travel as required for team, customer, and cross\-functional engagements. * Flexibility to perform other duties as deemed necessary by management. **And Ideally:** * Cybersecurity or adjacent enterprise security SaaS experience. * Prior time as a Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, or Escalations Engineer — credibility earned in the seat. * Product Management or program management exposure. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted support workflows and their governance. * Experience supporting FedRAMP or other regulated environments. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MM1 *We're committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable \- through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact* *Recruiting@Tenable.com* *for further assistance.* **Tenable Data Consent Statement** Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you: General Applicant Privacy Notice California Applicant Privacy Notice EU/EEA/UK Applicant Privacy Notice

Specialist 3 \& 4 assists in providing troubleshooting, guidance, and support in the delivery process of construction projects within the District. This position employs Department policies, technical guidance, and procedures related to TDOT's construction and e\-construction specifications, software, and websites to support the project delivery process. The District Operations Construction Transportation Engineering Specialist 3 \& 4 is responsible for collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders, including Project Teams, TDOT Divisions, Regions, and contractors to ensure contractual requirements are met on all District projects. This position will continuously evaluate District project performance indicators to implement acquired knowledge into policies and procedures that mitigate the District's risk and increase performance as part of fulfilling TDOT's strategic vision. This position must effectively articulate the full spectrum of project development and delivery concepts through training, mentoring, and collaborating as part of a matrix organization. **Responsibilities** * Serve as a resource for Project Teams and District staff as part of a matrix organization by applying the Project Delivery Network (PDN) through the full lifecycle of the project delivery process. Minimize risk by identifying and mitigating potential project conflicts and issues before, during, and after construction, and meeting the timelines and budget established by the project development process. * Integrate Quality Management into all deliverables, including plans and constructability reviews, risk workshops, field reviews and project troubleshooting, change order development and negotiation, invoice management, and critical path/project scheduling changes. * Assist with the development and maintenance of specifications, policies, procedures, and manuals in support of construction resources with the purpose of reducing errors, construction delays, and contractor claims. * Assist in the tracking and enforcement of contractual requirements of external stakeholders by ensuring Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) and On\-the\-Job Training goals are met. * Ensure the application of the Davis Bacon Act and that certified payroll requirements are included on all District projects. * Ensure appropriately trained and certified individuals are on the project site. * Assist the Team Lead and Resident Engineer with ensuring the District's work program is delivered on time and within budget. * Assist in the preparation, evaluation, and/or processing of project documents, including plans and constructability reviews, erosion control plans, change order development and negotiation, invoice management, and project close outs. * Assist in developing and delivering training to District staff. Support and assist with the Construction Proficiency Program when needed. Assist in ensuring District staff are given the opportunity to achieve all relevant proficiencies and qualifications. * Conduct and document progress meetings, utility relocation meetings, and all other meetings pertinent to project completion on time and within budget. * Provide exceptional customer service by facilitating the sharing of acquired knowledge with Project Teams, District staff, contractors, suppliers, utilities, and other project stakeholders. Support District offices and external partners by exercising effective listening skills and communicating effectively. **Competencies (KSA's)** **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Competencies (KSACs):** **The required KSACs for Engineering Specialist, I, II, and III include:** * Knowledge of engineering principles, potentially within a specific discipline as they relate to transportation projects * Knowledgeable in the use of computers and applicable programs, applications, and systems * Skilled in basic technical writing * Ability to communicate effectively, while interacting with internal and external stakeholders in a professional and courteous manner * Ability to manage time to ensure assignments are completed * Ability to use critical thinking to problem solve and make informed decisions * Ability to learn technical concepts and apply those concepts to work * Ability to follow verbal and written instructions * Ability to conduct work with a high degree of accuracy **Additional KSACs for Engineering Specialist II and III include:** * Skilled in strong technical writing * Ability to work within a project team * Ability to manage time and prioritize work items to ensure project assignments are completed **Additional KSACs for Engineering Specialist III include:** * Ability to resolve conflicts, coach, and mentor others, and support a culture of accountability, collaboration, and accomplishment * Ability to coordinate with the Project Manager and Project Team to proactively identify and resolve complex, multidisciplinary issues which may impact project scope, schedule, and/or budget

jobs.title: Software Engineer Director
jobs.description: Texas Capital is built to help businesses and their leaders. Our depth of knowledge and expertise allows us to bring the best of the big firms at a scale that works for our clients, with highly experienced bankers who truly invest in people’s success — today and tomorrow. While we are rooted in core financial products, we are differentiated by our approach. Our bankers are seasoned financial experts who possess deep experience across a multitude of industries. Equally important, they bring commitment — investing the time and resources to understand our clients’ immediate needs, identify market opportunities and meet long\-term objectives. At Texas Capital, we do more than build business success. We build long\-lasting relationships. Texas Capital provides a variety of benefits to colleagues, including health insurance coverage, wellness program, fertility and family building aids, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans with a generous 401K match, paid leave programs, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO). Headquartered in Dallas with offices in Austin, Fort Worth, Houston, Richardson, Plano and San Antonio, Texas Capital was recently named Best Regional Bank in 2024 by Bankrate and was named to *The Dallas Morning News*’ Dallas\-Fort Worth metroplex Top Workplaces 2023 and GoBankingRate’s 2023 list of Best Regional Banks. For more information about joining our team, please visit us at www.texascapitalbank.com. The Head of Digital Technology owns the strategy, architecture, and delivery of Texas Capital Bank's client\-facing digital channels, and leads the technology teams supporting online banking, mobile banking, and the digital experience for private and personal consumer banking clients. This leader sets the multi\-year digital roadmap and is equally accountable for shipping it: running digital as a managed channel with committed outcomes, modernizing the platforms beneath it, and staying close to the architecture, the code, and the production environment. This is a hands\-on leadership role, not a purely strategic one. We are seeking qualified candidates with a passion for innovation that have extraordinary levels of critical thinking, motivation, and initiative and aspire to deliver superior client experiences.
