jobs.description: **Work Schedule** Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions** Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Fluctuating Temps hot/cold, Loud Noises (Equipment/Machinery), Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)**Job Description** Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue exceeding $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving patient diagnostics and therapies, or increasing productivity in their laboratories, we are here to support them. \- Location / Division Specific Information Division: Laboratory Equipment Division (LED) Location: Marietta, OH Work Arrangement: On\-site The Laboratory Equipment Division combines deep scientific expertise, a collaborative culture, and strong operational excellence to deliver the laboratory equipment and consumables our customers rely on—quickly, reliably, and safely. Our smart lab solutions help customers focus on what matters most: delivering answers and innovations that save and improve lives. \- How will you make an impact? As R\&D – Data Systems Engineer, Technology Center, you will develop, maintain, and continuously improve the software, data acquisition, database, and engineering systems that enable product verification, reliability, and performance testing within the Technology Center. In this hands\-on technical role, you will partner closely with R\&D engineers and laboratory technicians to integrate data acquisition hardware, instrumentation, software, and data\-management solutions used to evaluate cold storage and laboratory equipment. You will also provide local technical ownership and support for engineering design applications, including SolidWorks and related engineering software. Your work will enable reliable, traceable, and efficient collection and analysis of engineering data while improving laboratory automation, test repeatability, and the productivity of product development teams. \- What will you do? Data Acquisition \& Test Systems * Develop, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot data acquisition and test\-control systems supporting controlled\-environment product testing. * Develop and maintain software applications and test scripts used to control laboratory equipment, acquire test data, and automate engineering test execution. * Integrate instrumentation and control hardware including thermocouples, temperature sensors, pressure transducers, flow sensors, power measurement devices, DAQ hardware, PLCs, and related laboratory equipment. * Partner with engineers and technicians to translate test requirements into effective data acquisition, instrumentation, and automation solutions. * Troubleshoot hardware, software, communications, instrumentation, and data\-quality issues affecting laboratory testing. * Support configuration, commissioning, and lifecycle maintenance of custom and commercially available laboratory test systems. Data, Database \& Laboratory Information Systems * Develop and maintain databases used for secure storage, organization, retrieval, and analysis of engineering test data. * Maintain appropriate data integrity, availability, backup, and redundancy practices for Technology Center test data. * Develop efficient methods for transferring test data from laboratory equipment into databases and engineering analysis tools. * Support standardization of test\-data structures, naming conventions, metadata, and reporting practices. * Identify opportunities to improve accessibility and usability of engineering data while maintaining appropriate controls. Engineering Software \& Systems Support * Serve as the local technical resource for engineering design software used by the Controlled Temperature Technologies R\&D team, including SolidWorks and related applications. * Coordinate software installation, configuration, licensing, upgrades, and troubleshooting in partnership with internal IT and third\-party vendors. * Evaluate new software and laboratory technology solutions and provide technical recommendations based on capability, compatibility, maintainability, and business need. * Maintain documentation for critical laboratory applications, configurations, interfaces, and system dependencies. Operational Excellence \& Continuous Improvement * Maintain a safe work environment and a high level of safety awareness while working with laboratory equipment and controlled\-environment test systems. * Establish and maintain standard work, documentation, and configuration practices for critical data and software systems. * Apply Lean / PPI principles to automate repetitive activities, simplify workflows, improve data availability, and reduce test\-system variability. \- How will you get here? Education * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering Technology, or related technical discipline preferred. * Associate degree in a related technical discipline with significant relevant experience may be considered. Experience * 3\+ years of experience developing, implementing, or maintaining software and data systems supporting engineering, laboratory, manufacturing, or test environments. * Experience developing and maintaining data acquisition and automated test systems. * Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining databases for engineering or test data. * Experience developing software or test applications using tools such as LabVIEW, Python, SQL, C/C\+\+, .NET, or similar development environments. * Experience integrating software with DAQ hardware, PLCs, instrumentation, sensors, or other physical test equipment. * Experience supporting engineering software applications, including SolidWorks or similar CAD platforms, preferred. * Experience supporting controlled\-environment, HVAC/R, refrigeration, thermal, or electromechanical product testing strongly preferred. * Experience working with third\-party software and hardware suppliers preferred. \- Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities * Strong understanding of data acquisition system architecture, instrumentation, signal acquisition, and engineering data management. * Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data structures, data integrity, backup, and retrieval methods. * Ability to develop and troubleshoot software that interfaces with physical hardware, instrumentation, and laboratory equipment. * Familiarity with sensors and instrumentation used for thermal testing, including thermocouples, pressure transducers, electrical measurements, and related DAQ devices. * Working knowledge of PLCs, industrial communications, and automated test\-control architectures preferred. * Working knowledge of HVAC/R, refrigeration, or controlled\-environment testing strongly preferred. * Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technicians, IT professionals, external vendors, and cross\-functional partners. * Ability to develop clear technical documentation and train users on software and test\-system applications. * Ability and willingness to work hands\-on in laboratory, prototype, and manufacturing environments. \- Our Mission and Values Our global team of approximately 125,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and pharmaceutical services. Together, we enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com. an analytical thinker with good engineering aptitude. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities** * Exercise judgment in setting work priorities and identifying next steps. * Able to quickly adapt to change with positive and constructive feedback. * Work in a fast\-paced environment and operate remotely from the main office with minimum supervision. * Must be able to stand, bend, and/or kneel for up to two hours at a time. * Able to lift to 75 pounds, push and pull equipment, and carry up to 50 pounds for at least 100 feet. * Some exposure to biohazards is a possibility during instrument service activities, as these instruments are used in biohazard environments and encounter human bodily fluids. This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes: * A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs * Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement * At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in accordance with company policy * Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan * Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total\-rewards

jobs.description: **About Thunes** Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes' proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real\-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes' Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M\-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more. Thunes' Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in\-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real\-time payments globally. Members of Thunes' Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super\-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks. Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/ **Context of the role** We are looking for a driven and product\-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data. In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision\-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day\-to\-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company. You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions. * Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics. * Design, develop, and maintain production\-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools. * Write production\-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery. * Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well\-structured, and fit for analytical use. * Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team. * Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities. **Professional Experience and Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field. * 2\-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role. * Strong hands\-on experience writing production\-level SQL. * Strong hands\-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development. * Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management. * Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions. * Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability. * Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast\-paced, data\-rich environment. * Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way. * Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery. * Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself. * Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery. *Sound like you? Apply now!*

jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: The AI Enablement Engineer helps teams across Topgolf, technical and non\-technical alike, get real value from AI by removing the friction that blocks adoption and building the reusable archetypes, skills, and governed integrations that let business teams build safe, working applications through Topgolf’s AI\-SDLC pipeline. This role acts as the technical backstop, reviewing AI\-generated code and specs for correctness, security, and adherence to engineering standards before anything ships. * Partner with teams across Topgolf, technical and non\-technical, to unblock AI adoption by configuring agent access, resolving friction, and showing teams how to get real value from available AI tools * Design and build archetypes and skills (e.g., SKILL.md files, intake questionnaires, spec templates, code scaffolds) that package engineering standards and governance into reusable building blocks for the AI\-SDLC pipeline * Connect agents to internal systems, data sources, and tools through governed connectors and MCP\-style integrations * Monitor archetypes and agents for model drift, prompt bloat, and other degradation as underlying models and usage evolve, and keep code scaffolds and prompts current with secure coding practices and platform engineering standards * Review AI agent\-produced code, specs, and gate results for correctness, security, scope adherence, and good development practice before production * Test archetypes and agents against adversarial prompting (prompt injection, jailbreak attempts) and implement guardrail hooks to enforce scope, safety, and policy compliance * Build documentation, examples, and light training (office hours, walkthroughs, guides) to raise teams' baseline capability with AI * Retire, merge, or extend archetypes based on usage and escalation patterns, and triage escalations to security, data owners, or app stewards, partnering with platform engineering so new archetypes and integrations fit the pipeline's runtime and release mechanics * Triage escalations and route findings to security, data owners, or app stewards, following the pipeline's escalation rules. * Partner with the platform engineering team so new archetypes and integrations fit the pipeline's constrained runtime, connector catalog, and release mechanics. Required Skills and Experience * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python and working knowledge of at least one other widely used language such as Go, TypeScript, or Java. * Strong grounding in core software development principles: automated testing, version control, code review, secure coding practices, and API design. * Hands on experience with LLM agent tooling, for example Claude Code, MCP, LangGraph, or a comparable framework, including prompting, tool use, and agent orchestration. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases, and judgment for when they are the right tool versus a simpler approach. * Ability to evaluate AI generated code for correctness and risk, and to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders in plain language. * Experience designing templates, documentation, or tooling that other engineers or non\-experts build from. Comfort operating as both a broad enabler, unblocking adoption across many teams, and a careful reviewer, gating what individual teams ship. * Preferred Qualifications * Experience setting up and administering AI coding tools or agent platforms, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, across a team or company. * Familiarity with the Claude Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or comparable agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. * Experience building internal AI adoption programs: office hours, documentation, champion networks, or similar. * Background in code review, static analysis, or security review, enough to interpret gate findings without necessarily building the scanners. Experience contributing to governance, approval, or escalation workflows for a technical platform. * What Success Looks Like * Teams across Topgolf, not just engineering, are visibly getting more done with AI than they were a quarter ago, and can point to you as part of why. * Business teams build safe, working applications inside the pipeline instead of routing every idea to engineering. * The archetypes you maintain stay current, well scoped, and easy for non\-technical builders to use without guessing. * What ships has already been checked against good software development practice, because you caught what the automated gates could not. * The archetype catalog and the tools you connect evolve based on evidence: what teams actually need, and what keeps showing up in questions and escalations. BENEFITS Free Play \& 1/2 price food! Health, dental, vision, 401(k) team member match, free mental well\-being platform – and that’s just for starters for those who qualify. ADA The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of the job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some incumbents assigned to the job to perform a different combination of duties. EEO Statement Topgolf is a global sports and entertainment community and is committed to equal opportunity and is firmly committed to preventing discrimination and harassment, including sexual misconduct, based on legally protected diversity characteristics (such as race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family status, citizenship, genetic information and veteran status) in its application and hiring processes and in its employment decisions. As an affirmative action employer, Topgolf also takes steps to prevent retaliation and to create a respectful, equitable and inclusive environment for our Guests, Associates, business partners, vendors, and the communities we serve. Topgolf is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, genetics or any other category protected under applicable law. Topgolf Entertainment Group does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Topgolf will not pay fees for unsolicited agency resumes and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered property of Topgolf Entertainment Group and will be processed accordingly without fee. Topgolf participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description: **About Traba** =============== Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain. We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships. But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale. We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses. You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0\-to\-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI. You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them. This role reports directly to our VP of Product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform * Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities * Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams * Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners * Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work * Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance * Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions * Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture * Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact * Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- **Real agent builder.** You have launched customer\-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously. **0\-to\-1 operator.** You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists. **AI\-native problem solver.** You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs. **First\-principles thinker.** You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks. **Customer\-embedded builder.** You believe the best products are built shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer\-embedded product development models is highly valued. **Technical depth.** You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex\-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details. **Builder mentality.** Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process. **Deeply collaborative.** You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 3 – 5 years of experience as a Product Manager * Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes * Experience building AI\-native products or customer\-facing agent systems * Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams * Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas * Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles * Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands\-on experience building with modern AI systems * Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area * A strong work ethic and desire to build a category\-defining company **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via Grubhub \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Team building events * Gympass Benefit * Flexible PTO * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $150,000 and $190,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long\-term success and upside of the business. The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high\-performing team in a fast\-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real\-time decision\-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem\-solving that drives meaningful impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Privacy Notice for CA Applicants Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K

jobs.title: Controls Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. **Where is the work:** Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires. **What’s in it for you:** A sustainable future demands ongoing digital advancement. Our digital solutions team leads the way in developing next\-generation climate technology focused on reducing demand\-side energy consumption and emissions. Our team—including BrainBox AI, Nuvolo, and more—combines technical expertise with advanced analytics to create data\-driven solutions that add real value for customers, communities, and the planet. Whether you're advancing AI in HVAC or driving analytics for greater efficiency, your ideas will help engineer solutions for stronger communities and a sustainable world. Trane Technologies is currently seeking a Controls Software Test Engineer to join our team in Clarksville, TN. The selected individual will be responsible for preparing, conducting and reporting on the testing of embedded\-based software for Trane Commercial HVAC products. **What you will do:** * Analyzing functional requirements, to generate a comprehensive set of test cases. * Writing functional test procedures and automated test scripts that provide comprehensive testing of the product requirements. * Executing test procedures and automated test scripts as part of formal product testing. * Conducting exploratory testing based on detailed knowledge of the product under test. * Reporting product issues within the defect tracking system. * Verifying product defect fixes. * Helping build and maintain the engineering test facilities (test room, test hardware and test software). * Assisting in the development of hardware and software simulators when appropriate. * Helping to advance testing tools, technology, and processes within Controls Engineering. * Make recommendations for improvement of the product testing process. * Individual should be able to: * Meet short\- and long\-term deadlines. * Effectively meet the needs of internal and external customers. * Work regularly and dependably. * Function in a team environment. * Demonstrate ability to cope with stress and maintain a pleasant and cooperative temperament with internal and external customers. * Demonstrate ability to perform mental tasks such as making decisions, learning, thinking rationally and exercising good judgment. * Take on other duties as assigned. **What you will bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Engineering Technology or Computer Science (or related discipline), or commensurate experience in software development or software testing is required. * Should have demonstrated proficiency with MS Office (i.e excel macros, pivot tables, xml files, excel formulas \& commands). * Must understand and adhere to safety measures when working with electrical equipment. * Ability to effectively communicate with others both in writing and verbally. * Course work or experience in the following areas is desired: current test methodologies, quality assurance practices, and networks. * Utilize laboratory instrumentation—including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters (DMMs), bench power supplies, and network sniffers (Wireshark)—to isolate physical layer signal degradation, serial bus faults (RS\-485\), power interruptions, and hardware defects. * Design, implement, and maintain version\-controlled test strategies, test suites, automated regression scripts (using Python, Postman, or Jenkins), and hardware and software test benches to simulate high device counts and stress\-test network scalability. * Replicate real\-world field conditions, edge cases, and failsafe scenarios—such as sudden loss of sensor signals, power brownouts, and network traffic load limits—to verify recovery protocols prior to production release. * Manage day\-to\-day physical lab jobs.title: Early Career Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** We're looking for an engineer early in their career who wants to build things, break them, and figure out why they broke. This is a hands on role from day one. You'll be in the shop as much as at a desk, and the work spans mechanical design, fabrication, testing, and the software and electronics that make hardware actually do something. You do not need to have done this professionally yet. What matters is that you've built real things, whether that was a competition car, a robot, or something you made at a makerspace because you wanted to see if it would work. Please note that this role is located at our warehouse in Mountain View that will soon be relocating to Fremont. **What You'll Do** * Design mechanical components and assemblies in CAD, and take them from concept through fabrication and test. * Build, wire, and bring up prototypes yourself. Machining, 3D printing, soldering, and assembly are part of the job, not someone else's job. * Run tests, collect data, and figure out what the results mean. Then iterate. * Write scripts and simple control code to support testing and to get hardware moving. * Work alongside other engineers and teams on integration. * Document what you build so the next person can pick it up. * Work out of our warehouse in Fremont, CA on testing, bring up, maintenance, and repair of hardware in service. **What We're Looking For** * 0 to 2 years of experience, with a degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, or something adjacent. New graduates are welcome. * Solid mechanical fundamentals: statics, materials, tolerancing, and a working command of CAD. * Comfort with code. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to write Python or C to read a sensor, drive a motor, or process test data. * Shop skills and the instinct to build rather than only model. You've used a mill, a lathe, a printer, or a soldering iron and you aren't precious about getting your hands dirty. * Genuine eagerness to learn. You ask questions, you chase down answers, and you'd rather be told what you got wrong than left alone with it. Compensation Range: $105K \- $145K

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Clinical Analytics
jobs.description: **Principal Software Engineer \- Clinical Analytics** Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values. **This position is based out of our headquarters in the Greater Seattle area.****\#LI\-hybrid** **Who We Need** Truveta is building a diverse and inclusive team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking enthusiastic new graduates who are problem\-solvers, collaborative teammates, and eager to make a difference in healthcare. If you're excited about purposeful work, joining a mission\-driven team, and launching your career in a supportive environment, Truveta could be the perfect place to start. **This Opportunity** At Truveta, you'll help define how health systems use data to improve the quality of care. You'll work at the intersection of cloud services, analytical data platforms, and user experiences, setting the technical direction for technology that lets clinical and quality teams define, monitor, and act on the metrics that matter most. Health systems deserve modern, intuitive tools for measuring care quality, yet getting answers from large\-scale clinical data still often takes specialized skills and long turnaround times. At Truveta, we are building a next\-generation analytics platform that lets health systems securely explore their data, track performance over time, and drive measurable improvements in patient outcomes. We are seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and technical strategy of Truveta's clinical analytics platform. You will be both a hands\-on builder and a force multiplier: designing the systems that power low\-latency analytics and self\-serve dashboarding, writing critical code, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring engineers across the organization. You will partner with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering leadership to translate the needs of health systems into a durable platform vision, then guide teams in delivering it. This role offers the opportunity to shape a foundational product area, tackle ambiguous and technically demanding problems, and make a meaningful impact on our mission of saving lives with data. **Work Areas:** * Define the end\-to\-end architecture for clinical analytics: analytical data serving, metric definition and computation, and self\-serve dashboarding and visualization for health systems. * Make foundational design decisions on OLAP and analytical storage, data modeling, query performance, caching, and scalability for population\-level health data. * Design secure multi\-tenant systems with strong data isolation, fine\-grained access control, and auditability appropriate for sensitive health data. * Determine how health systems define, customize, and share their own metrics and dashboards, balancing flexibility with governance, performance, and cost. * Build and prototype critical components, set technical standards, and lead design and code reviews across teams. * Mentor and grow engineers, and partner with other engineering leaders to align roadmaps and reduce technical risk across the broader Truveta data platform. * Establish engineering practices for reliability, observability, and operational excellence in production analytics services. **Key Qualifications** * BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 12\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale software systems, with a track record of technical leadership on complex, multi\-team initiatives. * Deep experience with data, OLAP, or analytics technologies, including analytical databases, BI and dashboarding platforms, and data modeling for high\-performance reporting workloads. * Strong backend engineering expertise in .NET (C\#), Python, or a similar language, including REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud\-native architectures on platforms such as Azure. * Demonstrated ability to make and communicate sound architectural tradeoffs, and to drive alignment among engineering, product, and executive stakeholders. * Proven experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical capability of a team. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical design documents and explain complex systems to diverse audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building embedded analytics, self\-serve BI, or data\-driven products for technical or business users. * Experience with multi\-tenant architectures, including row\-level security and tenant isolation, in regulated or sensitive\-data environments. * Familiarity with healthcare data, clinical quality measures, or health informatics. * Experience with containerized deployments, infrastructure as code, and operating high\-availability production services. * Experience applying AI or natural\-language interfaces to analytics and data exploration. **Why Truveta?** Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well\-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together. **We Offer:** * Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage * Great benefits package * Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans * 401K plan * Professional development \& training opportunities for continuous learning * Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off * Generous parental leave * Regular team activities (virtual and in\-person) * The base pay for this position is $222,000 to $240,000\. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target. Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options. *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents* *linked* *here.* Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude Black and Indigenous people, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA\+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don't meet all of the requirements. **Please note that all applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer as we are unable to sponsor work visas or permits (e.g., F****‑****1 OPT, H****‑****1B) at this time. We appreciate your interest in the position and encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.**

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Test & Integration Technician (Technician III)
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe general\-purpose, generally\-intelligent robots will be built in our lifetimes. Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real\-world operation must make the technology better, and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop. As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state\-of\-the\-art hardware, every robot we build at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy. **Culture** We believe something truly special happens when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything they do. We're characterized by both technical excellence and next\-level collaboration and respect. **The Role** Most test jobs hand you a pass/fail checklist and a bin for rejects. This one is the opposite. You'll take a robot fresh off the assembly line, bring it to life, and own it until it's verified, documented, and ready to ship. When it doesn't behave, and some won't, you'll work out why, prove it, fix it, and make sure it stays fixed. You'll work on our autonomous palletizing robot, which combines a collaborative robot arm, a battery\-powered mobile base, vacuum end\-of\-arm tooling, sensors, and safety systems. You'll partner with our Production Engineers (Test \& QA), who own the test process, while you run bring\-up and test at rate. We are motivated by atoms not electrons. The robots you release ship to real warehouses across the country, where every hidden fault becomes a field ticket. You are the last set of hands before the customer. **What you'll own** * Receiving robots from the line, inspecting build readiness and wiring workmanship, and performing safe initial power\-up * Loading and verifying software, firmware, calibrations, and configurations using our provisioning tools and procedures * Subsystem bring\-up: DC power and battery system, CAN communications, robot arm and controller, mobile base and drives, sensors, vacuum system, and safety circuits * Running functional and final acceptance testing, including multi\-hour continuous runs and log review for abnormal behavior * Triage across electrical, mechanical, software, networking, and configuration failures * Reproducing problems, isolating root cause with evidence, and performing repairs within approved procedures * Verifying every repair with targeted checks and retesting * Driving each robot's issues to closure, and escalating to Production Engineering with clear evidence when needed * Recording failures, repairs, configurations, and test results in ION and our issue\-tracking systems * Preparing robots for shipment: final checks, battery state of charge, arm stowing, and complete documentation before release * Coaching manufacturing technicians on bring\-up and helping build troubleshooting guides * Feeding recurring failures back to Production Engineering so they are fixed at the source * Following electrical safety, ESD, lithium battery handling, and equipment isolation procedures **How you'll be measured** More robots pass final acceptance testing the first time, fewer issues show up when robots arrive at customers, repeat failures and unnecessary part swaps go down, and Engineering gets clear evidence, not guesses, when escalation is needed. **Requirements** * Proven independent troubleshooting of complete robots, industrial automation equipment, or comparably complex electromechanical systems * Experience owning bring\-up and resolving failures, beyond assembly or routine pass/fail testing * Fluency reading electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and assembly drawings * Confident use of a multimeter to diagnose power, wiring, and signal problems * A sharp eye for wiring workmanship: crimps, ferrules, connector pins, strain relief, and cable routing * Working knowledge of DC power systems, motors, actuators, sensors, and connectors * Comfort with the Linux command line, IP networking, software installs, configuration checks, and log analysis * A methodical approach: form a hypothesis, test it, isolate the cause, verify the repair * Clear documentation and communication, including knowing the difference between a confirmed cause and a suspected one * Ability to prioritize production blockers, work independently, and escalate at the right time * Flexibility to work extended hours during production pushes and ship deadlines **Nice to haves (zero or more)** * 5\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience * Oscilloscope and CAN bus diagnostic tools * Experience with collaborative robot arms, mobile robots, or battery\-powered equipment * IPC/WHMA\-A\-620 or similar wiring workmanship training * Python or shell scripting for diagnostics and test execution * Technical training, an associate degree, or equivalent practical experience This is a full\-time, hourly role. The pay range is $38–$48 per hour, commensurate with experience. **Benefits** Tutor offers competitive benefits including fully employer\-covered health insurance, a managed 401(k), and regular in\-office meals. We also offer unlimited PTO and holidays. We host social events and maintain a collaborative, low\-ego work culture where people are trusted to take ownership and solve real problems. **How we hire** Finalists complete a hands\-on troubleshooting exercise with a representative fault, schematics, and logs. We want to hear how you think: your diagnostic approach, your proposed repair, and how you'd prove it's resolved. Tutor is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer - Earner
jobs.description: **About the role:** Product Design at Uber is about more than just making things look good\-it's about architecting how people and things move in the physical world. As a Lead Product Designer, you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigate competing priorities, and lead through influence, not control. This is a high\-impact environment where you will solve what is hard to shape the future of movement. This role is on our Earner design team, building the platform Earners rely on to plan and move through their day. You'll shape how millions of Drivers and Couriers experience Uber across surfaces and form factors, from tablet and foldable phone design to the earner assistant, where AI and voice help people navigate their day hands\-free. You'll also contribute to the universal systems every earner interaction depends on, like how the app handles loading and latency. You'll work closely with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and some of the best designers and researchers in the field, in a fast\-paced, collaborative setting. This is a 0\-to\-1 role. You'll make big decisions without perfect information and own the outcomes, whether that means defining how an Earner interacts with a foldable device or how they speak to their assistant to plan out their day. You'll navigate high\-stakes ambiguity, balance near\-term execution with long\-term vision, and advocate for the user in a fast\-moving, technical space. If you think critically and thrive on solving problems with real\-world impact at a global scale, this is where you'll grow. **What You Will Do:** * Lead human\-centered experience design for high\-impact domains, defining new interaction patterns and service models where none exist today, including for voice\-first experiences. * Own design problems end\-to\-end, from early\-stage research and conceptual wireframes to high\-fidelity prototypes and final production\-ready assets. * Design conversational and voice interactions for the earner assistant, helping Earners plan and move through their day hands\-free. * Partner as a key thought leader with Product, Engineering, and Operations to define requirements and shape the strategic roadmap, not just translate them into mocks. * Design across digital and physical touchpoints, translating complex logistical and technical systems into clear, intuitive flows for mobile, tablet, foldable, and voice interfaces. * Maintain and evolve Uber's design language by contributing to shared systems and foundational patterns, including universal systems like loading and latency, that ensure consistency across global platforms. * Prototype rapidly to test hypotheses and validate ideas early, using data and user research to iterate and raise the bar for quality and trustworthiness. **Time Spent in the Day:** * 40% Crafting UI/UX designs, wireframes, and high\-fidelity prototypes in Figma or with AI. * 25% Collaborating cross\-functionally to define requirements and align on product strategy. * 15% Partnering with UXR and Data Science to validate designs and analyze user feedback. * 10% Mentoring other designers and contributing to shared design systems and patterns. * 10% Presenting work to stakeholders and advocating for design\-led solutions **Basic Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of professional product design experience, with a track record of shipping successful digital products for mobile and web. * A portfolio showcasing high\-quality design work, strong systems thinking, and a deep understanding of user\-centered design principles. * Proficiency with Figma and a range of prototyping tools to bring complex ideas to life. * Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and lead design direction in fast\-paced, evolving environments. * Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience designing for multiple form factors and input methods, such as mobile, tablet, foldable devices, or voice. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience designing AI\-powered or LLM\-driven product experiences, including how to handle uncertainty, errors, and trust in AI\-generated content. * Experience designing conversational or voice user interfaces (VUI), including how to structure a natural back\-and\-forth voice interaction. * Experience in frontier or complex domains such as Autonomous Systems, AdTech, Fintech, or Enterprise/Operational tools. * Experience designing across physical and digital touchpoints, including geospatial or location\-aware systems. * Proven ability to collaborate with user researchers and data scientists to drive experimentation and A/B testing. * Advanced degree in HCI, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, or a related field. Experience building and implementing components within a global, scalable design system. * For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $211,000 per year \- USD $234,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Authoring
jobs.description: **The opportunity** ------------------- Three billion people a month play something built in Unity. We're the team changing how those things get made — building AI that generates assets, writes and repairs code, and turns an idea into something playable faster than has ever been possible. Our group owns the backend and operations behind all of it: the cloud infrastructure our AI products run on, the data and experimentation platforms that tell us what works, the evaluation systems that tell us whether the AI is actually any good, and the operations that keep everything running across regions and customers. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely **AI\-native**: for whom agents and AI tooling are how the work gets done rather than a productivity add\-on, and who can take a problem nobody has framed yet, explore it independently, and move quickly to something real. We've built the foundations over the past few months — CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, deployment standards — and they work. The platform is stable, and we intend to keep it that way. What we have not solved is how much of *understanding* it still depends on people: when a metric moves, someone works out what it means; when something degrades, a human reads dashboards and makes the call; when a model changes, we find out more slowly than we should. None of that scales with the speed we're now shipping at, and none of it needs to stay manual. If you like problems where the answer isn't in a runbook yet, several of these are genuinely open. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * **Raise the ceiling on AI\-native development.** We use AI across our workflow today, and we're not satisfied with how far it goes. You'll push it considerably further — agentic code review and repair, generated tests that stay honest as requirements change, and tooling the team adopts because it makes the work faster. We want someone who will change how this team builds software, not someone who will use the tools we already have. * **Rebuild observability so it explains itself.** Our telemetry has gaps, and much of what we collect is ambiguous, unlabelled, or only meaningful to whoever built it. You'll define what we measure across system health and business outcomes, make each metric self\-explanatory, and replace manual review and manual reaction with automated interpretation. * **Make diagnosis agentic.** Build the troubleshooting layer that correlates signals, proposes root causes, and takes safe automated action — so that understanding a production issue doesn't start with a person reading graphs. * **Mature our evaluation infrastructure with our Quality Engineering Lead.** Our products generate code, find and fix bugs, and produce art and design — output with no single correct answer. We have the beginnings of an evaluation system, and it isn't mature yet. You'd own the infrastructure side — making evaluation fast, repeatable and cheap enough to run continuously — partnering closely with the Quality Engineering Lead who owns the methodology. * **Explore what AI can do for gaming LiveOps.** Live games are managed continuously after launch: events and content, player behaviour and retention analysis, monetization, live health. We think Unity's data puts us in an unusual position to make that faster, smarter and far less manual. **We are early here and genuinely do not know yet what it becomes** — this is a problem to shape, not a roadmap to execute. * **Make agentic systems affordable.** As more of our product and our own workflow runs on inference, the economics become an engineering problem — token efficiency, routing work to the cheapest model that can do it, managing what an agent has to keep in context, and recovering agent state so a failed run resumes instead of starting over. You'll drive how we measure and optimize all of it. * **Contribute to technical strategy and architecture** for Unity AI and our backend platforms, run technical spikes with developers on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, and partner with product, design and other engineering teams to influence the roadmap. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **Hands\-on, current use of AI and agent tooling in your own engineering work.** Genuine daily practice, not familiarity with the concepts — and ideally experience pointing agents at problems beyond code generation. Expect to talk about what you have actually built * **A track record of working independently on problems that weren't fully defined** — choosing the direction, moving quickly to something real, and knowing when to change course * Experience building and shipping complex, user\-facing software products at scale * **Depth in observability** — monitoring, logging, alerting and debugging with tools such as Grafana — and a point of view on making telemetry interpretable rather than merely present * **An automation instinct in operational work** — you have replaced a manual judgment step in put quality at scale * Experience with the economics of agentic systems — inference and token cost, model routing, context and memory management, or checkpointing and state recovery for long\-running agent work * Background in games, live\-service operations, or player analytics **Additional information** Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Zone A: $210,300 \- $273,400 Zone B: $187,200 \- $243,300 Zone C: $165,600 \- $215,200 *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status. While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program **Life at Unity** Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com. *Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. Our differences are strengths that enable us to support the growing and evolving needs of our customers, partners, and collaborators. If you have a disability that means there are preparations or accommodations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please fill out* *this form* *to let us know.* *This position requires the incumbent to have a sufficient knowledge of English to have professional verbal and written exchanges in this language since the performance of the duties related to this position requires frequent and regular communication with colleagues and partners located worldwide and whose common language is English.* *This posting is intended to fill an existing vacancy, and we are committed to providing applicants with updates throughout the hiring process in accordance with applicable law.* *Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Unity does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. jobs.title: Post-doctoral Research Associate: College of Nursing - UTK
jobs.description: The **College of Nursing (CON)** at the University of Tennessee Knoxville, the state’s flagship research institution, seeks a **Post\-Doctoral Researcher** to provide advanced research training with Vinciya Pandian, PhD, MBA, MSN, ACNP\-BC, and support two complementary programs of research at the intersection of critical care, patient safety, immersive learning, and digital innovation. The fellow will receive mentored training while contributing to execution of the Center for Immersive Learning and Digital Innovation research focused on prevention of central line\-associated bloodstream infection (CLABSI) and to development of a competitive grant application focused on safe care for individuals with a tracheostomy. This is a grant\-funded position and is contingent upon the continued funding of the grant. Post\-Doctoral Research Training and Scholarship * Develop an independent program of research aligned with critical care, patient safety, immersive learning, digital health, and/or implementation science. * Receive mentored training in the design, execution, and evaluation of complex clinical and translational research, including systems engineering, human factors, implementation, quantitative and qualitative methods, and technology\-enabled interventions. * Contribute to development of grant application, including literature synthesis, refinement of aims and hypotheses, research strategy development, preliminary\-data integration, methods, milestones, implementation and evaluation plans, and coordination of contributions from interprofessional collaborators. * Develop grant\-writing skills through preparation of extramural proposals and career\-development applications appropriate to the fellow's trajectory. * Analyze and interpret research data and lead or co\-author data\-based manuscripts for peer\-reviewed journals. Prepare abstracts and presentations for scientific and professional conferences and communicate findings to clinical, scientific, and community audiences. * Gain experience with immersive and digital research platforms, including virtual reality, augmented/mixed reality, simulation, robotics, prototyping, artificial intelligence, and associated usability, acceptability, fidelity, and performance measures. * Develop mentoring and team\-science skills by working with students, research assistants, clinicians, engineers, and other collaborators. * Complete and maintain required human\-subjects protection, CITI, IRB, research\-integrity, privacy, and institutional training and compliance. Assistance with Project Direction (under the direction of the senior researcher) * Support day\-to\-day execution and transition/implementation of the Center for Immersive Learning and Digital Innovation research, maintaining protocol fidelity, study timelines, documentation, and quality\-control procedures. * Coordinate protocol set\-up and amendments; prepare and maintain IRB and regulatory materials; and assist with standard operating procedures, research manuals, study tracking, and reports. * Support participant screening, recruitment, consent/enrollment processes as permitted by protocol, scheduling, study visits, follow\-up, and communication with clinical and research partners. * Set up and maintain REDCap data\-collection instruments; monitor completeness and accuracy; perform data cleaning, coding, documentation, and preparation of analysis\-ready datasets. * Support retrospective chart review, surveys, focus groups/interviews, workflow observation/process mapping, and evaluation of interprofessional, provider, process, and patient outcomes as specified by study protocols. * Assist with implementation and evaluation of immersive and digital interventions, including training activities, usability and acceptability assessment, implementation fidelity, and documentation of barriers and facilitators. * Conduct or support quantitative and qualitative analyses and prepare summaries, tables, figures, presentations, manuscripts, progress reports, and other study products. * Coordinate with clinical, engineering, technology, simulation, infection\-prevention, statistical, and other collaborators; provide work direction to students or research assistants when assigned. * Support research laboratory set\-up and maintenance, including equipment, study materials, survey instruments, inventory, data\-security procedures, and quality control. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Earned PhD or equivalent research doctorate in Nursing, Health Science, Public Health, Biomedical or Health Informatics, Human Factors, Implementation Science, Psychology, Engineering, or a closely related field * Experience conducting or assisting with human\-subjects, clinical, simulation, implementation, or health\-services research * Demonstrated interest in critical care, acute care, patient safety, infection prevention, or technology\-enabled healthcare research * Evidence of scholarly productivity through peer\-reviewed publications, abs sional and interdisciplinary research teams * Data management and analytical skills using research software, with the ability to learn REDCap and other research tools Ability to follow research protocols, maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and resolve research related problems * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Clinical or research experience in intensive care, acute care, or other high\-acuity setting * Nursing or other health\-professional background * Experience with CLABSI prevention, central\-line care, infection prevention, airway/tracheostomy care, mechanical ventilation, or related critical\-care patient\-safety topics. * Experience with NIH, AHRQ, or other extramural grant development or project management. * Experience with REDCap, quantitative/qualitative data analysis, chart\-review data, or mixed\-methods research * Experience with simulation, virtual/augmented reality, digital health, robotics, or other emerging healthcare technologies * Experience coordinating multi\-site or interdisciplinary research and/or mentoring students or research assistants. **Work Location:** 1200 Volunteer Blvd Knoxville, TN 37996 **Duration:** 2 years **Compensation:*** Anticipated hiring range: $65,000 – $70,000 * **Application Instructions** For best consideration, applicants should submit a cover letter and resume before October 12 th , 2026\. Specific questions about the position may be sent to College of Nursing Human Resources, conhr@utk.edu **About the College of Nursing** With a longstanding tradition of excellence in nursing education, research, and clinical practice, we are proud to be a guiding force in healthcare education. We embrace innovation while honoring the values that have shaped our success. By offering cutting\-edge academic programs, supporting impactful research, and forging strong community partnerships, we prepare healthcare professionals who deliver high\-quality, culturally responsive care in a diverse and ever\-changing world. Join the Vol Nurse Family! **Get to know CON** The University of Tennessee, Knoxville, has shaped leaders, changemakers, and innovative thinkers since its founding in 1794\. The university is home to more than 38,000 students and 10,000 statewide employees—the Volunteers—who uphold the university’s tradition of lighting the way for others through leadership and service. UT Knoxville offers over 900 programs of study across 14 degree\-granting colleges and schools. As Tennessee’s flagship land\-grant university, its footprint spans the entire state. The university holds the highest Carnegie classification for research activity and has deep partnerships with industry leaders and the US Department of Energy’s largest multidisciplinary laboratory, Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The Knoxville campus serves and recruits for UT Knoxville, including the Institute of Agriculture and the Space Institute, as well as the UT Institute of Public Service. UT Knoxville considers its employees its number one asset. With values that focus on work\-life balance, compensation, and innovation leadership, all Vols are supported to advance professionally. Employees have access to career development and coaching, continued education, and an extensive list of development and training possibilities. The Volunteer employee experience implements structures and practices to attract and retain top\-tier talent, fostering a strong staff community and supporting a culture of involvement and engagement for everyone. The university holds a strong commitment to its land\-grant mission of learning and engagement, with a tradition of service and leadership that carries that Volunteer spirit throughout the state and around the world. It has been ranked nationally as “Best Employer for New Graduates,” “One of America’s Best Large Employers,” and “Best Workplace for Women,” and has been designated as “Best Place for Working Parents” by Forbes Magazine. Apply today and join the Tennessee Volunteer community!
