Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper\-targeted segmentation, AI\-powered recommendations, real\-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million\+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first\-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real\-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. **This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance\-driven future for the channel. **About the Role** ------------------ Data isn't a support function at Vibe, it's the fuel behind every decision the platform makes, from which ad to show to how we measure its impact. You'll join the Data Platform team and lead the Identity squad, the group responsible for attaching every event Vibe observes to a real identity: the foundation for targeting, measurement, and the training data our models learn from. This is a player\-coach role on a small, high\-leverage team, you, a staff software engineer, and an ML engineer, and it exists because identity resolution at Vibe's scale has outgrown ad hoc ownership and needs someone who can both push the algorithms forward and set the technical direction. You'd want this job because you'll own one of the hardest, most consequential problems in the stack end to end; because you'll stay hands\-on with clustering and entity resolution at real US scale rather than managing from a distance; and because you'll shape how identity evolves as the industry moves toward a privacy\-first world. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Technical Leadership** * Set the technical direction and roadmap for Vibe's identity stack end to end * Design and build clustering algorithms and pipelines that resolve identity at US scale * Make architecture decisions that scale economically and quantify their impact * Anticipate scaling pain before it turns into an incident * Drive systematic improvements to identity resolution accuracy **Reliability, Scale \& Cost** * Build observability into identity pipelines with meaningful alerts and healthy SLOs * Profile and optimize compute and storage across Dagster, Spark, and Iceberg * Treat infrastructure spend as a first\-class engineering concern **Expanding the Stack** * Extend identity capabilities into richer audience construction and attribution * Build platform\-level tooling so every team can resolve identity behind their events * Design identity approaches built for a privacy\-first future **People \& Partnership** * Lead the squad's senior engineer through 1:1s, feedback, and career development * Represent identity in cross\-team Data Platform roadmap decisions * Translate ambiguous stakeholder requests into concrete technical deliverables * Push back on requests where the right call is "not yet" or "not this way" **What You Need** ----------------- * 8\+ years building and operating production ML or data systems, including leading technical work as a tech lead, staff engineer, or team lead * Hands\-on experience with large\-scale entity resolution, clustering, or graph problems, with the ability to own and challenge the algorithms themselves * Strong distributed\-systems foundations across a modern orchestrator (e.g. Dagster), distributed compute (e.g. Spark), and large\-scale storage (e.g. Iceberg) * A track record of building evaluation frameworks and using them to drive measurable algorithmic improvements * Experience managing performance and cost at genuinely large data scale * Strong cross\-functional communication, with the ability to adjust detail level by audience and align stakeholders with conflicting priorities **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience in streaming TV advertising or programmatic advertising **Our Values** -------------- At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high\-performance environment with high\-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. **What We Offer** ----------------- *For candidates based in France, the pay range for this role is €127,000\-€171,000\. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.* *For candidates based in the USA, the pay range for this role is $132,000\-$264,000\. We will support relocation to New York City for great candidates.* At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we prove it : * Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. * Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! * Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. * Meal vouchers — Via Swile. * Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. * Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. **Our Interview Process** ------------------------- * We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting. * Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours. * Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly. * Technical interview — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together. * Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar. * Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit. * Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. Referral Instructions Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.title: Sr. Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Valspec—a global provider of system validation and lifecycle services—provides commissioning and qualification of computerized systems for clients in the Life Sciences industry. Established in 1999, Valspec's mission is to provide a wide spectrum of services that help its clients meet their capital project and lifecycle maintenance goals. Valspec's projects are critical to the industry, and to the people who rely on its products. Many projects ensure that life\-changing drugs are available to those who need them; others streamline production to meet demand at a lower cost, allowing for the discovery of new and innovative therapies. **Senior Validation Consultant (CSV)** -------------------------------------- **Location:** Northern California (Onsite/Hybrid Based on Project Requirements) ### **About Valspec** Valspec is a leading provider of engineering, validation, and lifecycle services to the life sciences industry. We partner with some of the world's most innovative pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to deliver projects that improve manufacturing performance, product quality, and patient outcomes. Our consultants work at the forefront of digital manufacturing, automation, validation, and regulatory compliance. ### **Position Summary** Valspec is seeking an experienced **Lead Validation Consultant** to support a major biopharmaceutical client in Northern California. This role will lead Computer System Validation (CSV) activities for Emerson DeltaV Distributed Control System (DCS) and associated GMP manufacturing and automation platforms. The successful candidate will serve as the technical lead for validation strategy, documentation, execution, and compliance activities while working closely with automation, quality, engineering, and manufacturing teams. This individual will play a key role in ensuring validated systems meet regulatory expectations and support reliable GMP operations. ### **Responsibilities** * Lead Computer System Validation (CSV) activities for Emerson DeltaV DCS and supporting GMP systems. * Develop and execute validation strategies in accordance with FDA, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and company quality requirements. * Author, review, and approve validation lifecycle documentation, including: + Validation Plans + Validation Master Plans (VMPs) + Risk Assessments + User Requirements Specifications (URS) + Functional Specifications + Traceability Matrices + IQ/OQ Protocols + Validation Summary Reports * Partner with automation and engineering teams to evaluate system designs and ensure compliance throughout the system lifecycle. * Review vendor documentation, FAT/SAT documentation, testing records, and design deliverables. * Lead validation execution activities and coordinate testing efforts across multiple stakeholders. * Assess system changes and support change control activities for validated systems. * Support data integrity assessments and validation activities associated with electronic records and electronic signatures. * Facilitate deviation investigations, impact assessments, and remediation activities related to validation deliverables. * Collaborate with Commissioning \& Qualification (C\&Q), Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and Automation teams to ensure integrated project execution. * Track validation deliverables, schedules, and project milestones while providing status updates to project leadership. * Mentor junior validation engineers and provide technical leadership during project execution. * Contribute to project planning, resource forecasting, and client\-facing discussions regarding validation scope and strategy. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or related technical discipline. * 10\+ years of Computer System Validation experience within FDA\-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences environments. * Demonstrated experience leading validation programs for Emerson DeltaV DCS platforms. * Strong knowledge of the CSV lifecycle and risk\-based validation methodologies. * Experience supporting GMP manufacturing systems and automation platforms. * Direct experience authoring and executing validation protocols and test documentation. * Strong understanding of: + GAMP 5 + 21 CFR Part 11 + Data Integrity principles + FDA and global regulatory requirements * Experience with deviation management, CAPA, and change control processes. * Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence project stakeholders. * Excellent written, verbal, and client\-facing communication skills. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous consulting experience supporting large pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients. * Experience validating manufacturing automation systems, SCADA platforms, MES systems, historians, and integrated process controls. * Familiarity with OSI PI, Syncade, Rockwell, Siemens, Honeywell, or related manufacturing systems. * Experience supporting large capital projects, facility expansions, or new manufacturing sites. * Proven ability to lead multiple validation workstreams simultaneously. ### **Key Competencies** * Technical Leadership * Computer System Validation (CSV) * Emerson DeltaV Expertise * Risk\-Based Validation * Regulatory Compliance * Client Relationship Management * Strategic Problem Solving * Cross\-Functional Collaboration ### **Why Join Valspec?** At Valspec, you'll work alongside industry experts delivering high\-impact projects for leading life sciences organizations. We offer challenging technical work, a collaborative culture, and opportunities to influence critical manufacturing and quality initiatives that help bring life\-changing therapies to patients. **Join a great team supporting world\-class life sciences clients throughout Northern California. Apply today!** **Why Join Valspec?** At Valspec, we offer more than just a job — we provide a career experience rooted in a standout culture, collaborative environment, and a strong sense of ownership. As an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) company, every team member has a stake in our success, fostering a shared commitment to excellence and innovation. We also offer a highly competitive benefits package, including: * Premium medical coverage * 401(k) with company match * Tuition reimbursement * Unique performance incentives * And more — all designed to support your growth, well\-being, and future. Join a team where your contributions matter, your development is prioritized, and your success is shared. When receiving e\-mails from a Proconex or Valspec recruiter, you will only receive e\-mails from addresses ending in @proconexdirect.com, @proconex.net or @valspec.net. Any other domains are impersonations and should be ignored. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the United States without company sponsorship. Also, we are not interested in working on a corp\-to\-corp basis with other companies at this time. Any third\-party unsolicited resume submission(s) will immediately become the property of Valspec. Valspec will not pay any fee to a submitting employment agency, person, or entity unless a signed agreement is established. Valspec is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other protected class. We are committed to providing a professional environment free of any discrimination or harassment, and we are proud to be a Drug\-Free Workplace.

jobs.title: Manager, IT Service Desk
jobs.description: Van Andel Institute (VAI), a world\-class biomedical research institute, located in Grand Rapids, Michigan, is dedicated to improving human health. We are pioneers in the fight against cancer, Parkinson's, and other diseases. We are committed to inspiring the next generation of scientists and educators. Van Andel Institute (VAI), a world\-class biomedical research institute, located in Grand Rapids, Michigan, is dedicated to improving human health. We are pioneers in the fight against cancer, Parkinson's, and other diseases. We are committed to inspiring the next generation of scientists and educators. **Lead the team that keeps discovery running.** Every experiment at VAI depends on technology that works \- from the laptop at a scientist's bench to the workstation that runs a core facility instrument. Our IT Service Desk and Workstation Engineering teams deliver that foundation, providing first and second level support and end\-user and laboratory computing services across the Institute. We are seeking a Manager, IT Service Desk to provide functional leadership for both teams. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, you will own the service strategy, the support model, the budget, and the people, and you will represent end\-user and laboratory computing to IT leadership, research leadership, and stakeholders across the Institute. This role is central to VAI's IT transformation, as we move from reactive support to proactive enablement and measure our success by the outcomes we deliver for science and education. This is a leadership role for someone who has run technical support in a research, clinical, or academic environment, understands that "the computer is down" can mean an experiment is at risk, and wants to shape how a growing institute supports its science. What You'll Do * Set the direction. Define the service strategy, service delivery model, and support tier structure for the IT Service Desk and Workstation Engineering, aligned with institutional and research priorities and the IT strategic roadmap. * Lead and grow the team. Lead, develop, and manage IT Support Analysts at all levels and the Workstation Engineer, including hiring, performance management, compensation recommendations, and career development. Design staffing models, organizational structure, and career pathways within the IT job architecture, and plan succession for critical technical roles. * Run the operating model. Own the operating model for an hourly (non\-exempt) workforce, including coverage design, after\-hours and on\-call policy application, timekeeping and overtime governance, and compliance with wage and hour requirements. * Own daily service delivery. Hold accountability for service desk operations and service level attainment, ensuring incidents affecting active experiments, instrument availability, and core facility operations are prioritized appropriately. Serve as management escalation for the function. * Measure and report. Define service level agreements, key performance indicators, and experience metrics, and report service performance and trends to IT leadership and governance forums. * Govern the standards. Set standards for end\-user and laboratory computing, including endpoint configuration, lifecycle strategy, and the standard hardware and software catalog, in partnership with Cybersecurity and the Institute's strategic hardware partner. * Support the science safely. Own the policy and governance framework for scientific instrument computing, including the risk\-based exception model developed with Cybersecurity for vendor\-controlled and legacy systems. * Connect the tiers. Establish and govern the escalation and handoff model between the service desk and third\-level support groups: High Performance Computing, Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, and Cybersecurity. * Mature the practice. Drive IT service management maturity, including ITIL practice adoption, process design, automation, self\-service, knowledge management, and problem management across incidents and endpoint performance. * Protect the data. Ensure service desk and endpoint practices comply with data handling requirements for regulated research and institutional data, including protected health information, controlled\-access research data, and sponsor data management obligations. * Manage the business of the function. Own budget, forecasting, and cost optimization, including procurement strategy for end\-user and laboratory computing, and manage vendor and partner relationships, including the Institute's strategic hardware partner and support and maintenance contracts. * Build capability and resilience. Sponsor end\-user training and technology adoption programs, ensure ongoing staff development on tools, platforms, and practices, and own business continuity and endpoint recovery planning for the function. What We're Looking For You are an experienced technical support leader with the operational discipline to run a service desk wel lp shape an IT organization in the middle of a multi\-year transformation. * Interesting problems. Laboratory and instrument computing, regulated research data, and a growing research campus mean the work is never routine. * A culture of growth. We invest in career development, encourage collaboration across disciplines, and treat change as an opportunity. Compensation and Benefits All full\-time employees of Van Andel Institute are eligible for benefits, effective Day One! This is a salaried, exempt position; compensation will be based on your experience and skills. Learn more about our offerings here: VAI Careers. How to Apply If you possess these attributes and enjoy working with motivated and driven people, we welcome speaking with you and encourage you to apply today! Complete the online application, submitting a single combined PDF document with the following: * Cover letter outlining your experience, career goals, and why you are interested in this position and Van Andel Institute * Current resume * Names and contact information of three professional references If you have questions about the application process or working at VAI, you are welcome to email Natalie Hartford, Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, at natalie.hartford@vai.org. *Note: To ensure your application is official and eligible for review, please submit it through our online system. Emailed applications are not considered official.* **ABOUT VAN ANDEL INSTITUTE** Van Andel Institute (VAI) is committed to improving the health and enhancing the lives of current and future generations through cutting\-edge biomedical research and innovative educational offerings. Established in Grand Rapids, Michigan, in 1996 by the Van Andel family, VAI is now home to more than 650 scientists, educators and support staff, who work with a growing number of national and international collaborators to foster discovery. The Institute’s scientists study the origins of cancer, Parkinson’s and other diseases and translate their findings into breakthrough prevention and treatment strategies. Our educators develop inquiry\-based approaches for K–12 education to help students and teachers prepare the next generation of problem\-solvers, while our Graduate School offers a rigorous, research\-intensive Ph.D. program in molecular and cellular biology. Learn more at vai.org. *Van Andel Institute is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) Employer. We are committed to cultivating a workplace in which different perspectives and experiences are welcomed and respected. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability (physical or mental), marital or veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, political ideology, or membership in any other legally protected class. We are an Equal Opportunity employer.* *As Van Andel Institute is a drug free employer, all prospective new employees undergo a urinalysis/drug test as part of our pre\-employment process. This is a 7\-panel drug screen and it includes testing for Marijuana, Cocaine, Amphetamines, Opiates, PCP, Barbiturates, and Benzodiazepines.* **About Grand Rapids, MI** Van Andel Institute is in downtown Grand Rapids, Michigan in the center of the Medical Mile. A remarkable combination of a cosmopolitan atmosphere and small\-town warmth, Grand Rapids is known for its philanthropic and sustainability\-driven community. It’s fun affordable and family\-friendly. Located on the banks of the Grand River, Grand Rapids offers all the big\-city excitement you'd expect from a million\-resident metropolis, featuring hundreds of restaurants and nightspots, theaters, museums, sports and concerts. The safe and clean downtown is surrounded by an eclectic mix of walkable neighborhoods and natural areas. The downtown area is safe and clean with an eclectic mix of walkable neighborhoods and natural areas.

jobs.title: Data Center Solutions Architect - Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **Solutions Engineering Department** The Solutions Engineering Department serves as the technical backbone of the sales organization, bridging customer business needs with the company’s technical capabilities and solutions. The team partners closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to design, validate, and present technically sound solutions that support revenue growth and long\-term customer success. Sales Engineers act as trusted technical advisors throughout the entire sales cycle—from early discovery and solution design to proposal development, RFP/RFI responses, and contract support. By translating complex technical requirements into clear, customer\-focused solutions, the department ensures alignment between customer expectations, technical feasibility, and operational delivery. **Position Overview** **This position can be based in a hybrid capacity at any of Vantage’s U.S. locations (3 days in the office, 2 days remote).** Vantage is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Solutions Architect to join our team in the data center industry. The Solutions Architect will be responsible for designing and implementing technical solutions that meet the complex needs of our clients. This role requires a deep understanding of data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including power distribution, critical backup systems, cooling architectures, life‑safety systems, and overall facility design. Familiarity with Telecom, and networking platforms is beneficial. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work closely with clients and internal teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high\-performance solutions. **Essential Job Functions** **Solution Design and Architecture:** * Contribute to customized data center solutions focused on electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including power, cooling, redundancy, and facility systems. * Serve as a subject matter expert on data center infrastructure, building systems, and white\-space fit\-outs * Support the development of high‑level solution concepts, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational alignment. **Client Engagement and Requirements Gathering:** * Engage with clients to understand their business needs, technical requirements, and challenges. * Conduct detailed requirements analysis and translate business needs into technical specifications. **Technical Leadership:** * Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, from initial concept and design to implementation and post\-deployment support. * Partner with Design Engineering, Construction, Operations, Commercial, Legal, and other departments to ensure successful delivery of solutions. **Technology Evaluation and Selection:** * Evaluate and recommend technologies, products, and services that align with client needs and industry standard methodologies. * Stay up\-to\-date with emerging technologies and trends in the data center industry to inform solution design. **Proof of Concept and Testing:** * Develop and lead proof\-of\-concept (POC) initiatives to validate proposed solutions. * Oversee testing and validation of solutions to ensure they meet performance, security, and reliability standards. **Documentation and Knowledge Transfer:** * Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of solution designs, configurations, and deployment procedures. * Provide knowledge transfer and training to clients and internal teams on the implemented solutions. **Pre\-Sales Support:** * Collaborate with sales teams to provide technical expertise during the pre\-sales process, including client presentations, proposal development, and RFP responses. * Assist in creating solution blueprints, cost estimates, and technical proposals. **Continuous Improvement:** * Identify opportunities for improving solution design processes, tools, and methodologies. * Contribute to the development of best practices and standards for solution architecture within the organization. **Additional Duties:** * Handle additional duties as assigned by Management. **Job Requirements** **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree is preferred. **Experience:** * Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in a customer‑facing technical or sales engineering role, supporting electrical and mechanical data center solutions during pre‑sales and early project phases. * Experience with Telecom and networking. * Proven experience in designing and implementing complex technical solutions in the data center or technology industry. **Skills:** * Strong organizational and project management skills. * Strong understanding of data center infrastructure * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to design scalable and reliable solutions. * Strong communication and social skills, with the ability to engage with clients and internal teams effectively. * Strategic problem solver with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. * Thorough with strong organizational skills. * Ability to manage numerous projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. * High level of integrity, professionalism, and ethical judgment. * Travel required is expected to be up to 5% but may increase over time as the business evolves. **Additional Details** * Salary Range: $135,000 \- $160,000 *(this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)* * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-AO2 We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage. We’ll be accepting applications for at least one week from the date this role is posted. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. **About the Role** As a Technical Lead Manager, you will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex customer deployments to the Securiti AI platform within Veeam. You will own three key areas: your team’s growth and performance, delivery across a portfolio of enterprise accounts, and the customer experience from first deployment through scaled use. You will help your team turn complex data, security, privacy, and AI needs into clear technical outcomes. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will stay close to the work by reviewing architecture, guiding technical decisions, supporting escalations, and improving the patterns and tools your team uses to deliver. Your impact will come through strong people leadership, clear communication, and predictable execution across multiple accounts. **What You’ll Do** * Manage and grow a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance, and career development * Own delivery across a portfolio of enterprise accounts, including planning, milestones, risks, timelines, and customer outcomes * Balance team workload and account assignments based on skills, capacity, customer needs, and growth opportunities * Set a clear operating rhythm for status updates, delivery cloud infrastructure * Set technical standards, reusable patterns, and playbooks that help the team deliver with quality and consistency * Champion AI\-forward ways of working, including reusable tools and automation that improve team speed and quality * Partner with Sales Engineering, Account Executives, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services on pursuits, escalations, roadmap feedback, and customer delivery * Share field learnings with Product and Engineering to improve the platform and strengthen how the FDE organization operates **What You’ll Bring** * 8–12\+ years of experience in technical, customer\-facing delivery roles, such as forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, platform engineering, or technical consulting * Experience managing engineers or technical delivery teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development * Strong program and delivery management skills, with experience managing multiple customer accounts, timelines, risks, and priorities at once * Strong communication skills, with the ability to set expectations and build trust with executives, business leaders, engineers, jobs.title: Senior Test Systems Engineer – LabVIEW / HMI / Data Acquisition
jobs.description: **About Vidac Solutions** **Vidac Solutions** is a growing engineering and systems integration company based in Fenton, Missouri. We design and build custom industrial test systems, data acquisition systems, environmental test equipment, and automated solutions for manufacturing customers. Our projects combine mechanical, electrical, controls, instrumentation, and software engineering to solve unique customer problems. As a smaller engineering company, our team members have significant ownership of their work and the opportunity to influence how we design and deliver systems. **About the Role** We are seeking an experienced **Test Systems Engineer** to take technical ownership of the software, HMI, and data acquisition side of our custom test systems. A key initial responsibility will be supporting and developing our existing NI LabVIEW\-based applications, including applications used for HMI, data acquisition, test monitoring, control, and reporting. The successful candidate must be comfortable inheriting existing LabVIEW applications, understanding code developed by others, troubleshooting problems, and independently supporting deployed systems. Our current systems commonly incorporate Yokogawa GM10 data acquisition hardware, instrumentation, sensors, PLCs, and industrial communications. While LabVIEW experience is important for supporting our existing systems, we are not looking solely for a LabVIEW programmer. We want an engineer who understands industrial test systems and data acquisition architecture and can help determine the best software and technology platforms for future Vidac systems. **What You'll Do** * Take ownership of existing NI LabVIEW applications used in Vidac test systems. * Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and maintain LabVIEW applications for HMI, data acquisition, monitoring, control, and reporting. * Configure and integrate Yokogawa GM10 and similar industrial data acquisition systems. * Develop operator interfaces for displaying measurements, trends, alarms, test status, and system controls. * Acquire, process, store, display, and export test data from instrumentation and industrial equipment. * Interface software with sensors, instrumentation, PLCs, controllers, and other equipment using industrial communication protocols. * Participate in the full project lifecycle from customer requirements and system architecture through programming, FAT, commissioning, and customer support. * Troubleshoot problems across software, communications, instrumentation, networking, and hardware. * Work directly with customers and Vidac engineers to define system requirements and translate them into reliable test\-system solutions. * Document software architecture, communications, configuration, and deployment procedures so systems can be effectively supported throughout their lifecycle. * Implement and maintain appropriate source\-control and software revision practices. * Support existing customer systems and diagnose issues with previously deployed equipment. * Evaluate LabVIEW and alternative HMI, SCADA, programming, and data acquisition platforms for future applications. * Help establish scalable software and data acquisition standards for future Vidac systems. **What We're Looking For** * Demonstrated experience developing industrial test, measurement, automation, HMI, or data acquisition systems. * Strong working knowledge of NI LabVIEW, including the ability to understand, troubleshoot, and modify applications originally developed by another programmer. * Experience integrating software with instrumentation and physical hardware. * Strong understanding of data acquisition, sensors, analog and digital signals, communications, and industrial networking. * Ability to troubleshoot problems that cross software and hardware boundaries. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently and take technical ownership of existing systems. * Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with customers and other engineering disciplines. A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred. Equivalent hands\-on experience will also be considered. **Experience That Would Be Especially Valuable** Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required: * Yokogawa GM10 / SMARTDAC\+ systems * Modbus TCP/IP or Modbus RTU * OPC\-UA * EtherNet/IP * NI DAQ hardware * PLC integration * Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell automation * SQL or other databases * NI TestStand * C\#, C\+\+, Python, or similar programming languages * Industrial HMI or SCADA platforms * Automated test equipment * Environmental or performance test systems * Git or other source\-control systems NI Certified LabVIEW Developer (CLD), Certified LabVIEW Architect (CLA), or equivalent demonstrated LabVIEW experience is preferred but not required. **What Success Looks Like** Initially, success means quickly becoming capable of supporting Vidac's existing LabVIEW\-based systems and providing continuity for active customer projects. Over time, this position will become a technical owner of Vidac's test\-system software and data acquisition architecture, helping establish standards that make our systems easier to develop, document, support, and scale. We are interested in engineers who can support what we have today while helping us build a stronger technology platform for tomorrow. **Why Join Vidac Solutions** * Meaningful ownership \- you won't be one programmer among hundreds. Your decisions will directly influence the systems we build. * Interesting engineering \- our projects combine software, instrumentation, controls, electrical, and mechanical engineering rather than repetitive application development. * Variety \- every customer and test application presents a different engineering challenge. * Customer exposure \- you'll see your systems move from concept through fabrication, testing, installation, and operation. * Technology influence \- you'll have an opportunity to help determine the software and data acquisition platforms we use going forward. * Growth opportunity \- as Vidac expands, this role has the potential to grow into broader technical leadership responsibility. * Competitive compensation and benefits. *Vidac Solutions is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer committed to a diverse workforce. Minority/Female/Disability/Vet/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity.*

jobs.title: Software Tester
jobs.description: Vision Point Systems, Inc. (VPS) is seeking Software Tester who verifies application quality and makes sure data arrives intact when systems move. You'll split your time between functional and regression testing on client applications and validating data migrations from legacy systems into new platforms, specifically Appian. You'll work alongside developers, business analysts, and performance and automation engineers on client delivery teams. The role suits a detail\-minded tester who is comfortable writing SQL and enjoys tracing a single wrong value back to its source. **Key responsibilities** **Software Testing** * Review requirements and user stories, then write clear test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria. * Run functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing across web and low\-code applications. * Log defects with clear reproduction steps, track them to closure, and retest fixes. * Contribute to automated regression suites and keep test data and environments ready for each cycle. * Report test progress, coverage, and risk to project leads in sprint ceremonies. **Data Migration Support** * Help define the migration test strategy, including source\-to\-target mapping review and validation rules. * Profile source data to find duplicates, nulls, bad formats, and orphaned records before migration. * Write SQL queries to reconcile record counts, totals, and field\-level values between source and target. * Validate transformation logic, data types, and referential integrity after each load. * Test migration scripts and ETL jobs in trial runs, including rollback and re\-run scenarios. * Confirm migrated data behaves correctly in the target application's screens, rules, and reports. * Document reconciliation results and sign\-off evidence for cutover decisions. **Requirements*** 2\+ years of software testing or quality assurance experience. * Working SQL skills: joins, aggregates, and comparison queries across tables. * Accessibility testing experience against WCAG 2\.1 AA or Section 508, using screen readers and tools such as axe or WAVE. * Experience writing test cases and logging defects in a tool such as Jira. * Understanding of relational data concepts: keys, constraints, and data types. * Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to finding root causes. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and business stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred qualifications** * Hands\-on testing experience with Appian or another low\-code platform. * Prior work on at least one data migration, conversion, or system consolidation project. * Familiarity with ETL tools or scripting (Python, PowerShell) for data comparison. * Experience with test automation frameworks or testing tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, or similar. * Exposure to Agile delivery and working on client\-facing consulting teams. * ISTQB or Appian certification. **Benefits** Full\-time employees with Vision Point Systems qualify for a generous benefits package including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Life Insurance (1× annual salary) * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability * 401(k) with company matching * Paid Training and Professional Development * Flexible work hours (when project schedules permit) * Opportunities for travel on engineering projects *Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

jobs.title: Quality Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description** ***Summary:*** The **Quality Engineering Manager** is responsible for leading the Quality Engineering function and developing a high\-performing team that supports customers, manufacturing operations, suppliers, and new product development activities. This role ensures the effective deployment of quality engineering principles, structured problem solving, risk reduction, and quality planning throughout the product lifecycle. The position serves as a key partner to Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to improve product quality, customer satisfaction, and business performance. Success in this role requires strong leadership, technical credibility, and the ability to influence and drive results across a cross\-functional organization. **Who will you be working with?** Our Quality Team partners closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Customers and Suppliers to ensure our products meet the highest standards of reliability and performance **How will you make a difference?** * Lead and develop a team of Quality Engineers, providing technical guidance, coaching, and performance management. * Lead quality initiatives supporting customer programs, manufacturing operations, suppliers, and new product development activities. * Provide technical leadership for customer quality issues, ensuring timely containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and communication. * Serve as the quality lead for high\-impact projects and critical business initiatives. * Drive the use of structured problem\-solving methodologies, including 8D, DMAIC, and root cause analysis, to resolve complex quality issues and prevent recurrence. * Lead APQP New Product Development (NPD) quality activities, including risk assessments, validation planning, and launch readiness reviews. * Apply and promote quality tools and methodologies including FMEA, PPAP, SPC, MSA, DOE, and Control Plans to improve product and process performance. * Partner with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to achieve quality objectives and improve customer satisfaction. * Lead customer\-facing quality activities including audits, issue resolution, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Analyze quality data and performance metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. * Support supplier quality improvement activities, including issue resolution, risk mitigation, and performance monitoring. * Develop and deliver quality\-related training and coaching to build organizational capability and strengthen quality awareness. * Ensure compliance with quality management system requirements, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. * Drive improvements in quality systems, tools, processes, and reporting methods to enhance product quality, operational performance, and customer satisfaction. **What do we want to know about you?** *Required* * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or related field preferred and 7\+ years of progressive experience in quality engineering, including 5 years in leadership roles. Equivalent combination of education and/or experience. * Proven success in implementing quality improvements in a manufacturing environment. * Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and similar standards. * Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, and project management skills. *Preferred skills* * ASQ Certification (CQE, CQA, CMQ/OE) or equivalent. * Lean Six Sigma Greenbelt or higher. * Experience in transportation, industrial, or safety\-critical product sectors. * Familiarity with digital quality tools, automation, and data visualization platforms. * Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and leveraging analytics tools such as Power BI or AI\-driven platforms to support data\-informed quality decisions. **What about the physical demands of the job?** This role may involve occasional movement through manufacturing or supplier environments, including standing, walking, and light lifting (up to 25 pounds). Use of hands for handling components and tools may be required. Reasonable accommodation will be provided as needed to support individuals with disabilities. **What else do I need to know?** Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable). **Additional Information** Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $91100\-129800 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible. **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?** At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. **Who are we?** Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike. Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com. **Culture powers us and the possibilities.** We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more. Need accommodation? Just let us know \- we’ve got you.

jobs.description: #### **Why Wendy's** When our square shaped burgers made their first sizzle on the scene more than 50 years ago, people knew our approach wasn’t like any other. This Lead Engineer – AgenticAI Systems establishes the enterprise strategy, hardware roadmap, and system architecture for AI compute platforms, edge device deployments, and high\-performance inference networks. This strategic role owns the reliability, cost optimization, security compliance, and long\-term technical direction for all AI infrastructure powering store operations, drive\-thru automation, and enterprise analytics. This role is to simplify and improve operations by leading the design of the infrastructure and platform that AI, machine learning, and agentic solutions run on. setting technical direction across multiple concurrent initiatives. **Responsibilities** * Define enterprise technical strategy, hardware roadmaps, and deployment architectures for distributed AI compute infrastructure, cloud platforms, and store\-level edge fleets * Establish enterprise system standards for reliability , disaster recovery, hardware security , and compute cost governance. * function teams, and Hardware Vendors to design network topologies, edge hardware specifications, and secure API gateways * Drive technical evaluations, vendor selection, and SLA negotiations for cloud infrastructure providers, GPU vendors, and edge hardware manufacturers * Provide overall technical oversight, architectural review, and engineering mentorship across infrastructure and AI teams. **Education:** Bachelor's Degree **Travel:** 10% **Pay Range:** $122,000\.00 \- $214,000\.00 Annually #### **What we expect from you** * BS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science with 5\+ years of systems engineering, cloud architecture, and infrastructure leadership. * Master’s degree in computer science or a related field is preferred. * Previous experience in the food service or related industry is preferred. * Demonstrated success architecting multi\-region cloud infrastructures, hybrid edge\-cloud networks, and large\-scale Kubernetes/GKE deployment fleets. * Exceptional track record of directing complex engineering initiatives, setting technical vision, and negotiating multi\-million\-dollar technology investments. * Mastery of heterogeneous compute topologies (GPU/NPU/TPU), low\-latency networking, distributed storage, and inference acceleration runtimes. * Proficient in the use of a variety of software applications including Python, Kubernetes/containerization tools, and cloud technologies (GCP, Azure, or AWS). **Expected Work Location (Remote)**: It is expected that you will primarily perform work remotely. You may be asked to travel, as needed, to the Wendy's Restaurant Support Center (RSC) (1 Dave Thomas Blvd, Dublin, OH 43017\), or to other location(s) as designated by the Company. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Wilson Language Training, we are committed to working together for our mission to achieve literacy for all. We believe literacy is a fundamental right and should be attainable for all people. We strive to reflect this belief in our work. The success of our team members is no less paramount. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every Wilson employee experiences truly satisfying professional development while feeling inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. Wilson Language Training is growing and is looking to hire a Site Reliability Engineer. The Site Reliability Engineer will work on one of our most critical, high\-traffic systems. You’ll be responsible for its reliability, security, and performance day\-to\-day, with a real voice in how its architecture evolves over time. Our cloud footprint spans both AWS and Azure, and you’ll work across both as our environments evolve. You’ll also be joining an experienced, collaborative team that values knowledge\-sharing and supports one another through incidents and day\-to\-day work alike. If you’re looking for meaningful, high\-impact work on a strong team, this is the role for you. **Essential Job Functions:** * Keep one of our most critical, high\-traffic systems reliable, secure, and performant, and help shape how its architecture evolves over time * Build and maintain the infrastructure\-as\-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation/CDK, or ARM/Bicep) that keeps our cloud environments reproducible and safe to change * Drive incident response and root\-cause analysis for your systems, and turn what you learn into fewer repeat incidents * Manage monitoring, alerting, and disaster recovery for your systems, including regular DR testing * Design for scale and cost: capacity planning, performance tuning, and high availability for high\-traffic workloads * Work across both AWS and Azure alongside our cloud engineering team, applying consistent reliability practices across our environments * Build security into everything you do, from CI/CD and code scanning to incident response * Mentor teammates, document what you build, and take part in on\-call rotation for your systems * Understand and display WLT's values * Other duties as assigned **Minimum Requirements** **Skills and Experience:** * 5\+ years in IT, including 2\-3\+ years focused on DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering, with hands\-on production experience on AWS and/or Azure * Strong, hands\-on experience architecting, deploying, and operating highly available workloads on AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, IAM, etc.), and comfort working in Azure as well * Hands\-on infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation/CDK, or ARM/Bicep) * Comfort with modern CI/CD (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or Azure DevOps) and monitoring/alerting tooling (Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar) * Solid scripting or coding ability (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar * Some exposure to cloud migration or re\-platforming projects * Experience with hybrid or multi\-cloud networking (VPNs, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, peering) * Container orchestration experience (Kubernetes or similar) * Security tooling experience (Snyk, OWASP, SonarQube, or similar) * A calm, methodical approach to troubleshooting complex systems under pressure **Nice to Have:** * Exposure to cloud migration or re\-platforming pojects * Experience with hybrid or multi\-cloud networking (VPNs, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, peering) * Container orchestration experience (Kubernetes or similar) * Security tooling experience (Snyk, OWASP, SonarQube, or similar) **Education or Certification**: * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience Less than 5% travel is expected. Wilson Language Training is an Equal Opportunity, Drug\-Free Employer Committed to Diversity in the Workplace. Wilson has identified the anticipated pay range for this role based on the many factors that we consider in defining compensation levels for our roles, including market data, and internal equity considerations. Actual pay, and allocation between base and any target discretionary bonus, will vary based on geographic location, education, work experience, skills, market data, and internal equity considerations. Wilson offers competitive benefits, including: * Medical, dental, vision, and Life \& Disability Insurance * 401k plan with partial employer match * Paid Time Off * Paid holidays * Tuition reimbursement * “O’Connor days,” which refers to a company\-wide office closure between Christmas and New Year’s Eve, as well as other perks. Anticipated Salary Range: $113,000 to $140,000

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer/AI Architect, Conversation Intelligence Systems
jobs.description: **Who we are** Xenoss is an AI engineering and integration services company, helping medium to large enterprises run AI transformation end\-to\-end, from situation analysis and goals framing to data discovery and preparation, pipeline building, model development, retraining pipeline design, solution deployment, and support. We build a broad spectrum of AI solutions such as user behaviour prediction, content generation, NLP, audience segmentation, pathfinding solutions, AI assistants, edge computer vision, fraud detection, and others. We work with prominent companies such as Microsoft, Toshiba, AstraZeneca, Activision Blizzard, Verve Group, Voodoo Games, and Telefonica, among others. We’re included in the top 100 software companies on the Inc. 5000 list. **What is the project** We’re hiring a Staff AI Engineer / AI Solution Architect to lead the AI architecture of a long\-term In\-Call Assistant initiative for a world\-leading financial services company. The project focuses on building a real\-time conversational AI system that supports front\-office employees during live customer conversations. The system identifies customer needs, objections, buying signals, and required process steps, and provides concise, context\-aware recommendations. The solution combines low\-latency signal detection, context preparation, specialist recommendation generation, RAG over approved product and policy knowledge, confidence management, and compliance guardrails. You will help define how the AI architecture, models, evaluation framework, and feedback loops are designed and evolved from the initial offline version to live production use **What will you do** You’ll lead the applied AI architecture across the In\-Call Assistant lifecycle, from data and taxonomy design to model training, evaluation, and production readiness. **Core work includes:** * Designing the end\-to\-end AI architecture for the In\-Call Assistant * Defining signal and trigger taxonomies for live conversations * Designing training strategies for signal detection and specialist recommendation models * Shaping data preparation, annotation, and SME validation workflows * Evaluating fine\-tuning, post\-training, RAG, and hybrid approaches * Designing low\-latency signal detection, routing, context preparation, and confidence management * Designing evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and model improvement cycles * Defining grounding, guardrails, abstention, and policy\-compliance behavior * Making trade\-offs between model quality, latency, cost, explainability, and governance * Partnering with AI engineers, data engineering, MLOps, and client SMEs **Technology landscape** You’ll operate across the modern applied AI and ML ecosystem, including: * LLM and smaller\-model training for conversational AI * SFT, DPO / preference optimization, LoRA / QLoRA, and PEFT * PyTorch and Hugging Face ecosystem * Signal extraction and multi\-label classification * RAG and knowledge\-grounded recommendation generation * Embeddings, retrieval, and context preparation * Low\-latency model serving and inference optimization * Golden dataset creation, annotation, and SME validation * Model evaluation, confidence calibration, and error analysis * MLOps, monitoring, feedback loops, and model governance **Scope of ownership and delivery context** At Staff/Architect level, you’ll own the applied AI architecture and evaluation strategy for a complex enterprise AI program. **Core ownership** * Define the AI approach for the conversation intelligence PoC * Establish the event / intent / insight taxonomy * Define the golden dataset strategy and annotation workflow * Establish evaluation frameworks and acceptance criteria * Drive trade\-offs between accuracy, explainability, latency, cost, and governance * Decide which modeling approaches are appropriate for each use case * Act as an escalation point for AI architecture, evaluation, and data strategy decisions **Team and delivery context** * Coordination and collaboration with the client team * Work within a cross\-functional team spanning AI engineering, data engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, and client stakeholders * Partner with domain SMEs on taxonomy, labeling, and validation * Mentor engineers working on extraction, evaluation, and data pipelines * Translate ambiguous business use cases into testable AI hypotheses and validation plans **What should you bring** **Must have** * Strong hands\-on experience with applied AI / ML systems in production\-oriented environments * Experience with NLP, conversational AI, or transcript\-based intelligence systems * Ability to design evaluation frameworks, not just run experiments * Experience building or validating structured datasets from unstructured text * Strong understanding of LLM\-based extraction, classification, RAG, and fine\-tuning trade\-offs * Practical knowledge of classical ML or predictive modeling * Understanding of probability\-based prediction, calibration, and outcome evaluation * Comfort working with messy enterprise data and incomplete labels * Ability to communicate with both technical teams and business stakeholders * Strong ownership of ambiguity, scope control, and PoC validation strategy **Nice to have** * Financial services domain exposure * Experience with sales, call center, or customer conversation analytics * Speech / ASR pipeline familiarity * Model governance and auditability experience * Experience with real\-time AI systems or low\-latency inference * Experience combining unstructured conversation signals with structured CRM, transaction, or customer profile data * Experience designing golden datasets and SME review workflows **Operating model** * Engagement structure: FTE\-equivalent via long\-term B2B contract * Work location: On\-site or closely aligned with the client team in New York * Infrastructure: Client environment only, no external training or data processing environments * Data residency: All work executed within the client perimeter * Delivery mode: PoC\-first, with a path toward production\-grade conversation intelligence and prediction systems Pay: From $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** We’re one of the world’s leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000\. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 10,000 people and serve over 120 million customers in 26 languages. We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of growth opportunities, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward\-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our global worldwide. Our focus on In\-Play betting has solidified our market\-leading position, featuring more than 1\.38 million In\-Play sporting events a year. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe (750,000\), we handle over 6 million HTTP requests daily and process more than 1\.5 million bets per hour at peak. **Job Description** We are seeking a highly pragmatic, results\-driven Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to join our newly established US Data team. In this role, you will build the reliable, automated infrastructure that powers our machine learning lifecycle. Your primary mission is to operationalize and scale the models developed by our data science team, taking them from prototype to robust, production\-grade systems with high velocity. You’ll focus on building reliable, automated and maintainable systems, keeping solutions pragmatic rather than over\-engineered. You will also be passionate about automation, software engineering excellence, and MLOps. You will report to the Data Science Team Leader and work in close alignment with the US AgentOps Team Lead (responsible for agentic and model orchestration platforms) and our UK technical excellence center. You will act as the bridge between model development and reliable platform engineering. The listed salary for this position is $120,000 – $140,000 annually. **Qualifications** * Proven experience as an ML Engineer, Data Engineer, or Software Engineer with a clear focus on deploying, monitoring, and scaling machine learning systems in production. * A pragmatic, proactive approach to system design, prioritizing speed, reliability, and business value over complex, theoretical infrastructure. * Strong Python programming skills, with a solid grasp of software engineering patterns, API development, and automated testing frameworks. * Extensive hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Practical experience with Vertex AI (specifically Vertex AI Pipelines, Endpoints, and Workbench). * Proficiency with containerization (Docker) and container orchestration tools. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate software engineering concepts for data scientists and operational requirements for product leads. * Experience utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform. * Experience running containerized workloads on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). * Familiarity with real\-time streaming tools like Apache Kafka or GCP Pub/Sub. **Additional Information** * Owning the deployment of machine learning models to production. Build and maintain scalable, low\-latency prediction endpoints using GCP Vertex AI. * Designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD/CT (Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, Continuous Training) pipelines for machine learning workflows using Vertex AI Pipelines, Cloud Build, and related GCP tools. * Setting up automated monitoring and alerting frameworks (e.g., Vertex AI Model Monitoring) to track data drift, model drift, and system performance in real\-time. * Championing best practices for software engineering within the Data Science team, including robust unit testing, containerization, version control, and CI/CD automation. * Working closely with the Data Science Team Leader, Junior Data Scientists, and the AgentOps Team Lead to accelerate deployment cycles, remove operational bottlenecks, and maintain high deployment velocity. bet365 provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Applied AI Lead
jobs.description: About BOI BOI is an AI Transformation Studio that helps ambitious companies redesign their growth engines for the autonomous age. We bring together unusually strong people in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. AI is rapidly reshaping how companies grow: how they innovate, acquire customers, personalize experiences, and scale commercial performance. Yet most organizations struggle to move beyond pilots and point solutions toward AI\-enabled growth systems that actually work at enterprise scale. About The Role As an Applied AI Lead, you will lead the day\-to\-day delivery of complex AI engagements, working across strategy, product, technology, and transformation to turn ambitious ideas into solutions that create real business value. Working closely with our Directors and Managing Director of Applied AI, you'll help clients identify where AI can make a meaningful difference, shape what to build, and work with cross\-functional teams to get it into the hands of real users. You'll move between business cases and roadmaps, product discovery and prototyping, delivery and adoption depending on what the problem requires. Applied AI is your major, but you're a generalist at heart. You can zoom out to understand the broader business and transformation challenge, then zoom in to help turn an opportunity into something tangible. You understand the distance between a compelling AI demo and a solution that works in the real world. You'll also bring credibility through practice. You use AI every day and have built your own workflows, tools, automations, or prototypes. We believe the best people to help companies apply AI are those who live it themselves. As you grow in the role, you'll take increasing ownership of client relationships, proposals, and commercial opportunities, with coaching and support from Directors. What You Will DoConnect Applied AI to Broader Transformation* Connect what you're building to the bigger picture: the business case, roadmap, capabilities, operating changes, and adoption required to create lasting value. * Help clients understand what needs to change around the technology for AI solutions to succeed at scale. * Translate lessons from individual products and use cases into broader implications for how the organization operates. * Know when the answer isn't another AI product, and bring broader strategy and transformation thinking when that's what the problem requires. Turn AI Opportunities Into Working Solutions* Translate business priorities and user problems into AI opportunities worth pursuing. * Lead product discovery with client teams and end users to understand workflows, define problems, and determine where AI can create meaningful value. * Shape AI products and solutions from early concept through prototype, build, deployment, and adoption. * Define what to build first, what success looks like, and what to cut, keeping teams focused on the optimal path to value. * Lead AI engineers, designers, and client teams to translate between business needs, user needs, and technical feasibility. * Prototype and test ideas using modern AI tools, agents, workflows, and automations. * Keep the work grounded in real users and measurable outcomes, not technology for technology's sake. Lead Complex Client Delivery* Own the day\-to\-day delivery of complex AI engagements, maintaining a high bar across multiple workstreams. * Structure work, set priorities, and keep cross\-functional teams moving. * Navigate ambiguity with confidence, proactively solving problems and making pragmatic decisions without waiting for direction. * Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders by leading workshops, challenging assumptions, and bringing structure to complex problems. * Stay hands\-on in the work while keeping sight of the broader objective and what the client needs to do next. Requirements* 4\+ years of experience in consulting, agency, venture building, or product. * Experience taking AI products, solutions, or use cases from problem definition through prototype, build, deployment, or adoption. * Demonstrated hands\-on use of modern AI tools in your own work. You've built workflows, automations, copilots, agents, or other practical AI solutions\- not just advised clients on them. * Experience leading significant workstreams or owning delivery for strategy or transformation engagements. * Experience with the broader transformation required to make AI stick — whether through business cases, roadmaps, operating models, capability building, adoption, or change. * Experience contributing to proposal development, engagement scoping, or growing existing client accounts. * Strong ability to translate between business ambition and technical feasibility Comfort operating in complex stakeholder environments with senior leaders * What We Screen For We are deliberately not\-for\-everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities: * Low ego\- You're confident, but grounded. You own mistakes, invite critique, share credit, and make the team better. * High aptitude\- You learn fast. You think clearly. You simplify complexity. You don't just execute\- you understand. You've worked on complex strategy or transformation engagements and know the difference between what looks good in a deck and what actually works in practice. * High ownership\- You don't wait to be told. You move things forward, take responsibility beyond your role, and stay resourceful in ambiguity. * Driven \- You focus on outcomes, not activity. * Commercial sharpness \- You recognize the problems worth solving, understand what creates value for clients, and spot opportunities to turn great work into broader relationships. * Passionate about AI \- You use AI daily. You experiment, build, and stay close to what's changing. You've built your own workflows, tools, automations, agents, or prototypes \- you don't work with AI from the sidelines. Benefits Salary: Up to $170,000 base, plus performance bonus. We also offer comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, hybrid working, professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high\-impact enterprise transformations.

jobs.title: Lead Palantir Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family Group:** IT\&S Group **Job Description:** We are seeking a highly skilled Palantir Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to collaborate with bpx engineering and operational teams to develop high\-quality digital solutions. This role is pivotal in creating a highly automated advanced digital enterprise across our oil and gas operations. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Palantir to drive business outcomes and strong foundational knowledge of data principles, connectivity with other platforms, operational workflows, application of AI, and a passion for adopting emerging technologies. A willingness to learn new tools and troubleshoot complex issues quickly is essential. jobs.description: **\*\*\*** **This person needs to be based on the West Coast \*\*\*** **About Nscale** ---------------- Nscale is the global hyperscaler engineered for AI infrastructure.
